title: LP Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The LP Analyst Intern will support the daily, monthly, and quarterly reconciliation of limited partner (LP) capital activity, including capital calls, distributions, and capital account statements, working closely with the Reconciliation team to help ensure timely and accurate reporting for fund investors.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in comparing LP capital account data from external fund administrators and general partners against internal records to identify discrepancies.
  • Support daily and monthly reconciliation of capital calls, distributions, and capital account balances.
  • Investigate identified issues within the reconciliation system, seeking support from mentors and department experts as needed.
  • Help build and maintain relationships with data providers, fund administrators, and internal stakeholders.
  • Validate LP-related data against available third-party and fund administrator sources.
  • Record and report the status of daily and monthly reconciliation delivery.
  • Develop familiarity with internal tools and processes used for LP/fund reconciliation.
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external parties to submit inquiries and provide timely status updates on relevant issues.

What You Will Learn

  • Learns to use professional concepts and available resources within the Reconciliation department to problem-solve LP and fund-related discrepancies.
  • Completes all initial new hire certification requirements and works on intermediate-level curriculum.

Technical Competency

  • General Technical Skills: Developing skills in Excel and internal reconciliation tooling and report navigation.
  • Accounting: Basic understanding of investment accounting, capital account statements, and fund-level accounting concepts. Basis agnostic.
  • Finance: Basic understanding of capital calls, distributions, fund performance metrics, and related financial concepts.
  • Asset Classes: Basic knowledge of alternative investment structures, including private equity, venture, and other limited partnership vehicles — what they are and how they are reconciled.
  • Market: Beginning to understand and apply Clearwater's core value proposition (aggregate, reconcile, report) as applied to LP and fund data.

Functional Competency

  • Developing acquired skills, procedures, and decision-making best practices to complete a variety of LP reconciliation issues, with guidance from mentors.
  • Tooling Skills: Beginner to intermediate skills in standard reconciliation tools; familiar with routine tasks but may require assistance with more complex actions.
  • Efficiency: Consistently completes assigned work. When errors occur, proactively learns from them and works to avoid repeat mistakes.
  • Metrics: Manages workflow based on productivity and quality metrics as outlined by the business.

Intangibles

  • Learning how to organize work and showing resilience in a challenging environment.
  • Internal Communication: Applies Level 1 servicing (quick, accurate, thorough responses) with the aid of mentors. Sphere of influence mainly self.
  • External Communication: Beginning to understand and apply Level 1 servicing with the aid of mentors, typically with low- to mid-level external stakeholders such as fund administrators and data providers.

Leadership

  • Oversight: Operates with some level of assistance from team members. Independently answers low-medium complexity queries; may require assistance with medium/high complexity.
  • Continuous Service Improvement: Primary focus is learning. Applies company policies and procedures to resolve issues and navigates knowledge base and documentation.

Requirements

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong accounting and/or finance skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and math skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Excel.
  • Working towards a bachelor's or master's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.
  • Desired full-time employment at Clearwater.

title: Director, Quality Engineering
description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

A Brief Overview
The EQA Practice Leader will represent the Enterprise Quality Assurance (EQA) organization in the APAC region, reporting directly to the EQA Leader. The EQA Practice Leader is a technical hands-on leader responsible for overseeing the implementation and execution of quality engineering practices across agile product teams for multiple domains under an SVP. This leader will be an expert in implementing standard test strategies, managing QA professionals embedded in each domain product team, and providing mentorship and coaching to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery. Creates "big picture" QA architectural roadmap for automation design and implementation to guide development and test teams. As a key bridge between the EQA and delivery organization leadership and Technical Product owners, this role ensures alignment of testing efforts with enterprise quality objectives and product goals. Will require effective leadership, influencing, negotiation, collaboration, coaching and conflict management skills

What you will do

  • Strategic Quality Planning: Contribute and execute on the long-term quality vision, aligning with company goals, and establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure quality performance.
  • Team Leadership: Leading and managing a team of quality engineers, assigning tasks, providing mentorship, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Process Improvement: Identifying opportunities for process optimization, analyzing data to identify root causes of quality issues, and implementing corrective actions to mitigate risks, improve product quality and QA productivity via automation and AI.
  • Quality Engineering: Writing, reviewing and approving quality plans, inspection procedures, test automation, data management testing and testing protocols to ensure products consistently meet specifications.
  • Compliance Management: Ensuring adherence to all relevant organization regulations, standards, and policies with the team.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Development, Information Management, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering Enablement and Operations, to ensure quality is embedded in all phases of software development.
  • Define and enforce standardized test strategies tailored to Agile delivery models and product roadmaps.
  • Ensure that QA metrics are defined, tracked, and reported to measure the effectiveness of the QA processes.
  • Spreadhead reduction of automation debt across teams and promoting in-sprint automation mindset.
  • Ensure defect management and triaging practices are consistent across teams under the delivery center. Ensure that all software products meet or exceed customer expectations in terms of quality and reliability.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) or Technology or equivalent experience .
  • 15+ Years Leading Quality Assurance functions including experience with the software development lifecycle, client consulting, software implementation with at least 7 years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience attracting, leading, and developing staff in a geographically dispersed environment.
  • Proven track record of managing and leading large, distributed QA teams.
  • Extensive experience with QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Experience in test efforts for cloud (AWS/Azure), containerized (Docker), and distributed environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and agile methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-centric mindset. Creative with ability to "think outside the box" for long-term solution.
  • Expert in Quality Engineering, test automation frameworks, and CI/CD integration using Jenkins, GitHub Actions etc.
  • Hands-on knowledge of functional and non-functional testing tools and practices.
  • Proven ability to lead distributed teams and influence senior stakeholders. Excellent communication, collaboration, and change management skills.
  • Utilized Generative AI (GitHub Copilot, AppliTool) towards QA use cases.
  • Test Management: Examples – Qtest, Browserstack, and others.
  • Automation: Examples – Playwright/Typescript, Postman, REST Assured, Ready API, Python.
  • CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Microsoft Teams, ADO.
  • Reporting: Examples - Allure, Power BI, custom dashboards.
  • Experience with ETL and Data Management testing and automation preferred.
  • Data: Databricks, Informatica or other tools preferred.

#LI-KW1

What you can expect from RGA:

  • Gain valuable knowledge from and experience with diverse, caring colleagues around the world.

  • Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

  • Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

title: Co-op or Intern, Business Analysis & Quality Assurance (January 2027)

· Exposure to test automation using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or similar.

· Exposure to APIs, SQL, Git, cloud platforms, or CI/CD.

· Experience using AI tools for coding, analysis, documentation, test generation, or automation.

title: International Trainee - Strategy & Business advisor
description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Om rollen

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

  • Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
  • Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee –Strategy & Business advisor

Business Area (BA) Generation is responsible for Vattenfall’s nuclear and hydropower operations. Our mission is to maximize business opportunities while contributing to a reliable, efficient, and environmentally sustainable energy system.

Our staff function Fleet Development within BA Generation, is responsible for strategic planning, optimization of our generation assets, business unit support and follow-up, and business development activities.

This includes conducting analyses, developing strategies, driving strategic processes, and pursuing business and development opportunities. We also monitor the progress of BA Generation’s objectives, track external developments, and perform benchmarking activities.

Your responsibilities:

  • Take part in analyses and strategy development to support future business decisions and goals, helping translate technical, operational and business insights into recommendations
  • Take part in business oversight activities, supporting our business units in their efforts to improve performance and deliver long-term value.

Kravspecifikation

As a Trainee - Strategy & Business advisor you recognize yourself in the following:

  • Master of Sience in Engineering or Business and Economics
  • You have a strategic and analytical mindset, being able to take in and analyze complex and sometimes contradictory information.
  • You are a strong team player who works effectively across teams and stakeholder groups, building trust and creating alignment to achieve shared objectives.
  • You are action oriented and enjoying taking on and deliver on new opportunities and challenges.
  • You are fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, German is a merit

Whether you aspire to a climate smarter career as an energy specialist, visionary manager, or inspirational project lead, we offer these opportunities within our Trainee Programme.

As Cato, our International Trainee in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

  • Be a recent graduate with an academic degree or expected graduation before March 2027.
  • Have maximum one year of work experience.
  • Be fluent in Swedish and English. Skills in other languages can be a merit.
  • Be willing to relocate for possible assignments throughout the organization.
  • Identify with our principles: active, open, positive and safety.

Location:

You will be working in the department Performance Optimization within Staff Function Fleet Development and located in Solna, Sweden.

Ytterligare information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations. Each position comes with a competitive salary and excellent remuneration package. Read more about the elements of the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme here.

Application process

We welcome your application in English via the application button on this page. Please include an updated resume. When applying, you will fill out screening questions, including your motivation. No cover letter or motivation letter is needed. The deadline to apply is October 18th, 2026. Selection will start after the application period with online tests, followed by interviews between the end of October to end November. We kindly ask you to use the same email address during the whole process (application and online test) otherwise there is a risk that your application is excluded due to system reasons. .

title: Assistente de Logística - PCD
description:
Vaga Afirmativa para PCDs

Posição: Assistente de Logística

Tipo de trabalho: Contrato CLT – 100% Presencial

Localização: Itapoá - SC

Temos uma visão maior que o oceano: integrar a logística de contêineres, conectando e simplificando a cadeia de suprimentos de nossos clientes. E nós contamos com as nossas pessoas para que isso aconteça!

O que oferecemos?

Estamos em uma jornada revolucionária para simplificar o comércio global, que nos dará a chance de oferecermos um grande impacto na economia mundial, e em sua carreira. Com responsabilidade pessoal significativa, você vai aprimorar o seu conhecimento da indústria e construir comunicação e habilidades comerciais altamente valorizadas em papéis voltados para o cliente – muito possivelmente em um ritmo que vai surpreendê-lo.

Energizante e pioneiro, este também é um ambiente que mantém você motivado. Você vai se juntar a uma equipe genuinamente diversificada e talentosa que é apaixonada por estar focada em tecnologia, nos clientes, e nos colegas.

E graças à nossa escala global, você estará bem-posicionado para explorar oportunidades na Maersk ao redor do mundo. Os muitos outros destaques incluem as mais modernas iniciativas de desenvolvimento de talentos e benefícios competitivos.

Nossa oportunidade:

Estamos buscando nosso novo Assistente de Logística, que será responsável pela execução dos serviços de transporte de coleta e entrega, controle de insumos da frota, contribuindo para os níveis de excelência operacional e resultados da área.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Recepcionar, organizar, conferir e controlar toda a documentação que envolve os serviços de transporte coleta e entrega (conhecimento de transporte, nota fiscal, comprovantes, canhotos, ordem de serviços), mantendo as planilhas de controles e sistemas atualizados.
  • Apoiar os processos de roteirização de entregas e coletas, através de relatórios especificos, visando obter as melhores opções e o cumprimento do agendamento.
  • Efetuar controles e atualizações em sistemas TMS KMM, SIL (Opentech), E-Cargo entre outros, visando a execução das rotinas incluindo outras áreas da empresa.
  • Controlar a documentação necessária de comunicação do acidente de trabalho, bem como seu trâmite e prazos, repassando as informações aos colaboradores e setores envolvidos. Controlar dados estatísticos e preencher relatórios solicitados.
  • Monitorar as operações diárias, com base em sistemas de rastreamento e através de aparelhos de comunicação, com o objetivo de garantir o recebimento do frete.
  • Efetuar os controles fisicos e sistemicos de peças e insumos no TMS KMM, objetivando a acuracidade do inventário e controle de custos da frota.

Quem estamos procurando:

Se você tem os requisitos abaixo, essa é sua chance de entrar para esse time de alto desempenho e fazer parte desse grande momento na nossa organização!

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Conhecimento em transporte rodoviário e desejável familiaridade com cabotagem e outros modais logísticos
  • Desejavel conhecimento em processos de gerenciamento de risco, sistemas de monitoramento e rastreamento
  • Conhecimento intermediário de pacote office, com foco em Excel
  • Habilidade e vivência no manuseio de sistemas TMS
  • Perfil proativo, organizado, orientado para resultados e com boa comunicação interpessoal

Na Maersk nós valorizamos a diversidade dos nossos talentos e sempre nos esforçaremos para recrutar a melhor pessoa para o trabalho. Valorizamos a diversidade em todos os suas formas, incluindo – mas não se limitando a – gênero, idade, nacionalidade, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência ou crenças religiosas. Estamos orgulhosos de nossa diversidade e em vê-la como uma verdadeira fonte de força para a construção de equipes de alto desempenho.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Store Planning Intern, Spring 2027
description:
Job Posting Title:

Store Planning Intern, Spring 2027

Req ID:

Job Description:

About the Role & Program

Disney Consumer Products (DCP) brings the magic of Disney’s beloved stories, franchises, and characters to families and fans around the world. From toys to apparel, books to games, our global marketing organization profoundly impacts The Walt Disney Company and the international markets in which we operate. With a portfolio of world-class franchises including Disney, Pixar, Marvel, 20th Century Fox, National Geographic, and Star Wars, we are a worldwide industry and category leader delivering innovative products that entertain and inspire!

Are you curious, quick to learn, and eager to take initiative? As a Store Planning Intern at the Disneyland Resort, you’ll bridge the gap between the onstage Operations teams and the Merchandise teams and gain a deep understanding of how we create unforgettable moments through products. Together, we devise strategies and manage product flow, ensuring that each location tells a unique story. Our goal is to help Guests recreate their experiences at home with the merchandise they purchase.

This internship is a full-time, in person, six-month commitment in the Anaheim, CA area from January 11th, 2027, to June 4th, 2027.

What You Will Do

You will build leadership skills and gain valuable experience in communication & critical thinking. You will collaborate on the short-term and long-term strategic direction for the Disneyland Resort merchandise shops under your responsibility. Strategies are defined using guest data, product strategies, operational feedback, and financial data.

On any given day, you might:

  • Analyze and interpret business reports, assess key performance indicators while looking at current trends, and think critically about how to improve sales and guest experiences
  • Provide strategic feedback to Merchandise Strategy & Merchandise Planning teams to help shape product offerings and strategies
  • Communicate and create positive relationships with Operations teams for the implementation of merchandise strategies
  • Collaborate with Product Strategy and Visual Presentation to adapt merchandise offerings for quarterly updates and seasonal events, ensuring they align with guest expectations
  • Review upcoming product strategies, select items for each merchandise shop, and create floor plans & product flow calendars in collaboration with Visual Presentation

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Genuine passion for retail and merchandise, with a desire to grow in the industry
  • Knowledge and/or experience in merchandise planning, merchandise financials, forecasting, and trend analysis
  • Advanced Excel skills with an eagerness to continue building proficiency with elements like pivot tables
  • Highly skilled in creating and presenting PowerPoint decks
  • Excellent relationship, partnership, coaching, and leadership abilities
  • Proven experience setting priorities and meeting established timelines

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior retail experience
  • Knowledge of retail math

Education

  • Senior year preferred
  • Major or previous coursework in Business, Finance, Retail/Merchandise, Math, or a closely related field

Eligibility Requirements & Program Information

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all the requirements below:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree, taking at least one class at the time of application posting, OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship​
  • Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney Internship or Disney College Program
  • Be at least 18 years of age​
  • Possess unrestricted work authorization​

Additional Information

  • Be compliant with The Disney Look appearance guidelines while at work
  • The dates of this internship are January 11th, 2027 – June 4th, 2027
  • Must have the ability to work full-time hours (approximately 40 per week) Monday - Friday, for the duration of the internship
  • Being able to provide one's own housing and reliable transportation to/from work is required

title: Practice Representative - Winchester, MA
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Job Summary: Serves as a primary point of contact for patients and visitors in an outpatient unit and provides excellent customer service through clear communication. Reports to the manager with input from assigned physicians, nurses and other health care providers.<br><br>

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:
  1. Communicates with and assists patients, other employees and the general public in a courteous, helpful manner by phone and in person. Provides accurate information, directions and/or guidance and follows up promptly to ensure that needs have been met.
  2. Takes complete and accurate information from patients/callers, prioritizing and facilitating communication of information to providers. Prepares schedules, medical records and other documents in accordance with quality standards. Maintains patient confidentiality at all times, whether by phone, discussion with providers or distribution of patient information by email, fax, etc.
  3. Performs check in, registration, and verification of demographic and fiscal information according to medical center policies and procedures and utilizing hospital computer systems. Confirms prior authorizations, referrals and pre-certifications for patient's insurance and managed care plan. Collects required co-payments according to standards. Directs patients to next service area.
  4. Monitors patients and visitors entering, waiting, and leaving the practice. Facilitates timely flow and proactively solves flow issues (i.e., early or late patient, late provider, etc.) Acts as liaison between patient and practice staff to ensure optimal flow and service delivery.
  5. Processes patient check out, schedules follow-up appointments and related diagnostic and/or lab tests making every reasonable effort to accommodate patient and provider needs. Provides patient with any relevant educational materials as indicated. Enters visit billing tickets.
Required Qualifications:
  1. High School diploma or GED required. Associate's degree preferred.
  2. 0-1 years related work experience required.
  3. Basic familiarity with computers. Ability to navigate at a basic level within web-based applications.
Preferred Qualifications:
  1. One year experience in a healthcare or service/hospitality environment.
Competencies:
  1. Written Communications: Ability to read, and write in English in order to understand basic safety instructions and take direction from supervisors; communicate effectively with patients, families and other medical center staff; and respond to basic questions.
  2. Oral Communications: Ability to understand spoken English in order to follow basic safety instructions and take direction from supervisors; communicate effectively in basic English with patients, families and medical center staff in response to routine questions.
  3. Knowledge: Ability to demonstrate basic knowledge of fundamental concepts, practices and procedures with the ability to use them in routine situations. Specialized knowledge not required.
  4. Team Work: Ability to interact respectfully with other employees, professional staff and/or external contacts to offer ideas, identify issues, obtain information or deliver services.
  5. Customer Service: Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature of the Job:
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally

Pay Range:

$20.50 - $27.59

Compensation may exceed the base hourly rate depending on shift differentials, call pay, premium pay, overtime pay, and other additional pay practices, as applicable to the position and in accordance with the law.

description:

Nogle af vores fordele:

Dokumenteret høj medarbejdertilfredshed og motivation

Løbende muligheder for læring og udvikling

Konkurrencedygtig løn og attraktiv pensions- og ferieordning

Fokus på sundhed, herunder sundhedsforsikring, sund og lækker mad og fitness på flere lokationer.

I denne rolle vil du sammen med resten af HS-teamet drive vores indsats inden for arbejdsmiljø og supportere en sikker drift af vores kraftværker i Ørsteds forretningsenhed Bioenergy. Stillingen er todelt – den indeholder primært back office-arbejde som HS-specialist med specialistopgaver, men også frontlinearbejde som HS-partner på tværs af Bioenergys kraftvarmeværker. Som HS-specialist vil du arbejde tværgående og i tæt samarbejde med de lokale HS-partnere, som supporterer kraftværkernes daglige drift med bl.a. dataanalyser, hændelsesundersøgelser, vurderinger af HSE-udbud, procedurer m.m.

**Velkommen til Bioenergy
**Du bliver del af HS-teamet, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger vil være med til at realisere vores strategi på både arbejdsmiljø- og sikkerhedsområdet. Teamet består af 15 engagerede kolleger med specialistviden inden for arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhed, og vi ser os selv som ”One Team” ift. sikkerhedsarbejdet. Vi samarbejder tæt med de underleverandører, der udfører langt størstedelen af de praktiske opgaver på værkerne. Som HS-specialist vil dit bidrag sikre et sikkert og godt arbejdsmiljø på kraftværkerne. I vores team støtter, hjælper og sparrer vi med hinanden samt deler viden – det betyder, at vi gør hinanden bedre, og dermed gør vi forretningen tilsvarende bedre samt mere sikker for alle. Vores tone er uformel.

I jobbet vil du:

  • rådgive kolleger og samarbejdspartnere i arbejdsmiljø og sikkerhedsrelevante emner herunder supportere udarbejdelsen af kemiske risikovurderinger
  • foretage hændelsesundersøgelser og analyse af mulige årsager og forbedringsområder
  • lede og supportere implementering af HS-relaterede projekter på tværs af kraftværkerne, herunder udvikle og implementere relevant HS-træning og vejledninger
  • sikre HS-læring og videndeling på tværs af lokationer og afdelinger
  • supportere linjefunktionerne med HS-krav i forbindelse med udbudsmateriale
  • arbejde med dataanalyse for at prioritere indsatsområder og vurdere risikobilledet, herunder udarbejde og støtte implementering af nye retningslinjer
  • udvikle og forbedre Ørsteds og leverandørers sikkerhedsperformance (i tæt samarbejde med HS-partnerne og vores kolleger i linjefunktionerne).

For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

  • er struktureret, proaktiv og har solid erfaring med HS-området (ISO 45001) og udvikling af en god sikkerhedskultur
  • har praktisk erfaring med at drive mindre projekter, kampagner og forandringsledelse
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig har samarbejdsevner til at indgå i et større team
  • har fokus på at sætte initiativer i gang, men samtidig sikre, at de fastsatte mål realiseres, og at opgaverne evalueres og afsluttes
  • er stærk til at kommunikere skriftligt og mundtligt på både dansk og engelsk.

Selvom din profil ikke matcher alle punkterne, har du måske andre kompetencer, der vil være relevante. Mener du, at du kan bidrage til teamet, så send os din ansøgning.

**Form fremtiden med os
**Send din ansøgning og CV til os så hurtigt som muligt.

Hvis du ønsker at anmode om justering af arbejdsmetoder eller arbejdsmønstre eller hjælp til rekrutteringsprocessen, så send en e-mail til accommodation@orsted.com.

Bemærk venligst, at din ansøgning kun bliver taget i betragtning, hvis den indsendes via vores online karriereside. Vi tager ikke ansøgninger eller forespørgsler fra eksterne rekrutteringsbureauer eller bureauer i betragtning til denne stilling.

Lønrammen:

For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau kr. 54.600,- - kr. 60.400,- for den annoncerede lokation. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af relevante kompetencer, erfaring og forventet opgavevaretagelse inden for det angivne løninterval for at sikre et fair og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Hvor det er relevant, kan du desuden være berettiget til variabel løn og en omfattende fordelspakke.

Vores fordelspakke:

I denne stilling får medarbejdere, der opfylder berettigelseskravene, adgang til: arbejdsgiverbetalt pension (11 % indbetaling), fuld forsikringsdækning (ulykke, liv, kritisk sygdom og sundhedsforsikring); fem ugers betalt ferie plus 10 ekstra betalte fridage pr. ferieår; 3 % feriepengetillæg; adgang til Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality, herunder holdtræning, fysioterapi, massage og trivselstilbud; en multimediepakke (mobiltelefon, pc, internet); medlemskab af personaleklub med sports- og kulturaktiviteter; samt adgang til virksomhedens kantine (månedlig frokostordning eller dagsbilletter).

Baggrundstjek før ansættelse:

Visse stillinger kræver et baggrundstjek som en del af ansættelsesprocessen. Hvis dette er aktuelt, vil du blive informeret herom i løbet af rekrutteringsforløbet. Baggrundstjek udføres af en ekstern udbyder i overensstemmelse med lokal lovgivning.

title: Sr. Product UI/Visual Designer - FO Applications
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product UI Visual Designer to take our product experiences from rough structure to polished, production-ready visual design. Our products are trading systems, trading idea research management systems, and risk management systems built for the Front Office at hedge funds and asset management firms - data dense, highly transactional tools used by traders, portfolio managers, and analysts every day. You'll work primarily from wireframe schematics and rough AI-generated prototypes - turning that early-stage thinking into interfaces that are visually refined, consistent, and true to the CWAN Design System. This role also has a standing responsibility beyond individual projects: partnering with the team that maintains the CWAN Design System to propose, define, and document new design standards as our product surface area grows.

You'll sit at the intersection of craft and consistency - someone who can make a screen look and feel right, and who also cares about codifying why it's right so the whole design system gets stronger over time.

What You'll Do : Visual design execution

  • Interpret wireframes, low-fidelity schematics, and rough AI-generated prototypes and translate them into high-fidelity, production-ready visual designs.

  • Apply and enforce our existing visual design standards - typography, color, spacing, iconography, elevation, and layout grids - across every screen you touch.

  • Make sound design judgment calls when a wireframe or AI prototype is ambiguous, incomplete, or visually inconsistent, resolving gaps without waiting for direction.

  • Prepare polished, developer-ready Figma files with clear specs, redlines, and component usage so engineering can build from your work with minimal back-and-forth.

  • Partner with product designers, product managers, and engineers to review work in progress and ensure visual quality holds up from concept through shipped feature.

Design system contribution

  • Work directly with the CWAN Design System team to identify gaps where current standards don't cover a new pattern, component, or use case.

  • Propose new or updated visual design standards (components, tokens, patterns, documentation) based on recurring needs you encounter in project work.

  • Contribute polished, system-ready component and pattern designs - not just one-off screen solutions, so new standards are reusable across the product.

  • Document rationale and usage guidance for new standards so other designers can apply them consistently without re-litigating the decision.

  • Give and incorporate feedback in design system reviews, and help audit existing product surfaces for drift from current standards.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product/UI visual design, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong visual craft (typography, layout, color, hierarchy) applied to real product interfaces.

  • Proven ability to take low-fidelity input - wireframes, sketches, or AI-generated concepts and elevate it into refined, standards-compliant visual design.

  • Deep fluency in Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, and design tokens/variables.

  • Working knowledge of design systems: how components, tokens, and documentation fit together, and how design decisions scale across a product.

  • Sharp eye for visual consistency and the judgment to know when a new pattern deserves a system-level standard versus a one-off exception.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills - comfortable presenting and defending design decisions to designers, PMs, and engineers.

  • Comfort designing for dense, data-heavy professional workflows where information hierarchy, precision, and speed of comprehension matter as much as visual polish.

  • Adept at using AI tools to streamline design work and make updates to designs — e.g., familiarity with Claude to make updates to Figma designs, evaluate and refine AI-generated prototypes, draft design system documentation, and speed up day-to-day production work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing financial services software - ideally trading systems, trading idea/research management systems, or risk management systems - for the Front Office at hedge funds or asset management firms.

  • Experience contributing directly to a formal design system or component library, in any capacity.

  • Front-end literacy (HTML/CSS fundamentals) sufficient to have informed conversations with engineers about implementation.

  • Experience with motion or interaction design for UI components.

  • Familiarity with Claude Design, and the ability to create and/or update Claude Code prototypes.

Tools & Ways of Working

Figma is our primary design tool, and the CWAN Design System is the shared source of truth for components, tokens, and patterns. AI tools — including Figma AI Design Agent, Figma Make, and Claude — are part of our everyday workflow, from making updates to Figma designs and evaluating rough AI-generated prototypes to speeding up documentation and production work, and proficiency with them is expected. Familiarity with Claude Design and Claude Code prototypes is a plus. You'll work closely with the CWAN Design System team on standards work, and with product designers and engineers on day-to-day screen work — often moving between the two in the same week.

What we offer:

  • Business casual atmosphere in a flexible working environment

  • Team-focused culture that promotes innovation and ownership

  • Access cutting-edge investment reporting technology and expertise

  • Defined and undefined career pathways, allowing you to grow your way

  • Competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits

  • Maternity and paternity leave

  • Personal Time Off and Volunteer Time Off to give back to the community

  • Work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year

  • Work from home Fridays

Why Join Us? This is an incredible opportunity to lead a passionate engineering team that is shaping the future of investment management technology. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, apply now!

Salary Range

$156,400.00 - $210,841.00

This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). The Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. For this role, benefits include: health/vision/dental insurance, 401(k), PTO, parental leave, and medical leave, STD/LTD insurance benefits. Under the direction of the Production Manager and with the support of management staff, the Process Owner is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the 3 shifts 24 hours operations under his responsibilities. description:
About Us:

At the forefront of medical discovery as it relates to understanding the causes of obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, cancer and dementia, Pennington Biomedical Research Center is a campus of Louisiana State University and conducts basic, clinical and population research. The Center includes Basic Science, Clinical Research, and Population and Public Health, enabling both focused research and translational science. Research at Pennington Biomedical is supported broadly by multiple NIH Research Centers, and includes approximately 65 faculty and 20 postdoctoral fellows who comprise a network of 44 laboratories and 13 highly specialized core service facilities. Pennington Biomedical is located within state-of-the-art research facilities on a 222-acre campus in Baton Rouge, Louisiana.

Job Posting Title:

Postdoctoral Researcher - Mitochondrial Energetics and Nutrient Utilization (MENU) Lab

Position Type:

Other Academic

Department:

LSUPBRC Clinic - MENU Lab (Jacob Mey (00053188))

Work Location:

LSU - Pennington Biomedical

Pay Grade:

Other Academic

Job Description:

Pennington Biomedical Research Center, a world-renowned academic research institute of Louisiana State University, is seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher in the Mitochondrial Energetics and Nutrient Utilization (MENU) Laboratory.

The Postdoctoral Researcher will conduct advanced, independent, and collaborative research focused on clinical dietetics, precision nutrition and underlying biological mechanisms underlying the relationships between diet and health. This position is responsible for designing and executing innovative research studies, analyzing and interpreting complex experimental data, with particular focus on multi-omics platforms and bioinformatics, and disseminating findings through peer-reviewed publications and scientific presentations. The Postdoctoral Researcher mentors students and research staff, collaborates with multidisciplinary investigators, and supports the laboratory's overall research mission while ensuring compliance with institutional, regulatory, and laboratory safety standards.

Major Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and conduct independent and collaborative research studies investigating the physiological mechanisms underlying diet-health and diet-disease relationships using advanced experimental approaches.

  • Analyze high dimensional datasets utilizing modern bioinformatics techniques, especially pertaining to metabolic and nutrient utilization pathways.

  • Plan, execute, troubleshoot, and optimize complex metabolic assessment techniques, including hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamps, oral glucose tolerance tests and mixed meal tolerance tests.

  • Design and implement research studies involving analyzing large-scale datasets on diet and health e.g. NHANES and other specialized databases necessary to achieve research objectives.

  • Plan, execute, troubleshoot, and optimize complex laboratory techniques, including mass spectrometry, molecular biology, protein analysis, histological and immunohistochemical methods, metabolic assays, and other specialized techniques necessary to achieve research objectives.

  • Collect, process, and analyze biological specimens, including blood, breath, tissue, and cultured cells, ensuring sample integrity and adherence to established laboratory, biosafety, and quality assurance procedures.

  • Analyze, interpret, and integrate complex experimental data using appropriate statistical methods and scientific software to generate meaningful conclusions and identify future research directions.

  • Prepare manuscripts, abstracts, scientific reports, and presentations for publication in peer-reviewed journals and presentation at local, national, and international scientific conferences.

  • Contribute to the development of grant proposals, fellowship applications, progress reports, and other sponsored research activities by generating preliminary data, drafting scientific content, and assisting with research planning.

  • Collaborate with principal investigators, faculty, clinicians, and multidisciplinary research teams to develop innovative research strategies, establish new methodologies, and advance the overall scientific goals of the laboratory and institution.

  • Mentor graduate students, research associates, technicians, and other trainees by providing scientific guidance, technical instruction, and oversight of laboratory activities while fostering a collaborative research environment.

  • Maintain accurate, comprehensive, and well-organized research records, ensuring compliance with institutional policies, funding agency requirements, laboratory safety regulations, and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), where applicable.

  • Assist with laboratory management activities, including maintenance and calibration of research equipment, inventory management, protocol development, regulatory documentation, and implementation of quality control procedures to support efficient laboratory operations.

  • Remain current with emerging scientific literature, technological advances, and best practices nutrition, metabolism, and related disciplines by participating in laboratory meetings, seminars, journal clubs, professional development activities, and scientific conferences.

  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • PhD in nutrition, physiology, or closely related biomedical discipline.

  • Two (2) years of experience conducting independent laboratory research in nutrition, metabolism, or related biomedical discipline, which can include internships, academic research, or work in a clinical or research lab setting.

  • Proficiency in a variety of molecular, cellular, biochemical, and physiological laboratory techniques, with the ability to develop, optimize, and troubleshoot experimental protocols.

  • Experience analyzing and interpreting complex scientific data using appropriate statistical methods and scientific software, with a focus on bioinformatics.

  • Record of scholarly achievement, including peer-reviewed publications and scientific presentations commensurate with career stage.

  • Knowledge of experimental design, research methodology, and scientific principles applicable to translational or basic biomedical research.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary research team.

  • Strong scientific writing, verbal communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to prepare manuscripts, reports, and grant-related materials.

  • Experience in mentoring or training students, research staff, or laboratory personnel is preferred.

  • Commitment to maintaining compliance with laboratory safety procedures, institutional policies, and applicable regulatory and funding agency requirements.

Preferred Experience

  • Clinical dietetics, human nutrition and metabolism, and bioinformatics related to plasma metabolomics and multi-omics platforms.

title: Senior Manager, AI Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary:

Role Overview

As part of Product & Engineering team within the Global Digital Network, the Senior Manager, AI Engineer will help advance Coca-Cola’s transformation into a digital-first, data-driven enterprise. We are seeking an AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI solutions across The Coca-Cola Company’s digital product portfolio. This is a hands-on engineering role at the frontier of applied AI, responsible for taking business requirements or user needs from prototype to production, developing domain-specific AI agents, and integrating cutting-edge GenAI and agentic frameworks into enterprise platforms.
​

The ideal candidate is a skilled, curious AI practitioner who writes high-quality code, thrives in fast-moving agile squads, and has deep hands-on experience building and deploying AI systems or products in cloud environments. You are as comfortable discussing model architecture with a data scientist as you are reviewing a CI/CD pipeline with a DevOps engineer, and you bring the engineering discipline to turn promising AI prototypes into reliable, production-ready products.

What You’ll Do for Us

  • Develop and deploy AI agents and GenAI solutions: prototype, iterate, and take to production domain-specific AI agents capable of information gathering, insight generation, and intelligent action. Design and implement AI agents using open interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) to securely connect agents with enterprise data, tools, and external systems while enabling coordinated multi-agent workflows across business domains

  • Write and optimize production-grade AI code: produce high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code in Python and other relevant languages. Optimize AI models and inference pipelines for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency at scale. Ensure all code adheres to The Coca-Cola Company’s engineering standards for quality, security, and observability

  • Deploy and operate AI solutions on cloud infrastructure: deploy, monitor, and optimize AI agents and models on Azure cloud infrastructure. Build and maintain MLOps pipelines covering model training, versioning, inference, and CI/CD. Ensure high availability, scalability, and end-to-end observability for AI products in production

  • Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms: collaborate with Application Engineering and Data Engineering squads to embed AI outputs into product workflows, APIs, and user-facing features; work cross-functionally to translate data science prototypes into robust, production-ready applications; and ensure seamless integration of AI components with existing enterprise data platforms and business systems

  • Implement AI observability and telemetry: implement runtime observability for AI agents and LLM applications, including tracing, reasoning paths, token consumption, latency, cost, output quality, and guardrail violations to ensure production reliability

  • Build agent evaluation frameworks: design agent evaluation pipelines, develop evaluation harnesses, benchmark datasets, regression tests, and automated quality scoring to continuously assess agent accuracy, safety, and business performance

  • Engineer enterprise AI context: design retrieval pipelines using enterprise semantic layers, knowledge graphs, vector search, and business ontologies to ground AI agents in trusted enterprise context and improve response quality

  • Implement AI safety and runtime controls: configure runtime AI controls including policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop workflows, autonomy thresholds, prompt injection defenses, and secure tool execution for enterprise AI agents

  • Design multi-agent systems: design and orchestrate multi-agent systems that coordinate planning, reasoning, tool execution, and human collaboration across complex enterprise workflows

  • Operate AI applications in production: manage prompt versioning, evaluation, experimentation, routing strategies, cost optimization, and the production lifecycle for LLM- and agent-powered applications using modern LLMOps and AgentOps practices

  • Support digital twin capabilities: develop AI capabilities that support enterprise digital twins by integrating operational, commercial, and enterprise data into intelligent simulations, predictions, and decision-support workflows

  • Collaborate effectively within agile engineering teams: work closely with Technical Leads, software engineers, data engineers, and fellow AI Engineers to design, build, test, and deliver AI capabilities. Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical design discussions, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving to ensure high-quality engineering outcomes

  • Maintain technical currency and drive continuous improvement: stay current with advances in AI, machine learning, and Generative AI and integrate relevant developments into existing and new solutions; conduct rigorous testing and validation to ensure reliability, accuracy, and explainability of AI agents and outputs; and contribute to internal knowledge sharing, code reviews, and engineering best practices

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

  • 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in AI or ML engineering with a demonstrated track record of taking AI models and solutions from development to production

  • Strong proficiency in Python with working knowledge of additional languages such as Java or C++

  • Experience building and deploying LLM-powered and agentic AI applications in production using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A), or similar

  • Experience deploying and operating AI and ML solutions on cloud infrastructure with Azure strongly preferred and AWS or GCP also acceptable

  • Experience with vector databases, embeddings, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, semantic search, or context engineering

  • Experience developing RESTful APIs or integrating AI capabilities into enterprise applications

  • Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, or AgentOps practices including model and prompt versioning, evaluation, experimentation, routing strategies, observability, cost optimization, and production lifecycle management

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals including API design, testing, version control, CI/CD, containerization using Docker and Kubernetes, and model deployment and monitoring for AI systems

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments including sprint execution, code review practices, and cross-squad collaboration

  • Experience implementing responsible AI practices including runtime guardrails, AI safety controls, model explainability, data privacy, and secure agent execution

  • Experience implementing AI observability and telemetry including tracing, reasoning diagnostics, token consumption monitoring, latency, cost, output quality, and runtime performance for production AI applications

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with Technical Leads and Product teams to translate business requirements into well-scoped AI solutions

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain AI products and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: Analyst,MDM
description:
At Maersk, we are a global leader in integrated logistics, pioneering the industry for over a century. Our commitment to innovation and transformation continuously redefines the boundaries of what’s possible—setting new benchmarks for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

We believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and strive to ensure our people reflect the customers we proudly serve. With a workforce of over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade.

Join us as we leverage cutting-edge technologies and create global opportunities. Let’s sail together towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.

Purpose of the role

This role is responsible for managing and maintaining master data for 70+ APM Terminals globally, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and compliance with defined standards. The individual will create, validate, and update master data records, perform quality checks, and resolve data inconsistencies or duplicates. The role involves handling requests from global stakeholders, supporting data governance initiatives, and maintaining high data quality. Candidates should be comfortable working with large datasets using Excel and basic SQL for analysis and reporting. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication are essential for success in this role.


You will be responsible for:

  • Validate, and update master data requests, ensuring adherence to data quality rules and country-specific exceptions.

  • Conduct periodic quality checks on master data to maintain accuracy and consistency.

  • Update vendor and customer master data in alignment with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and data guidelines.

  • Identify, analyze, and resolve duplicate records within the master data system.

  • Collaborate with Data Steward and Governance teams to support data quality initiatives and clean-up activities.

  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for master data processes.

  • Participate in discussions with Business Partners and Stakeholders, addressing ad-hoc requirements with urgency and professionalism.

  • Utilize SQL queries to extract and analyze data for quality checks and reporting purposes.

  • Create and maintain Power BI dashboards to monitor and report on data quality.

  • Support audit requirements and ensure compliance with master data guidelines.

  • Continuously improve data management processes by identifying areas for enhancement.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in Master Data Management (MDM) or a related field.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

  • Strong communication skills for effective stakeholder interaction.

  • Attention to detail with a proactive approach to resolving data issues.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work effectively.

Qualifications

  • Graduate of any bachelor's degree.

  • Fluent in English with good communication skills.

What We Offer:

  • Impact: Be part of a team that directly contributes to global operations.

  • Opportunity: Unlock professional and personal growth through diverse career pathways.

  • Innovation: Work with a team that embraces technology and continuous improvement.

  • Global Exposure: Collaborate across geographies and cultures.

  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible working arrangements to support your well-being

title: Technical Support Analyst II
description:

Job Description:

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

The Business Operations team helps guide and articulate technology strategy and research and is responsible for driving the day-to-day operation of the Product & Technology organization, including project and portfolio management and tracking; organization-level capital, space, and resource management and allocation; process management; technical incident management; and our administrative and workplace experience support team.

Job Summary:

As a key member of the Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology team, the Technical Analyst I plays a critical role in supporting global media production and distribution systems. This role serves as the first line of technical engagement, responsible for intake, triage, and resolution of incidents, issues, and service requests, while ensuring seamless collaboration with engineering teams. The selected candidate will be able to leverage problem solving skills to execute the right runbooks to maintain service availability.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Resolve standard issues and fulfill requests by following documented procedures
  • Serve as the initial technical point of contact for customer-reported issues, leveraging strong problem-solving skills to triage and resolve concerns efficiently
  • Work with and effectively communicate with Software, Infrastructure, and/or Network Engineers during incidents about necessary solutions to drive issues to resolution
  • Closely monitor active incidents, and support engagement of engineering teams to ensure timely resolution of complex technical challenges
  • Act as a technical liaison between customers, internal support teams, and product engineering to ensure alignment and transparency throughout the resolution process
  • Monitor service‑health and communication channels (Datadog, BigPanda, Teams, email) and raise issues promptly to major incident management or to support teams as necessary
  • Document incidents thoroughly in ServiceNow and Jira; maintain ticket hygiene and ensure all fields are correctly filled out
  • Participate in training programs to build and enhance technical acumen

The role performs operational protocols using runbooks for supported systems to ensure high service availability and minimal disruptions. An ideal applicant should possess a solid technical background in IT, software, or production support, with problem solving skills to aid in resolving issues.

This role demands swift incident detail gathering and analysis while providing troubleshooting support. Collaboration with engineering for specialized expertise is required. Active participation in incident management to ensure comprehensive documentation and lifecycle tracking for efficient issue resolution is vital. This role supports high service availability while minimizing disruptions across critical systems.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:

Incident Intake & Escalation

  • Serve as the main point of contact for handling incidents reported by stakeholders by capturing incident details through phone calls, chat, or monitoring.
  • Analyze incidents thoroughly to understand their scope and impact; work tickets, triage, and/or escalate as necessary.
  • Collaborate with technical support teams, engineering, and support teams to ensure incidents are resolved quickly.

Documentation, Incident Tracking and Reports, & Training

  • Operate within the ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, and PagerDuty environments and ensure that procedures around tracking and reporting issues are being followed.
  • Participate actively in incident management processes, documenting and tracking incidents throughout their lifecycle.
  • Document solutions, best practices, and troubleshooting procedures to contribute to the knowledge base.

Monitoring

  • Monitor various service-health platforms and stakeholder communication platforms like Teams, Datadog, BigPanda, email, etc.
  • Proactively identify and address potential issues or performance bottlenecks.

Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:

Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in a 24x7 IT call center or helpdesk role
  • Knowledge of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, PagerDuty, and JIRA
  • Hands-on experience fulfilling user service requests and leveraging problem solving skills to troubleshoot front-line technical issues
  • Ability to work well under pressure and manage priorities with urgent deliverables
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective stakeholder, peer interaction, and collaboration with other teams


Preferred Qualifications

  • ITIL v3 or ITIL v4 Foundation Certification
  • Experience with observability tools such as Datadog, BigPanda, Conviva, Grafana, Splunk
  • Familiarity with streaming media workflows, broadcast systems, and IT infrastructure
  • Familiarity with Major Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management

Preferred Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field

title: Motion Picture Media Finance - Assistant

Creative Artists Agency (CAA) is the leading entertainment and sports agency, with global expertise in filmed and live entertainment, digital media, publishing, sponsorship sales and endorsements, media finance, consumer investing, fashion, trademark licensing, and philanthropy. Distinguished by its culture of collaboration and exceptional client service, CAA’s diverse workforce identifies, innovates, and amplifies opportunities for the people and organizations that shape culture and inspire the world. The trailblazer of the agency business, CAA was the first to build a sports business, create an investment bank, launch a venture fund, found technology start-up companies, establish a philanthropic arm, build a business in China, and form a brand marketing services division, among other innovations. Named Most Valuable Sports Agency by Forbes for eight consecutive years, CAA represents more than 2,000 of the world’s top athletes in football, baseball, basketball, hockey, soccer, in addition to coaches, on-air broadcasters, and sports personalities and works in the areas of broadcast rights, corporate marketing initiatives, social impact, and sports properties for sales and sponsorship opportunities. Founded in 1975, CAA is headquartered in Los Angeles, and has offices in New York, Nashville, Memphis, Chicago, Miami, London, Munich, Geneva, Stockholm, Shanghai, and Beijing, among other locations globally.

Job Description

The Role

We are looking for an Assistant to support an agent in our Media Finance Group in Los Angeles. This particular assistant will work across the packaging, financing, and sales of independent films, documentaries, and docuseries. This business involves working closely with filmmakers, producers, financiers, distributors, and buyers throughout every stage of a project, from development and packaging through festival strategy, sales, and distribution. The office’s primary responsibility is to help package, finance, and sell films outside of the studio system, and is heavily involved in film sales across all the major festivals such as Cannes, Sundance and Toronto. The ideal candidate will have a passion for film and curiosity for how films are developed, financed, and sold. Additionally, the Assistant is administratively capable of handling a high volume of tasks, across multiple time-zones, with the ability to clearly communicate with the agent, clients, and peers. This is a great desk to learn the independent film business from both the creative and commercial sides, while gaining exposure to filmmakers, production companies, buyers, financiers, and distributors.

Responsibilities

  • Manage administrative duties including handling heavy phones and emails, client calendar management, booking reports, preparing expense reports, updating contracts, scheduling travel and general office management tasks
  • Serve as the first point of contact with clients, Agents and Network/Studio Executives
  • Track clients, potential clients projects and financiers
  • Assist with special projects, research, flagging trades, news and compiling information as needed
  • Stay up to date on current events within the entertainment landscape, especially as it relates to Motion Pictures and Television

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10 months of professional administrative or equivalent experience
  • Ability to work well in fast-paced environments; meet tight deadlines; lead multiple projects and expectations; maintain a sharp focus while handling competing priorities; ability to work well under pressure
  • Attention to detail, strong organization and problem-solving skills are a must
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, while understanding the importance of maintaining confidentiality
  • Strong command of the Microsoft Office suite, especially Word, Excel and Teams
  • Ability to anticipate needs and execute time-sensitive matters
  • Team oriented and able to communicate and collaborate with employees at all levels
  • Adept at quickly learning new processes, technology, and ability to assimilate oneself and become familiar with existing systems

Education

  • BA/BS from an accredited University or College preferred

Location

On-Site in Los Angeles, CA, United States

The base hourly rate for this position is in the range of $20.00-22.00. This position also is eligible for benefits and discretionary bonus. Ultimately, wages may vary based upon, but not limited to, relevant experience, time in role, business sector, and geographic location, among other criteria.
