title: Medical Laboratory Technologist, Cytogenetics
description:
Are you fascinated by the world of genetics and genomics, and their impact on patient care? As a Medical Laboratory Technologist, Cytogenetics at Mount Sinai Hospital, you will join a world-class team at the forefront of genetic diagnostics. Here, you will utilize cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with experts across various disciplines, and play a vital role in providing results used for the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of genetic conditions.
Is this you?You are a highly motivated and detail-oriented Genetics MLT with a keen interest in the ever-evolving field of genetics. You thrive in a collaborative environment where scientific discussions are encouraged, and you are eager to learn from experts in genetics. The diverse range of tests and technologies employed in this lab ensures there's always something new to learn and opportunities to expand your skillset.
You’re eager to delve into advanced areas of genetic testing; this lab does a lot of work focused on constitutional and cancer genetics. You’re energized by the challenge of troubleshooting complex cases, developing and validating new testing methods, and staying ahead of the curve in genetic technology. You find it deeply rewarding to help patients and their families through your interpretation of results and data, recognizing that the work you do saves thousands of lives every year.
You embrace innovation. The opportunity to work with the most advanced sequencing instruments (e.g. NovaSeq X Plus) and analysis software (e.g. DRAGEN NGS pipeline) appeals to you. This lab is pioneering ground-breaking techniques like low-pass whole genome sequencing for prenatal CNV detection. It's an exhilarating time to be working in genetics, and you're eager to contribute your expertise to a team dedicated to continuous learning and professional growth.
About the Diagnostic Medical Genetics teamThe Diagnostic Medical Genetics Laboratory at Mount Sinai Hospital is a hub for cutting-edge diagnostic testing and innovative method and test development. We are dedicated to improving patient care through a deeper understanding of genetics. Equipped with advanced technologies, the lab offers a wide range of genetic and genomic testing, supporting diverse clinical needs across various specialties. A collaborative spirit thrives within the lab, bringing together a team of skilled professionals, including geneticists, genetic counselors, variant analysts, bioinformaticians, medical laboratory technologists and technicians. This team is united by a shared passion for unraveling the complexities of genetic disorders, pioneering new diagnostic and therapeutic approaches, and ultimately, making a tangible difference in the lives of patients and their families.
In this role you will:

Perform Molecular and Cytogenetics procedures as outlined in the laboratory standard operating procedures to aid in diagnosis and management of patients.
Rotate through the laboratory testing benches, becoming thoroughly familiar with theory and performance of all procedures and techniques relating to each bench area
Identify and accurately report cytogenetic findings using the International System for Human Cytogenetic Nomenclature
Ensure the accuracy, legibility and completeness of results submitted for reporting where applicable
Perform all quality control procedures and basic troubleshooting whenever results are beyond expected or allowable limits according to established protocol
Accession and process specimens in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
Prioritize work and respond to urgent or unpredicted demand for specimen processing or testing
Prepare reagents, buffers, calibrators, quality control and other materials as required. Assist in inventory control of reagents and supplies
Perform test/procedures related to method evaluation, test optimization and validation
Observe and follow the processes, policies and procedures of the quality management system of corresponding discipline(s)
Assist in orientating and demonstrating procedures or technology to new staff or students as requested
Perform the following techniques as applicable to the testing being performed and interpret results with an understanding of the disease being analyzed:

Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Sanger Sequencing, including library preparation and analyses
DNA extraction from fresh or frozen blood, fresh, frozen or paraffin-embedded tissue
RNA extraction from fresh or frozen blood, fresh or frozen tissue
Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)
Quantitative fluorescent polymerase chain reaction (QF-PCR) techniques and analysis
Gel electrophoresis and analysis
Microsatellite Instability Testing (MSI) techniques and analysis
Multiplex Ligation-dependent Probe Amplification (MLPA) techniques and analysis
Microarray techniques and analysis
Special stains, FISH and other procedures as required

Microscopic (bright field & fluorescent) analysis of chromosome preparations

G-Banding, digital imaging and computer automated karyotyping of chromosome preparations

Perform other duties consistent with the job classification as required

Job Requirements:Mandatory

Canadian Society for Medical Laboratory Science (CSMLS) certified MLT in Cytogenetics and Molecular Genetics Technology (Dual License)
Currently registered and in good standing with the College of Medical Laboratory Technologists of Ontario (CMLTO)
Candidates eligible to write the upcoming Clinical Genetics CSMLS exam will be considered

Preferred

Experience in Medical Genetics

Skills and Knowledge

Demonstrated problem recognition and problem solving skills
Demonstrated organizational, time management and prioritization skills
Demonstrated satisfactory work performance and attendance record

Note: In accordance with accreditation standards, employment is conditional upon applicant demonstrating proof of visual colour discrimination ability pertinent to the essential duties of the job.

If this sounds like you and you feel ready to build your career within pathology and laboratory medicine, apply now and let us know why you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Instrumentation Technician C
description:
Instrumentation Technician C

Company:

The Boeing Company

At Boeing, we are all innovators on a mission to connect, protect, explore and inspire. From the seabed to outer space, you’ll learn and grow, contributing to work that shapes the world. Find your future with us!

Boeing Test and Evaluation (BT&E) is seeking a Instrumentation Technician C to join our teams in either Tukwila, WA or Seattle, WA. In this role, you will work with blueprints, schematics, technical manuals and bulletins, National Bureau of Standards, manufacturers’ specifications, oral and written instructions. You will be installing instrumentation, primarily strain gauges and thermocouples on all models of Boeing aircraft civilian, military and space.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Receive work assignment from team leader or supervisor and obtain necessary materials and equipment

  • Obtain appropriate engineering drawings and test documents, as required, for assignment if drawings, sketches, and documents are not with work assignment

  • Fabricate wire or fiber optic bundles used to connect various types of test and computer equipment together or test sensing equipment used to monitor and measure, for the purpose of collecting and storing data during test

  • Set up and perform qualification test, bench test, or automatic test as required per work assignment, test document, test equipment manuals, and/or engineering instructions

  • Install fiber optic strain gages, thermocouples, accelerometers, and strain gages by soldering, bonding, spot welding, or using mechanical fastening devices

  • Use a scissor or boom lift to access areas for instrumentation installation this work is performed both inside hangars and outside on airfields

  • Perform modification of test equipment to meet engineering configuration, as required

  • Select proper hand, power, and/or bench tools needed to perform required operation, such as screwdrivers, pliers, torque wrenches, crimpers, cable tools, band saw, drill press, and sander, as required

  • Use shop tools and any test equipment required to complete work assignment

  • Write tie-ins, and maintain records such as work log for areas/equipment as required

  • Devise and/or build shop aids and work around methods as necessary to test/troubleshoot systems

  • Handle and protect components and assemblies such as static sensitive equipment in accordance with shop procedures and drawing requirements

  • Handle and dispose of hazardous materials (ketone, naphtha, alcohol, epoxy, acids) in approved manner (in accordance with Safety Data Sheets) using personal protective equipment as required

  • Pack electronic equipment for travel as required per drawing and Boeing applicable specifications

  • Check work after completion of each operation to be sure job is per drawing or other instructions

  • Put completed job or reworked job up for inspection as required

  • Contact team leader/supervisor/engineer/planner when assistance is needed (e.g. if there is questions about drawings or paperwork, if drawings and paperwork do not match, or when any other problem arises)

  • Maintain personal and tool certifications, as required

  • Comply with applicable tool control policies

  • Effectively accomplishing the tasks, duties and responsibilities of this job requires at least these attributes

  • Ability to use precision measuring tools and test equipment and interpret results

  • Knowledge of routing, clamping, tying, connecting and terminating wires and/or wire bundles in electrical systems and assemblies, per the appropriate electrical codes

  • Knowledge of aircraft electrical and mechanical systems

  • Ability to calculate and apply advanced mathematics

  • Know and interpret data from a coordinate system to identify multiple axis and dimensional references (3-D)

  • Ability to set up and operate floor mounted hydraulic and/or mechanical operated equipment

  • Ability to demonstrate entry level competency in operation of PIT (Power Industrial Trucks), in a safe manner as required

  • Ability to safely operate various types of hand tools and/or hand-held power tools as required

  • Effectively communicate information

  • Knowledge of basic electricity and electrical systems

  • Operate various types of test equipment, perform testing and interpret results, as required

  • Knowledge of proper use, handling, and disposal of hazardous materials/chemicals, oils, coolants, and lubricants per government regulations and Boeing procedures

  • Travel up to 10% of the time, both domestically and internationally.

The following Physical Demands may be requirements of this job:

Frequent (3-6 Hrs.)

  • Carrying less than 10 pounds; Climbing/balancing (stairs, ladders, poles, scaffold); Finger manipulation (keyboarding, other); Flexion/Extension (head bent down, head bent back); Handling (holding, grasping); Lifting less than 10 pounds; Reaching (overhead); Rotation of head/neck; Sitting; Standing; Walking

Occasional (1-3 Hrs.)

  • Bending at the waist; Carrying 10-35 pounds; Twisting at the waist; Use of low impact vibratory tools (drilling/sanding); Lying down (back, side, front); Operating of foot controls; Pushing/pulling 10-35 pounds; Pushing/pulling less than 10 pounds; Kneeling; Lifting 10-35 pounds; Crawling; Crouching (squatting)

The following Chemicals/Materials may be requirements of this job:

Frequent (3-6 Hrs.)

  • Metals (aluminum, brass, iron, Monel, nickel, steel); Plastics (acrylic, fiberglass, graphite, resins); Sealants (latex, polysulfide, silicon); Solvents (acetone, turpentine, MEK, MPK, Isopropho); Adhesives (epoxy, acrylonitrile, organic rubber)

Occasional (1-3 Hrs.)

  • Alkalis (acid neutralizers, strong detergents); Liquid Coatings (etching mask, lacquer, penetrant d); Acids (boric, muriatic, nitric, hydrochloric)

The following Environmental Conditions may be requirements of this job:

Continuous (6-8 Hrs.)

  • Noise (constant or intermittent sounds or pitch)

Frequent (3-6 Hrs.)

  • Nonionizing Radiation (sub-radio frequency, radio); Elevated Platforms (wings, lifts, cranes, ladders); Extreme Heat (ovens and furnaces)

Occasional (1-3 Hrs.)

  • Atmospheric Conditions (fumes, noxious odors, dust); Confined Spaces; Welding Equipment (Arc/Cutting, Flux-Cored, Gas-Me)

The following Personal Protective Equipment may be requirements of this job:

Continuous (6-8 Hrs.)

  • Face/Eye Protection (safety glasses, goggles); Fall Protection (safety belts, harnesses, lifeline); Protective Footwear (steel-toed shoes, rubber boot)

Frequent (3-6 Hrs.)

  • Protective Headwear (welding helmets, hard hats); Hand/Arm Protection (gloves, arm protectors); Hearing Protection (ear inserts, canal caps, earmuff)

title: Associate Verification Engineer
description:
Hi, we are ecobee.

ecobee introduced the world’s first smart Wi-Fi thermostat to help millions of consumers save money, conserve energy, and bring home automation into their lives. That was just the beginning. We continue our pursuit to create technology that brings peace of mind into the home and allows people to focus on the moments that matter most. We take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment, all while being part of the exciting, connected home revolution.

In 2021, ecobee became a subsidiary of Generac Power Systems. Generac introduced the first affordable backup generator and later created the category of automatic home standby generator. The company is committed to sustainable, cleaner energy products poised to revolutionize the 21st century electrical grid. Together, we take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment.

Why we love to do what we do:

We’re helping build the world of tomorrow with solutions that improve everyday life while making a positive impact on the planet. Our products and services work in harmony to provide comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind for millions of homes and businesses. While we’re proud of what we’ve done so far, there’s still a lot we can do—and you can be part of it.

Join our extraordinary team.

We're a rapidly growing global tech company headquartered in Canada, in the heart of downtown Toronto, with an office in Leeds, UK, and remote ecopeeps in the US. We get to work with some of North America and UK's leading professionals. Our colleagues are proud to bring their authentic selves to work, confident that what we do is grounded in a greater purpose. We’re always looking for curious, talented, and passionate people to join our team.


Who’ll you be joining:
Our Hardware Team is made up of engineers with a wide variety of specialties, skill sets, backgrounds, and experiences ranging from HVAC control to RF design, digital logic, avionics, test fixtures, embedded software development, PCB layout and power electronics. They aim to bring their wide experience to the cross-functional squads that they are a part of, with a focus on collaboration, learning, development.

As an Associate Verification Engineer, you will be at the forefront of validating and delivering high-reliability products and test systems for next-generation hardware. This role is ideal for a hands-on engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working across electrical, mechanical, RF, and software domains. You’ll own the full lifecycle in executing complex test systems—from concept and design to automation and compliance—ensuring our products meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and regulatory readiness.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, requiring four days per week in the office to ​support collaboration, and flexibility to work remotely for the remainder of the week.


How you’ll make an impact:

Verification Testing

  • Execute design verification tests on pre-production hardware using oscilloscopes, power supplies, e-loads, thermal chambers, and data loggers
  • Modify hardware to facilitate verification testing to measure current consumption, voltage ripple, etc. under specific verification test cases
  • Validate signal integrity and timing of communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, SDIO) using oscilloscopes, decoders, logic analyzers
  • Perform hardware verification testing under changing environmental test conditions by creating custom thermal test profiles
  • Record results, annotate screenshots, summarize findings, and create clear documentation for peer-reviewable reports
  • Host meetings to summarize results, escalate blockers, and request support when needed
  • Provide engineering judgement to conceptualize, design, and propose verification test cases

Test Development & Automation

  • Document standardized test procedures to facilitate rapid testing and development
  • Interface several test instrumentation systems and setup acquisition equipment for overnight testing
  • Create Python scripts to interface with test equipment via SCPI commands, compile, align, analyze data, and generate plots
  • Develop basic Linux shell scripts to evaluate stress hardware and collect metrics for long-term tests
  • Import example application code for new hardware evaluation modules, modify C code to configure basic settings to ensure hardware is in specific operational modes

Hardware Development

  • Modify and rework pre-production samples as needed to support verification testing by changing component values, fly-wiring design corrections, etc.
  • Read and interpret datasheets, understand component specifications, compare and contrast results to verification tests
  • Support evaluating and testing prototype circuits for new products
  • With the help of senior engineers, complete the schematic capture and layout for basic circuits
  • Perform SMT assembly using stencils and reflow equipment for low component count and fine pitch circuit boards

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Design, Firmware, Manufacturing, Test Fixtures) to expose design problems and determine root cause
  • Author clear and concise requests or instruction sets for other teams to implement a specific set of requirements
  • Create block diagrams and documentation that communicates verification test design implementation
  • Track and communicate test progress, risks, and summarize key findings

What You’ll Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Computer, or related Engineering field
  • 2+ years of experience in hardware development and test automation
  • Proficient in Altium for schematic capture and PCB layout
  • Skilled in scripting with Python
  • Familiar with embedded development in C and Linux environments
  • Hands-on experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, e-loads, signal generators, thermal chambers
  • Strong communication and project management skills

Just so you know: The hired candidate will be required to complete a background check.

What happens after you apply:
Application review. It will happen. By an actual person in Talent Acquisition. As we sometimes get upwards of 100+ applications for some roles, it can take a few days, but every applicant can expect a note regarding their application status.

Interview Process.

  • A 30-minute phone call with a member in Talent Acquisition
  • A 1 hour interview with the Hiring Manager and leadership team to assess background, product experience, technical depth and overall fit for the role.
  • The final round will be an hour long technical case study and presentation. We normally give candidates a week to complete the case study.

Generac is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role based in Toronto, ON is $74,900 - $93,600 CAD. This compensation will ultimately be in line with the location in which the position is filled. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidate’s relevant work experience, skills, certifications and geographic location. This role is eligible for variable compensation including short term and long-term incentives.

This position includes a comprehensive benefit package that includes medical, dental and vision plans; life, long-term disability, flexible spending and health savings accounts, accrued paid time off, paid Holidays (10 for Ontario, 11 for British Columbia) and RRSP retirement benefits

title: Associate, GP Solutions
description:
ORIX Corporation USA (ORIX USA)

Established in the U.S. in 1981, ORIX USA has grown organically and through acquisition into the investment and asset management firm we are today. With a specialization in private credit, real estate, and private equity solutions for middle-market focused borrowers and investors, we combine our robust balance sheet with funds from third-party investors, providing a strong alignment of interest.

ORIX USA and its subsidiaries — ORIX Advisers, ORIX Capital Partners, Signal Peak Capital Management, Boston Financial, Lument, Real Estate Capital and NXT Capital — have approximately 2100 employees across the U.S. and have ~ $97 billion in assets, which includes $44.0 billion in assets and commitments, in addition to $52.9 billion in servicing and administering assets, as of December 2025.

Our parent company, ORIX Corporation, is a publicly owned international financial services company with operations in 30 countries and regions worldwide. ORIX Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8591) and New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: IX). For more information, visit .

Purpose and Job Summary

ORIX USA GP Solutions is a leading provider of strategic capital to middle and lower middle-market private equity sponsors. We deliver bespoke financing solutions across the full spectrum of GP Solutions transactions including single-fund and diversified NAV loans, preferred equity fund financing, fund securitizations, GP management company financing, and continuation vehicles. We have invested ~$700 million in over 20 deals in the past 36 months and are scaling rapidly as demand for NAV-based and GP-level financing accelerates across the private equity landscape.

We are seeking an Associate to join a small team with a broad mandate. You will work directly with senior team members across origination, structuring, underwriting, and execution, rather than being limited to one part of the deal process. Our transaction set spans a wide range of deal types, and each is individually structured — there is no standard product here, so the work rewards creativity and rigorous thinking rather than pattern repetition. Today, our team invests from ORIX USA's balance sheet with the expectation that our platform will expand to include third-party capital over time. Associates joining at this stage will play a critical role in building our platform for the long term.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Diligence: Conduct detailed analysis of new investment opportunities through review of transaction portfolios and sponsor capabilities; and quantitative analyses to assess financial performance of underlying assets in support of investment underwriting
  • Underwriting: Preparation of materials for Investment Committee consideration including investment memoranda, supporting documentation and analyses, and financial modeling
  • Monitoring: Management of the GP Solutions investment portfolio including review and synthesis of quarterly and annual reporting investment sponsors, internally constructed valuation analyses, preparation of quarterly and annual investment activity and performance reporting for investors, and annual third-party audit support
  • Other: Pipeline management; assist as needed with other assignments and in outside business development efforts; establish strong working relationships with other team members, operate effectively with limited oversight while meeting tight timelines

Education, Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited top tier university with a degree in finance, economics, or related field with a 3.5 minimum GPA;
  • Extremely intellectually curious and highly self-motivated;
  • 1-2 years of experience in private equity, private credit, investment banking, or related fields;
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Copilot, PowerPoint, and Word;
  • Specific skills leveraging AI models to drive workflows uniquely valuable;
  • Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously;
  • Ability to work independently; and
  • Ties to and/or desire to reside in Dallas for the long term






Life at ORIX

We are committed to the health and well-being of our employees and offer a quality, competitive benefits package that provides valuable healthcare and financial protection for our workforce, while emphasizing a healthy work/life balance.

You Time

We want you to have the time needed to recharge and manage life with our competitive vacation policy, floating personal holidays, extensive leave options, our annual observed holidays, and more.

Family Care

Every family has a different journey and ORIX USA Group is proud to offer extensive benefit programs such as: infertility coverage, adoption support, child and elder care, fully paid maternity, and generous parental leave benefits to help you and your families along the way.

Flexible Work Arrangements

ORIX associates enjoy the advantages of our hybrid working model with a 3 day in-office minimum requirement.

The Director is responsible for leading the operational strategy, infrastructure, controls, and day-to-day support model for the firm’s Fixed Income Separately Managed Account (SMA) business. This leadership role will help develop and oversee the end-to-end operating environment supporting fixed income portfolios, ensuring that the platform is scalable, controlled, efficient, and capable of supporting continued business growth and product expansion.   • Ensure appropriate controls around trade capture, allocation, confirmation, settlement, and reconciliation.

Job Summary

Intern, Internal Audit & Enterprise Risk Management: June - August 2027 (Hybrid)



Position Dates: June 7, 2027 – August 13, 2027

Position Overview

Insulet Corporation is seeking a motivated, intellectually curious, and detail-oriented intern to join the Global Internal Audit & Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) team for Summer 2027.

This internship provides hands-on experience across Internal Audit and ERM within a global medical device company. The intern will work alongside experienced professionals to evaluate business processes, assess risks, analyze data, and support initiatives that strengthen governance and risk management capabilities.

The role offers exposure to operational, financial, technology, compliance, and enterprise risks, as well as opportunities to collaborate with Finance, Quality, Compliance, Information Technology, Operations, and other business functions. This is a hybrid role with an expectation to work on-site in Acton, Massachusetts, as business needs require.

Key Responsibilities

Internal Audit

  • Assist with risk-based audits across operational, manufacturing, commercial, corporate, technology, supply chain, and other business functions.
  • Participate in process walkthroughs, stakeholder interviews, and documentation of key business processes and controls.
  • Perform audit testing and analyze information to evaluate process design and effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Support enterprise risk assessment, risk monitoring, and reporting activities.
  • Participate in risk workshops and discussions with business stakeholders.
  • Help document risk mitigation plans and track progress against established commitments.

Data Analytics & Emerging Technologies

  • Analyze business and audit data using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
  • Support continuous auditing and monitoring initiatives through data analysis.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and potential opportunities for process improvement.
  • Explore appropriate uses of artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies to enhance audit and risk management activities.

Cross-Functional Governance Exposure

  • Collaborate with Finance, Quality, Compliance, Information Technology, Operations, and other business partners to understand how governance and risk functions support business objectives.
  • Gain exposure to Insulet's Internal Controls (SOX) function, a second-line function within Controllership, and understand how it coordinates with Internal Audit and other assurance functions. The internship is not positioned as a SOX testing role.

Education & Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Risk Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Minimum GPA of 3.0.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and collaborate effectively as part of a team.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ideal candidates will be undergraduate students completing their junior year and entering their senior year after the internship.
  • Internship, co-op, project, or coursework experience related to audit, accounting, finance, analytics, information systems, risk management, or technology.
  • Familiarity with artificial intelligence tools and emerging business technologies.

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in both Internal Audit and Enterprise Risk Management within one internship.
  • Exposure to a broad range of business processes and risks across a global medical device company.
  • Opportunities to apply data analytics and emerging technologies to real-world work.
  • Mentorship from experienced audit, risk, finance, and business professionals.
  • Experience communicating project results and recommendations to department leadership.
  • The opportunity to contribute to meaningful work at a mission-driven company focused on improving the lives of people with diabetes.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to travel to Insulet's Acton, Massachusetts office as needed.

Insulet Corporation (NASDAQ: PODD), headquartered in Massachusetts, is an innovative medical device company dedicated to simplifying life for people with diabetes and other conditions through its Omnipod product platform. The Omnipod Insulin Management System provides a unique alternative to traditional insulin delivery methods. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. Insulet’s flagship innovation, the Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System, integrates with a continuous glucose monitor to manage blood sugar with no multiple daily injections, zero fingersticks, and can be controlled by a compatible personal smartphone in the U.S. or by the Omnipod 5 Controller. Job Summary
As a Ship-to-Shore Technician, you will play a vital role in supporting the safe and efficient operation of vessels arriving and departing at the port. In addition to mooring responsibilities, the role will also involve performing general maintenance and support tasks as required to ensure overall port and equipment readiness.

Key Accountabilities/Job Functions

The Ship-to-Shore Technician is responsible for, but not limited to the following:

Docking and Undocking Operations

  • Assist in safely docking and undocking cruise ships at port using mooring lines, ropes, and related equipment.
  • Work in coordination with the ship’s captain, crew, and port authorities to ensure that vessels are safely secured and aligned with docking infrastructure.

Mooring Line Management:

  • Handle and manage mooring lines, ensuring they are properly fastened, tense, and released.
  • Perform visual inspection of mooring lines and related equipment regularly for wear and damage, ensuring everything is in safe working condition. (Regularly performed by ship crew)

Ship and Dock Safety

  • Maintain safety protocols during mooring procedures, ensuring that all tasks are performed in accordance with safety regulations.
  • Monitor weather conditions and report any changes that could affect docking or undocking procedures.

Communication and Coordination

  • Communicate effectively with other team members on board and shore-based personnel.
  • Work with the Port Authorities to ensure the timely and safe transfer of passengers and cargo.


Emergency Procedures

  • Be trained to respond in case of an emergency during docking or undocking operations, including accidents or hazardous situations.
  • Ensure all mooring operations are conducted efficiently and safely, even under adverse weather conditions or emergencies.

PPE Equipment (MANDATORY)

  • Must always be in possession of steel toe boots (or prescribed non-slip safety shoes), safety vest, hard hat, gloves, radio/communication device. (To be provided by Carnival)

Cleaning & Maintenance of Pier & Mooring Equipment & Fixtures:

  • Ensure all mooring equipment such as winches, ropes, and fenders are properly maintained and operational (through visual checks and inspections).
  • Gangway Inspections & Maintenance: Inspect gangway components for wear, corrosion, proper tension, secure connections, and smooth operation to ensure safe pedestrian access and functionality.
  • Fenders: Conduct visual inspections of pier fenders and associated hardware to identify cracks, deformation, excessive wear, or damage caused by vessel contact, and report deficiencies as needed.
  • Mooring Bollards: Regularly inspect mooring bollards for structural integrity, including corrosion, cracks, loose anchor bolts, foundation stress, and coating condition, to ensure safe vessel mooring.
  • Stanchions & Pier Fixtures: Inspect stanchions and associated components for corrosion, damage, misalignment, or instability, ensuring they remain secure and serviceable.
  • Ropes: Inspect ropes for wear, fraying, or damage, and verify they are properly positioned and suitable for continued use.
  • Mooring Equipment Maintenance: Perform minor maintenance and repairs of mooring equipment when necessary.
  • Pier & Dock Cleaning: Maintain clean, safe, and non-slip pier surfaces by removing dirt, salt, algae, stains, debris and other buildup by pressure washing and using prescribed cleaning equipment and solutions, along all designated cruise pier and trestle areas.
  • Cleaning Equipment Operation: Safely inspect, operate, and maintain cleaning equipment, including scrubbers and pressure washers, ensuring proper use, cleaning, and storage after each operation.

  • Perform minor maintenance support to technical teams including plumbing, electrical, masonry, carpentry, and HVAC functions.

title: Team Lead til Building & Structures i Bioenergy, Avedøre Power Station | Ørsted
description:
Forestil dig en fremtid, hvor du bidrager til målrettet eksekvering af mindre projekter på vores kraftværkers bygningsanlæg

Velkommen til Bioenergy
Du bliver del af Maintenance Projects, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger i Building & Structures løser et bredt spekter af projekter inden for kraftværkernes bygningsmasse, havne, veje, kloakker m.v. Vi har projekter på både vores jyske og sjællandske kraftværker. Projektlederne i afdelingen har ansvaret for deres projekter fra start til slut. Det betyder, at de håndterer detailspecificering af opgaven ud fra det godkendte oplæg og budget, indhenter priser og gennemfører evt. udbud samt står for den endelige udførelse af projektet på sitet.

I vores team arbejder vi selvstændigt og med stor beslutningskraft, vi værdsætter det gode humør og er bevidste om, at sammen kan vi gøre forskellen.

I jobbet vil du:

  • være daglig leder af 4 projektledere i Building & Structures, 3 på Sjælland og 1 i Jylland
  • være ansvarlig for, at afdelingen lever op til sine mål om bl.a. at levere rettidigt på egne projekter, og at der er styr på økonomien
  • sikre vidensopbygning i teamet
  • deltage som ansvarlig projektleder på opgaveløsning (ca. 50 % af tiden)
  • indgå i tæt dialog med eksterne rådgivere og sikre de rette ressourcer til opgavernes udførelse
  • være med til at forme afdelingen og give den det rette projektledermindset.

For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

  • har en baggrund som bygningsingeniør, bygningskonstruktør eller på anden måde har erfaring med en rolle som denne, og at du er bekendt med fagbegreberne inden for projektledelse
  • kan og gerne har praktisk erfaring med at lede, motivere og skabe klar retning for specialister og projektledere
  • evner at skabe overblik over afdelingens projekter og sikre, at de er on track
  • har kendskab til bygherre- og entreprenørstyring herunder har erfaring med at drive projekter inden for byggebranchen
  • har fokus på eksekvering og evner at gøre det komplekse enkelt, ligesom du arbejder selvstændigt og formår at prioritere og tilpasse opgaver til din egen hverdag
  • både kan og har lyst til at kommunikere og agere bredt i organisationen og motivere dine medarbejdere

Selvom din profil ikke matcher alle punkterne, har du måske andre kompetencer, der vil være relevante. Mener du, at du kan bidrage til teamet, så send os din ansøgning.

Form fremtiden med os
Send din ansøgning og dit CV til os så hurtigt som muligt.

Hvis du ønsker at anmode om justering af arbejdsmetoder eller arbejdsmønstre eller hjælp til rekrutteringsprocessen, så send en e-mail til accommodation@orsted.com.

Bemærk venligst, at din ansøgning kun bliver taget i betragtning, hvis den indsendes via vores online karriereside. Vi tager ikke ansøgninger eller forespørgsler fra eksterne rekrutteringsbureauer eller bureauer i betragtning til denne stilling.

Lønrammen:

For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau kr. 59.700,- - kr. 70.800.- for den annoncerede lokation. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af relevante kompetencer, erfaring og forventet opgavevaretagelse inden for det angivne løninterval for at sikre et fair og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Hvor det er relevant, kan du desuden være berettiget til variabel løn og en omfattende fordelspakke.

Vores fordelspakke:

I denne stilling får medarbejdere, der opfylder berettigelseskravene, adgang til: arbejdsgiverbetalt pension (11 % indbetaling), fuld forsikringsdækning (ulykke, liv, kritisk sygdom og sundhedsforsikring); fem ugers betalt ferie plus 10 ekstra betalte fridage pr. ferieår; 3 % feriepengetillæg; adgang til Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality, herunder holdtræning, fysioterapi, massage og trivselstilbud; en multimediepakke (mobiltelefon, pc, internet); medlemskab af personaleklub med sports- og kulturaktiviteter; samt adgang til virksomhedens kantine (månedlig frokostordning eller dagsbilletter).

Baggrundstjek før ansættelse:

Visse stillinger kræver et baggrundstjek som en del af ansættelsesprocessen. Hvis dette er aktuelt, vil du blive informeret herom i løbet af rekrutteringsforløbet. Baggrundstjek udføres af en ekstern udbyder i overensstemmelse med lokal lovgivning.

Forestil dig en fremtid med Ørsted

Bliv en del af verdens førende virksomhed inden for vedvarende energi

Bliv en del af en verdensførende virksomhed inden for vedvarende energi
Ørsted er verdensførende inden for havvind, og vi er en af de største virksomheder i verden inden for vedvarende energi. Hos os er du med til at skabe en verden, der udelukkende kører på grøn energi. Som et af verdens førende selskaber inden for vedvarende energi bygger vi på vores medarbejderes nysgerrighed og passion, når vi innoverer og udvikler nye teknologier eller skalerer eksisterende teknologier, samtidig med at vi samarbejder med regeringer, leverandører og vores industripartnere om at gøre løsninger inden for vedvarende energi til virkelighed. I Ørsted arbejder vi sammen med stor respekt for hinanden, og vi er altid åbne overfor nye perspektiver på, hvordan vi kan løse vores opgaver, uanset hvor store eller små de er.

Om Ørsted

  • Vi leverer bæredygtige, stabile og konkurrencedygtige energiløsninger – herunder havvind, landvind, solenergi og energilagring – til lande, virksomheder og lokalsamfund.
  • Det er vores vision at skabe en verden, der udelukkende kører på grøn energi.
  • Vi byggede verdens første havvindmøllepark, Vindeby i Danmark, i 1991, og i 2022 idriftsatte vi verdens største, Hornsea 2 i Storbritannien.
  • Vi blev grundlagt i Danmark i 2006 og er i dag ca. 8.000 medarbejdere i 15 lande over hele verden – og vi bliver hele tiden flere.

Et inkluderende team

I Ørsted gør vi vores yderste for at være en inkluderende arbejdsplads, hvor du bliver respekteret for den, du er, værdsat for de unikke perspektiver, du bidrager med, og får en fair belønning for de resultater, du opnår. Alle vores medarbejdere har de samme muligheder for at få indflydelse og udvikle sig uanset alder, race, etnicitet, fødested, køn, seksuel orientering eller handicap.

title: Lead, Internal Audit
description:
Mylan Inc.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

This posting supports ongoing hiring needs and may be used to consider candidates for upcoming opportunities.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Lead, Internal Audit will make an impact:

Internal Audit serves the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors and management as an independent and objective resource designed to enhance and protect organizational value by providing risk-based and objective assurance, advice, and insight. Internal Audit brings a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of governance, risk management, processes and controls, and assists management in achieving goals and objectives while maintaining the highest standards of integrity and respect. The Lead, Internal Audit supplements oversight provided by the Internal Audit managers during the performance of audits of internal control over financial reporting, risk-based audits and special projects and / or leads projects as the primary field supervisor. Additionally, the Lead serves as a primary contributor when understanding processes and performing detailed testing, ensuring timely audit / project completion supported by quality documentation from all team members.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Ensure accounting transactions and balances are recorded in accordance with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.

  • Ensure compliance, quality and operational processes are functioning efficiently, effectively and in accordance with company policy.

  • Prepare and review work papers for concurrent workstreams to ensure organized in accordance with departmental standards and that work performed supports conclusions.

  • Provide coaching and direction to less experienced team members.

  • Draft and contribute to audit reports detailing scope, findings and remediation plans.

  • Contribute to the effective communication of audit and special project scope, status, findings and remediation plans with management (local, regional, and global). Develop strong relationships with local, regional and global leaders of the company, while maintaining objectivity.

  • Monitor implementation status of remediation activities.

title: Sr Equity Options Trader
description:

title: Senior Nonqualified Deferred Compensation Specialist
description:
Experience GuideStone!

We are an innovative organization that invests in the spiritual, relational, financial, physical and professional development of our employees. We have a culture that values excellence, teamwork, humility, integrity, compassion and stewardship.

We offer employees a generous benefits package, flexible work schedules, the opportunity to be involved in community outreach and tuition reimbursement.

The Senior Nonqualified Deferred Compensation Specialist is a highly skilled individual contributor responsible for the administration, operational oversight, and continuous improvement of nonqualified deferred compensation plans and related executive benefit arrangements. Operating with minimal supervision and wide latitude for independent judgment, this role serves as a technical and operational resource supporting executive-level participants, highly valued participants, plan sponsors, participant representatives, and internal business partners. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
A.P. Moller - Maersk

A.P. Moller – Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs c. 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers’ supply chains.

We Offer

Joining Maersk will embark you on a transformational journey with great opportunities for career development within a global organization. As a Senior OSS Engineer, you will design, engineer and run our capabilities for the Operational Support Systems (OSS) and Tools stack for network and perimeter products and platforms that enable highly distributed global business for site, fleet, asset and IoT connectivity, required to deliver against our strategy. You will be exposed to a wide and challenging range of needs and opportunities requiring you to engage closely with stakeholders across all levels within Maersk as you mature and evolve our OSS capabilities for Network OSS to become world class.

The Brief

A globally focused shipping and transportation organisation is continuing to drive an ambitious and complex change and transformational programme to deliver a service of excellence for its customers and clients worldwide. The Global CTIO has a mandate from the Maersk board to lead the Technology transformation of Maersk which will enable the Maersk business strategy to become the global integrator of container logistics through digitising the Maersk business processes and customer engagement.

The Technology Function is fundamental to enable the company’s transformation and in response to this demand, our in-house technological capability is growing exponentially. We are recruiting world class talent to ensure that the technology services are modernised to enable Maersk to become a logistics integrator leveraging a competitive advantage through technology.

Why this job matters?

The Network OSS Engineering function is essential to our transformation, it is a central team within Network Architecture & Engineering, responsible for the delivery of product roadmaps, technical vision and quality across Fulfilment and Assurance that underpin our network and perimeter capabilities and products.

Reporting to the Senior OSS Engineering Manager you will serve as a Senior OSS Engineer, ensuring that our systems and tools for the network OSS realise business value. Your role is responsible for technical design and delivery of solutions across the network OSS applications landscape from monitoring to analytics driven AIOps. All built to industry leading standards and running seamlessly across various cloud and on-prem platforms, allowing frictionless and seamless operations of our network and perimeter platforms.

It has a critical role to play as we continue to develop our long-term multi-technology and multi-product network and perimeter capabilities, connecting our asset, sites and people on land and at sea. Delivering best in class software and tooling that not only meet the need of our business today but will be a differentiator, enabling our colleagues and partners with technology solutions that are a catalyst for productivity and innovation.

Scope

All data networks provided to Maersk across Core, Edge and Cloud locations (offices, warehouses, terminals, vessels, data centres, cloud etc), and the perimeter services that protect and enable them including but not limited to:

  • Wireless Transport: Satellite | 4G/LTE | 5G
  • IoT Networking Solutions: Industrial Wi-Fi
  • WAN: Internet | IP/MPLS | Next-Gen/SD WAN
  • LAN: DC Networking | SDN | Fixed & Wireless
  • Perimeter: Load balancers | NG Firewalls | Security Service Edge

Specific Job Requirements

The role holder shall possess a solid understanding of DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, Jenkins, build pipelines and source control systems and have a working knowledge of cloud infrastructure services: compute, storage, networking, hybrid connectivity, monitoring/logging, security and IAM.

Collaborate with stakeholders and Business Analysts to gather, document and understand requirements. Articulate functional and non-functional requirements to business and technical stakeholders.

Product mindset and passion about building for internal stakeholders and external customers.

Work with product owners to prioritize features for ongoing sprints and implement features based on service line demand, industry trends, known defects, and issues.

To be a successful technologist at Maersk, you must be passionate about building, enabling and sustaining our business, as well as inspiring and developing our people. Further, in this role you will:

  • Be a world class expert in the OSS domain, implementing the defined architectural roadmap for Network tooling for the Maersk Group.
  • Support delivery and program management with estimations and planning.
  • Validate all the Non-Functional requirements and provide inputs to the applications team on capacity exercise.
  • Practice TDD and follow best practices.
  • Produce high-quality, clean and performant code.
  • Implement and publish APIs for ecosystem clients to consume platform services in a consistent way.
  • Adopt a product mindset and passion about building for internal and external ecosystem.

What I'll be doing – your accountabilities?

Software Engineering – Build and integrate applications in the OSS ecosystem. Engineering of the software tools to drive Fulfilment and Assurance OSS capability to underpin all networking and perimeter services across Core, Edge and Cloud. To be considered for this opportunity the candidate needs to have following technical qualifications:

  • Expertise in building/troubleshooting and debugging containerized applications using Kubernetes using microservices concepts like observability and scalability.
  • Excellent experience and knowledge of Java 17+. Well versed with Spring boot.
  • TDD with Unit Testing (such as Junit or Mockito) and Integration Testing.
  • Strong experience with Python, API development and testing tools such as Postman, and automation scripting, with the ability to develop production-ready services, integrations and proofs of concept for observability, AIOps and agentic AI use cases.
  • Hands-on experience with microservices, container and cloud technologies, ingress controllers, API gateways, PromQL and LogQL.
  • SRE Exposure an advantage. Experience defining service KPIs, SLIs and SLOs using open-source observability tooling such as Prometheus, Mimir, Grafana, Loki and ELK, together with instrumentation, telemetry and log analytics.
  • Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL, Streaming (Kafka) and large-scale batch processing
  • Experience with frontend technologies like react/angular etc. is desirable
  • Solid experience in DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, build pipelines and source control systems
  • Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs and integrating platforms through webhooks and event-driven interfaces.
  • Experience monitoring application performance, resolving production issues and operating services using SRE practices.
  • Comfortable working in agile methodologies (ideally Scrum)

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Shipping and Receiving Clerk - Tulsa
description:
The Shipping and Receiving Clerk is responsible for accurately receiving, inspecting, storing, preparing, and shipping materials and products. This position ensures that incoming and outgoing shipments are processed correctly and on time while maintaining accurate inventory records and a clean, safe, and organized work environment.

FACILITY/GROUP SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Receive, inspect, identify, and appropriately route incoming raw materials, parts, supplies, and finished equipment.
  • Prepare, package, stage, and process materials and equipment for domestic and/or international shipment.
  • Load and unload trucks and safely move materials throughout the facility using forklifts and other material-handling equipment.
  • Verify incoming and outgoing materials against applicable shipping, receiving, and inventory documentation; identify and communicate discrepancies.
  • Prepare and maintain required shipping and receiving documentation and coordinate pickups and deliveries with carriers as needed.
  • Perform inventory transactions and maintain accurate material locations and records using applicable inventory systems.
  • Support cycle counts, physical inventory activities, and investigation of inventory discrepancies.
  • Pick, stage, and kit materials to support production, service, customer orders, and other facility requirements.
  • Package and protect materials and equipment appropriately for storage, internal movement, or shipment.
  • Coordinate with production, operations, purchasing, and other internal groups to support material availability and timely movement of goods.
  • Organize warehouse and staging areas to support efficient material flow and accessibility.
  • Maintain clean, orderly work and storage areas and properly care for assigned warehouse equipment.
  • Prioritize receiving, material movement, and shipping activities based on facility and customer requirements.
  • Communicate material shortages, shipping/receiving discrepancies, delays, and other issues that could affect operations.
  • Support continuous improvement activities that improve material flow, inventory accuracy, organization, and warehouse efficiency.
  • Perform other warehouse, shipping, receiving and material-handling responsibilities as required to support facility operations.
  • Previous shipping, receiving, warehouse, or inventory experience preferred.
  • Ability to read and understand purchase orders, packing slips, shipping documents, and product labels.
  • Basic computer skills and ability to use inventory, warehouse, or shipping software.
  • Basic math skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to accurately count, verify, and document inventory.
  • Good organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Dependable attendance and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Forklift certification preferred or willingness to become certified.
  • Experience with UPS, FedEx, or other shipping systems is a plus.

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.

  • Ability to bend, reach, stoop, push, and pull throughout the workday.

  • Ability to regularly lift and carry up to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Ability to safely operate material-handling equipment when trained and authorized.

  • Ability to work in a warehouse environment where temperatures and noise levels may vary.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer - DevOps
description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

POSITION SUMMARY

This role will be pivotal in advancing the company's mission of delivering secure, reliable, and innovative software solutions for U.S. government and DoD clients. The Cybersecurity Engineer serves as the resident security subject-matter expert embedded within the DevOps squad, owning the security compliance posture for software deployed in federal, DoD, and other highly regulated secure environments. The ideal candidate brings direct, hands-on experience operating within secure federal technology environments and a strong working knowledge of the security frameworks, tooling, and authorization processes that govern government-hosted systems. This individual will drive RMF/ATO lifecycle management, STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, and DevSecOps integration across Sphera's product lines, ensuring that all systems maintain continuous compliance and readiness for deployment in secure government operating environments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead cybersecurity for software deployed in secure federal and DoD environments, ensuring compliance with applicable government security policies, access requirements, and accreditation expectations.
  • Execute RMF activities, including system categorization, security control selection, implementation, assessment, and ATO documentation for federal or DoD-hosted systems.
  • Implement, configure, and validate STIGs across layers using DISA-approved or equivalent government security tooling.
  • Mitigate OWASP Top 10 and application-layer vulnerabilities across services.
  • Monitor security controls, scan vulnerabilities, and audit systems, producing reports and coordinating remediation with development and DevOps.
  • Manage POA&Ms, coordinating with government security stakeholders, ISSMs, and internal teams to track and resolve open findings.
  • Support FedRAMP and FISMA compliance, aligning controls with NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.
  • Integrate security tooling and automated checks into CI/CD pipelines, advancing DevSecOps maturity.
  • Collaborate with engineers and the Principal Solutions Architect to conduct threat modeling, security design reviews, and application-level security assessments.
  • Maintain System Security Plans (SSPs), security architectures, and supporting ATO documentation packages in alignment with federal and DoD requirements.
  • Lead incident response activities for security events affecting systems deployed in secure government environments, coordinating with customer cybersecurity personnel and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor SIEM alerts, analyze logs, and investigate anomalous activity.
  • Evaluate the security posture of third-party integrations, vendor tools, and emerging technologies for adoption in secure federal or DoD environments.
  • Embed security requirements into sprint planning, feature development, and release processes with the TPM, engineering squads, and product owners.
  • Stay informed on evolving federal, DoD, DISA, and agency-specific security policies, DISA guidance updates, and emerging threats, and proactively communicate their impact to the engineering organization.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • U.S. citizen required; active DoD security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one due to secure federal enclave access.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in a federal, DoD or similarly regulated secure environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of secure federal or DoD environments, including segmented networks, access control, approved software baselines, and applicable security requirements.
  • Experience supporting or leading RMF processes, including ATO package preparation and submission for federal or DoD systems.
  • Proficiency in applying STIGs using DISA-approved tools (SCC, STIG Viewer, Nessus/ACAS) or comparable vulnerability and compliance platforms.
  • Solid understanding of FedRAMP Moderate and FISMA compliance, with ability to map security controls to NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.
  • Experience with vulnerability management tools (e.g., Tenable.sc, Nessus, ACAS) in federal or DoD environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise security tools including SIEM, IDS/IPS, and network security controls.
  • DevSecOps experience, including integrating SAST, DAST, and SCA scanning into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
  • Familiarity with PKI, CAC/PIV authentication, and certificate management in federal or DoD environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to translate complex security findings into actionable guidance for engineering teams and brief government stakeholders.
  • DoD 8570/8140 compliant certification at IAT Level II or higher (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, CEH, CAP, or equivalent).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience working in segmented networks with an understanding of federal, DoD, or similarly regulated infrastructure and security requirements.

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS

  • Proven time management, organizational and follow-up skills to meet deadlines.
  • Work effectively, independently, and in a dynamic team environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Must be willing to learn new technologies and processes as needed.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Secure Federal Environment Expertise

Strong working knowledge of secure federal, DoD, or similarly regulated operating environments, including security requirements, approval workflows, access constraints, and operational expectations — enabling the team to navigate complex government security landscapes with confidence and minimal disruption to delivery.

RMF and Compliance Execution

End-to-end ownership of RMF activities, from control implementation through ATO documentation, ensuring systems remain authorized and compliant throughout their lifecycle.

DevSecOps Integration

Embeds security as a continuous, automated discipline within engineering pipelines, reducing friction and shifting security left in the development lifecycle to maximize engineering velocity without sacrificing compliance.

Exceptional Stakeholder Communication and Collaboration

title: Contract Specialist
description:
Job Posting End Date

10-03-2026

Job Summary

Are you ready to work in a supportive, fast-moving environment where your work matters? This position serves as a Contract Specialist and management professional and is responsible for complex, high-value, and strategically critical supplier contracts. The role is responsible for developing and executing contracting strategies, leading sophisticated negotiations, managing commercial risk across a portfolio of contracts, and advising leadership on contractual, operational, financial, and regulatory impacts.

The position partners closely with Legal, Supply Chain, Finance, Risk Management, Engineering, Project Management, and executive leadership to optimize supplier performance, protect company interests, and achieve business objectives. In this high-visibility position, you will provide guidance and direction to junior contract professionals and lead cross-functional teams during major contracting initiatives.

Job Description

What You'll Do: ​

  • Develop and execute comprehensive contracting and commercial strategies for major capital projects, enterprise procurement initiatives, and strategically important supplier relationships.

  • Lead complex negotiations involving commercial, legal, operational, regulatory, and financial considerations, securing favorable terms while balancing business objectives and risk tolerance.

  • Serve as the primary commercial advisor to business leadership, project teams, and stakeholders regarding contract interpretation, risk allocation, dispute resolution, claims management, and supplier performance issues.

  • Conduct detailed commercial, financial, and contractual risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies throughout the contract lifecycle.

  • Lead cross-functional teams in the evaluation, negotiation, administration, and closeout of high-value and high-risk contracts.

  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, value creation, process improvement, and contractual optimization across assigned supplier portfolios.

  • Develop and maintain executive-level reporting on contract portfolio performance, supplier risk exposure, claims activity, commercial outcomes, and key performance indicators.

  • Lead formal dispute resolution efforts, including claims analysis, settlement negotiations, mediation support, and coordination with Legal on litigation-related matters.

  • Perform commercial analysis of supplier proposals, pricing structures, cost escalation provisions, market conditions, and total cost of ownership considerations.

  • Establish governance frameworks for strategic supplier relationships, including performance scorecards, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Evaluate changing regulatory, market, and industry conditions and recommend contract modifications or risk mitigation strategies to protect company interests.

  • Lead negotiations associated with contract amendments, renewals, terminations, transitions, and supplier restructuring events.

  • Manage the commercial impacts of force majeure events, supply disruptions, regulatory changes, and other significant business contingencies.

  • Develop, improve, and standardize contract templates, policies, procedures, negotiation playbooks, and best practices to enhance organizational effectiveness.

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to Contract Specialists and other team members regarding contract strategy, negotiation techniques, risk management, and contract administration practices.

  • Represent the organization in executive discussions with suppliers, industry partners, regulators, and external stakeholders on contract-related matters.

  • Support strategic sourcing, supplier selection, and procurement activities through commercial leadership, due diligence, and negotiation expertise.

  • Other duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field of study + 6 years of relevant work experience.

  • (or) In lieu of Bachelor’s degree must possess an Associate’s degree in related field of study, and a minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience.

  • (or) In lieu of Associate’s degree must possess a High School Diploma or equivalent, and a minimum of 10 years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as a Masters in Business Administration, Law degree or global equivalent.

  • Nine (9) years of contract administration, subcontract administration, and procurement experience.

  • Experience developing and negotiating contracts terms and conditions for contracts related to services, construction, engineering, materials and equipment installation.

  • Experience administering the Request for Proposal/Request for Quotation process.

  • Experience in work change, claims evaluation and negotiation.

  • Experience with Contract Lifecycle Management systems.

Other Requirements:

  • Physical demand level is Sedentary

  • Apply problem-solving skills and use creativity in problem solving.
