Job Summary:

Are you a Dietitian who likes working with kids and wants to work in an engaging team environment, where your recommendations are sought after? Come join our Great Team! This Pediatric Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) will care for patients in Geisinger’s Janet Weis Children’s Hospital, on the campus of Geisinger Medical Center, Danville, PA.
Our Dietitians work with the healthcare team to deliver excellent nutritional care and education for our neonatal and pediatric patients. This includes independent order writing privileges for managing nutritional care of our patients including parenteral and enteral nutrition. Applicants can expect to be a respected and valued part of the healthcare team.

Job Duties:

Provides safe, ethical, and competent evidence-based nutritional therapy that meets the standards of practice and the scope of practice as stated by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics. Manages the individual’s nutrition care in collaboration with the health care team and other nutrition professionals.

  • Using the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics’ and Nutrition Care Process, assesses individual needs through synthesis of information obtained through the assessment interview, food and nutrition and related histories, review of the medical record, and discussion with other members of the interdisciplinary health care team in assigned area
  • Develops a plan to meet assessed needs including recommendations regarding: the composition of diet and meal patterns and supplements; and the volume, rate, and composition of parenteral and enteral feedings.
  • Confers with the health care team to develop goals related to patient care.
  • Documents in accordance with established standards.
  • Evaluates nutritional status of individuals and makes recommendations regarding provision of optimal care.
  • Counsels individuals, families, and care provider on normal nutrition and therapeutic diets with consideration given to the individual's educational, cultural, and socioeconomic background.
  • Plans and conducts group classes for individuals in various areas of nutrition as indicated.
  • Writes nutrition related orders for hospitalized patients in accordance with the Clinical Nutrition policy as indicated.
  • Consults, educates, and advocates on behalf of individuals, groups, and special populations regarding food, culinary, nutrition and health issues, food security and insecurity, nutrition programs, nutrition wellness and resources.
  • Plans for continuing nutrition care for individuals, as needed, using ancillary resources.
  • Self-evaluates results and monitors for trends and changes in productivity related to workload.
  • Compiles statistics and completes Clinical Productivity worksheets on a timely basis.
  • Participates in departmental initiatives to meet strategic goals.
  • Actively participates on appropriate committees for the organization and represents the Clinical Nutrition department in decisions made by these committees.
  • Precept students as indicated. Mentor and train new staff members, colleagues, and other members of the care team as applicable.


Work is typically performed in a clinical environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. The specific statements in this profile are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements considered necessary to successfully perform the job. Additional competencies and skills outlined in any department-specific orientation will be considered essential to the performance of the job related to that position.

Join our team and receive up to a $7,500 joining bonus, plus, relocation assistance for qualified candidates.

As a valued Dietitian at Geisinger, you can expect:

  • Cutting-edge, top-of-scope practice – including independent order writing, protocol medication adjustments, and more

  • Our medical team seeks and implements our recommendations for their patients

  • Career growth through our Professional Development Program

Hours: Full-Time (40 hours per week); M-F 8:00a.m.-4:30 p.m.; some weekends

We Support Flexibility:

Dietitians who have pediatric experience and/or CSP certification are preferred, however not necessary as training can be provided.

Education: Bachelor's Degree is required

Licensure: Pennsylvania Registered Dietitian License is required.

Applicants must be registered or eligible to sit for registration through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR) or qualify under a reciprocity agreement with CDR in conjunction with The Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics (AND)

* Will consider New Graduate Dietitians graduating within 1-2 months. Salary commensurate with experience and credentials.

Benefits of working at Geisinger:

  • Full benefits (health, dental and vision) starting on day one

  • Three medical plan choices, including an expanded network for out-of-area employees and dependents

  • Pre-tax savings plans with healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA) and a health savings account (HSA)

  • Company-paid life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage

  • 401(k) plan that includes automatic Geisinger contributions

  • Generous paid time off (PTO) plan that allows you to accrue time quickly

  • Up to $5,000 in tuition reimbursement per calendar year

  • MyHealth Rewards wellness program to improve your health while earning a financial incentive

  • Family-friendly support including adoption and fertility assistance, parental leave pay, military leave pay and a free Care.com membership with discounted backup care for your loved ones

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Referrals for childcare, eldercare, & pet care. Access free legal guidance, mental health visits, work-life support, digital self-help tools and more.

  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity insurance, identity theft protection, universal life and pet and legal insurance

Bachelor's Degree- (Required)

Communication

title: Platform Operations Engineer - Cambridge MA - 3rd Shift Overnights
description:
Would you like to work on one of the world's most highly distributed computing platform?

Do you enjoy acting quickly to solve problems?

Join our Platform Operations Team

The Platform Operations team in Infrastructure Engineering & Operations focuses on deploying large-scale changes to our numerous networks safely, while optimizing and integrating change safety into GPO's numerous workflows. The team is devoted to solving the toughest technical challenges while implementing changes to optimize efficiency and effectiveness.

Partner with the best

As a Platform Operations Engineer, you will be responsible for change safety in Operations, improving and streamlining existing processes and procedures while being a point person for issues and questions. This role will also participate in the incident reduction initiative and long-term troubleshooting of customer-facing issues triggered by a change on the deployed network.

As a Platform Operations Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues in area of specialty
  • Identifying and implementing process and efficiency improvements in favor of change safety
  • Improving tools, alerts, documentations, and procedures in favor of change safety
  • Maintaining positive relationships across the teams
  • Collaborating with our global Change Safety Optimization team to maintain consistent workflows across the group
  • Working 4:30 PM - 12:30 AM Eastern Standard Time on Monday through Friday in the Cambridge, Massachusetts office for the first six months and can be 50% office and 50% remote after

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in a relevant related technical field or its equivalent
  • Possess experience of administering, monitoring and resolving issues in a high availability platform environment
  • Demonstrate experience of Linux/Unix system and an understanding of SQL and Scripting languages
  • Be experienced in network technologies and internet protocols such as TCP/IP, WAN and DNS
  • Be a team player, able to collaborate, prioritize, and solve problems in an ever-changing environment
  • Have excellent communication and written skills to articulate technical information to internal teams and customers
  • Be required to undergo or possess and maintain a successfully adjudicated USG Tier 3 background investigation

Work in a way that works for you

FlexBase, Akamai's Global Flexible Working Program, is based on the principles that are helping us create the best workplace in the world. When our colleagues said that flexible working was important to them, we listened. We also know flexible working is important to many of the incredible people considering joining Akamai. FlexBase, gives 95% of employees the choice to work from their home, their office, or both (in the country advertised). This permanent workplace flexibility program is consistent and fair globally, to help us find incredible talent, virtually anywhere. We are happy to discuss working options for this role and encourage you to speak with your recruiter in more detail when you apply.

Learn what makes Akamai a great place to work

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

We power and protect life online, by solving the toughest challenges, together.

At Akamai, we're curious, innovative, collaborative and tenacious. We celebrate diversity of thought and we hold an unwavering belief that we can make a meaningful difference. Our teams use their global perspectives to put customers at the forefront of everything they do, so if you are people-centric, you'll thrive here.

Working for you

At Akamai, we will provide you with opportunities to grow, flourish, and achieve great things. Our benefit options are designed to meet your individual needs for today and in the future. We provide benefits surrounding all aspects of your life:

  • Your health
  • Your finances
  • Your family
  • Your time at work
  • Your time pursuing other endeavors

Our benefit plan options are designed to meet your individual needs and budget, both today and in the future.

About us

Akamai powers and protects life online. Leading companies worldwide choose Akamai to build, deliver, and secure their digital experiences helping billions of people live, work, and play every day. With the world's most distributed compute platform from cloud to edge we make it easy for customers to develop and run applications, while we keep experiences closer to users and threats farther away.

Join us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you!

Akamai Technologies is an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer that values the strength that diversity brings to the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race/ethnicity, protected veteran status, disability, or other protected group status.

If no date is displayed, applications are being accepted on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.

title: Lead Logistics Customer Experience and Operations Senior Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Reverse Logistics & Warehouse Returns Specialist to manage end-to-end return operations, inventory reconciliation, warehouse coordination, and transportation execution. The role requires strong SAP knowledge and experience working in warehousing, contract logistics, electronics manufacturing, or supply chain operations environments.

Key Responsibilities

Reverse Logistics Management

  • Manage customer returns, RMA (Return Material Authorization), and return-to-stock processes.
  • Coordinate return shipments between customers, warehouses, repair centers, and carriers.
  • Investigate shipment discrepancies, damaged goods, shortages, and inventory variances.
  • Ensure timely processing of return orders and disposition activities.

Warehouse & Inventory Operations

  • Perform inventory reconciliation and stock movement tracking.
  • Coordinate with warehouse teams for receiving, put-away, transfers, and returns processing.
  • Monitor inventory accuracy and support cycle count activities.
  • Track material movements and inventory adjustments.

SAP Transaction Processing

  • Execute inventory and warehouse transactions in SAP.
  • Process Goods Receipt (GR), Goods Issue (GI), Stock Transfers, and Return Orders.
  • Update material movement records and inventory status.
  • Support inventory reporting and operational controls.

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Work closely with Warehouse, Transportation, Planning, Procurement, and Customer Service teams.
  • Coordinate with logistics providers and carriers for shipment execution.
  • Provide updates on return status, inventory availability, and operational KPIs.

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor return cycle times and operational KPIs.
  • Prepare reports using SAP and Excel.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance productivity and inventory accuracy.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Experience

  • 3–10 years of experience in:
    • Reverse Logistics
    • Warehouse Operations
    • Inventory Management
    • Supply Chain Operations
    • Contract Logistics
    • Returns Management

SAP Knowledge (Preferred)

Experience in one or more:

  • SAP MM (Materials Management)
  • SAP WM (Warehouse Management)
  • SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)
  • SAP SD (Sales & Distribution)

Preferred Process Exposure

  • RMA Processing

  • Inventory Reconciliation
  • Warehouse Coordination
  • Stock Transfers
  • Goods Receipt / Goods Issue
  • Transportation Coordination
  • Inventory Accuracy Management
  • Material Movement Tracking

Tools

  • SAP
  • Advanced Excel
  • Power BI (Preferred)
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)

title: A Lineman - Transmission (Oncor)
description:
Position Summary

The Class A Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Lead crew members in the absence of the Employee in Charge and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefings.

  • Train and mentor apprentices and ground workers.

  • Install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Willing and capable to obtain knowledge in bare hand work – 44kV and 500kV.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at constructions job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: LP Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The LP Analyst Intern will support the daily, monthly, and quarterly reconciliation of limited partner (LP) capital activity, including capital calls, distributions, and capital account statements, working closely with the Reconciliation team to help ensure timely and accurate reporting for fund investors.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in comparing LP capital account data from external fund administrators and general partners against internal records to identify discrepancies.
  • Support daily and monthly reconciliation of capital calls, distributions, and capital account balances.
  • Investigate identified issues within the reconciliation system, seeking support from mentors and department experts as needed.
  • Help build and maintain relationships with data providers, fund administrators, and internal stakeholders.
  • Validate LP-related data against available third-party and fund administrator sources.
  • Record and report the status of daily and monthly reconciliation delivery.
  • Develop familiarity with internal tools and processes used for LP/fund reconciliation.
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external parties to submit inquiries and provide timely status updates on relevant issues.

What You Will Learn

  • Learns to use professional concepts and available resources within the Reconciliation department to problem-solve LP and fund-related discrepancies.
  • Completes all initial new hire certification requirements and works on intermediate-level curriculum.

Technical Competency

  • General Technical Skills: Developing skills in Excel and internal reconciliation tooling and report navigation.
  • Accounting: Basic understanding of investment accounting, capital account statements, and fund-level accounting concepts. Basis agnostic.
  • Finance: Basic understanding of capital calls, distributions, fund performance metrics, and related financial concepts.
  • Asset Classes: Basic knowledge of alternative investment structures, including private equity, venture, and other limited partnership vehicles — what they are and how they are reconciled.
  • Market: Beginning to understand and apply Clearwater's core value proposition (aggregate, reconcile, report) as applied to LP and fund data.

Functional Competency

  • Developing acquired skills, procedures, and decision-making best practices to complete a variety of LP reconciliation issues, with guidance from mentors.
  • Tooling Skills: Beginner to intermediate skills in standard reconciliation tools; familiar with routine tasks but may require assistance with more complex actions.
  • Efficiency: Consistently completes assigned work. When errors occur, proactively learns from them and works to avoid repeat mistakes.
  • Metrics: Manages workflow based on productivity and quality metrics as outlined by the business.

Intangibles

  • Learning how to organize work and showing resilience in a challenging environment.
  • Internal Communication: Applies Level 1 servicing (quick, accurate, thorough responses) with the aid of mentors. Sphere of influence mainly self.
  • External Communication: Beginning to understand and apply Level 1 servicing with the aid of mentors, typically with low- to mid-level external stakeholders such as fund administrators and data providers.

Leadership

  • Oversight: Operates with some level of assistance from team members. Independently answers low-medium complexity queries; may require assistance with medium/high complexity.
  • Continuous Service Improvement: Primary focus is learning. Applies company policies and procedures to resolve issues and navigates knowledge base and documentation.

Requirements

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong accounting and/or finance skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and math skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Excel.
  • Working towards a bachelor's or master's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field.

title: Lead, Network Security Analyst
description:
Job Classification:

Technology - Information Security

Are you interested in building capabilities that enable the organization with innovation, speed, agility, scalability and efficiency? The Global Technology team takes great pride in our culture where digital transformation is built into our DNA. When you join our organization, you will unlock an exciting and impactful career while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world's leading financial services institutions.

Your Team & Role

As a Lead, Network Security Analyst within the Network Security Strategy & Analysis team, within the ISO Infrastructure Security team, you will serve as a senior individual contributor focused on assessing enterprise network security capabilities, identifying risk and technical debt, and developing actionable strategies for Zero Trust, network segmentation, network access control, and network security modernization. You will partner with Network Engineering, Network Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Identity, Architecture, and other security teams to translate analysis into prioritized roadmaps and measurable risk reduction. You will explain difficult concepts, influence stakeholders, and work on extremely complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of risk, controls, architecture, and business impact.

This role does not own day-to-day administration or operations of network security platforms; instead, this team will use analysis to drive environmental hardening and risk reduction. Success requires technical depth, strategic thinking, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to lead work through influence across multiple teams.

Here Is What You Can Expect on a Typical Day

  • Lead complex current-state analysis/assessments of network security architecture, controls, processes, and technical debt across campus, data center, cloud, and remote-access environments.

  • Develop strategic recommendations, target-state architectures, transition roadmaps, and prioritized risk-reduction plans for Zero Trust networking, segmentation, NAC, ZTNA, firewall, proxy, and related capabilities.

  • Analyze architecture, configuration, telemetry, asset, vulnerability, and control data to identify material risks, systemic gaps, and opportunities to harden the environment.

  • Functionally lead workstreams and provide technical guidance to less-experienced team members without direct people-management responsibility.

  • Partner with operational and engineering teams that own the technologies to validate findings, define remediation approaches, establish milestones, and drive agreed actions to completion.

  • Participate in security architecture and design reviews, documenting requirements, assumptions, risks, compensating controls, and recommended decisions.

  • Contribute to reusable reference architectures, security patterns, engineering requirements, decision frameworks, and assessment methods aligned to enterprise standards.

  • Communicate complex network security risks and tradeoffs to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders using concise, evidence-based recommendations.

  • Define outcome-oriented metrics and contribute to executive reporting that demonstrates risk reduction, control maturity, roadmap progress, and technical-debt retirement.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices and recommend where they should influence the network security strategy.

  • Be the network security subject matter expert within the ISO Infrastructure Security Team.

The Skills & Expertise You Bring

  • Bachelor of Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience in related fields.

  • Advanced network security engineering, architecture, advisory, or strategy experience in a large and complex enterprise environment.

  • Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems, develop analysis plans, evaluate alternatives, and deliver clear recommendations with minimal guidance.

  • Ability to functionally lead complex work, mentor others, and effectively leverage diverse ideas, experiences, and perspectives.

  • Strong business insight and the ability to balance security risk, operational feasibility, customer impact, cost, and delivery constraints.

  • Experience with agile delivery or program-management methods and cross-functional execution.

  • Excellent problem solving, written communication, executive presentation, facilitation, and collaboration skills.

Advanced Experience and/or Expertise with Several of the Following

  • Enterprise network architecture and security controls across campus, branch, data center, cloud, internet edge, and remote-access environments.

  • Firewalls, secure web gateways, proxies, ZTNA, VPN, DNS security, WAF, load balancers, and network detection capabilities, including platforms such as Check Point, Cisco, and Zscaler.

  • Zero Trust principles, NIST SP 800-207, identity-aware access, least privilege, continuous verification, and policy-based access models.

  • Network segmentation and microsegmentation strategies, trust-zone design, application dependency analysis, and east-west traffic controls.

  • NAC strategy and design, including device discovery, profiling, authentication, authorization, 802.1X, exception handling, and phased enterprise adoption.

  • Security architecture reviews, threat modeling, risk assessments, control design, compensating controls, and remediation planning.

  • Information Security policies, standards, procedures, engineering specifications, NIST frameworks, ISO 27000 standards, NIST 800-53, and CIS Controls.

  • Security analytics using SIEM, network telemetry, configuration data, asset inventories, vulnerability data, and CMDB/IPAM sources to identify and quantify risk.

  • Metrics, KRIs, KPIs, maturity assessments, business cases, and multi-year security roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SANS GIAC, or comparable security certification.

  • Advanced network or security certifications from Cisco, Check Point, Zscaler, GIAC, or equivalent providers.

  • Experience driving large-scale Zero Trust, segmentation, NAC, firewall modernization, or ZTNA transformation programs.

You'll Love Working Here Because You Can

Join a team and culture where your voice matters and where your work improves security outcomes. As you put your skills to use, we will help you expand both your technical and leadership capabilities through meaningful work and continuous learning.

What we offer you:

You’ll appreciate the beauty of our 26-acre campus nestled conveniently near shopping, dining options, and Bartlesville’s bustling downtown. General Summary:

The PT Day Shift Certified Medication Aide is responsible for providing personal and non-personal care assistance to residents when there is a need and following each resident’s personal plan of care; assists residents so that current living conditions can be maintained for as long as is safe and appropriate; promotes independence with daily activities while giving assistance to each resident.

title: Exercise & Training Analyst
description:
Job Posting End Date

09-27-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

The Exercise & Training Analyst will focus primarily on enterprise training activities, while supporting related exercise activities across Emergency Management, Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, operational resilience, incident management, and enterprise preparedness in alignment with the Enterprise Resilience Policy and the Training, Exercise and Evaluation Standard. This role assists with exercise and training material development, facilitation logistics, evidence collection, exercise documentation, after-action reporting, corrective-action tracking, records maintenance, and program reporting, with an emphasis on establishing and maintaining reliable systems of record for training completion, supporting evidence, and audit-ready documentation. The Analyst supports validation activities by coordinating logistics, capturing evidence, documenting results, and assisting with assessment against defined objectives, assumptions, dependencies, RTO/RPO expectations, validation criteria, and success measures. Assignments may focus on exercise activities, training activities, Disaster Recovery testing, or integrated exercise and training efforts based on program needs. The Analyst contributes to consistent, audit-ready documentation and supports readiness activities under moderate guidance.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

Essential Job Functions & Tasks:

  • Assists with training activities and supports related exercise activities consistent with the Enterprise Resilience Policy, the Training, Exercise and Evaluation Standard, HSEEP methodology, adult learning principles, and enterprise preparedness expectations.

  • Supports assigned exercise activities, training activities, Disaster Recovery testing, or integrated exercise and training efforts based on program needs, role expectations, and enterprise preparedness priorities.

  • Provides and maintains exercise and training materials, curricula, job aids, facilitation materials, learner feedback summaries, completion records, and role-based readiness support for resilience roles and responsibilities.

  • Supports the creation and maintenance of a formal resilience training plan focused on the attitudes, behaviors, and skills needed by resilience stakeholders, from planning-function expectations to role-based responsibilities and readiness requirements.

  • Supports tabletop, functional, full-scale, seminar, workshop, Disaster Recovery testing, and training delivery activities by preparing materials, coordinating logistics, capturing evidence, and documenting results.

  • Establishes, maintains, and supports systems of record for training documentation and evidence, including exercise plans, controller materials, master scenario events lists, validation materials, training attendance records, completion records, evidence artifacts, and audit-ready training documentation.

  • Assists with exercise observations, learner feedback, after-action report support, capability gap identification, training effectiveness review, and improvement recommendations.

  • Consults with Business Units, Operating Companies, and stakeholders on assigned exercise and training requirements, training effectiveness, documentation quality, and program improvement opportunities.

  • Supports corrective-action tracking, improvement-plan follow-up, documentation updates, status reporting, exercise records, calendars, databases, and program reporting.

  • Supports Disaster Recovery testing activities by coordinating logistics, capturing evidence, documenting test results, and assisting with validation of recovery readiness against defined objectives, assumptions, dependencies, RTO/RPO expectations, validation criteria, and success measures.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Basic knowledge of Enterprise Resilience Policy and Training, Exercise and Evaluation Standard expectations; HSEEP methodology, adult learning principles, ICS, NIMS, exercise documentation, corrective-action tracking, instructional design, training facilitation, learning evaluation, virtual facilitation platforms, learning management systems, exercise management tools, and change management concepts.

License(s)/Certification(s) are listed below:

  • HSEEP training, AEM, ABCP, CPTD, ATD certificate programs, Prosci, or equivalent.

Exercise & Training Analyst - Associate (SG6)

Education and Work Experience requirements are listed below:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Business Continuity, Risk Management, Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Business, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant experience.

  • 0-1 year of experience in exercise support, training delivery, emergency management, business continuity, operational resilience, incident management, enterprise preparedness, instructional design, facilitation, evaluation, improvement planning, or related disciplines, including experience supporting exercise documentation, training logistics, records maintenance, and stakeholder coordination.

Exercise & Training Analyst (SG7)

Education and Work Experience requirements are listed below:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Business Continuity, Risk Management, Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Business, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant experience.

Work Experience Requirements are listed below:

  • 2-4 years of experience in exercise support, training delivery, emergency management, business continuity, operational resilience, incident management, enterprise preparedness, instructional design, facilitation, evaluation, improvement planning, or related disciplines, including experience supporting exercise documentation, training logistics, corrective-action tracking, and stakeholder coordination.

title: Administrative Fellow (CS International) - Onsite
description:
Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!

No matter where you live or where you are from, we are here to help you.

Cedars‑Sinai is one of the best hospitals in America. We are ranked nationally in multiple specialties by U.S. News & World Report. Cedars‑Sinai provides expert care and medical treatment using innovative technology and the latest research. Learn more about what makes Cedars-Sinai a top hospital in the U.S. and internationally.

Every year, thousands of patients from around the world receive treatment at Cedars-Sinai. We offer new treatments, surgeries and clinical trials that are only available at a few hospitals in the U.S. Cedars-Sinai is known for ground-breaking medical research and specialized care. We treat each patient with a personalized treatment plan.

Why work here?

Beyond outstanding benefits and competitive salaries, we take pride in hiring the best and most hardworking employees. Our talented members reflect the culturally and ethnically diverse community we serve. They are proof of our commitment to creating an inclusive environment that fuels innovation and the gold standard of patient care we strive for.

What will you be doing:

The Administrative Fellowship (CS International) is designed to prepare professionals to grow as forward-thinking leaders in healthcare administration. This non-clinical fellowship offers a dynamic experience through various rotations, executive exposure, leading high-impact projects aligned with both organizational priorities and individual development goals and hands-on training.

Administrative Fellows are immersed in departmental rotations tailored to the focus of each area and are paired with dedicated mentors who provide guidance through regular check-ins. The Fellow contributes to strategic initiatives and serves as project leads and/or co-leads for at least one project for each rotation and performs analysis to drive meaningful outcomes. Through mentorship, meaningful professional relationships, and experiential learning, fellows build core competencies in healthcare operations, communication, relationship management, project development and execution, budgeting, strategy, and organizational development.

This comprehensive experience equips fellows with the insight and skills needed to lead effectively within a complex and evolving healthcare environment.

  • Engages in structured rotations across different departments or areas to contribute and gain exposure to key functions, operational practices, and strategic priorities.
  • Collaborates with project sponsors to define project scopes, timelines, identify resources and learning objectives; and meets regularly to assess progress and refine goals. Meets with mentor on a recurring basis.
  • Leads, co-leads and takes ownership of at least one high-impact project from initiation to delivery that aligns with organizational priorities and drives meaningful outcomes in each rotation. This includes performing functions such as managing timelines and deliverables, analyzing workflows, identifying opportunities for improvement, and presenting actionable recommendations.
  • Conducts data and operational analysis, prepares presentations, and develops reports and recommendations to support strategic and operational initiatives.
  • Partners with rotation leaders and mentors to define goals for each experience and receive regular, constructive feedback. When working with leadership, may assess other situations, consider alternatives and determine appropriate courses of action for a project and/or an operational initiative.
  • Builds relationships with stakeholders across the organization to gain insight into challenges, innovations, and best practices. Gains in-depth knowledge of day-to-day operations in primary placement rotation departments.
  • Participates in executive and departmental leadership meetings to observe decision-making and contribute when appropriate. Shadows leaders to deepen understanding of institutional goals, programs, and impact.
  • Develops key interpersonal, analytical, and management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.
  • In collaboration with mentors or preceptors, may define, plan and execute one capstone project or a workstream of a major organizational project aligned with organizational priorities; which may include co-leading or facilitating the completion of project deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder communications to ensure successful completion.

Experience Requirements:

One (1) plus year of relevant work experience in business, healthcare, or a related field; this may include internships, practicum placements, or graduate assistantships completed in hospitals, health systems, physician groups, ambulatory settings, public health, health insurance, managed care, or healthcare consulting.

Educational Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Health Sciences, Management or other Fellowship related field.

Master’s degree in Health Administration (MHA), Business Administration (MBA), Public Health (MPH), Health Science (MHS), Public Administration (MPA), Public Policy (MPP), Health Services Administration (MHSA) or a related field. Degree must be completed before Fellowship begins.

title: Principal Project Manager, Rail + Transit
description:
TYLin is a globally recognized, full-service infrastructure consulting firm committed to providing innovative, cost-effective, constructible designs for the global infrastructure market. With over 3,000 employees throughout the Americas, Asia, and Europe, the firm provides support on projects of varying size and complexity. Together, we enhance conventional designs with smarter, more resilient systems. We provide people with better mobility. We steward precious resources by finding more sustainable solutions.

Job Summary

This posting is intended to gather expressions of interest from experienced professionals for anticipated opportunities expected to arise over the next 3-6 months. While an immediate vacancy may not be available, we are building relationships with talented professionals who are interested in joining our Rail + Transit team as new projects and hiring needs materialize.

TYLin is seeking an accomplished Principal Project Manager, Rail & Transit to play a central role in delivering complex rail and transit programs across the Pacific Northwest.

This is a technically focused leadership role for a senior practitioner who thrives on project delivery - someone known for bringing clarity to complexity, leading multidisciplinary teams, and consistently executing at a high level.

You will be a key figure in delivering major rail and transit projects while also supporting client development and pursuits, helping strengthen TYLin’s presence across Washington, Oregon, and the broader Pacific Northwest market.

If you’re at a stage where you want to stay close to the work while still influencing clients, strategy, and growth, this role offers that balance.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

What You’ll Focus On

Lead Delivery of Complex Rail & Transit Projects — Primary Focus (~70%)

  • Serve as Project Manager or Project Director on major rail and transit programs across the Pacific Northwest.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across civil, structural, track, systems, facilities, and other transit disciplines.

  • Drive project execution—including scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and client expectations—from planning through delivery.

  • Act as a senior technical and project delivery authority, providing guidance on design decisions, constructability, coordination, and delivery strategy.

  • Ensure projects are delivered to TYLin’s standards for technical excellence, safety, quality, and client satisfaction.

  • Support coordination with transit agencies, municipalities, contractors, consultants, and project partners throughout all phases of delivery.

  • Help establish strong project teams, accountability, communication, and delivery processes.

Support Client Development & Pursuits — ~30%

  • Leverage existing relationships, market knowledge, and technical credibility to support business development efforts.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients and agencies across the Pacific Northwest transit market.

  • Contribute to pursuits through positioning, capture planning, client engagement, and proposal development.

  • Support interviews and technical presentations, bringing project delivery credibility to pursuit strategies.

  • Help identify and shape new opportunities aligned with TYLin’s rail and transit capabilities.

  • Build relationships across the regional transportation market while strengthening TYLin’s long-term client partnerships.

Mentor & Strengthen Technical Teams

  • Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and project leadership to project managers, engineers, designers, and other technical staff.

  • Help develop the next generation of project delivery leaders within the Rail & Transit practice.

  • Share best practices and help elevate consistency, technical quality, and delivery capability across the team.

  • Contribute to a collaborative, delivery-focused culture grounded in accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

What You Bring

  • 15–25+ years of experience in Rail & Transit project delivery, with a strong emphasis on complex infrastructure programs.

  • Proven track record as a Project Manager or Project Director on major rail, transit, or transportation infrastructure projects.

  • Deep expertise in one or more areas such as civil, structural, track, stations, rail facilities, systems, or transit infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of project execution, including scope, schedule, budget, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and multidisciplinary integration.

  • Established relationships within the Pacific Northwest transportation and transit market, or demonstrated ability to quickly establish credibility and relationships within the region.

  • Experience working with public-sector transportation agencies, transit authorities, municipalities, contractors, and/or major program partners.

  • Experience supporting pursuits and contributing to winning work, without primary responsibility for sales targets or P&L.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.

  • PE, RA, or other relevant professional registration strongly preferred, depending on discipline.

  • Strong communication, leadership, and relationship-building skills.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Delivery-first leadership – Stay close to the technical work and project execution while providing senior-level leadership.

  • High-impact projects – Contribute to complex and highly visible rail and transit programs shaping transportation across the Pacific Northwest.

  • Regional growth opportunity – Play an important role in strengthening and expanding TYLin’s presence across the Pacific Northwest.

  • Balanced role – Influence client relationships, pursuits, and growth without stepping away from project delivery or carrying full P&L responsibility.

  • Influence without bureaucracy – Be a senior voice in how projects are delivered, teams are developed, and opportunities are pursued.

  • Strong platform – Leverage TYLin’s national and international transportation expertise, multidisciplinary capabilities, and established client relationships.

Who This Role Will Suit

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Is a proven project and delivery leader but prefers technical and project leadership over full business-unit management.

  • Enjoys leading complex projects and being accountable for execution and outcomes.

  • Has credibility with clients and technical teams and can build trusted relationships across the transportation industry.

  • Has strong project delivery experience and understands what it takes to successfully coordinate complex, multidisciplinary infrastructure programs.

  • Wants to contribute to growth and strategy while remaining grounded in project delivery.

  • Enjoys mentoring others and helping develop stronger project managers and technical leaders.

  • Is looking for a senior role with meaningful regional impact without stepping fully away from the technical side of the business.


Additional Information

TYLin is committed to pay equity. As part of that commitment, we have provided the base compensation range of $200,000 - $290,000 annually for this position and local market. We recognize that each candidate brings a unique set of skills, experience, education and competencies to the table that will be reflected in our offer. TYLin is proud to offer exciting career development opportunities.

#LI-Hybrid

#LI-GINorthwest

TYLin offers a comprehensive total rewards package. Our benefits may include extensive medical, disability and life insurance coverage, continuing education benefits, paid time off, employee assistance program and a retirement savings plan with company matching contributions.

We encourage all candidates to explore our total rewards offering.

Collaboration, mission-driven focus, discipline, and leadership skills developed through military service benefit us all. Whether you are a Veteran, Guardsman or Reservist, a Military Spouse or you are planning to transition to civilian life in the near future, we welcome and value your application.

TYLin is an equal opportunity employer, and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type as protected by federal, provincial, state or local laws. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The company and its employees are required to comply with all local health authority, legal or lawful client requirements.

title: Servicetekniker inom kontorsmaskiner
description:
Serviceakuten i Malmö söker nu en ny medarbetare

Vi har varit verksamma inom branschen i över 23 år och har fått förtroendet från ett stort antal företag att ta fram effektiva lösningar för utskrifts och dokumenthantering. Vi vet att alla företag, oavsett storlek är beroende av en fungerande kontorsmiljö, då alla driftsstopp innebär att företaget förlorar dyrbar tid. Vi är stolta över vår verksamhet som genomsyras av mycket god service, noggrannhet och flexibilitet. Allt för våra kunders bästa.

Vi söker dig vars personlighet präglas av stort eget ansvarstagande och att du vill utvecklas i det du gör. Vi uppskattar entreprenörskap och personligt engagemang. Att sätta kunden i fokus är självklart för dig.

Servicenivån till våra kunder utgör grunden till våra fortsatta framgångar, det är därför mycket viktigt att du är lyhörd för kundens önskemål samt har en hög servicekänsla.

Arbetsbeskrivning:

Som Servicetekniker hos oss kommer du att arbeta omväxlande inne i vår verkstad/kontor i Malmö och på plats ute hos våra kunder. I verkstaden arbetar du med b.la. montage av kopieringsmaskiner, installationer, reparationer och felsökning, här arbetar du även med support. Ute hos våra kunder ansvarar du för arbetsuppgifter så som installationer, service, support samt enklare information/utbildning i hur våra maskiner fungerar. Din arbetsplats är i första hand Malmö med omnejd, men vi vill poängtera att det är vanligt förekommande med kunduppdrag i hela Skåne samt ibland även i övriga Sverige. Vi kommer utbilda dig löpande internt. I huvudsak består arbetet av reparation och felsökning samt installationer av kontorsmaskiner hos kund. I tjänsten krävs att du har B-körkort. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.

Vem är du?

För denna tjänst krävs ingen specifik utbildning, snarare rätt personliga egenskaper. Du har stor social kompetens, är praktiskt lagd, lösningsfokuserad med ett utmärkt kundbemötande. Du som person är serviceinriktad, flexibel, utåtriktad och har ett gott ordningssinne.

Du kan en del om IT och har grundläggande förståelse för nätverk. Du har ett logiskt tänkande vilket gör dig till en teknisk problemlösare.

Vi vill gärna att du har intresse av att utvecklas tillsammans med oss och vi med dig. Med det menar vi att du brinner för både din egen och företagets utveckling. Att din arbetsmoral är hög ser vi som självklart. Du har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Då våra system är databaserade ser vi att du är tekniskt lagd med goda IT-kunskaper.

title: Operator - 3rd Shift
description:
Mylan Technologies, Inc.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

This posting supports ongoing hiring needs and may be used to consider candidates for upcoming opportunities.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Operator role will make an impact:

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Visually inspect the product during operation, observe equipment and process for proper operation, seek maintenance assistance for problems and recommend improvements.

  • Assist with the set up and running of Production equipment.

  • Prepare and clean manufacturing rooms and equipment for inspection as required and keep work area in a clean and orderly condition.

  • Ensure all products are properly labeled and stored.

  • Document material runs via Batch Production Records, In-Process Sheets, Log Books, and Time Sheets.

  • Assist in training new personnel in the manufacturing operation as directed by the supervisor or manager.

  • Perform calibration on scales, line meters, coating ovens, micrometers, etc as instructed.

  • Coordinate the work of other Operators and acts as a back up to Senior Operator as directed by the supervisor or manager.

The minimum qualifications for this role are:

  • HS diploma

  • Minimum of one year of experience is required. However, a combination of experience and/or education will be taken into consideration.

  • Must possess good mechanical, communication, time management, organizational, interpersonal, and writing skills, and computer skills including Microsoft Word and Excel and Lotus Notes.

title: Software Engineer II - Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer II for the Login Services Platform Engineering team within Core Security Engineering. Our mission is to build the foundational identity platform that Uber's security and infrastructure organization runs on — spanning how we govern non-human identities, how we model identity and access as queryable knowledge, and how we authenticate and authorize both people and autonomous agents at scale.

You'll work across three interconnected platform programs: Non-Human Identity (NHI) Governance, the Security Knowledge Graph, and uSSO / Agentic R&D. Each is foundational infrastructure that other security and engineering teams build on top of — which means the systems you write need to be correct, observable, and safe to depend on.

What You'll Do

Non-Human Identity Governance — Build the tooling and detection logic that governs the sprawling web of permissions between personnel, workloads, agents, service accounts, and infrastructure. Develop inventory and risk-identification pipelines that surface dangerous patterns — runaway group membership, over-privileged service accounts — before they become incidents. Contribute to eliminating personnel misuse of non-human identities by migrating credentials to secretless patterns and onboarding privileged access management (PAM) enforcement.

Security Knowledge Graph — Help build a single, queryable knowledge graph of identity, assets, ownership, and access controls that is becoming foundational to Uber's security infrastructure strategy. Design and ship the ingestion framework, CI/CD pipeline, and self-service tooling (schema browsing, query benchmarking, scaffolding) that let any security or infra team onboard their own data sources without bespoke integration work. Build toward near-real-time ingestion for high-value signals like access and group-membership changes, and extend the graph to support both human consumers (dashboards, investigation tools) and AI agents querying it directly.

uSSO / Agentic R&D — Help evolve uSSO into an identity platform that works natively for both humans and autonomous agents, strengthening authentication as more of Uber's workload shifts to agentic systems acting on behalf of people and services. This means building the underlying platform to be robust and agent-compatible, and defining how Uber issues, verifies, and scopes identity for agents — establishing clear on-behalf-of relationships and policy standards for how agents can safely access production systems and SaaS.

Diagnose and resolve complex distributed-systems problems across these platforms under continuous, high-volume, security-critical traffic — with a focus on correctness, latency, and operational resilience.

Basic Qualifications

4+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in a production environment.

Ability to take ownership of a well-scoped technical problem, break it into concrete steps, and drive it to completion with appropriate urgency.

Working knowledge of backend infrastructure fundamentals: service architecture, data stores, caching, and asynchronous/event-driven messaging.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with graph data models and query languages (e.g., Cypher), or with streaming/near-real-time data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Flink).

Experience with identity and access management concepts: service accounts, privileged access management, non-human identity, OAuth, or SSO.

Interest or experience in emerging problems around AI agent identity and authorization — how autonomous systems should be authenticated, scoped, and audited.

Familiarity with Golang and with modernizing legacy backend systems.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year - USD $190,000 per year.

You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

title: Software Developer (InteleShare)
description:
We are seeking a Software Developer to join the InteleShare team and contribute to Intelerad's secure, cloud-based medical image sharing platform. In this role, you will design and deliver features that connect healthcare providers, imaging centers, hospitals, and patients — enabling timely, accurate diagnoses across institutions and geographies. You will work within a cross-functional Agile team, take ownership of features end to end, and contribute to a platform that handles DICOM medical imaging at scale.

InteleShare is a polyglot platform: a Perl/mod_perl services tier on PostgreSQL, a JavaScript web client (jQuery and vanilla JavaScript across the established pages, React and TypeScript in newer areas), a Java (Spring Boot) storage service backed by S3 and other cloud object stores, and a C#/.NET on-premises harvester that speaks DICOM and HL7 to customer PACS. You will start in one or two of these codebases and grow into the others over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain features across the InteleShare web application and services tier — typically the web front end (jQuery and vanilla JavaScript in the established pages, React in newer areas) and the Perl service APIs it calls — taking ownership from scoping through delivery, ensuring solutions are tested, documented, and meet sprint commitments.
  • Write and tune PostgreSQL queries and schema changes for a large, high-volume production database, following the team's schema versioning and migration process.
  • Translate customer support escalations and stakeholder requirements into well-engineered technical solutions, reproducing issues across the full stack (browser, API, database, storage, DICOM/HL7 interfaces) and resolving root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Contribute to code quality through thorough pull request reviews, unit and integration tests, and clear documentation, supporting team-wide standards and knowledge sharing.
  • Support DevOps and operational initiatives including containerized AWS/Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, and participation in production troubleshooting alongside senior engineers.
  • Work as a full-stack generalist across languages and codebases as business needs evolve, identifying opportunities for improvement and taking the initiative to implement them within an Agile/Scrum workflow.

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • 3+ years of professional web application development experience, or equivalent experience with a demonstrable track record of delivering production-quality software.
  • Proficiency in at least one server-side language (Perl, Python, Java, C#, Ruby, PHP, or equivalent) and willingness to become productive in Perl, which powers the InteleShare services tier.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including the ability to read query plans and diagnose slow queries.
  • Solid JavaScript skills, including direct DOM and jQuery work; experience with React or a comparable component framework.
  • Proven ability to work independently in a distributed team environment, managing priorities and delivering outcomes with minimal oversight.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex, long-term goals into well-scoped, deliverable increments.
  • Comfort working across multiple languages, frameworks, and problem domains as business needs evolve.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Perl development experience (mod_perl or other server-side Perl).
  • REST API and PostgreSQL database development expertise.
  • Frontend development experience: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS/LESS, and React (with Redux, TypeScript, and a component library such as Ant Design in newer areas); familiarity with webpack, Jest, and Playwright or Selenium.
  • Familiarity with containerized deployment: building Docker images and working with Helm charts in a Kubernetes pod deployment model.
  • Git/GitHub version control experience and familiarity with unit and integration testing best practices.
  • AWS cloud services knowledge (S3, EC2, RDS, ECR, CloudWatch).
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology in fast-paced development environments.
  • Background in healthcare technology: DICOM, HL7, FHIR, medical imaging, or radiology workflow understanding.
  • Exposure to a regulated development environment (HIPAA, FDA, ISO 13485/9001, or similar).

title: Analista De Qualidade (Validação) - Fabrica Valinhos
description:
Analista de Validação, as competências mais valorizadas combinam conhecimento técnico, regulatório, estatístico e de gestão de projetos. Considerando os temas de validação discutidos na reunião Assessment RDC 48 - Valinhos, os principais focos estão em validação de processos, qualificação de equipamentos, validação de sistemas de água, métodos analíticos e sistemas computadorizados.

Competências Técnicas

1. Validação de Processos

Capacidade de demonstrar que os processos produzem consistentemente produtos dentro das especificações.

Conhecimentos esperados:

  • Ciclo de validação.
  • Análise de risco.
  • Protocolos e relatórios de validação.
  • Revalidação periódica.
  • Critérios de aceitação.

Exemplos em Personal Care:

  • Fabricação de sabonetes.
  • Misturas
  • Envases
  • Processos de sanitização.

2. Qualificação de Equipamentos (IQ/OQ/PQ)

Domínio das etapas de:

  • IQ (Installation Qualification).
  • OQ (Operational Qualification).
  • PQ (Performance Qualification).

Equipamentos típicos:

  • Estufas.
  • Geladeiras.
  • Fluxo laminar.
  • Autoclaves.
  • Equipamentos analíticos.
  • Tanques e misturadores.

A necessidade de qualificação de equipamentos laboratoriais foi um dos pontos abordados na avaliação regulatória da fábrica.

3. Validação de Limpeza

Avaliar e documentar a eficácia dos processos de limpeza.

Competências:

  • Definição de pontos críticos.
  • Amostragem por swab.
  • Estudos microbiológicos.
  • Limites de resíduos.
  • Recuperação analítica.

Relaciona-se diretamente aos procedimentos internos de limpeza, sanitização e monitoramento microbiológico da fábrica.

4. Validação de Métodos Analíticos

Conhecimento dos parâmetros de validação:

  • Exatidão.
  • Precisão.
  • Linearidade.
  • Robustez.
  • Especificidade.
  • Faixa analítica.
  • Limite de detecção e quantificação.

Para quem trabalha com laboratório, esta é uma das competências mais valorizadas.

5. Validação do Sistema de Água

Conhecimentos em:

  • Água potável.
  • Água purificada.
  • Pontos de uso.
  • Mapeamento do sistema.
  • Monitoramento microbiológico.
  • Investigação de desvios.

O sistema de água foi identificado como uma das áreas prioritárias para formalização e validação.

6. Validação de Sistemas Computadorizados

Capacidade de atuar com:

  • SAP.
  • MES.
  • Quality One.
  • Sistemas laboratoriais.
  • Integridade de dados.

A validação desses sistemas foi apontada como necessária no contexto regulatório discutido pela fábrica.

Competências Regulatórias

Conhecimento de normas e legislações

Cosméticos

  • RDC 48/2013.
  • ISO 22716.
  • Boas Práticas de Fabricação.

Qualidade

  • CAPA.
  • Change Control.
  • Desvios.
  • OOS.
  • Investigação de causa raiz.

A reunião destacou a necessidade de fortalecer processos de validação, investigação e documentação para atendimento regulatório.

Competências Estatísticas

Um diferencial extremamente valorizado.

Ferramentas:

  • ANOVA.
  • Regressão.
  • Capabilidade.
  • CEP.
  • Estudos de tendência.
  • Definição de tamanho amostral.
  • Estatística para validação.

Pela sua experiência com análises estatísticas, essa já é uma competência forte no seu perfil.

Competências em Gestão de Projetos

O Analista de Validação normalmente coordena atividades multidisciplinares.

Necessita:

  • Gestão de cronograma.
  • Gestão de stakeholders.
  • Priorização de riscos.
  • Gestão de documentação.

Ferramentas Digitalmente Valorizadas

title: Vice President, Consumer Packaged Goods
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment.

When you join BW Design Group as a Vice President, Consumer Packaged Goods, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world’s leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Architecture + Engineering + Construction (AEC) Business and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.

Role Overview
We are seeking a Vice President, Consumer Packaged Goods to build, secure, and execute large-scale capital programs ($100M+), with direct accountability for bookings, commercial strategy, and delivery outcomes. This client-facing growth leadership role blends strategic client alignment with deep technical expertise to expand multi-project initiatives across processing, packaging, utilities, and facility modernization—including hygienic design, cold chain, and regulated food manufacturing environments—in both brownfield and greenfield settings.

Operating outside traditional utilization expectations (e.g., billable hours), the role is measured by bookings, margin-aware account growth, delivery performance, and long-term client value—empowering you to focus on high-impact client strategy, pursuit leadership, and capital alignment in an entrepreneurial environment. Dedicated preconstruction, engineering, and construction teams support the role, ensuring technical depth and delivery leadership partnership complement your accountability in client development. Success in this role is defined by secured bookings, profitable delivery of multi-project capital programs, and sustained executive-level client relationships.

What You’ll Do

  • Own bookings targets, pricing strategy, and commercial positioning, developing opportunities into secured design-build (DB) and engineer-procure-construct (EPC) initiatives supporting food and beverage processing, packaging, utilities, and distribution facilities—leveraging your technical insights to achieve outcomes.
  • Engage client executive stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) to align capital investment with growth, reliability, Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA)/Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) compliance, and speed-to-market objectives.
  • Lead pursuit strategy and executive presentations; negotiate commercial terms, delivery approach, pricing, and risk allocation with direct accountability for contractual outcomes, drawing on technical expertise to build client trust.
  • Lead internal subject matter experts (SMEs) across process, architecture/engineering (A/E), preconstruction, construction, and controls to deliver integrated DB/EPC solutions.
  • Participate in go/no-go reviews, pipeline governance, forecasting, and customer relationship management (CRM) discipline to support predictable growth and backlog health.
  • Serve as executive sponsor through execution and closeout, remaining accountable for client satisfaction, commercial performance, and long-term account profitability.

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years leading and delivering capital programs for manufacturing clients in a design-build, EPC, or integrated A/E/C environment—particularly within food, beverage, CPG, or other regulated production environments—with personal responsibility for securing work, pricing, and delivery execution.
  • Deep understanding of food manufacturing operations, including people and material flows, hygienic zoning, adjacency planning, reliability constraints, and operational readiness across processing and utility systems, applied to inform client alignments and de-risking strategies.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary delivery teams with authority over scope, cost, schedule, and margin.
  • This role requires ownership of commercial outcomes and delivery risk within a DB/EPC model, using technical expertise to secure and execute high-value contracts.
  • Use industry experience and technical knowledge in delivery strategy development and cost/schedule de-risking, including preconstruction, constructability, phasing, shutdown/tie-in planning, and risk management—all to support client pursuits and margin-aware growth.
  • Food & Beverage manufacturing experience strongly preferred; Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) or life sciences/pharma experience transferable where candidates have delivered regulated, capital-intensive manufacturing facilities.
  • Experience working in quality-driven and regulated environments; Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP)/current GMP (cGMP) and HACCP exposure a plus.
  • Executive-level communication skills with the ability to influence and align technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel for client engagement, site walkdowns, and industry events.
  • BS or MS in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) preferred but not required; Master of Business Administration (MBA) and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) a plus.


At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. A successful Senior Managing Director has a market presence and a strong client reference list based on experience.

• The individual should possess an active network of client Board and C-suite contacts, and proven ability to convert client references into new business. The ideal candidate will be able to originate at least $4 million in annual sales of consulting services. Sales pursuits typically involve teaming with others to sell various service capabilities.

• Exhibit leadership skills which serve as a model for FTI personnel, and which serve to engage and motivate superior performance.

• Recruit, train, develop and evaluate client service personnel.

• Demonstrate project management and client management expertise.

• Lead the production of client service methodology and engagement deliverables.

• Manage client engagement risk and exhibit creative problem solving techniques to address client service delivery challenges.

• Provide strategic insights to aid in guiding project direction and outcomes.

• Travel required to clients and to FTI office(s)

• A Bachelor’s degree from accredited college/university, advanced degree preferred.

• CPA, CIRA, CTP or equivalent certification preferred.

• Minimum of 20 years of relevant business transformation consulting experience, including with a nationally recognized firm.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders to achieve mutual outcomes.

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in project management, preferably in electrical construction. Knowledge of construction technology, scheduling, equipment and methods required.

title: Spacecraft Operations Systems Engineer, Mid-Career
description:
Spacecraft Operations Systems Engineer, Mid-Career

The Boeing Company

The Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS) organization is seeking a Mid Level Spacecraft Operations Systems Engineer to join our team in Springfield, Virginia.

The candidate will work at a spacecraft ground station as a part of a Mission Operations team. The Command and Control Engineering team is responsible for all aspects of spacecraft operations and maintenance.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for all aspects of spacecraft operations, mission planning and/or monitoring and trending the on-orbit spacecraft telemetry looking for adverse trends that could affect operations, as well as planning and execution of all required spacecraft maintenance and recovery from spacecraft anomalies.

  • Coordinate with management and peers to ensure the integrity of high quality operational products, including procedures, tools, detailed event logging, and system configuration.

  • Analyze technical data, verify and sustain specific systems configuration in accordance with defined constraints and operational requirements.

  • Mentor trainees to complete training and certification, includes providing training opportunities and oversight.
