title: Security Systems Designer II
description:
Job Description:

This role is responsible for the overall design of security systems projects, including access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, fire/life-safety interfaces, networking, power, pathways, and related low-voltage system components. The role works closely with sales, project management, operations, field personnel, customers, engineers, IT stakeholders, and other trades to incorporate project requirements and develop complete, coordinated security system designs. This role supports submittals, bill of materials development, redlines, as-builts, and design updates throughout the project lifecycle. Previous work experience with electronic safety and security systems, low-voltage construction, system integration, and drafting is helpful in order to succeed in this position. Contributes to the desired safety and work culture of the organization.

Pre-Design Drawings/Development:

  • Confer with engineering, marketing, production, or sales departments, or with customers, to establish and evaluate design concepts, designs, and operational plans.

  • Meet with customers, project teams, specialists, and stakeholders to confirm security system intent, owner standards, access control requirements, camera coverage, alarm points, fire/life-safety interfaces, network needs, and project scope before design development.

Design Drawings/Development:

  • Produce electrical, electronic, or mechanical drawings, sketches, blueprints, and/or engineering instructions for assembly, or other related documents or graphics necessary for security design.

  • Translate security drawings into design specifications

  • Examine project plans, specifications, door schedules, reflected ceiling plans, network standards, estimates, take-off sheets, and owner requirements to design effective and coordinated security systems.

Responding to Changes in Scope:

  • Consult with engineers to ensure that security equipment or systems meet design specifications.

  • Maintains close contact with system specialist personnel and, depending on location, respond to material needs as they arise.

  • Modify, refine, or update designs to conform with customer specifications, production limitations, I/O on controller, or changes in design trends as needed.

  • Update device layouts, risers, point lists, camera schedules, access control point lists, intrusion zone lists, and security system design documents based on field changes and approved scope revisions.

  • Stay current with security system technology, networked devices, video platforms, access control panels, intrusion systems, fire/life-safety interfaces, licensing, cabling, power, and integration requirements.

Choosing Parts for Security Systems:

  • Research security equipment and related component needs, sources, competitive prices, delivery times, licensing requirements, compatibility, and ongoing operational costs.

  • Select access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, fire interface, network, power, cabling, and field device components that meet project specifications and functional requirements.

  • May prepare material lists, coordinate substitutions, confirm product compatibility, and submit purchase requests for outside material.

Customer Service and Coordination:

  • Present designs, submittals, reports, device layouts, and system concepts to customers, engineers, project teams, and other stakeholders for review and approval.

  • Independently and proactively resolves conflicts, questions, and coordination gaps involving doors, power, network, pathways, fire/life-safety interfaces, ceiling conditions, device locations, and owner standards before final system designs are issued.

  • May respond to Requests for Information (RFIs), support design clarifications, and help customers or engineers understand security system functionality, limitations, and project impacts.

Documentation:

  • Prepares completed job documentation, including submittals, device schedules, risers, bill of materials, cable schedules, installation details, programming requirements, commissioning documents, and closeout documents that meet contract requirements.

  • Generate security system input/output summaries, door hardware coordination notes, camera schedules, access control point lists, intrusion zone lists, and related design records.

  • Document changes in material, equipment, device locations, network requirements, system configuration, and field conditions.

  • Interpret change order requests and take necessary design action to support project completion, accurate pricing, and final documentation.

Training:

  • Instruct individuals on how to properly and efficiently operate technical tools and equipment.

  • Help individuals understand how to affectively implement ideas.

  • Guide individuals through the work day to assist with any needed tasks.

  • Suggest new ways of doing or thinking about tasks to improve efficiency and/or quality of work.

title: Manufacturing Estimator
description:
Job Description Summary

As an Estimator, you will be responsible for accurately estimating the cost, materials, and labor required for projects. You will collaborate closely with Production Managers, Engineers, VDC/BIM, Project Managers, Purchasing, and external customers to ensure that manufactured products are delivered on time and within budget. Your role will involve analyzing project specifications, interpreting blueprints, and assessing resource requirements to develop comprehensive cost estimates.



Job Description:

Role & Responsibilities

Project Analysis:

  • Review project specifications, drawings, and other relevant documents to understand project requirements.

  • Identify and assess the scope of work, including the types and quantities of components needed for manufacturing.

Cost Estimation:

  • Utilize estimating software and tools to calculate the cost of materials, labor, equipment, and other resources required for manufacturing.

  • Conduct cost analysis based on historical data, market trends, and supplier quotations.

  • Prepare detailed cost estimates and proposals for submission to clients.

Material Takeoff:

  • Perform material takeoffs from blueprints and specifications to determine the quantities of electrical components needed for manufacturing.

  • Create bills of materials (BOMs) and procurement lists for purchasing departments.

Collaboration:

  • Coordinate with Production Managers, Engineers, VDC, Project Managers, External Customers and Purchasing teams to ensure alignment on project requirements and timelines.

  • Communicate effectively with suppliers and subcontractors to obtain pricing and lead time information for electrical materials and components.

Risk Assessment:

  • Identify potential risks and challenges associated with manufacturing projects, such as material availability, lead times, and cost fluctuations.

  • Develop mitigation strategies to address risks and ensure project success.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Stay updated on industry best practices, technological advancements, and market trends related to manufacturing.

  • Recommend process improvements and cost saving measures to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the estimating process.



Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or associate’s degree in an Engineering discipline (civil, mechanical, electrical, industrial,) Construction Management, or related major preferred.

  • Proven estimating experience in manufacturing or general or electrical construction preferred.

  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting electrical drawings, blueprints, and specifications.

  • Strong analytical and mathematical skills with attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with estimating software and tools (e.g., Accubid, Trimble, Bluebeam).

  • Excellent communication and people skills for effective collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to think critically.

  • Knowledge of electrical codes, regulations, and industry standards.



Physical Requirements


•This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, filing cabinets, photocopiers and fax machines.
•Employees are frequently required to sit, and occasionally required to kneel, reach, stoop, crouch or crawl.
•This position requires the ability to lift files, open file cabinets, and bend or stand as necessary.

Travel Consultant

The Senior Special Investigative Unit (SIU) Auditor investigates and audits potential healthcare fraud, waste, abuse, and coding irregularities across claims, billing, documentation, and reimbursement. This role requires advanced auditing expertise, industry-specific investigative knowledge, and sound judgment to identify and address improper billing and reimbursement. You will also lead proactive audit initiatives that strengthen oversight and protect the integrity of the claims process.

What You’ll Do

Audit and Coding Review

  • Conduct retrospective and prospective audits of medical claims, provider billing, coding, and clinical documentation.
  • Validate CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, DRG, modifier, and revenue code accuracy and reimbursement compliance.
  • Apply knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, and disease processes when evaluating records.

Investigative Analysis and Fraud Prevention

  • Analyze billing trends and data to identify suspicious activity, improper reimbursement, and emerging risk.
  • Develop fraud prevention strategies and support provider education, remediation, and corrective action.
  • Use sound judgment to independently investigate complex issues and recommend next steps.

Reporting, Compliance, and Case Documentation

  • Prepare clear audit findings, overpayment determinations, investigative documentation, and recommendations for leadership.
  • Maintain confidentiality, chain-of-custody standards, and compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and coding guidance.

Legal Support, Collaboration, and Operational Execution

  • Manage multiple audits and investigations, coordinating priorities, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners and provide affidavits or sworn testimony when needed.
  • Mentor junior auditors and lead process improvements and proactive audit initiatives.

  • 5 years of healthcare coding, auditing, SIU, compliance investigation, claims analysis, appeals, provider dispute, or related experience (Required)

  • Additional certification such as CPC-P, CPMA, CCS, CFE, or CHC preferred
  • Experience with SIU case management systems, SQL, Excel, and data analytics or audit tools.

title: Production Control Clerk II
description:

Job Description

The Production Control Clerk performs clerical tasks in the production control function. One coordinates and controls work orders released to Production as well as goods moving back and forth between Production and Flight Team.

description:
.

At Anglian Water, we stand out as a frontrunner in providing water and water recycling services in the UK, setting the industry standard for quality and customer service. What truly sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to offering the support and growth opportunities that empower our teams to make a tangible impact on our customers and the environment.

Our dedicated team, comprised of skilled professionals, plays a crucial role in delivering key services. We take pride in collecting and treating water, ensuring its return to the environment through rivers and coastal outlets. With over 7,000 pumping stations and a network of 76,000 kilometres of sewers directing to more than 1,000 water recycling centres, our team is at the heart of a vital and impactful operation.

Join us and be part of a team where your skills and passion can make a real difference. We believe in creating an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we welcome all candidates who are ready to contribute their unique perspectives and skills to our mission of environmental stewardship.

What you will be doing?

Join our team as a Field Technician in Water Recycling Services, where you'll play a vital role in safeguarding the environment, public health and maintaining critical infrastructure. You’ll tackle issues in our network including blockages, odours, flooding and incidents. You'll deliver exceptional service levels to our customers while adhering to environmental regulatory standards.

As part of our standby roster, you'll be ready to tackle additional out-of-hours work, ensuring uninterrupted service delivery. Safety is paramount in all aspects of the role, and you'll be expected to uphold health and safety protocols diligently.

If you are passionate about joining a team dedicated to environmental stewardship and play a hands-on role in our operations, then we’d love to hear from you!

Your duties will include:

  • Operating a single person, high pressure water jetting unit which you will be trained in as well as specific CCTV equipment- helping to identify and promote repair work for any problems found on our sewerage network.
  • Taking ownership for investigating and offering first time resolutions for sewerage issues encountered by our customers.
  • Responding to incidents, and completing planned maintenance work
  • Accurately collating and recording all feedback from site through our IT systems.
  • Predominately lone working, engaging with both our internal and external customers on a daily basis.

What does it take to be a Field Technician?

  • Experience or willingness to work outside in all weathers, hands on/manual experience is beneficial
  • Good IT literacy, with the ability to confidently use handheld devices, mobile applications and digital systems to record work activities, update job records and communicate effectively with customers and colleagues.
  • Ability to work autonomously as well using your own initiative
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally and empathetically with customers, particularly during service disruptions, incidents and potentially challenging situations.
  • Full driving license- having a 4.5 tonne license would be advantageous as the role will eventually require this (training will be provided if needed)
  • In this role you must be able to work within a confined space, and at height without restrictions. Due to harness weight limits, your maximum weight cannot be in excess of 113 kilograms, and you will be expected to complete relevant occupational health checks including Hand-arm Vibration (HAV)

Inclusion at Anglian Water:

Inclusion is for everyone and we are an equal opportunity employer, which means we’ll consider all suitably qualified applicants regardless of gender identity or expression, ethnic origin, nationality, religion or beliefs, age, sexual orientation, disability status or any other protected characteristic. We recruit and develop our people based on merit and their passion for creating better outcomes, and we’re committed to creating an environment where all our colleagues feel they belong.

description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will help shape the future of investing at Empower by leading the evolution of our digital brokerage experience.

This role sits at the intersection of brokerage, equity compensation, and Empower’s broader financial ecosystem. In the near term, you will lead efforts to create a more connected and intuitive experience across Empower Personal Dashboard, our Stock Plan Services capabilities, and Pershing’s NetX Investor services. At the same time, you will play a key role in advancing Empower’s native brokerage experience, creating a modern investing experience that is increasingly integrated into the broader Empower ecosystem.

Our ambition is to make Empower a financial home base where customers can understand their complete financial picture, manage their workplace equity and investments, and take action with confidence, all through a cohesive digital experience.

You will bring deep knowledge of digital brokerage and Stock Plan Services experiences, strong product judgment, customer obsession, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership. You should understand both the complexity behind brokerage and equity compensation and what customers increasingly expect from modern investing experiences.

You will partner closely with our equity compensation product lead, engineering, design, research, operations, compliance, business leaders, and external brokerage and technology partners to simplify that complexity and create experiences customers want to use.

What You Will Do

  • Refine the vision and roadmap for Empower’s digital brokerage experience, spanning Stock Plan Services, existing brokerage capabilities, and the evolution toward a more cohesive native Empower investing experience.

  • Collaborate and define the product strategy for connecting Empower’s Personal Dashboard, Stock Plan Services via OptionTrax platform, and Pershing’s NetX Investor experiences as well as progressing our emerging native brokerage capabilities into intuitive customer journeys.

  • Identify opportunities to eliminate fragmentation across platforms and create a more seamless experience for customers moving between workplace equity, brokerage accounts, and their broader financial lives.

  • Help shape and build Empower’s next-generation brokerage capabilities, applying customer expectations and best practices from leading digital investing platforms while creating an experience differentiated by Empower’s broader financial ecosystem.

  • Own critical end-to-end experiences for stock plan participants, including equity awards, holdings, transactions, account experiences, and the transition from workplace equity into broader investing and wealth-building journeys.

  • Translate complex brokerage, equity compensation, operational, regulatory, and technology requirements into experiences that feel simple and intuitive to customers.

  • Partner with engineering, design, research, operations, compliance, and business teams from discovery through launch and ongoing optimization.

  • Partner effectively with external brokerage, clearing, custody, stock plan, and technology providers while maintaining ownership of the end customer experience.

  • Develop a deep understanding of customer needs through qualitative research, usability testing, behavioral data, competitive research, and direct customer feedback.

  • Define and track measures of success across adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, transaction behavior, asset retention and consolidation, and overall digital experience.

  • Use experimentation, analytics, rapid validation, and customer feedback to test hypotheses and continuously improve the product.

  • Navigate the full product lifecycle—from defining the problem and product strategy through requirements, prioritization, delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.

  • Influence the longer-term investing strategy at Empower by identifying new capabilities and experiences that can make Empower a more valuable destination for customers' financial lives.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including significant experience building and leading complex digital consumer financial products.

  • Directly relevant experience with digital brokerage, Stock Plan Services, equity compensation, or investing products, with a strong understanding of the customer journeys and infrastructure that power these experiences.

  • Experience designing digital experiences for stock plan participants, including familiarity with equity awards and the lifecycle of employee equity compensation.

  • Strong understanding of brokerage customer experiences, including areas such as account opening, funding, positions and balances, trading, transactions, statements, servicing, and portfolio experiences.

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify technically and operationally complex financial products into intuitive customer experiences.

  • Experience working across internal platforms and third-party providers to deliver an experience that feels cohesive to the end customer.

  • Proven experience owning the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and product strategy through execution, launch, measurement, and optimization.

  • Strong product judgment and an appreciation for excellent consumer product design, including the ability to distinguish between simply delivering functionality and creating an experience customers value.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using quantitative and qualitative insights to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and measure outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align engineering, design, business, operations, compliance, and other stakeholders around a product vision.

  • A strong customer orientation and demonstrated ability to solve complex customer and business problems.

What Will Set You Apart

  • 3+ years of directly relevant experience building digital Stock Plan Services, brokerage, or investing experiences.

  • Experience building digital experiences for equity compensation products, including restricted stock, employee stock purchase plans, stock options, or similar programs.

  • Experience building or modernizing a direct-to-consumer brokerage experience, particularly across account opening, funding, trading, portfolio management, or brokerage servicing.

  • Experience integrating third-party brokerage, clearing, custody, or stock plan infrastructure while owning the customer-facing experience.

  • Experience bringing traditionally fragmented financial experiences together into a cohesive digital ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with the product patterns and customer expectations established by leading digital brokerage and investing platforms.

  • Experience operating in a regulated financial-services environment and partnering effectively with legal, risk, compliance, and operations teams.

  • Fintech experience and strong knowledge of emerging investing and brokerage trends.

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup

Relevant du vice-président aux placements, ce rôle vise essentiellement à soutenir les conseillers et à stimuler les ventes régionales de produits de Gestion de patrimoine de HUB.

  • Connaissance approfondie des fonds distincts et des fonds communs de placement.

  • Attitude positive, fort désir d'aider les autres, curiosité intellectuelle et un bilan de rendement constant.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale.

  • Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes avec une attention exceptionnelle aux détails.

  • Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office et connaissance des principales plateformes de réunion en ligne.

  • Formation postsecondaire d'une université ou d'un collège accrédité.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Votre bien-être est notre priorité, et nous le soutenons grâce à une multitude d'avantages :

Dans cet esprit, nous avons conçu notre processus de sélection pour qu'il soit accessible à tous. Nous vous encourageons à nous faire savoir si vous avez besoin d'aide ou d'accommodements pendant le processus de recrutement. Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances pour chaque candidat de réussir et de s'épanouir dans notre environnement de travail inclusif.

Pour nous, le service n'est pas seulement une valeur, c'est notre engagement. Nous maintenons cet engagement envers nos employés, nos clients et nos communautés. Chacun de nos bureaux régionaux contribue activement aux causes locales, agissant de façon concrète là où c'est le plus nécessaire.

title: Senior Professional Service Designer
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Professional Service Designer leads service design projects that improve patient, customer, associate, and caregiver experiences across our core businesses. You will work within a pod structure aligned to a specific CenterWell line of business, and translate research and stakeholder insights into service concepts, experience strategies, and actionable recommendations that align people, processes, technology, and data.

You will support the planning and facilitation of discovery research, partner interviews, journey-mapping sessions, and workshops to understand needs and identify opportunities for service improvement. You will create current and future-state service and experience blueprints that clarify frontstage and backstage interactions, handoffs, dependencies, pain points, and the people, process, technology, and data elements required to deliver the intended experience.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in service design, design, human-centered design, design research, behavioral or social sciences, business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in service design, experience design, design research, or a related field.
  • Experience with written, verbal, visual storytelling, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to communicate recommendations to leaders and partners.
  • Demonstrated experience creating service blueprints, experience blueprints, customer journeys, ecosystem maps, process flows, and other service design artifacts.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft applications and collaborative research, mapping, and visualization tools used to document insights and develop service design artifacts.
  • You will have strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to plan discovery activities, coordinate contributors, manage dependencies, and deliver high-quality work across multiple workstreams.
  • You will summarize qualitative and quantitative inputs, identify connections across people, processes, technology, and data, ask questions, and translate findings into clear opportunities and recommendations.
  • Comfort conducting discovery research, including partner interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, and collaborative workshops, and summarizing findings into applicable insights.
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on improving consumer experiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's Degree
  • Healthcare experience or subject-matter expertise in clinical care or pharmacy environments.

title: Senior Commercial Director
description:
What We're Looking For

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.

This opportunity entails being responsible for commercial issue resolution, risk management, contract administration and compliance, and change management on alternative delivery mega transportation project(s) of a diverse and complex nature with a contract price from $500 million to over $1billion. Provides commercial services and trains staff on basic contract interpretation and application, manage project communication in all mediums, oversee contract, state, and federal compliance; oversee and manage project risks, issues, and potential changes to resolution. Oversees project staff in review of the contractor’s activities, roles and responsibilities, communication protocols, and execution and application of contract provisions. Primary author of correspondence, vets all project-specific processes and procedures, and co-drafter’s internal management plans. Co-reviewer and commenter of all contractor reports and Management Plans. On-site liaison to support the client’s legal department for resolution of claims, formal disputes and litigation. Capture lessons learned on policies, contractual strategies, and project issues, and assists in drafting commensurate contract provisions. Part of an owner’s representative team providing contractor oversight and project support services. Oversees the work of direct reports and provides guidance on day to day responsibilities.

What You’ll Do:

Draft and co- draft technical memos, policy papers, and issue analysis codifying recommendations, contract position taken, or resolution documents.
  • Reviews correspondence works with various members of the project team and the owner to develop responses and propose and draft responses.
  • Oversees the project team’s review of technical and administrative submittal responses, participates in meetings, reviews reports and minutes, and coordinates project communication utilizing a variety of methods.
  • Assists in the resolution of potential change orders, change orders, dispute resolution, and provide claims, formal dispute, and litigation support.

  • 15 years of project management, contract drafting & negotiation, construction claims resolution or related experience.

  • Proficient in complex document interpretation, analysis, problem solving, and communication

title: FT CMA Overnight Shift
description:
Position Title: FT CMA – Overnight Shift

Salary: $14/hr – negotiable based on experience. Med Cart differential: $1/hr additional when passing meds. Shift differentials for overnights($1/hr) & weekends ($1.50/hr)

Schedule: Varies, to include weekends as well.

Who we are:

When you work at Green Country Village Senior Living, you’ll notice that it’s more than a typical senior living community. It’s a uniquely uplifting community where active older adults enjoy vibrant living, rewarding opportunities, exceptional hospitality, and great friendships. This retirement community is conveniently located in the warm and welcoming town of Bartlesville, Oklahoma. You’ll appreciate the beauty of our 26-acre campus nestled conveniently near shopping, dining options, and Bartlesville’s bustling downtown. You won't find our unique combination of an all-inclusive lifestyle, superior hospitality, and beautiful location anywhere else. We are currently seeking compassionate FT Overnight Shift, Certified Medication Aide to join our dedicated nursing team. If you’re looking for a different perspective on enhancing the lives of seniors with a person-centered approach to care and supporting company progress across multiple departments come join us today!

You will enjoy:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance, Aflac – 82.3% of associate medial premium is paid by employer!
  • A free meal for every shift worked
  • Now Offering Daily Pay!
  • Generous PTO plan that accrues faster the longer you’re employed
  • Six paid holidays
  • Holiday Bonuses
  • Employer paid life and disability insurance
  • 403(b)
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Your personal and professional growth is important to us, so we provide continual professional training and career advancement opportunities.
  • You will enjoy being part of a great team in a fun, engaging work environment!

Who you are:

  • Passionate about serving Seniors.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and desire to work as a cohesive team member.
  • Excellent organizational skills, time-management skills, and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated with ability to balance resident care in a person-centered approach.
  • Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality.
  • Safety focus to ensure safe environment for residents and guests.

Education and Experience:

  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Current Oklahoma certification as Certified Nurse Aide (CNA).
  • Current Oklahoma certification as Certified Medication Aide (CMA).
  • Experience in Senior Living preferred.
  • Ability to maintain 100% confidentiality with all work, conversations, documents, etc.
  • Ability to recognize and respond to emergency situations.
  • Ability to display a courteous, friendly, and helpful attitude to the public, residents, and employees at all times.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to stand/walk for up to 100% of the work day.
  • Ability to assist in bathing and dressing of residents with disabilities.
  • Must be able to access and navigate full campus.
  • Ability to independently push a wheelchair with a resident weighing up to 200 pounds.
  • Ability to independently lift, balance, and carry up to 30 pounds.

General Summary:

The FT Overnight Shift Certified Medication Aide is responsible for providing personal and non-personal care assistance to residents when there is a need and following each resident’s personal plan of care; assists residents so that current living conditions can be maintained for as long as is safe and appropriate; promotes independence with daily activities while giving assistance to each resident.

In addition to the above-listed responsibilities, the Certified Medication Aide administers medications in an accurate and timely manner and may function as a Team Leader for the shift as assigned.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Monitors the work of the Assisted Living personnel assigned to her/his shift, if serving as Team Leader.
  • Monitors/performs direct care of residents as outlined in each resident’s plan of care.
  • Administers direct care to residents as necessary.
  • Makes daily rounds to residents.
  • Gives and receives accurate shift reports.
  • Records accurate and timely resident progress notes, condition change notes, and other documentation as required and/or assigned.
  • Keeps physicians and families informed of each resident’s condition, as required.
  • Administers medications (includes preparation, administration, and charting) and compliance with goal of 100% accuracy.
  • Completes all assigned tasks and items listed on shift checklist.
  • Keeps Charge Nurse, Nursing Coordinator, and Assisted Living Director informed of the status of each resident.
  • Assists with meal service including table set-up, serving, tableside assistance, apartment deliveries, beverage service, dining room cleaning, etc.
  • Records accurate and timely resident progress notes, condition change notes, and other documentation as required and/or assigned.
  • Adheres to Hospitality Promises;
    • We greet residents, employees and guests warmly, by name and with a smile.
    • We treat everyone with courteous respect.
    • We strive to anticipate resident, employee and guest needs and act accordingly.
    • We listen and respond enthusiastically in a timely manner.
    • We hold ourselves and one another accountable.
    • We embrace and value our differences.
    • We make residents, employees and guests feel important.
    • We ask “Is there anything else I can do for you?”
    • We maintain high levels of professionalism, both in conduct and appearance, at all times.
    • We pay attention to details.

title: Director Release Train Product Management
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Aspen Technology, a business unit inside Emerson Corporation, is a leading industrial software company, serving over 3,000 customers with over $1 billion in annual revenue, more than 60 locations worldwide, and nearly 4,000 employees. AspenTech solutions address complex environments where it is critical to optimize the asset design, operation and maintenance lifecycle. Through AspenTech’s unique combination of deep domain expertise and award-winning innovative software suites, customers in asset-intensive industries can improve their operational excellence while achieving sustainability goals.

The AspenTech Performance Engineering Solution provides a market leading integrated suite of products to optimize the performance of process industry assets across the CAPEX and OPEX cycles and is powered by flagship process modeling products such as Aspen HYSYS and Aspen Plus with a proven track record of value creation over several decades.

Your Impact

  • As a Director, Release Train Product Management working within the Scaled Agile Framework, you are responsible for turning vision into reality by managing the program backlog, prioritizing features, and collaborating with Solution Product Management to deliver solutions that align with business goals with the shortest lead time.
  • Execution Strategy: Responsible for the Program Backlog, working with Solution Product Management, the System Architect, and the Release Train Engineer to prioritize the backlog to maximize the delivery of value over time.

  • Lean Portfolio Alignment: Apply Lean economics, including WSJF and value-based prioritization techniques, to optimize sequencing and maximize outcomes.

What You'll Need

  • 10+ years of progressive product-centric software development leadership, including a demonstrated record of success delivering value with quality.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, with preference to Chemical Engineering. Advanced degree is a plus.
  • Experience in process engineering and optimization will be extremely important including real life user experience of AspenTech Performance Engineering products such Aspen HYSYS and Aspen Plus.
  • Experience in communicating product vision and road maps to the development teams.

title: Cyber Security Architect, SD
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.

Position Summary:

The Cloud Security Architect performs cloud security posture and configuration reviews to identify misconfigurations, security control gaps, support migrations, and opportunities for improvement. This role executes assessment workflows using CSPM-based approaches and delivers clear, prioritized recommendations aligned with client objectives and relevant standards. This is remote based in the United States.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct cloud configuration and security posture reviews using CSPM approaches and automated scanning methods aligned with Ankura cloud assessment practices.

  • Assess cloud configurations against predefined requirements and map gaps to common standards and regulatory expectations referenced in client deliverables, such as NIST, ISO, and CIS.

  • Analyze results and deliver client-ready reports that include prioritized remediation recommendations and actionable roadmaps.

  • Support reviews across key cloud security domains commonly covered in cloud assessments, including identity and access, network segmentation, logging and monitoring, workload configuration, and security governance.

  • Manage internal and third-party resources as needed for projects and client engagements

  • Collaborate with engagement leads and stakeholders to validate findings and ensure recommendations are practical and aligned with the client’s operating model.

  • Work with clients and business leaders to support statements of work (SOWs) and engagement delivery.

  • Work cross-functionally with IT, engineering, and security stakeholders to drive adoption of cloud security controls and operational improvements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent experience

  • 10+ years of relevant experience

  • Cloud Certificate (Azure /AWS/GPC) required

  • Experience delivering cloud security assessments for Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, and/or AWS environments, including configuration analysis and remediation planning; experience with GCP and Oracle Cloud is a plus.

  • Experience configuring Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Purview is a plus.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured executive summaries and detailed findings and recommendations.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, migrating, and operating security controls in Microsoft Azure and/or Microsoft 365 environments.

  • Practical knowledge of identity and access management patterns in Microsoft cloud environments (for example, Entra ID and privileged access concepts).

  • Experience implementing security governance and controls that support compliance and risk management expectations in cloud environments.

  • Experience with CSPM tools and workflows used in cloud posture reviews, such as Prisma Cloud or Zscaler Posture Control is preferred.

  • Experience with cloud security posture management and configuration review programs, including translating findings into prioritized remediation plans is preferred.

  • Familiarity with security frameworks commonly used in cloud assessments, including NIST, ISO, and CIS mappings is preferred

  • Willingness to travel as needed (approximately 25%)

  • Please note that this role requires permanent authorization to work in the U.S. (i.e. U.S. citizen or permanent resident).

This includes policy development, regulatory and permit compliance oversight, workforce training, and corporate reporting aligned with federal and state regulations, permits, and company policies. The role provides leadership and coordination of ES&H functions, including environmental permitting, compliance programs, and the development and continuous improvement of management systems supporting the operating, while ensuring the safety and health of employees.

Job Description

What you will be doing:

  • Lead and oversee environmental, safety, and health (ESH) programs, compliance initiatives, management systems, and continuous improvement efforts.

  • Develop, implement, and communicate policies, procedures, standards, and program enhancements to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including OSHA, MSHA, and environmental requirements.

title: Associate Claim Counsel, Bond & Specialty Insurance
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim, Legal

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$89,800.00 - $148,300.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers Insurance is seeking a highly motivated and knowledgeable Associate Claim Counsel to join our Bond & Specialty Insurance team. Bond & Specialty Insurance (BSI) provides management and professional liability, cyber, crime insurance, and surety bonds to or on behalf of businesses and/or nonprofits of all sizes. The BSI Claim Counsel team conducts thorough investigation, analysis, evaluation, and disposition of claims and claim litigation to achieve superior customer service and to optimize claim results. Travelers’ Private/Non-Profit Team provides executive and organizational management liability coverage to privately held companies and non-profit entities of all types and sizes as well as certain governmental public entities. As an Associate Claim Counsel, you will effectively manage all assigned BSI claims, typically of lower severity and complexity within our organization, and with close supervision from management. You will manage outside counsel relationships, negotiate settlements, and ensure stakeholders are supported throughout the claims process. In addition to comprehensive claim and risk management, you also will provide legal advice and/or insight to our underwriting colleagues and non-attorney claim colleagues and participate in BSI claim strategic initiatives.
This particular position will afford the successful candidate an exciting opportunity to shape a unique position within BSI Claim, focused on Employment Practices Liability matters. This position will have a national footprint and will handle a wide variety of claims from throughout the field regions. This Associate Claim Counsel will handle new claims, but may also manage existing claims due to the absence or departure of a claim professional.
Travelers offers a hybrid work location model that is designed to support flexibility.
This job does not manage others.

As of the date of this posting, Travelers anticipates that this posting will remain open until October 29, 2026.

What Will You Do?

  • Analyze, investigate, and resolve Bond & Specialty Claims of lower severity and complexity with close supervision, following operational policies.
  • With close management supervision, retain, monitor, and manage outside counsel (and other vendors, as applicable) by actively utilizing incident response and/or litigation management plans and budgets, and negotiate settlements when appropriate to ensure effective legal and/or claim outcomes, involving litigation matters of lower severity and complexity.
  • Prepare management reports on loss development, financial exposure, and resolution strategies with a high degree of guidance from management.
  • Develop and coordinate recovery efforts with the Recovery Management Unit to optimize loss mitigation opportunities, as needed.
  • Attend mediations, settlement conferences, trials, depositions to support claim resolution, and may attend other internal/external business meetings with supervision as needed.
  • With significant supervision, provide a variety of legal and business support to underwriting colleagues which varies by business unit and may include negotiating indemnity documentation, drafting product forms and endorsements, reviewing contracts and bond forms, all involving matters of lower complexity, and supporting marketing and/or risk management efforts through broker visits and seminars.
  • Ensure stakeholders/customers feel ‘secure, respected, and cared for’ throughout the duration of the claims process.
  • Ensure compliance with BSI Claims processes, procedures, and best practices.
  • Maintain thorough documentation of claim activities, decisions, and communications, adhering to record-keeping standards and confidentiality protocols.
  • To perform the essential functions of this job, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance Adjuster License(s) is required to comply with state and Travelers’ requirements. Generally, license(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the job and must obtain ongoing continuing education credits as mandated. Additionally, the maintenance of an active legal license in the state of your principal office location and remaining current with all Continuing Legal Education (CLE) is required to perform this role.
  • Management Liability
  • Prepare timely and thorough coverage evaluations and correspondence to Insureds.
  • Maintain and note claim files pursuant to company best practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • One to five years of relevant legal or claim handling work experience.
  • Ability to effectively work through conflict and resolve issues with a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to make sound decisions and negotiate terms and conditions within designated authority limit.
  • Solid verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate coverage determinations.
  • Solid time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities with an attention to detail, data and analytics.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective and collaborative relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Juris Doctor Degree.
  • Properly licensed, registered or authorized, and in good standing, to practice law in the jurisdiction in which you will be working.
  • Valid driver’s license or access to alternative means of transportation to travel to mediations, conferences, field offices, trials, and/or depositions.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Remote
description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

Remote Work Welcome

Be part of a transformative team that is shaping the way First American builds and delivers world-class technology products that fuel the real estate industry. We are looking for forward-thinking engineers who will envision, design, build, and deploy AI-native systems - from concept to production - that provide exceptional experiences and lasting value to our customers.

First American is seeking software engineering candidates to grow our team. An ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience deploying LLMs and agentic systems into production. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead projects as part of a small, focused engineering delivery team, building intelligent, reliable software that drives meaningful business outcomes. You will be part of a transformative team whose mission is to modernize our core Title & Settlement Platform using modern architectures, cloud-native services, and production AI systems.

What You'll Do:

  • Build & Deploy AI Systems (0 → 1): You will own the full lifecycle of LLM-powered features - from early prototyping and prompt design through production deployment, monitoring, and iteration. This includes fine-tuning workflows, building evaluation harnesses, and inference infrastructure that serve real users at scale. You will make pragmatic decisions and ship AI capabilities that are reliable, cost-effective, and measurably valuable.
  • Agentic Systems Development: Design and implement autonomous agent architectures that reason, plan, use tools, and execute multi-step tasks with minimal human intervention. You will build orchestration layers, memory systems, guardrails, and feedback loops that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within business workflows. You will define agent behaviors, constraints, and failure modes - ensuring systems degrade gracefully and remain explainable.
  • Code: You will be an active contributor to the codebase, designing, developing, testing, and deploying code supporting our most complex functional areas. Using agentic development, you will architect and implement modern services that are scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant. You will build backend services and APIs that enable secure, reliable interaction between AI agents and internal or external systems. First American embraces AI as a core tool in our development process. You will use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) as part of your daily workflow, and help establish team-wide practices for agentic authoring - including prompt patterns, context management, and quality gates that maximize engineering velocity while maintaining code quality.
  • Collaborate / Partner: Collaborate closely with product management, solution architects, AI/ML practitioners, and cross-functional teams to iteratively design, develop, and validate outcome-driven solutions. You will translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped solutions, helping stakeholders understand what's feasible, what's risky, and what delivers the highest value.
  • Operational Excellence: Implement solutions that are high quality, secure, observable, and production-ready. Establish evaluation strategies, cost monitoring, latency budgets, and guardrails that ensure AI systems behave reliably in production. Contribute to reviews of designs, code, artifacts, and metrics with a focus on both system performance and LLM usage efficiency.
  • Continuous Improvement: Join a team determined to achieve ambitious goals by providing regular feedback, mentoring peers, and driving continuous improvement. Advocate for modern engineering practices that improve development velocity, system robustness, and long-term quality.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building production-grade systems
  • Demonstrated experience taking LLM-powered features from prototype to production (0 → 1), including prompt engineering, evaluation, deployment, and iteration
  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems - including planning/reasoning loops, tool use, memory/context management, and orchestration
  • Strong experience building large-scale, back-end services and APIs using modern languages and frameworks
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as part of a modern software engineering workflow
  • Solid understanding of LLM operational concerns: token economics, latency optimization, model routing, caching strategies, and cost management at scale
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and quality metrics for AI systems (accuracy, hallucination rates, task completion, regression testing)
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, cloud-native infrastructure, and distributed system design
  • Ability to build robust, scalable, reusable solutions that safely integrate AI capabilities into core platforms
  • Ability to mentor and influence other engineers, sharing knowledge and raising overall technical quality
  • Ability to unblock yourself and help accelerate the team in achieving complex, cross-disciplinary goals
  • Outcome-oriented mindset, using metrics and data to evaluate both system behavior and development effectiveness
  • Experience driving engineering best practices for high-functioning teams through effective use of tools and automation
  • Familiarity with deployment and observability strategies that support continuous delivery and high availability

Pay Range: $129,300.00 - $172,300.00 Annually

title: Rotational Portfolio Implementation Associate
description:
Who We Are:

We are a leading global investment management firm offering high-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.

Who You’ll Work With:

The Portfolio Management Group (“PMG”) is responsible for portfolio implementation and supports the global portfolio management teams by implementing portfolio decisions and serving as the contact point with the trading desks, operations, and sales teams.

Interns will play a key role to provide support in all aspects of the business. Specific responsibilities and activities may include:

  • Project-based initiatives related to process improvement and portfolio strategies.
  • Data Analysis.
  • Partnering with team members to best support the goals of the group.
  • Interacting and networking with professionals throughout the firm to fuel career success needs.

What You’ll Do:

The Portfolio Implementation Summer Internship will provide students with firsthand exposure to careers in asset management, investment research, and financial services. Summer Interns will be placed in one of the following groups:

Equity Portfolio Management Group

Equity PMG will allow the intern to gain exposure as to how investment managers get their equity, currency and derivative investment ideas implemented. The intern will work on day-to-day tasks as well as project work to improve the effectiveness of portfolio management techniques and to experience how both quantitative and fundamental research is used in the context of managing equity mandates.

Fixed Income Portfolio Management Group

Fixed Income PMG will allow the intern to gain exposure as to how investment managers get their bond, currency and derivative investment ideas implemented. The intern will work on day-to-day tasks as well as project work to improve the effectiveness of portfolio management techniques and to experience how technology is being used to enhance our investment process.

Multi-Asset & Hedge Fund Solutions Management Group

Multi-Asset Strategies PMG supports the implementation of the systematic, outcome oriented and income driven investment solutions. The intern will learn how various instruments are used in order to implement the various investment ideas. Day to day tasks and project work will help to improve the efficiency of our portfolio management processes. They will gain an understanding of the complex structures and sub strategies that can be combined to meet the needs.

What We’re Looking For:

Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business, or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us

  • December 2026 through May/June 2027 Bachelor’s degree candidates in business, finance, economics, math, computer science, engineering, or liberal arts.
  • Cumulative GPA of 3.2 or better.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (must be able to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship now or in the future.)
  • Candidates must be available to work full-time from June through August.
  • Selected candidates will need to successfully complete a thorough background check.
  • It is not permissible to simultaneously take academic classes or hold other employment that will conflict with the internship schedule.
  • An interest in the financial markets, industry regulations, and portfolio management.
  • Detail-oriented with strong quantitative and analytical skills that can be leveraged to evaluate portfolios.
  • The ability to prioritize, multitask and work effectively with a team in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to effectively communicate and build relationships with teams throughout the organization.
  • An ability to think holistically, understand end-to-end processes and reconsider the status quo.
  • A proactive and inquisitive approach toward new challenges and problem solving.

How We Invest in You:

AB’s purpose is to pursue insight that unlocks opportunity. It is why we exist and what we work at every day. Our shared values define how we work. They’re a foundation of our culture, which empowers all of us to be our complete selves – and contribute our distinctive talents. We invest in one another, strive for distinctive knowledge, speak with courage and conviction, and act with integrity – Always!

We recognize the value of investing in one another and providing you with the opportunity to showcase your newly learned skills as a commitment to your growth! That’s why we’ve crafted an exciting training program that will include, but not limited to, the topics listed below:

  • Introduction to Capital Markets
  • Advanced Technology Trainings such as Python, PowerBI, SQL, etc.
  • Diversity Equity & Inclusion programming

  • Career Compassing
  • Networking opportunities
  • Investment case studies

All are encouraged to apply. title: Analista de Transporte Pleno
description:
Posição: Analista de Transporte Pleno

Tipo de trabalho: Contrato CLT – 100% Presencial (in-house)

Localização: Lagoa Santa - MG

Temos uma visão maior que o oceano: integrar a logística de contêineres, conectando e simplificando a cadeia de suprimentos de nossos clientes. E nós contamos com as nossas pessoas para que isso aconteça!

O que oferecemos?

Estamos em uma jornada revolucionária para simplificar o comércio global, que nos dará a chance de oferecermos um grande impacto na economia mundial, e em sua carreira. Com responsabilidade pessoal significativa, você vai aprimorar o seu conhecimento da indústria e construir comunicação e habilidades comerciais altamente valorizadas em papéis voltados para o cliente – muito possivelmente em um ritmo que vai surpreendê-lo.

Energizante e pioneiro, este também é um ambiente que mantém você motivado. Você vai se juntar a uma equipe genuinamente diversificada e talentosa que é apaixonada por estar focada em tecnologia, nos clientes, e nos colegas.

E graças à nossa escala global, você estará bem-posicionado para explorar oportunidades na Maersk ao redor do mundo. Os muitos outros destaques incluem as mais modernas iniciativas de desenvolvimento de talentos e benefícios competitivos.

Nossa oportunidade:

Estamos buscando nosso novo Analista de Transporte, que será responsável por planejar, controlar e otimizar os processos de transporte, contribuindo ativamente para melhorias operacionais, redução de custos e garantia do nível de serviço (SLA), com maior autonomia analítica e interação com stakeholders internos e externos.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Analisar dados do TMS para identificar tendências, entregas pendentes, ocorrências e entregas em andamento. Monitorar continuamente o status das remessas/entregas e agir proativamente para evitar atrasos nas entregas.
  • Resolver problemas e/ou potenciais problemas com as transportadoras e/ou o cliente. Monitorar e gerenciar entregas pendentes e exceções. Controlar e gerenciar reentregas.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre a transportadora, pares e clientes internos da Maersk e do cliente. Comunicar-se com as transportadoras, com o cliente e a pares/equipe da Maersk para solucionar problemas. Fornecer atualizações sobre os KPIs, verificando os SLAs acordados (clientes e transportadoras).
  • Responder rapidamente às solicitações do cliente. Coordenar com as transportadoras soluções alternativas para minimizar interrupções no serviço. Forte relacionamento com as transportadoras para solucionar problemas. Relacionamento com o Departamento de Compras para desenvolver continuamente transportadoras alternativas.
  • Identificar oportunidades, otimizar rotas, transportadoras e utilização de veículos para melhorar o nível de serviço e os prazos de entrega.
  • Servir como elo entre transportadoras, equipes de transporte/armazém e o cliente. Resolver problemas de entrega e manter altos níveis de satisfação do cliente.
  • Utilizar sistemas de gestão de transporte (TMS) para monitorar o desempenho e gerar relatórios.

Quem estamos procurando:

Se você tem os requisitos abaixo, essa é sua chance de entrar para esse time de alto desempenho e fazer parte desse grande momento na nossa organização!

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Logística, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em operações de transporte, preferencialmente em operadores logísticos ou transportadoras.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas TMS e/ou ferramentas similares de gestão de transporte.
  • Conhecimento intermediário no Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel.
  • Familiaridade com Power BI, incluindo manuseio da ferramenta e interpretação de dados para apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Perfil analítico, adaptável e proativo, com habilidade para solucionar problemas, comunicar-se de forma eficaz e atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.

Na Maersk nós valorizamos a diversidade dos nossos talentos e sempre nos esforçaremos para recrutar a melhor pessoa para o trabalho. Valorizamos a diversidade em todos os suas formas, incluindo – mas não se limitando a – gênero, idade, nacionalidade, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência ou crenças religiosas. Estamos orgulhosos de nossa diversidade e em vê-la como uma verdadeira fonte de força para a construção de equipes de alto desempenho.
