title: Analyst, Analytics, Data Science
description:
GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB

As a Data Scientist on Quad's Insights and Analytics team, you will play an important role in driving the effectiveness of media campaigns through advanced data analysis. You will be responsible for executing modeling projects using a variety of home-grown and 3rd-party tools. This includes data cleansing, formatting, loading, execution, model evaluation, and result reviews. In collaboration with the broader team, you will help craft the insights from these models and turn those insights into recommendations for our clients. Throughout the process, we expect you to seek ways to improve the processes.

Location: Mexico City, 3 days in office; Applicants must hold Mexican citizenship

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Model Execution: Load, execute, and refine statistical and machine learning models to assess and improve media effectiveness. Develop processes and data pipelines to support media planning and optimization.
  • Data Analysis: Conduct thorough analyses of media performance data, including engagement metrics, conversion rates, and ROI. Identify trends, patterns, and insights to inform media strategy.
  • Insights Generation: Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable insights. Prepare detailed reports and visualizations that communicate the impact and effectiveness of media strategies.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including media planners, marketing strategists, and data engineers, to ensure alignment of data insights with overall media strategy.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay curious about the latest industry trends and advancements in data science and media analytics. Propose and implement improvements to existing models and methodologies.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven experience in data science, particularly in building and deploying predictive, explanatory, or decomposition models.
  • Strong proficiency in statistical analysis and machine learning techniques.
  • Experience with data visualization tools and techniques for effective communication of insights.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex data clearly and understandably.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Good English proficiency, recognizing that your manager is bilingual and will aid where necessary.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. A Master's degree or higher is preferred.

title: Director, Account Management - Wellness
description:
Director, Account Management – Wellness

Vi is the market-leading Enterprise-AI platform for health, serving the world’s largest health organizations – from Fortune 500 health providers to pharma and consumer brands – helping them maximize patient activation, engagement, operational excellence and health outcomes. Vi offers four main product lines: Acquire, Engage, Operate and Pulse. Backed by $125M+ in R&D, our powerful platform serves over 190 million members daily – and growing. We are based in New York, Austin, Nashville, and Tel Aviv.

Role Summary

As Director of Account Management – Wellness, you will own the client relationship and delivery results for a portfolio of enterprise wellness accounts. This role is built for someone who genuinely wants to master the platform – who gets energized by understanding how Vi’s products work end-to-end, where they create real value, and how to apply them to solve specific client challenges. You’re as comfortable in a product deep-dive as you are in a C-suite conversation.

Revenue growth matters – you’ll drive POC conversions, upsells, cross-sells, and renewals toward an NRR of 110%+. But the engine behind that growth is product knowledge: understanding what Vi can do, helping clients unlock it, and feeding what you learn back into the roadmap through close collaboration with Client Performance and Product teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own & Grow Client Relationships – Serve as the lead product and client partner for enterprise wellness accounts. Build trusted relationships with VP and C-suite stakeholders while staying close to the day-to-day to ensure delivery matches commitments.
  • Master the Platform – Develop deep, working knowledge of Vi’s full product suite (Acquire, Engage, Operate, Augment, Pulse). Understand how each product line works mechanically, how they connect, and how to apply them to the specific dynamics of wellness clients. Be the person in the room who actually knows the product.
  • Translate Product into Client Value – Take what you know about the platform and make it land for clients – helping them understand what’s possible, configuring solutions to their context, and connecting product capabilities to outcomes they care about.
  • Drive Revenue Growth – Convert POCs, secure upsells and cross-sells, and contribute to strong NRR. The commercial results follow from doing the product and client work well.
  • Retain & Expand – Keep clients engaged and growing through hands-on account stewardship, not just relationship management. Identify risks early and resolve them.
  • Feed the Roadmap – Be a credible voice in product conversations internally. Surface patterns from your accounts, advocate for the right builds, and help Vi’s product evolve based on what wellness clients actually need.
  • Partner Across Teams – Work closely with Client Performance, Product, and Solutions teams. Be the connective tissue between what clients are experiencing and what gets prioritized internally.
  • Tell the Performance Story – Translate platform data and outcomes into clear narratives for senior stakeholders – linking Vi’s work to business results, not just activity metrics.
  • Lead & Develop – Bring a player/coach mentality. Own your accounts fully while helping develop the people around you.

What We’re Looking For

  • Product Depth & Curiosity – You want to understand how the product actually works, not just how to position it. You invest time in platform knowledge, ask good questions of the product team, and bring that understanding into every client conversation. This is the core of how you add value.
  • Hands-On Account Ownership – You don’t delegate your way through accounts. You’re comfortable in the data, working a problem directly, and taking ownership of outcomes – not just relationships.
  • Consultative Mindset – You operate like a trusted advisor. You diagnose before you prescribe, and your recommendations are grounded in how the product actually works and what the client actually needs.
  • Commercial Awareness – You understand the business model and can manage renewals and expansions. Commercial outcomes matter, but they’re a byproduct of doing the product and client work well – not the starting point.
  • Strategic Marketing & Omnichannel Literacy – Comfortable guiding clients through performance marketing and omnichannel engagement strategies. Understands member acquisition dynamics. CRM or call center experience is a plus.
  • Stakeholder Engagement – Experience working with VP/C-level stakeholders while staying connected to the operational layer where the work actually happens.
  • High IQ & EQ – Strong ability to influence internal and external teams. You read rooms well and adapt accordingly.
  • Startup DNA – Strategic, creative, and entrepreneurial. You build structure where there isn’t any and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Problem-Solving Skills – You identify and resolve issues before they escalate. You bring solutions, not status updates.
  • Wellness Industry Knowledge – Familiarity with the wellness landscape is a nice to have.

title: Health, Safety & Environment Officer
description:
The role

As Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) Officer - Netherlands & Belgium, you carry two complementary and equally important responsibilities at Fastned.

First, you are the on-the-ground HSE representative for the Netherlands and Belgium, the person ensuring that our construction projects, stations and offices in both countries are safe, compliant and continuously improving. You work closely with construction managers, field operations, asset management, design and local leadership teams, with a focus on practical HSE execution in the field: incident management, inspections, training, toolbox talks and engagement with contractors and authorities.

Second, and uniquely for this role, you own the HSE Culture and Training pillar for the entire HSE department, across all Fastned markets. You are responsible for making safety visible, relevant and engaging company-wide: from campaigns and safety moments to lessons learned sessions and internal HSE communications. This is not a support task, it is a leadership responsibility within the team

You report to the Head of Health, Safety & Environment and collaborate frequently with the Electrical Safety Engineer and other teams across Europe.

What you'll do

Own the HSE Culture & Training pilar

  • Lead the HSE communication and awareness pillar for the entire HSE team, not just for NL & BE.

  • Lead and drive the HSE communication and awareness strategy for the entire HSE department, ensuring safety topics are visible, relevant and engaging across all Fastned markets and teams.

  • Design and deliver campaigns, initiatives and regular communications that keep HSE top of mind across construction, field and office environments.

  • Translate complex safety requirements, regulatory updates and incident learnings into clear, accessible messages that resonate with different audiences - from technicians on site to office-based colleagues across countries.

  • Build and maintain a calendar of awareness activities (e.g. safety moments, themed campaigns, lessons learned sessions, international safety days) and coordinate their delivery across all markets in collaboration with local HSE colleagues.

  • Act as the editorial owner of HSE internal communications (e.g. newsletters,Notion page, updates, safety alerts), ensuring consistency, quality and relevance across the organisation.

  • Collect feedback on the effectiveness of communication initiatives and continuously improve the approach based on what works in the field.

Keep people and sites safe in NL & BE

  • Act as the visible and approachable HSE contact for project managers, field technicians, contractors and suppliers across NL & BE.

  • Support design and construction reviews, during the Construction Design Management process, to integrate HSE requirements from the start.

  • Deliver toolbox talks and hands-on HSE support to internal teams and contractors in the field.

  • Support the implementation of HSE management system processes in your markets (e.g. critical controls checklists, contractor management, local procedures).

  • Help ensure legal compliance with Dutch and Belgian HSE legislation in collaboration with the Head of HSE and external advisors.

Manage incidents, compliance and continuous improvement

  • Coordinate incident reporting, support root cause analysis and follow up on corrective and preventive actions at site level.

  • Monitor trends in incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions in NL & BE and propose systemic improvement actions.

  • Ensure HSE documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection reports, risk assessments, method statements and training records.

  • Feed learnings from the field directly into the company-wide communication and awareness programme you lead.

Deliver results and collaborate across the business

  • Take full ownership of your HSE objectives and commitments in the Netherlands & Belgium, ensuring work is delivered reliably and on time.

  • Proactively flag risks to delivery or compliance and propose pragmatic solutions.

  • Use HSE data and dashboards to prioritise actions and support decision-making with stakeholders.

  • Share learnings and best practices across markets and support cross-country initiatives led by the Head of HSE.

About You

  • You are passionate about safety and you enjoy being out in the field as much as working with data and procedures.

  • You are pragmatic, collaborative and comfortable engaging with people at all levels, from contractors on site to local management.

  • You bring 3 to 5 years of experience in HSE position, enough to hit the ground running, but with plenty of room to grow.

  • Knowledge of HSE legislation and safety standards relevant to the Netherlands and/or Belgium (e.g. working at height, road safety, contractor safety, etc.).

  • Strong skills in incident investigation and incident analysis, and experience following through on corrective actions.

  • Ability to work independently across multiple sites and stakeholders, prioritising effectively and following up proactively.

  • Comfortable using data and simple dashboards (e.g. Excel, Databricks) to monitor performance and support decisions.

  • Strong communication skills in English and Dutch, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain HSE topics clearly and constructively.

  • A valid driving licence and willingness to travel frequently between locations in the Netherlands and Belgium, and further occasionally.

Join us in building a better future!

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We put a focus on work-life balance, provide you with genuine work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place.

Our benefits include:

  • Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation.

  • Attractive Pension plan fully covered by Fastned.

  • 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you 2 ‘Mission Days’ you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

title: Design For Test Intern, MS - Summer 2027
description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

The Compute and Custom Solutions (CCS) Business Unit within Marvell develops cutting-edge SoCs and processors in advanced process nodes for some of the largest companies in the world. We develop silicon solutions for the growing data center, enterprise, wireless, and automotive compute markets, collaborating with strategic customers from architecture and design all the way through layout, packaging, prototype validation, and production ramp-up.
The CCS DFT (Design for Test) team is a key part of Marvell's global DFT community, with global ownership and responsibility for delivering generic and more advanced custom DFT architecture solutions, methodology, and design. The team provides technology development, EDA/methodology development, and IP/chip design development. As an intern, you will be working with this team to directly enable customer DFT requirements in the CCS BU, gaining hands-on experience with industry-leading tools and methodologies used to build some of the world's most complex SoCs.

What You Can Expect

  • Develop understanding of the block level or chip top DFT and pattern generation flows for complex SOC designs
  • Execute DFT insertion, pattern generation and verification flows for Scan, Memory Built-in Self-Test (MBIST), Boundary Scan and IP macro test
  • Run DFT checks and analyze results to resolve testability issues and improve DFT coverage
  • Support DFT flow automation through scripting (Tcl, Python, or shell) to improve design flows
  • Contribute to DFT documentation, methodology improvements and automation
  • Present intern project results to the team at the end of the internship

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a Masters in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields
  • Good understanding of digital logic design using Verilog/System Verilog
  • Knowledge of DFT concepts, JTAG standards and Boundary scan implementation
  • Knowledge of Scan test, memory BIST/BISR, functional test, JTAG, and other test methodologies is a plus
  • Experience in programming and scripting languages such as Python, Shell, Tcl
  • Knowledge of using AI assisted tools for coding, scripts and automation is a plus
  • Effective teamwork and communication skills

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

30 - 59, $ per hour.

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.





Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

title: DevOps Technical Delivery Manager
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment.

As a DevOps Technical Delivery Manager for the Information Solutions team you will own delivery accountability for DevOps and platform engineering work across the firm's client engagements. Acts as the single point of accountability for DevOps delivery commitments between clients, project teams, and the DevOps Engineering team, translating project and client needs into sequenced, achievable work and holding the team's delivery commitments to scope, schedule, budget, and quality. Engineers retain direct technical dialogue with their client counterparts; this role owns the commercial scope, sequencing, and schedule commitments arising from that dialogue. Owns intake, prioritization, and delivery cadence for the DevOps backlog, and is the person Project Managers, Engineering Managers, and clients go to for a clear and predictable answer on platform work. This role has no direct reports; performance management and career development for DevOps engineers are owned by the DevOps Engineering Manager. Success is measured by client outcomes, on-time and on-scope delivery, and the throughput and predictability of the DevOps team

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary client-facing point of accountability for DevOps and platform delivery across engagements

  • Lead client and stakeholder conversations on platform scope, sequencing, dependencies, risk, and delivery expectations

  • Translate client business and operational requirements into clear, sequenced DevOps delivery plans

  • Set and manage delivery expectations proactively; communicate schedule and scope changes before they become escalations

  • Run delivery status reviews, readiness checkpoints, and go-live coordination with client IT, OT, and operations stakeholders

  • Negotiate and sequence platform work around client change-control constraints, including restricted deployment windows, change freezes, and the approvals required before any production system is restarted, and reflect those constraints in delivery commitments

  • Own resolution of delivery escalations, coordinating the right technical resources and closing the loop with the client

  • Represent the DevOps team at project kickoff, design review, commissioning, and startup milestones

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with client technical and business stakeholders that support account retention and growth

  • Coordinate hand-off to Day-2 operations, whether retained by the client, delivered by the firm, or delivered through an external operations partner, with the operating model agreed before go-live rather than at it

  • Act as the single point of intake for the DevOps team for all incoming project requests, capacity questions, technical escalations, and scope discussions

  • Own intake, triage, and prioritization of the DevOps backlog, balancing project deadlines, client priorities, technical risk, and team capacity

  • Insulate the team from one-off pulls and protect focus time for committed work

  • Run the team's delivery cadence (fourteen-day sprints with planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives), maintained on the team's GitHub project board with per-issue sprint, size, and client attribution, without overhead creep

  • Maintain visibility into each engineer's current load and commitments; flag overload, idle capacity, and blocked work early

  • Track and report delivery metrics, including throughput, cycle time, commitment reliability, escaped defects, and client satisfaction

  • Partner with Project Managers and Engineering Managers across the firm to integrate DevOps scope into broader project plans and report progress consistently

  • Surface prioritization conflicts and trade-offs that require a decision above this role to the DevOps Engineering Manager and the Practice Co-Leads

  • Continuously improve how the team delivers: intake templates, backlog hygiene, estimation practice, runbook quality, hand-off documentation, on-call coverage, and sprint metrics

  • Partner with the DevOps Engineering Manager on capacity forecasting and on the staffing implications of the forward pipeline

  • Support business development through scoping, estimating, and proposal input for DevOps and platform work

  • Own change order identification and the commercial impact of scope adjustments on DevOps work

  • Track engagement financial health for DevOps scope, including hours consumed against budget, burn rate, and margin risk

  • Maintain sufficient technical depth in Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, containerized industrial platforms, and the on-premises infrastructure this team operates (bare-metal clusters, distributed storage, and site networking) to challenge estimates, assess delivery risk, and hold credible client conversations without escalation

  • Partner with the Principal DevOps Engineer on architecture decisions that affect delivery feasibility, sequencing, and cost

  • Act as a positive role model of the firm's culture and the Guiding Principles of Leadership

  • Other duties as assigned.

  • Billable Hour Target expectations will be provided by Leader during the on-boarding process.

title: Electro-Mechanical Assembly Technician
description:
Join Rigaku in shaping a better world through new perspectives!

Electro-Mechanical Assembly Technician

Newton Scientific (NSI) is seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Electro-Mechanical Assembly Technician to support the manufacturing of precision electro-mechanical products. This is a full-time, hourly position. The Assembly Technician will primarily perform mechanical and electronic assembly tasks, including soldering, precision assembly, and inspection. Training will be provided for the right candidate who demonstrates motivation, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on assembly work and working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Job Responsibilities:

Mechanical & Electrical Assembly

  • Assemble electro-mechanical products and subassemblies according to work instructions, drawings, and specifications
  • Perform precision mechanical assembly using hand tools and assembly fixtures
  • Assemble electronic components and wiring harnesses
  • Perform through-hole and surface mount soldering as needed
  • Apply adhesives, epoxies, RTV, and other assembly materials as directed
  • Inspect assemblies for workmanship, completeness, and compliance with specifications
  • Maintain accurate assembly documentation and production records
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members regarding production schedules, questions, or issues
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area
  • Support continuous improvement efforts and assist with other production activities as needed

Qualifications:

Required:

o High school diploma or GED

o 1–3 years of assembly, manufacturing, or related production experience

o Strong attention to detail and manual dexterity

o Ability to follow written and verbal instructions

o Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Preferred:

o Experience working with small electronic and mechanical parts and precision assemblies

o Experience with through-hole and/or SMT soldering

o Experience using common hand tools and assembly equipment

o Experience working in a manufacturing environment

o Experience reading assembly drawings, work instructions, or manufacturing documentation.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods
  • Frequent use of hands for fine assembly and soldering tasks
  • Ability to lift and move materials up to 20 lbs.
  • Manual dexterity and good visual acuity for precision assembly work

Compensation

$25.00 - $30.00 per hour. Starting pay will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and internal equity. The final offer may fall anywhere within the posted pay range.

About Newton Scientific

Newton Scientific is a leading developer and manufacturer of miniature X-ray sources and high-voltage systems worldwide. As a subsidiary of Rigaku Corporation, NSI combines the collaborative culture of a small company with the stability and resources of a global organization. Employees work directly with advanced electro-mechanical products used in cutting-edge applications around the world.

Why join Newton Scientific?

  • Competitive pay based on experience and qualifications
  • Potential eligibility for annual merit and company performance-based bonus after 6+ months
  • Stable Monday-Friday work schedule, potential opportunity for overtime after completion of training (based on production demand)
  • Four weeks of Total Time Off (TTO) accrued during your first year
  • Eleven paid holidays annually
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Company sponsored events such as lunches, Holiday Dinner Party, happy hours, etc.
  • Convenient Charlestown location with free parking, large windows, and building amenities

Must be able to meet minimum qualifications to apply.

NSI is an EEO/AA employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Applicants must be able to prove they can legally work in the US.

title: VP of Engineering, E&A
description:
About Us:

Afinitas, headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, is a global leader in equipment, forming systems, and essential accessory products that support transportation, water, and utility precast concrete infrastructure worldwide. We provide industry-leading production equipment; highly engineered formwork; and a broad portfolio of precast concrete, electrical, and construction accessories, along with structural products and systems designed for bridge, highway, and heavy construction applications. Afinitas is part of BW Forsyth Partners, LLC, the investment group of global manufacturing and engineering consulting firm Barry-Wehmiller, a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members, united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.



Job Description:

POSITION SUMMARY

The Vice President, Global Engineering will be responsible for building a globally aligned engineering team across all Equipment & Automation (E&A) division sites. This leader will analyze the current state of engineering and lead a change management effort to drive standard global design philosophy, tools, methods, and metrics to enable consistency and quality of designs for the global manufacture of E&A products. This leader will lead the Engineering function for the division; both for the sold-work engineering cycle from customer product requirements through final production; and for the product development cycle from new product conception through production. The role will define and implement a global engineering team structure in a way that creates technical career paths while leveraging competencies across all levels of the engineering organization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assess the current state of Mechanical and Controls engineering within E&A’s multisite network and plan, develop, organize, implement, and execute a holistic framework, systems and structure for the engineering team
  • Lead, motivate, and develop the functional team (whether direct or indirect reporting) on an ongoing basis, and provide direct feedback and coaching to ensure a culture where team members feel cared for and perform with excellence
  • Define optimal engineering organization structure to support growth and career development, while promoting global flexibility of the group
  • Spearhead the development, communication, and implementation of global engineering standards for software used, design principles, drafting standards, BOM structure, part numbering, use of standard parts, HMI design, programming languages, etc.
  • Instill a generational product development approach to balance product line improvement and innovation with standardization and consistent manufacturability
  • Manage team members in project planning and priority setting to ensure operational objectives are obtained
  • Work in partnership with the VP, Global Operations and VP, Global Service & Aftermarket to ensure Engineering organizational structure and resources are aligned and supported to drive division-wide project management and E&A operation needs.
  • Submit thoughtful investment analysis (aligned with step-change) for any required technology or tools that expedite the engineering department’s progress
  • Create and drive tools and metrics that inform and improve performance, including analysis around shared capacity, reduced engineering content, and efficient team utilization
  • Drive an environment of continuous improvement and provide organizational support and structure to lead sustainable changes within the engineering function
  • Engage with multi-functional partners and business leaders, including those in operations, supply chain, service, sales, marketing, and the executive leadership team
  • Provide leadership and management expertise for the measurement and effectiveness within the Engineering function, utilizing data and metrics to instill Engineering accountability
  • Facilitate alignment with R&D team to ensure smooth handoff of new products into our Engineering team
  • Determine primary and secondary sites for key product lines and assess Engineering talent and development needs to achieve multi-site manufacturing
  • Provide support and assist with the change management with the introduction of new products

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years in a global company leading Engineering or Operations, with experience building and leading Engineering programs; experience in capital equipment, or complex systems manufacturing is desired
  • A technical degree in engineering or similar field is desired; the ideal candidate will have an advanced technical degree or MBA
  • A proven-track record of driving Engineering in identifying areas or improvement across an organization, implementing corrective actions and best practices when necessary
  • Demonstrated effective leadership (both direct and through influence) across multiple locations and cultures
  • Experience in a strategic leadership role that required formulating plans and policy and developing and implementing new strategies and procedures.
  • Ability to communicate and present complex information in a concise, compelling, and positive manner, as well as to listen and consider different points of view

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This is an office position that will require travel to a manufacturing facility. The employee must be able to correctly wear and use any Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required by the employer when in the manufacturing area.

title: Quality Technician III
description:
Worker Type

Regular


Job Description

Summary
The Quality Technician III supports the Quality Engineering group through processing First Article Inspection (FAI) and Part Approval Process, selective inspection, analysis and processing of internal Nonconformance Reporting (NC) material and other administrative and logistical support duties. Represents the Quality Department in witnessing and documenting UAV flight acceptance test activity.

Position Responsibilities

  • Processes inbound or outbound FAI and deliverable submissions accurately and timely including: receipt and analysis of parts and/or supporting documentation; completion of associated records and logs; communication of submission status as needed to QEs, managers, engineers or interested parties; processing of parts after completion; maintaining records and files associated with submissions; and other related tasks

  • Conducts selective inspection under the direction of the QE group including: receipt and verification of material, completion and maintenance of related documentation, communication of inspection results to concerned parties and processing of material after verification using Agile/Oracle database

  • Processes internal non-conforming material as needed in support of QE including: retrieval and analysis of material, interpretation of preliminary findings and restatement of problem statements to ensure understanding of problem, processing material through the necessary NC processes, communication of status to concerned parties, maintaining necessary documentation and processing material to internal and external suppliers

  • Provides general support of QEs including communication, Corrective Action Request processing, product evaluation, and sorting activities under exceptional circumstances, and interfacing with other team members as necessary to complete assigned tasks in support of continuous improvement initiatives using A3, Six Sigma DMAIC forms

  • Leads & facilitates problem solving activities such as Fishbone, 5-Why, Fault-tree, etc. Plans and coordinates QA Technician I and II activities and provides general guidance

  • Support DCMA Source Inspection process

  • Responsible for creating the Final Inspection documentation package including COC, TDR's, etc., and as necessary support internal/external customer inspection

  • Represents and supports QEs during internal and 3rd party audits regarding the essential functions above and as needed regarding our measurements system and documented system

  • Develops and maintains process instructions for quality-related activities

  • Works on assignments that are moderately difficult, requiring judgement in resolving issues or in making recommendations

  • Other duties as assigned

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent

  • 2 - 4 years of related work experience is required or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

  • Has Aerospace quality management system experience (AS9100DD) and/or internal audit experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in mechanical inspection methods and skills including surface plate work, hand tools, and gages, etc.

  • Solid ability to read and understand drawing requirements including a solid understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance to ANSI Y14.5

  • Good knowledge of FAI validation and verification process requirements

  • Good knowledge of engineering drawings and specification systems

  • Strong computer skills and is proficient in MS Office Suite (Word, Access, PowerPoint, Excel)

  • Must be able to fill out the necessary flight test documentation

  • Must document any/all non-conformances encountered

  • Must have the skills necessary to perform pre and post-flight visual inspections on flight hardware and components

  • Must possess the skills necessary to remove and replace field replaceable components on aircraft. Will populate excel spreadsheets on a daily basis documenting flight test results

  • Must able to work efficiently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

  • Required to travel to and from remote flying sites on a daily basis

  • Must have a valid California driver's license and clean driving record

  • Willingness to work overtime also a must

Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies

  • 2 year technical degree preferred; Quality system courses and/or equivalent experience preferred

  • Solid ability to accurately record and manage data, records, files and other documents to support tasks

  • Has an analytical approach to problem solving and high organizational skills in a fast-paced environment as well as effective time management, interpersonal and communication skills

  • Strong ability to manage time and prioritize tasks

  • Receives little instruction on daily work, general instructions on newly introduced assignments. Has substantial understanding of the job and applies knowledge & skills to complete wide range of tasks

  • Able to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties

  • Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives

  • Takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products

  • Is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others, and the company

  • Has effective problem-solving, analytical, interpersonal and communication skills. Focuses on teamwork, collaboration and puts the success of the team above one's own interests

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work the majority of the time outdoors in varying weather conditions, when needed, during flight test activity (Frequent)

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. and carry/move objects of varying shapes and sizes (Frequent)

  • Regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (Frequent)

No Clearance

title: Supply Chain BI Solutions Analyst
description:
Location: Markham, Ontario

Job Description:

Position: Supply Chain BI Solutions Analyst

Type: Full-Time | Permanent | Hybrid

Location: Markham, ON

About Us:

Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Job Description Summary:
Reporting into our Manager, BI Solutions, the primary focus of the Supply Chain BI Solutions Analyst role is to support our supply chain strategy, user, and customer experience by supporting Supply Chain systems, designing approaches using qualitative and quantitative methods through data and analytics to help us optimize and evolve our growing Pet Valu network.


The successful candidate will be responsible for building and fostering partnerships across the organization while supporting excellence within our Supply Chain team(s). They should be an effective communicator with the ability to collaborate with multiple levels of the organization, leveraging critical thinking skills to collect, analyze, and interpret data and situational/system opportunities. Additionally, they should be looked upon as a subject matter expert to align with best Supply Chain practices and be in sync with our Supply Chain network, systems, strategy, team culture, and the Pet Valu community. The Supply Chain Solutions Analyst role is ideal for someone passionate about using qualitative and quantitative methods to unlock opportunities for driving Supply Chain excellence and supporting key growth initiatives, with an overall belief in being part of something bigger.


Job Description:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Support in managing Blue Yonder and WebPortal data maintenance/accuracy, and exception management to support Vendor and DC/Store order flow.

  • Assist in ensuring Supply Chain application integrations are working as expected, identifying opportunities where they exist.

  • Identify and work on potential enhancement opportunities, collaborating with BA to represent the business in providing the requirements for development.

  • Lead and support User Acceptance testing on various enhancements and maintaining detailed documents.

  • Understanding the processes associated with inbound / outbound data flow between Supply Chain systems and ERP to help manage data issues.

  • Utilize various data analysis tools and techniques to identify patterns, outliers, and areas for improvement.

  • Perform complex data mining and ad-hoc data analysis using various tools.

  • Use data visualization tools to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.

  • Work closely with business leads to gather and document business requirements to support Supply Chain initiatives.

  • Ability to work positively with the team and cross-functional partners involved in key projects and/or Pet Valu business.

  • Strong planning, prioritization, and time management skills.

  • Self-motivated with a focus on driving exceptional results with a profound sense of teamwork and accountability.

  • Create/generate reports/dashboards, writing scripts where possible to automate.

  • Coordinate tasks for projects and other strategic initiatives with business leads.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Competencies:
Technical

  • Familiarity with Blue Yonder (JDA) and data mining applications (Tableau, Power BI, Excel, IBM Cognos) and languages (SQL, R, Python, VBA, DAX) and other basic coding languages.

Analytical

  • Strong analytical thinking and a commitment to improving data integrity and credibility for all programs.

  • Superior analytical skills that enable teams to interpret and transform customer needs, converting them into a better customer experience.

  • Use data to provide business insights that support our transformation journey.

  • Write scripts to analyze data to discover patterns, meaningful relationships, irregularities, and trends.

Teamwork

  • An effective team player who adds complementary skills and contributes valuable ideas and feedback.

  • Accountable for fulfilling any commitments made to others on the immediate or cross functional team.

  • Ensure the right business leads are informed and involved when required.

  • Build partnerships and work collaboratively with teams to achieve shared objectives.

  • Willing to “roll up their sleeves” when necessary to support tasks.

Execution with excellence

  • Take on new opportunities and challenges with a sense of urgency and enthusiasm.

  • Learn innovative methods, tools, and technology and apply them to business requests and tasks.

  • Demonstrate the ability to work independently on complex technical and business opportunities.

  • Acquire and utilize the necessary information from subject matter experts to deliver excellence.

Communication

  • Establish and maintain effective, dynamic relationships with management and user groups across the organization.

  • Demonstrate the ability to present and communicate effectively across cross functional teams, leadership, and third-party providers.

Experience, Education, Certifications:

  • Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Business, Math, Statistics, or related field.

  • 1-3 years of practical analytical experience in a professional environment or business setting, preferably in Supply Chain.

  • Preferably 1 – 3 years of Blue Yonder Supply Chain application experience.

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL to query relational databases.

  • Enhanced skills in using and implementing data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

  • Experience with open-source languages such as R, Python is an asset.

  • Proficient in advanced Microsoft 365 applications including Excel, Power Automate, SharePoint, Teams, Word, and Outlook.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills (written and verbal).

  • Must be able to travel to offices, stores, and distribution centers as required.

Compensation:

The targeted salary range for this position is $65,000-$70,000 annually. The final offer will be based on factors such as market location, relevant skills, experience and internal equity.

Ready to join the team?

We’re looking for passionate people who bring strong skills and live our core values of safety, compassion, expertise, and efficiency every day. If you’re energized by doing meaningful work, taking pride in what you deliver, and making a real impact for pets, people, and communities, you’ll feel right at home here. Join us and build a career where purpose, care, and excellence come together - because love lives here™.

Why work for us?

At Pet Valu, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We’re passionate about creating an environment where you feel supported, included, and empowered to grow - both personally and professionally. Some of the perks of working with us include:

Pet Valu is an equal opportunity employer committed to inclusion and accessibility. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process, in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA).

title: Senior Financial Systems Analyst
description:
Worker Type

Regular


Job Description

Summary
The Senior Financial Systems Analyst provides hands-on functional support for existing production finance systems and supports implementation activities for Oracle Fusion ERP and other finance applications, serving as a key functional resource for business process execution, system testing, training delivery, and user support. This role combines strong Oracle Fusion functional knowledge with process documentation, testing coordination, and training capabilities, supporting the Finance Systems team while helping drive operational excellence and end-user success.

Position Responsibilities:

Finance Systems Support & Implementation Execution

  • Support functional execution in Oracle Fusion workstreams (Procure to Pay, Record to Report, Quote to Cash, Project to Close) based on requirements defined by business and project teams
  • Document business processes, system workflows, and functional specifications for current-state and future-state operations
  • Ensure proper functional setup including chart of accounts, calendars, ledgers, business units, payment terms, tax rules, and approval hierarchies
  • Partner with IT Infrastructure on integration testing for Salesforce CRM, Workday HRIS, and third-party applications
  • Troubleshoot functional issues, research support documentation, and coordinate with Oracle support for complex problems

EPM, Apex & Finance Transformation Support

  • Provide functional support for Oracle EPM Cloud (PBCS, FCCS, Planning) including user setup, dimension maintenance, and troubleshooting planning/budgeting issues
  • Support Apex application rollout including functional testing and user training for finance-specific workflows and data collection forms
  • Coordinate testing for integrations between Oracle Fusion, EPM, and Apex applications, ensuring data accuracy and process alignment
  • Support finance transformation projects through functional configuration, testing coordination, training delivery, and capitalization documentation; assist with capex and opex reporting requirements

Testing Coordination & Quality Assurance

  • Develop comprehensive test scripts for unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) covering all Oracle Fusion workstreams and business scenarios
  • Support UAT execution including tester coordination, sandbox environment setup, test data preparation, and daily issue tracking during testing windows
  • Manage defect tracking using project management tools (Jira, Smartsheet) with clear documentation, priority assignment, and timely resolution; document test results and obtain UAT sign-offs for audit compliance
  • Execute regression testing after Oracle quarterly updates to validate existing functionality and identify impacts from new features

Training Development & Delivery

  • Design role-based training curriculum aligned with job responsibilities (AP Processor, AR Specialist, GL Accountant, Financial Analyst, Manager Approver, etc.)
  • Create and maintain training materials as evergreen content including user guides, quick reference cards, video tutorials, sandbox exercises, and FAQs
  • Deliver live training sessions (virtual and in-person) for end users across business units, including train-the-trainer sessions and post-training office hours for additional support

Production Support, Hypercare & Ongoing Operations

  • Support existing production finance systems (Oracle Fusion, EPM, Apex, and other applications) including daily troubleshooting, user support, and system maintenance; execute implementation activities for Oracle Fusion and other finance systems; provide hypercare support during go-live stabilization periods (first 90 days post-implementation), including extended hours and weekend availability
  • Serve as functional support for end users, troubleshooting Oracle Fusion issues and escalating to IT when necessary; monitor usage patterns, adoption metrics, and support tickets to identify training gaps
  • Maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, providing guidance on Oracle Fusion capabilities, support approaches, and leading practices

Business Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document end-to-end business processes using process flow diagrams, RACI matrices, and written procedures for all finance workstreams; maintain functional knowledge base including configuration decisions, business rules, and troubleshooting guides
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and adoption of new Oracle Fusion features introduced in quarterly updates
  • Partner with Accounting SMEs to gather feedback on pain points, bottlenecks, and enhancement requests for prioritization

AI/LLM Usage & Productivity

  • Use LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini) as daily productivity tools for creating test scripts, training materials, user documentation, and process guides; leverage AI to accelerate UAT preparation including test case generation and defect analysis
  • Collaborate with Senior Data & AI Analyst to validate AI agent outputs, provide user acceptance feedback, and support deployment by creating training materials for AI-enhanced workflows


Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience):

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field
  • 3-5 years of experience in finance systems, ERP implementation, or business process analysis
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financial Management (or Oracle EBS, PeopleSoft, SAP, NetSuite, or comparable ERP)
  • Experience coordinating UAT, developing test scripts, and managing defect resolution for ERP implementations
  • Experience designing and delivering end-user training for finance systems or business applications

Functional & Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of financial accounting processes including Procure to Pay, Quote to Cash, Record to Report, and Project to Close
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion functional configuration (setup tables, value sets, approval rules, reporting trees)
  • Proficiency with Oracle Fusion reporting tools (OTBI, BIP, Smart View, FBDI) for data extraction and analysis
  • Experience with testing tools and methodologies (test case design, traceability matrices, defect management, regression testing)
  • Strong Excel skills for data analysis, validation, and reporting; familiarity with SQL is a plus
  • Working knowledge of Oracle EPM Cloud (PBCS, FCCS, Planning) or comparable budgeting/planning platforms
  • Experience supporting Oracle Apex or low-code application platform rollouts and testing
  • Understanding of capex vs. opex accounting and finance project capitalization requirements

Communication & Training Skills

  • Strong written communication skills with ability to create clear, concise, user-friendly documentation for diverse audiences and translate technical jargon into business language
  • Effective presentation and facilitation skills for delivering training sessions to groups of varying technical abilities
  • Patient, supportive coaching style with ability to explain complex system functionality in simple terms
  • Active listening skills and empathy for user challenges during system transitions and go-live events

AI & Emerging Technology Skills

  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and experience using AI tools for productivity and content creation; willingness to experiment with new capabilities and interest in emerging finance technology trends
  • Basic understanding of AI agent concepts and ability to collaborate with technical teams on AI solution validation

Personal Attributes

  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused with commitment to accuracy in all deliverables
  • Self-starter who takes initiative to identify and solve problems proactively
  • Flexible and adaptable in fast-paced, changing environments with competing priorities; team player with collaborative mindset
  • Customer-service orientation with focus on end-user experience and satisfaction


Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in an office environment (Constant)
  • Required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (Frequent)


Clearance Level

No Clearance

title: International Trainee - Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes, and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives, and contribute to solving one of society’s most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall, and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each trainee position is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area, and working location. Each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges, and matching profile.

What you will experience

  • Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges
  • Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall’s different markets, business areas and locations through program activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration
  • Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives, and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm explains “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics Engineer

As a Hydro Power Optimisation and Data Analytics Engineer Trainee, you will join Production Support, a specialist and development function that supports safe, efficient and flexible hydropower production through optimisation, data analysis, digital tools and common working methods.

You will work closely with optimisation and development engineers, as well as colleagues in Production, Control Centres, Asset Management, IT and Markets. Together, you will turn operational and market-related needs into analyses, decision support and practical improvements for the operation of our generating units.

The role combines analytical problem-solving with hands-on development. You will use production and measurement data to evaluate performance, identify deviations and improvement opportunities, and contribute to the development of optimisation models, system services, forecasts, visualisations and data-driven working methods.

This is an opportunity to build broad expertise at the intersection of hydropower operations, energy markets, engineering and digitalisation, while contributing to increased flexibility, availability and long-term value from our hydropower assets.

Examples of your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Analyse production, operational and market-related data to identify trends, deviations and opportunities for improved performance
  • Support optimisation of generating units, water use and ancillary services through calculations, simulations and structured evaluation
  • Develop and improve analytical models, dashboards, visualisations and decision-support tools
  • Contribute to production analyses and technical studies for plant upgrades, operational changes and investment decisions
  • Work with data quality, measurement data and requirements for reliable and reusable data products.

Qualifications

Requirements for this trainee position

  • A Master of Science in Engineering or equivalent degree in a relevant field, such as Energy Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or Data Science
  • Knowledge of data analysis, statistics, optimisation, modelling or simulation
  • Experience from programming or analytical tools, for example Python
  • Be fluent in Swedish and English; proficiency in additional languages is considered a merit.

You also recognize yourself in

  • You approach complex questions in a structured and analytical way, and can turn data into clear conclusions
  • You have an interest in optimisation, digital solutions, and how they create operational and business value
  • You are curious, proactive, and motivated to test new methods while maintaining quality and reliability
  • You enjoy collaborating across professional boundaries, and can communicate technical findings to different audiences
  • You take responsibility, share knowledge, and are motivated by creating practical improvements for the business
  • You are motivated to combine engineering knowledge, data and collaboration to improve hydropower production.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for Vattenfall’s trainee programme, you should:

  • Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the program starts in March 2027
  • Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
  • Be available for the full-time program from its start date
  • Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
  • Be open to mobility opportunities, and collaboration across different locations
  • Demonstrate curiosity, initiative, and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive, and Safe.

Additional Information

Location

This position is located in Luleå, Sweden. You will work within Production Support in Business Unit Hydro Nordics.

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve."

title: Werkvoorbereider Na-aanleg
description:
Werkvoorbereider Na-aanleg

Ben jij op zoek naar een baan met veel afwisseling en verantwoordelijkheid? Ben je van nature nieuwsgierig, vind je het een uitdaging om problemen op te lossen en ben je goed in het contact met mensen? Lees dan snel verder!

Als werkvoorbereider ben je de spil in de voorbereiding van telecomnetwerken. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor zowel de technische als administratieve aspecten, van vergunningaanvragen tot personeels- en werkplanningen. Je zorgt ervoor dat alles soepel verloopt en dat alle neuzen dezelfde kant op staan. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de engineering van jouw eigen projecten

Een echte verbinder en bruggenbouwer. Je werkt nauw samen met diverse stakeholders, van opdrachtgevers tot eindgebruikers. Je hebt oog voor hun belangen en weet ze te betrekken bij het project. Je bent een kei in stakeholdermanagement en zorgt voor een optimale samenwerking.

Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team op de locatie in Tilburg. Samen met de Teamleider, Uitvoerders en andere Werkvoorbereiders pak je de verschillende projecten op.

Een greep uit de werkzaamheden

  • Samen met de uitvoerder organiseer en plan je monteurs in per deelgebied:

  • Je beheert voorlopige en definitieve plan data;

  • Ook bereid je de schouw voor en controleer je op naleving van kwaliteitseisen;

  • Je bestelt materialen en beheert de voorraden;

  • Je verzorgt de engineering voor jouw eigen projecten;

  • Uiteraard ben je het aanspreekpunt voor monteurs en bent ook in staat hen goed te begeleiden;

  • Uitgevoerde werkzaamheden, waarbij je revisies en materialen controleert;

  • Je ondersteunt de teamleider in zijn administratieve taken;

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het aanvragen van vergunningen en het voorbereiden van bodem checks;

  • Je stuurt het team aan op KPI’s en bent verantwoordelijk voor het afrekenen van aansluitingen.

Wat krijg je van ons

  • Een afwisselende en uitdagende functie voor 40 uur per week;

  • Een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring, met groeimogelijkheden tijdens je tijd bij Circet;

  • 8% vakantiegeld, wat we in mei uitbetalen;

  • Circet heeft een goede CAO (Metaal & Techniek) met bijhorend pensioen;

  • Een functie gebonden jaarbonus;

  • Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen, samen 38 vrije dagen per jaar (als je fulltime werkt). Met de mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 vrije dagen in te ruilen voor een hoger salaris;

  • Uiteraard krijg je van ons een reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Een laptop en een telefoon;

  • Circet NL werkt samen met Benefits at Work. Op dit platform kun je flink besparen dankzij leuke kortingen op mode, elektronica, dagjes uit en meer;

  • Bij ons kun je sporten met korting via ons bedrijfsfitness plan;

  • De mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen via de trainingsmodules van GoodHabitz of, wanneer je grotere stappen wilt maken, via onze Circet Academy.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Je hebt een MBO niveau 4 of HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een technische richting;

  • Je bent in het bezit van VCA;

  • Enkele jaren werkervaring als Werkvoorbereider

  • Natuurlijk ben je een kei in plannen en organiseren;

  • Je hebt een hoog verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en werkt accuraat;

  • Je bent leergierig en toont initiatief.

Wie is Circet?

Facetimen met je familie, razendsnel internetten, je elektrische auto opladen of een avondje Netflix: het kan allemaal dankzij ons werk.
Wij leggen supersnelle glasvezelnetwerken aan, zetten mobiele netwerken om naar 5G, installeren digitale meters en laadpalen en upgraden het elektriciteitsnet. Wij bouwen aan de vitale infrastructuur van de toekomst.

Ambitie en enthousiasme vinden wij belangrijker dan ervaring — via onze Circet Academy leiden we je verder op. Circet is wereldwijd een van de snelst groeiende organisaties in onze branche. Dat komt niet alleen door onze expertise, maar vooral doordat we het samen doen.

Solliciteren
Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer via de knop hieronder.

title: Manufacturing Maintenance Planner
description:
PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and schedule preventive and corrective maintenance work using the Max Maintenance system
  • Review, prioritize, and validate maintenance work requests for completeness and accuracy.
  • Develop detailed job plans including labor estimates, required tools, materials, permits, drawings, and safety requirements.
  • Coordinate maintenance schedules with production to minimize operational disruptions.
  • Maintain and optimize preventive maintenance (PM) programs based on equipment reliability and historical performance.
  • Create and maintain equipment bills of materials (BOMs), maintenance procedures, and equipment documentation.
  • Coordinate with Purchasing and Storeroom personnel to ensure parts and materials are available before scheduled work.
  • Monitor maintenance backlog and prioritize work based on criticality, safety, compliance, and operational needs.
  • Support shutdowns, turnarounds, and major maintenance projects through detailed planning and scheduling.
  • Ensure compliance with company safety policies, environmental regulations, and applicable maintenance standards.
  • Generate maintenance performance reports and key performance indicators (KPIs) for management.
  • Assist in developing annual maintenance budgets and forecasting maintenance resource requirements.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Excellent planning and organizational skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Effective verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of maintenance planning and scheduling best practices.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work across departments.
  • Ability to interpret technical manuals, engineering drawings, and equipment documentation.
  • Data analysis and KPI reporting capabilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to walk throughout manufacturing facilities for extended periods.
  • Occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to climb ladders, stairs, and access elevated platforms.
  • Ability to work in industrial environments with exposure to noise, heat, moving machinery, and varying weather conditions.
  • Manufacturing production facility with occasional office work.
  • May require occasional overtime, weekends, or on-call support during equipment failures or plant shutdowns.
  • Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required in designated production areas.
  • Technical Expertise
  • Communication
  • Results Orientation

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate degree in Industrial Maintenance, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of maintenance planning, maintenance supervision, or industrial maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience using CMMS software (SAP PM, Maximo, Max Maintenance, Infor EAM, Oracle, Fiix, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and industrial manufacturing systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
  • Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP).
  • APICS, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications.
  • Experience with predictive maintenance technologies.
  • Knowledge of TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) and Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM).

title: Employee Benefits Data Analyst
description:
**This is a hybrid role, requiring three days per week in the office.**

About HUB

In a rapidly changing world, HUB advises businesses and individuals on how to prepare for the unexpected. As one of the world’s largest insurance brokers, our focus is dedicated to providing our customers with the peace of mind that what matters most will be protected — through unrelenting advocacy and tailored insurance solutions that put our clients in control. Our growing team of professionals across North America represents a broad, deep and one-of-a kind aggregation of entrepreneurs and leaders recognized for their excellence throughout the insurance community.

Why Choose HUB?

Throughout our network of more than 600 HUB offices in North America, we offer a competitive, exciting, and friendly work environment that sets our employees up for long-term success. At HUB, we believe in investing in the future of our employees and provide continuous opportunities for growth and development. Our culture empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization, focusing on expanding the industry knowledge of our insurance professionals to better serve our valued clients. We are committed to providing you with competitive and flexible benefits options that are rooted in your current needs yet evolves as your needs change over time. Join us as you build your career and grow your professional skills.

We are the perfect fit if you:

  • are seeking a fast-paced role at a rapidly growing organization
  • have a desire to help others protect their future
  • enjoy taking initiative and helping grow the business
  • are focused on learning and development to enhance your industry knowledge and expertise
  • are a self-starter willing to invest time and energy to learn the technical aspects of our business
  • believe in integrity and building success by developing relationships with others

Data Analyst

HUB’s Data Analysts provide the critical data analytics and underwriting support to our Employee Benefits Department and customers that make us a leading sales and service organization in the insurance industry. Through a robust network of resources, you will be amongst some of the industry’s top talent to help guide and support our customer’s needs and help them find the right solutions.

This role requires an individual who is professional, highly analytical, driven, and self-motivated. The individual will provide timely, professional, and accurate data analytics services to the Employee Benefits Department and its customers. As a Data Analyst you will be responsible for sourcing, manipulating, and formatting data, using data to formulate projections and drive negotiations, and working in partnership with a team to develop effective cost management solutions as a part of a 3–5-year strategic plan. This role is designed as a launchpad for early-career professionals, with structured mentorship and a defined growth path toward senior analyst and financial consulting roles.

Responsibilities

  • Provide detailed and accurate data analytics services on a growing block of business to Hub’s clients

  • Produce client-facing reporting to include financial reporting and claims utilization, independent underwriting and renewal analysis, renewal projections, IBNR estimation, analysis of medical and pharmacy plan cost dynamics and budgeting
  • Build strong knowledge of carrier products and networks, cost management solutions, and funding mechanisms
  • Provide data and insight to support carrier negotiations and the overall renewal/marketing process
  • Build your skill set around data analytics
  • Support client service and sales by staying informed on industry trends
  • Actively engage in and support training and development opportunities

  • BA/BS required, preferably in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, or a related field
  • 1-3 years of professional experience (internships included) in data analysis, finance, or a related field; insurance or employee benefits exposure is a plus but not required.
  • Strong in analytics, mathematics, problem-solving and negotiation skill sets
  • Must be highly proficient in Microsoft Excel as well as other MS Office products
  • Experience or familiarity with data warehouse and business intelligence environments (e.g., SQL, Snowflake, Power BI) is a plus
  • Comfort learning and working with AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g., Claude) is a plus
  • Ability to present benefits data to key stakeholders, including HR teams, executives, and clients.
  • Must be detail-oriented, well-organized and have the ability to manage a high-volume workload with competing demands
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced team environment
  • Ability to travel to client sites as needed
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.

As a Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.

Your Impact

  • Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
  • Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
  • Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
  • Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
  • Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
  • Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.

This role is ideal for a highly organized individual who is committed to supporting multilingual learners and contributing to a structured, data-driven educational environment.

Instructional Support

  • Reconcile EL program reports to ensure accurate student data and participation records.

  • Complete required monitoring documentation for reclassified students (FEP1 and FEP2).

  • Participate in EL team meetings and network training sessions.

  • Collaborate with school staff to support student success and effective program implementation.

  • Maintain inventory and organization of AZELLA testing materials and EL program supplies.

  • Support school-wide initiatives focused on student achievement and language development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrate strong organizational and data-management skills.

  • Possess proficiency in English, including reading, writing, and speaking.

  • Demonstrate the ability to work effectively with multilingual learners and diverse student populations.

  • Show strong attention to detail and the ability to manage compliance-related responsibilities.

  • Demonstrate collaboration, professionalism, and initiative in a team-based environment.

  • Be able to follow established processes and work independently when needed.

  • Pass required background checks and obtain an Arizona IVP Fingerprint Clearance Card.

Compensation & Benefits

AMS offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support professional growth and long-term career success.

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer contributions.

  • Medical, dental, life, and disability insurance.
