title: Platform Engineer (Project Hire)
description:
Job Posting Title:

Platform Engineer (Project Hire)

Req ID:

10157372

Job Description:

The Platform Engineer is a skilled, independent contributor who designs, implements, and supports core platform and infrastructure capabilities that power magical Disney Experiences across parks, resorts, cruises, and consumer products. You will focus on data pipelines, on-prem server architecture, observability, and DevOps automation, ensuring robust, scalable, and reliable environments that enable teams to deliver seamless guest and cast experiences.

We are seeking an individual to take full ownership of a large-scale Splunk environment supporting mission-critical operational and engineering systems. This role will be responsible for managing the entire Splunk ecosystem from the infrastructure layer (bare metal) through application-level development, in direct support of software engineering teams responsible for complex physical systems and real-time operations.


This is a hands-on role requiring deep technical expertise across infrastructure, data ingestion, and observability, with a strong emphasis on reliability, scalability, and performance.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will act as a proficient problem-solver and effective partner to engineering and product teams, owning platform components from design through operations while mentoring colleagues and working with minimal guidance. You will emphasize automation, observability, and lifecycle management platforms to improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and support data-driven decisions that enhance Disney Experiences worldwide.

  • Own and manage the full Splunk stack

  • End-to-end responsibility from bare metal infrastructure → OS → Splunk architecture → dashboards and analytics

  • Design, deploy, and maintain Splunk infrastructure

  • Install, configure, and optimize Splunk components (indexers, search heads, forwarders, clustering)

  • Manage both on-premise/physical server environments and hybrid integrations

  • Support real-time operational systems

  • Enable monitoring and observability for high-availability, real-time engineering systems

  • Build dashboards and alerts used by engineering and operations teams

  • Develop data pipelines and ingestion strategies

  • Integrate data from diverse sources (logs, sensors, applications, control systems)

  • Optimize parsing, indexing, and search performance

  • Partner with software engineering leadership

  • Work closely with Software Engineering Managers and system teams

  • Translate operational requirements into scalable Splunk solutions

  • Performance tuning and system reliability

  • Identify bottlenecks across infrastructure and data pipelines

  • Ensure high availability, redundancy, and system resilience

  • Security, governance, and access control

  • Implement role-based access and data governance best practices

  • Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards

  • Continuous improvement

  • Recommend architecture improvements and modernization strategies

  • Evaluate tools within the Splunk ecosystem (e.g., ITSI, ES, Cribl, etc.)

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience with Splunk administration and development

  • Proven experience owning a Splunk environment end-to-end

  • Strong hands-on experience with:

  • Splunk Enterprise architecture (indexers, search heads, clustering)

  • Data ingestion, parsing, and optimization

  • Dashboard and alert development

  • Experience managing on-prem / bare-metal infrastructure

  • Linux administration (preferred)

  • Server provisioning, performance tuning, and system monitoring

  • Experience supporting real-time, high-availability systems

  • Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting engineering, industrial, or operational technology (OT) environments

  • Familiarity with observability and logging tools beyond Splunk (e.g., Cribl, ELK, Prometheus)

  • Experience with event-driven systems, telemetry data, or IoT/sensor integrations

  • Exposure to high-throughput environments with large-scale data ingestion

  • Splunk certifications (Admin, Architect, or Developer)

Required Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field or relevant work experience

title: Video & Motion Designer
description:
About Topgolf

Topgolf is a sports entertainment company that has changed how millions of people experience golf—and a genuinely energizing place to build a career. Every year, guests visit our venues for an experience that's hard to find anywhere else: hitting golf balls toward a target-lined outfield, tracking every shot in real time, enjoying great food and drinks, and connecting with friends, family, and coworkers.

With more than 100 venues worldwide and proprietary Toptracer technology integrated into our guest experience and licensed globally, Topgolf operates at the intersection of entertainment, technology, and hospitality. We are a growing, dynamic business with meaningful opportunities to innovate, scale, and continuously improve how we support our teams and our guests.

What We're Seeking

The Video & Motion Designer is responsible for creating engaging video and motion content across paid media, organic social, in-venue experiences, digital marketing, and internal communications. This role combines video editing, motion graphics, animation, and post-production expertise to bring creative concepts to life while maintaining Topgolf brand standards. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable assembling narrative-driven video content, creating motion graphics, and delivering platform-specific assets at a high volume and quality in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What You Will Do

Key Responsibilities

  • Assemble raw footage into polished, engaging videos following provided briefs and creative direction
  • Manage the full post-production workflow, from media management and rough cuts through color correction, audio mixing, and final delivery
  • Create original motion graphics, animated assets, and kinetic typography for marketing campaigns, social media, venue experiences, games, web, and app experiences
  • Develop platform-specific video and motion executions—including 6-, 10-, 15-, and 30-second ads—for paid media, social, in-venue displays, digital channels, and OOH placements
  • Collaborate with Creative Directors, Designers, Project Managers, Marketing partners, and external vendors to bring creative concepts to life
  • Organize and maintain media libraries, project files, templates, and archived assets

Core Competencies for Success

Creative Storytelling & Video Production

Brings narrative instincts and technical craft to transform raw footage into polished, brand-aligned video content.

  • Assembles raw footage into polished, engaging videos following provided briefs and creative direction.
  • Develops storyboards, narrative-driven videos, sizzle reels, executive presentations, and internal communications content.

Post-Production & Technical Execution

Manages the full post-production pipeline with expert command of industry-standard editing and motion tools.

  • Manages the full post-production workflow including media management, transcoding, assembly edits, rough cuts, fine cuts, color correction, audio mixing, and final delivery.
  • Maintains expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, with strong working knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator.

Motion Graphics & Animation

Creates original animated content and motion graphic executions that elevate brand storytelling across channels.

  • Creates original motion graphics, animated assets, and video content for marketing campaigns, social media, venue experiences, games, web, and app experiences.
  • Incorporates kinetic typography, animated brand elements, and visual effects that elevate the overall creative experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partners closely with Creative and Marketing stakeholders to bring creative concepts to life while honoring brand standards.

  • Collaborates closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Project Managers, Marketing partners, and external vendors.
  • Implements concepts and visual direction from Creative leadership while ensuring alignment with Topgolf brand standards.

Organizational Rigor & Execution

Delivers high-volume, platform-specific assets on tight timelines without sacrificing quality.

  • Organizes and maintains media libraries, project files, templates, and archived assets.
  • Incorporates feedback efficiently through multiple rounds of revisions while maintaining project timelines and creative quality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Film, Video Production, Motion Design, Animation, Multimedia, Graphic Design, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • 3–5+ years of professional experience in video editing, motion design, or post-production within an in-house creative team, agency, production company, or marketing organization
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects
  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Experience with video editing workflows including media management, transcoding, compression, codecs, and platform-specific exports
  • Experience creating motion graphics, kinetic typography, and animated social content
  • Strong storytelling instincts with the ability to craft narrative-driven edits
  • Highly organized with exceptional file management and project organization skills
  • Effective time management with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to receive and implement creative feedback

Bonus Qualifications

  • Knowledge of on-set production, including lighting, camera setup, and audio capture
  • Experience with Blackmagic, Canon, and Sony camera systems
  • Understanding of graphic design fundamentals and visual storytelling principles
  • Experience with visual effects (VFX) and 3D animation tools such as Houdini, Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar software

Sounds like a fit? We can't wait to meet you!

BENEFITS

Free Play & 1/2 price food! Health, dental, vision, 401(k) team member match, free mental well-being platform – and that’s just for starters for those who qualify. View team member benefits here.

title: International Trainee - Environmental Specialist
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

  • Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
  • Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee – Environmental Specialist

You will join Waste & Environment West, a team that supports Vattenfall's businesses with environmental expertise across hydropower, nuclear power, new nuclear, wind power and heat. In this role, you will contribute to environmental assessments, permitting activities and environmental coordination in projects and operational activities. You will collaborate with environmental specialists, project teams, technical experts and authorities, while gradually taking on more responsibility as your knowledge grows. This is an opportunity to develop your expertise in environmental management and environmental legislation while bringing a fresh perspective to the environmental challenges connected to the energy transition.

Your responsibilities:

  • Support environmental specialists with environmental matters in projects and operational activities across several of Vattenfall's business areas.
  • Contribute to environmental assessments, environmental plans, permit processes and environmental documentation.
  • Help review environmental legislation and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in environmental coordination, environmental risk assessments and chemical-related matters.
  • Collaborate with colleagues, specialists and authorities across different energy technologies.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Environmental Specialist

  • Academic background in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering or a related field.
  • Basic knowledge of environmental legislation, permitting processes, regulatory requirements or environmental management.
  • Experience of environmental matters in projects, permitting processes or interaction with authorities is considered an advantage. This experience may have been gained through a thesis project, internship, student employment or an early-career role.
  • Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

You should also recognize yourself in

  • Enjoying collaboration with colleagues from different disciplines and building strong relationships across teams and stakeholders
  • Being comfortable navigating changing priorities and new challenges
  • Working in a structured and careful way when handling documentation, environmental requirements and stakeholder communication
  • Being curious and motivated by learning how environmental considerations are applied across different energy technologies.

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:

  • Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027
  • Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles
  • Be fluent in English
  • Be available for the full-time programme from its start date
  • Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements
  • Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location: Gothenburg or Ringhals

You will be working in the Waste & Environment West team at Business Unit Vattenfall Power Solutions, located in Gothenburg and Ringhals, Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations.

title: Physical Security Assurance Specialist, NA
description:
About Vantage


Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Physical Security Department

The North America Physical Security Department is focused on delivering a best-in-class security program aligned with Vantage’s vision of becoming the leading industry physical security data center provider. Our mission is to safeguard our data center environments through comprehensive, scalable, and standardized physical security processes that deter threats, promote rapid incident response, ensure regulatory compliance, and support Vantage’s rapid growth.

The department leads all physical security efforts across North America, ensuring that every Vantage data center operates within a consistent, scalable, and standardized security framework. Our teams design and implement physical security programs, systems, and processes that deter threats, strengthen site resiliency, and enable rapid response to incidents. We partner closely with Operations, Engineering, Construction, IT, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that physical security is embedded into every phase of the asset lifecycle and supports Vantage’s rapid expansion.

Position Overview

This role may be based at any Vantage location within the United States, following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office and 2 days flexible).

The Specialist, Physical Security Assurance and executes operational assurance, control-testing, assessment, and compliance activities supporting the North America Physical Security program. The Specialist evaluates whether physical security controls are appropriately implemented and operating effectively, documents defensible evidence and conclusions, identifies control deficiencies and risk themes, and coordinates corrective actions through validated closure.

Serving as a key connection between physical security standards and site-level execution, the Specialist applies consistent assurance methodologies across the portfolio and supports audit readiness, risk management, quality assurance, performance reporting, and continuous improvement. The role works cross-functionally with Security, Operations, Technology, Construction, and other stakeholders to strengthen control effectiveness, accountability, and program maturity.

Duties

Audit Execution and Control Testing

  • Conduct site audits, assessments, and control testing across physical security environments

  • Execute standardized control test procedures and validation processes aligned with enterprise frameworks

  • Perform physical inspections of security infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, and intrusion detection systems

  • Validate system configuration, coverage, and operational performance

Data Collection and Documentation

  • Collect, review, and maintain audit evidence in accordance with established standards and audit requirements

  • Ensure all documentation is accurate, complete, and audit-ready

  • Maintain detailed audit records, workpapers, and supporting artifacts

  • Support development of audit reports and findings documentation

  • Coordinate evidence collection and validation for internal and external audits, customer reviews, and other assurance activities

  • Support document lifecycle activities, including version control, periodic review, approval tracking, publication, retention, and archival

Compliance Management

  • Maintain the corrective-action register and monitor action owners, target dates, aging, status, and closure evidence

  • Review remediation evidence to determine whether corrective actions sufficiently address identified deficiencies

  • Escalate overdue, recurring, or material control deficiencies in accordance with established governance requirements

  • Support root-cause analysis for recurring findings and systemic control weaknesses

  • Support the maintenance of physical security risk registers and facilitate the linkage of assessment findings, control deficiencies, and corrective actions to applicable risks

Quality Assurance

  • Conduct quality assurance reviews of physical security programs, processes, and audit deliverables to ensure consistency, accuracy, and alignment with established standards and governance requirements

  • Analyze audit, assessment, and compliance data to identify trends, recurring control deficiencies, and opportunities for continuous improvement across the physical security program

  • Support the development and maintenance of quality metrics, performance indicators, and assurance reporting to measure program effectiveness and drive operational excellence

  • Maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering assessment completion, control-test results, findings by severity, remediation aging, overdue actions, repeat findings, evidence quality, and control effectiveness

Operational Assurance Support

  • Perform periodic assurance checks and control reviews beyond formal audits

  • Monitor and evaluate control performance and relevant system-health indicators

  • Support the development and implementation of continuous-assurance processes and capabilities

  • Manage assigned assessments and assurance deliverables with limited day-to-day supervision

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Partner with site security teams, regional operations, and technical teams to clarify audit findings, validate corrective actions, and ensure alignment with security standards

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to stakeholders on required remediation actions

  • Support cross-functional collaboration to improve control implementation and operational consistency

Job Requirements

Required

  • Three or more years of relevant experience in physical security, quality assurance, audit, compliance, risk management, or a related control-based environment. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience may be considered

  • Working knowledge of access control systems, video management systems, intrusion detection and alarm systems

  • Ability to apply audit, assurance, quality-control, or control-testing methodologies and translate requirements into repeatable test procedures

  • Experience developing dashboards and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms to track compliance, audit findings, corrective actions, and key performance indicators

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to collect, validate, and document evidence

  • Ability to analyze and interpret control effectiveness and compliance requirements

  • Experience documenting findings, managing corrective actions, reviewing remediation evidence, and monitoring issues through closure

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

  • Travel is expected up to 25%

Preferred

  • Experience in data center, critical infrastructure, or enterprise environments

  • Familiarity with governance frameworks, audit processes, or compliance programs

  • Experience supporting SOC audits, customer audits, ISO-aligned management systems, or enterprise assurance programs

  • Experience conducting physical security risk assessments, site-security reviews, or security vulnerability assessments

  • Familiarity with corrective-action management, root-cause analysis, and continuous-improvement methodologies

  • Experience aligning programs to ISO 27001, ISO 9001, or comparable standards

Wait, there’s more! At Vantage Data Centers, we offer our Colleagues:

  • Collaborative work environments with dynamic growth opportunities

  • Our commitment to your ongoing career development and education

  • Comprehensive and competitive benefits package

  • Opportunity to work on some of the world's most iconic and innovative projects and to shine as an industry leader

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $100,000 - 115,000 (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits

  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.


Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.


Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.


Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.


We’ll be accepting applications for at least one week from the date this role is posted. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!

title: PG Depot Engineer
description:

title: Project Scheduler Associate - Sr. | Transmission

09-28-2026

The role ensures insurance policies, claims, payments, accounting entries, and related transactions are processed accurately, timely, and in compliance with established procedures.

  • Experience processing insurance policies, claims, payments, reconciliations, accounting transactions, or related operational activities preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and required.

Position Summary:

An Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Intern at Crane Resistoflex is responsible for supporting manufacturing operations by identifying workplace hazards, improving safety performance, and reducing environmental impacts across the facility. This role works closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, and Maintenance teams to evaluate processes, recommend improvements, and implement projects that enhance employee safety, environmental stewardship, productivity, and operational efficiency. They will also own larger cost reduction projects from ideation, feasibility and design, Capital Expenditure approval, and implementation. The EHS Intern will drive continuous improvement initiatives, conduct risk assessments, support environmental sustainability efforts, and ensure safe work practices are incorporated into manufacturing operations. Lead/Support quality improvement initiatives as per IATF 16949-2016 to achieve set sigma level for value stream. Guide production team on issue resolution using knowledge relevant to your department specialties.

Principle Duties (includes, but is not limited to):

  • Design and implement improvements to production processes and controls.
  • Develop improvements to manufacturing methods to improve safety, reduce cost, or increase productivity.
  • Conduct safety audits, inspections, ergonomic evaluations, and risk assessments to identify hazards and recommend corrective actions.
  • Partner with operations and engineering teams to proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with equipment, processes, and facility operations.
  • Research and develop opportunities to reduce workplace risks, improve operational efficiency, and support sustainability goals.
  • Aid operations in ensuring parts are safely fabricated in accordance with product specifications.
  • Analyze processes for safety, quality, and efficiency opportunities.
  • Resolve quality issues, identify trends, determine root causes, and take corrective actions.
  • Improve manufacturing process to reduce process variability and increase yields.
  • Represent engineering as part of a cross-functional team including safety, quality, and operations.
  • Prioritize and execute projects within the agreed upon timeline and provide updates on project status.
  • Take ownership of projects and execute through design, fabrication, implementation, and sustainment.
  • Participate in week-long team-based problem solving / continuous improvement events.
  • Develop and manage action plans for long term projects through completion.
  • Research and develop high value cost saving opportunities and use data to project savings that justify any necessary capital expenditure.
  • Participate in quality improvements as per IATF 16949 2016 ensure to complete toll gates for DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plan, MSA, Process capability study for in house process
  • Ensure requirements of relevant standards like ISO 9001-2015, PED 2014/68/EU, API Spec. Q1, API 6D, etc. are being consistently met and improved.

Essential Qualifications / Experience:

  • In progress of achieving B.S. in Environmental Health, Engineering, or related degree.
  • Problem solving and root cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to work hands on in a manufacturing environment and engage effectively with employees at all levels.
  • Proficient with 2D and 3D CAD software

Preferred Qualifications/Experience

  • Exposure to lean manufacturing and 5S practices.
  • Proficient with data analysis, statistics, and applied mathematics.

  • Working experience with SolidWorks and AutoCAD

title: AVP, Product Management
description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:

LPL Financial is seeking an Assistant Vice President, Data Product Owner (DPO) to own and manage Wealth Management data products. This individual contributor role is responsible for the day-to-day ownership, execution, and governance of assigned datasets, ensuring they are accurate, usable, and aligned with business needs. The role partners closely with engineering, data stewards, and business stakeholders to define requirements, manage data quality, support governance activities, and drive adoption of high-quality data products across the organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the named Data Owner for assigned Wealth Management data products.

  • Define and maintain business definitions, metadata, data product documentation, use cases, and consumer information.

  • Establish and maintain data quality rules, thresholds, and monitoring practices in partnership with Data Stewards.

  • Evaluate datasets for fitness-for-purpose and support data access decisions within established governance guardrails.

  • Prioritize and manage enhancements through the data product backlog and roadmap.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for consumers of assigned data products.

  • Support Wealth Management domains including clients/participants, accounts and transactions, and securities and pricing.

  • Ensure data products support operational, business, and regulatory use cases.

  • Execute data product lifecycle activities including defining, building, publishing, operating, and enhancing data products.

  • Maintain data product artifacts such as product charters, product canvases, backlogs, and roadmaps.

  • Partner with delivery teams to ensure requirements are documented and actionable.

  • Identify and manage Critical Data Elements (CDEs).

  • Monitor data quality metrics and trends and drive remediation of data defects and issues.

  • Escalate material data risks to appropriate leadership when necessary.

  • Collaborate with engineering and data custodians to review data structures, transformations, lineage, and schema changes.

  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications.

  • Utilize enterprise data governance and data catalog tools.

  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and other stakeholders to support enterprise initiatives requiring trusted data products.

title: IT Operation Engineer
description:
The IT Operations Engineer delivers exceptional, personalized technology support to clients across all work environments. This position ensures seamless operation of all technology systems—on-premises, cloud, and mobile—providing proactive solutions and rapid response to maintain an uninterrupted user experience. The role requires discretion, professionalism, and a commitment to excellence in every interaction.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Rapid Issue Resolution:
    Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems across hardware, cloud applications, SaaS platforms, and connectivity (Wi-Fi, VPN, and Zero Trust network access) with minimal downtime.
  • Desktop & Deskside Support:
    Provide hands-on desktop and deskside support, including hardware setup, software installation, peripheral configuration, and workstation troubleshooting for executive offices.
  • Confidentiality & Security:
    Ensure strict adherence to data privacy and security protocols, including multi-factor authentication, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and Zero Trust principles, when handling sensitive information.
  • Personalized Technology Consulting:
    Advise executives on emerging technologies, cloud upgrades, and optimizations tailored to their workflows and preferences.
  • Disaster Recovery & Continuity:
    Participate in planning and execution of cloud-based business continuity and disaster recovery strategies, including data redundancy and rapid failover, for executive systems.
  • Documentation & Training:
    Maintain clear documentation of configurations and processes using modern knowledge-base and ticketing platforms. Provide discreet training and guidance to VIPs on new tools and workflows as needed.

Technical Expertise Required:

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Windows/macOS endpoint management; familiarity with Copilot and other AI-powered productivity tools.
  • Proficiency in mobile device management platforms (Intune, Jamf) for iOS/Android/macOS, and secure remote access technologies (VPN, Zero Trust Network Access, RMM tools).
  • Strong understanding of modern networking (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6/7), unified communications platforms (Teams, Zoom), and security protocols including MFA and Zero Trust.
  • Experience with cloud backup and disaster recovery solutions, endpoint detection and response (EDR)/next-gen antivirus, email security tools, and system performance tuning.
  • Familiarity with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python) to streamline routine support tasks.
  • Hands-on desktop support skills, including PC/Mac hardware break-fix, OS imaging and deployment, printer/peripheral setup, and A/V and conference room equipment support.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

Key Attributes:

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure with urgency and precision.
  • High level of discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Adaptability and eagerness to learn emerging technologies in a fast-changing IT landscape.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally (minor travel required) to support executive locations or offices as needed.

Skills, Education, and Experience:

  • Education:
    Bachelor’s Degree in a computer-related field preferred (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Experience:
    • 5+ years of progressive IT support experience, with at least 2+ years in executive or VIP technology support.
    • Proven expertise in Ethernet network environments, enterprise-grade peripherals, and advanced troubleshooting.
    • Hands-on experience with server platforms (HP, Lenovo, or equivalent), including deployment and monitoring tools.
    • Solid desktop support background, including ticketing systems, asset/inventory management, and new-hire onboarding/offboarding.
    • Strong background in Microsoft ecosystems (Windows Server, Exchange, O365) and mobile device management (iOS, Android).
    • Familiarity with cloud technologies, remote access solutions, and collaboration platforms.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Understanding of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, WINS, and network security principles.
    • Proficiency in endpoint security, backup solutions, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Soft Skills & Attributes:
    • Exceptional communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to interact confidently with senior executives.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset.
    • Project management experience for technology rollouts and upgrades.
    • High level of discretion and professionalism when handling sensitive information.
    • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Other Requirements:
    • Must be available for on-site support 5 days/week, flexible for after-hours/on-call needs, and committed to white-glove, premium service.

Salary Range:

The expected base salary for this position ranges from $65,000 to $75,000 annually. The actual base salary will be determined on an individualized basis taking into account a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, education, and, where applicable, licenses or certifications held. title: ServiceNow HR Business Analyst
description:
The ServiceNow HR Business Analyst supports the Global ServiceNow HR Product in delivering Chubb’s global HR service delivery needs. This role gathers, analyzes, and translates business requirements into technical specifications, helps implement and optimize HR processes, and works closely with global HR stakeholders and the HR Technology team to identify pain points, design solutions, configure the platform, and support efficient HR operations. The role also partners with the Technology team to support integration with Chubb’s chatbot, and related enhancements.   • Project Management: Contribute to project planning, execution, and monitoring of release plans and other projects.

  • HR Process Knowledge: Strong understanding of HR processes and HR service delivery.
  • ServiceNow Expertise: Experience configuring and customizing ServiceNow HRSD, including workflows, forms, reporting, and data handling.

The pay range for the role is $87,600-$128,400. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. title: Technology Internships
description:

Are you passionate about technology, innovation, and solving complex problems? Join ACI Worldwide's Technology Internship Program and gain hands-on experience building and supporting the software and infrastructure that powers digital payments around the globe.

Clients trust us to manage the intricacies of their transactions and disputes, synthesising legal and commercial knowledge to provide counsel that translates into successful outcomes. By leveraging our deep understanding of real estate and legal frameworks, we help clients achieve their goals in a dynamic and evolving market.

We are currently looking for a junior to mid-level real estate associate to join our New York and Chicago offices.

In addition to strong academic credentials, you should possess excellent technical skills and a solid base of knowledge and experience across the real property sector. Bright and adaptable, you should be willing to work across a broad range of real estate matters and asset classes, including work that may fall outside a traditional real estate practice.

Working on a relatively high volume of matters at any one time, you will need to be highly organized, adept at managing multiple workstreams and producing outstanding results within the short deadlines often demanded by our clients’ projects.

Collaborative and cooperative, you should enjoy working as part of a team but also demonstrate an independence of thought and action, proactively anticipating clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations by developing creative and original solutions to their problems.

  • Conduct and coordinate due diligence for real estate transactions, including acquisitions, dispositions, financings and joint ventures

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED

Experience

  • 2 years of experience in a manufacturing or comparable work environment where duties include inventory control.

Preferred Job Requirements

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

title: Risk Specialist
description:
Your role

As Risk Specialist, you help Fastned strengthen its risk and control framework while enabling the business to grow responsibly and at speed. You combine a structured, analytical approach with pragmatism: making risk management practical, accessible, and proportionate to the challenges of a fast-growing organisation.

You will work across all stakeholders in the organisation: from Operations and Construction to Product & Engineering, and business functions such as Finance and Legal & Compliance. By partnering closely with teams throughout the company, you help protect revenue, support scalable and compliant growth, and embed a culture in which risks and controls are understood and owned across the business.

What you will contribute

You will play a key role in further developing and embedding risk and control awareness across Fastned. Together with the Sr Risk Manager, you will help ensure that risks are identified, assessed, monitored, and addressed effectively. It is a team of two, so you will be close to everything.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Define, maintain, and drive Fastned's risk management framework, including policies, control measures, risk appetite principles, and the risk roadmap.

  • Lead fraud detection and investigation as a key operational risk domain, developing detection rules, managing alerts, and investigating suspected incidents involving customers, employees, and third parties.

  • Make risk tangible by translating risk exposure into measurable indicators, developing KRIs and dashboards, and monitoring alerts to identify emerging risks and prioritise follow-up.

  • Act as subject matter expert and trusted advisor to (senior) stakeholders, embedding risk considerations in decision-making and ways of working across the organisation.

  • Increase risk and control awareness throughout the business, enabling all departments to identify, assess, and own their risks and controls.

  • Guide and coach risk champions across the organisation, strengthening the first line and building lasting risk capability at all levels.

  • Define and implement risk reporting, including thematic deep dives, communicating findings clearly to audiences ranging from operational teams to the Managing and Supervisory Board.

  • Work cross-functionally on projects, ensuring risk and control considerations are embedded from the start.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in risk management, internal control, or a similar role.

  • Strong understanding of risk concepts and control frameworks, with practical experience applying them.

  • Experience building or shaping risk practices rather than only maintaining them. The ability to navigate an organisation where risk practices are still taking shape, with flexibility and pragmatism, is a must.

  • Experience with fraud risk and knowledge of fraud typologies. This is a significant part of the role, so practical exposure counts for a lot.

  • An understanding of what being a listed company means for risk and compliance. Having worked in a listed environment, or in a scale-up or fast-growing organisation, is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence colleagues at all levels; strong written and spoken English required, Dutch is a plus.

  • The confidence to challenge constructively and bring structure to complex or evolving situations, while helping teams move forward, without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Proactive, pragmatic, curious, and result-driven; able to work independently and as part of cross-functional teams.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort digging into data. Experience building data models and dashboards, or working with BI/AI tools and SQL, is a strong plus.

  • Acts with high integrity and confidentiality.

  • A relevant professional certification in risk management or a related field is a plus, as is a bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Information Science, Law, or equivalent.

Not sure you tick all the boxes, but have a high motivation? Just reach out to us, we're curious to hear your motivation!

Join us in building a better future!

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We put a focus on work-life balance, provide you with genuine work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place.

Our benefits include:

  • Stock option plan - we believe in shared value creation.

  • Attractive Pension plan fully covered by Fastned.

  • Company bonus plan.

  • 29 holidays. Additionally, we give you 2 ‘Mission Days’ you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Fully electric company car.

  • Yearly training budget of € 3000.

  • Access to the mental health platform Nilo Health including 10 sessions with psychologists of your choice.

  • Urban Sports Club Subscription.

  • Additional parental benefits above legal minimum, including coaching via Foundtree.

  • Accessibility to Women's Health platform Flouria.

  • Daily lunches, snacks & drinks are provided at our office locations

  • Company events year-round, including an exciting yearly trip abroad with all employees.

title: SRAM Circuit Design Intern, MS - Summer 2027
description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell's Central Engineering Foundational IP team is looking for a motivated SRAM Circuit Design Intern to join us in Burlington, VT. You'll work hands-on as part of a team designing, verifying, and characterizing high-performance memory used in cutting-edge semiconductor technologies. This role is an incredible opportunity to apply your digital and analog circuit design fundamentals while collaborating with experienced engineers on real-world products that are deployed at scale.

About the Position:
Are you ready to use your engineering background to innovate and deliver the data infrastructure technology that connects the world and enables the powerful AI tools that are revolutionizing our industry? The Central Engineering Memory Development team designs and implements cutting edge memory solutions for state-of-the-art ASICs and business units within Marvell. As a member of the Memory Development team you will join a select group of engineers working in the world’s most advanced process technologies and forge the way for industry leading chip design. The team designs custom SRAM compilers, hardware security IP, and software to guide System on Chip (SoC) memory usage in advanced Gate All Around (GAA) and FinFET semiconductor nodes.
This team hires some of the biggest problem solvers in Silicon and has a huge impact on the work done at Marvell. The customers served by this team are often other chip companies and big tech companies, familiar names to all candidates.

What You Can Expect

  • Design and implement custom digital circuits optimizing Power, Performance, and Area metrics (PPA)
  • Schematic entry (Cadence Virtuoso), Circuit Simulation (Spectre, MDL), Verification (Verilog, VHDL)
  • Statistical analysis of complex circuits across a wide Process, Voltage and Temperature range
  • Process and visualize data using scripting tools (Perl, Python, Copilot)
  • Verilog test pattern generation, simulation and waveform debug for large, complex memory designs
  • Analyze, summarize, document, and present results to stakeholders to justify design approaches

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field with an expected graduation date between Fall 2027 – Summer 2028

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity working in a Unix/Linux environment

  • Understanding of analog or digital memory circuits

  • Strong Programming Skills in common scripting languages

  • Previous exposure to Cadence design tools

  • Ability to work independently with regular check-ins and team support

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

35 - 69, $ per hour.

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.





Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights for our interns: medical, dental, and vision coverage, perks and discounts, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and paid holidays. Additional compensation may be available for intern PhD candidates. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

title: Business Analyst
description:

2+ years of experience as a business analyst, preferably in a warehouse or supply chain environment.

Possess strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actional insights.

Effectively use Microsoft Office software to communicate via email, to review reports and documents.
Demonstrate outstanding customer service and interpersonal communication skills.
Possess a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Be able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Be able to research, analyze data, and solve problems.
Be able to prioritize work projects and multi-task.
Read, write, speak, and understand English.
Be able to add, subtract, multiply, and divide, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.

Skills development assignments include, but are not limited to, successful completion of compulsory training, testing and certifications; attainment of required Operator Qualifications; and demonstration of proficiency in performance of job duties associated with regulated and non-regulated distribution work. title: Associate Power Systems Engineer -Outage Management System
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) is a high growth area in our business that unlocks an electric distribution utility’s ability to monitor, manage, control, and optimize the grid. As an Associate Power System Engineer you will be involved in all aspects of the successful delivery of systems to our customers. You will be engaged with our customers supporting efforts to design, build, configure, troubleshoot, and test the deployment of our systems. This position gives you broad exposure to the entire ADMS and will focus on advanced applications such as Distribution Power Flow (DPF), Fault Location Isolation & Service Restoration (FLISR), and Volt/VAR Control & Optimization (VVC/VVO). In this role, you will be a primary point of contact with our customers throughout and after the project lifecycle. You will have the opportunity to work across functional teams including other ADMS Application Engineers, the Architecture & Product Solution teams, and our Software Development organization. This is a hybrid role with 4 days in the office environment.

Your Impact

  • Implementation of control systems at electric utilities that improve their efficiency to operate the modern grid while ensuring contract requirements and specifications are met.
  • Participate in design, planning, and execution of ADMS projects.
  • Installation and configuration of advanced distribution management applications such as Distribution Power Flow (DPF), Fault Location Isolation & Service Restoration (FLISR), and Volt/VAR Control & Optimization (VVC/VVO).
  • Support testing events with the customer.
  • Work closely with OSI development teams to troubleshoot, prioritize, and test product changes.
  • Interface with the utility’s Geographic Information System (GIS) teams to extract, translate, and load the electrical network model to the Distribution Management System.
  • Configure and integrate software components to meet contract requirement specifications and test with customers.
  • Train customers on how to operate the systems being delivered.
  • Provide technical support to troubleshoot and resolve issues observed on live systems.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years work experience in a similar engineering role or an advanced degree with less years of experience.
  • Programming and scripting experience (C/python).
  • Strong work ethic including willingness to learn and investigate new technologies and problems.

The PSW Coordinator oversees, supports and monitors PSW’s to ensure that direct personal and nursing care fulfil the holistic needs of the resident in accordance with Southbridge’s policies and procedures.   • Complete audits on documentation in POC including BSO as per schedule. · Assume responsibility for personal/professional growth and development through Staff Development Program, committees, and in-services.
  • Audit therapeutic tubs as per schedule to ensure they are clean prior to use, that includes observing PSW’s cleaning/disinfecting between use, and they follow cleaning and disinfection protocols to minimize the spread of infection.

  • Contributes to the delivery of person and family-centered care by utilizing communication strategies (person-centered language) that demonstrate compassion, validate emotions, support dignity, and promote understanding.
  • Audits of units to ensure cleanliness, tidiness to ensure safety and advocate for optimal quality of life for the residents.

  • Demonstrate understanding of the Residents’ Bill of Rights.

Infection Control & Prevention

  • Perform all duties in accordance with Infection Prevention and Control standards, policies, and procedures

Customer Service

  • Ensuring resident privacy
  • Respecting resident’s property
  • Advocating on behalf of the resident

Accountabilities

  • Carry out all assigned duties in compliance with applicable Occupational Health and Safety legislation and Company policy.
  • Follow safe work practices as directed by their supervisor and as required by the applicable Occupational Health and Safety legislation.
  • Participate in all required occupational health and safety training.
  • Use appropriate equipment and wear personal protective equipment or clothing, as required.
  • Report any known or identified health and safety hazards or violations to their supervisor.
  • Refrain from any conduct that puts themselves, workers, contractors, or others at risk. · Ensure the maintenance of a safe environment for residents, staff, and visitors; adhere to expectations that hazardous

conditions and actions are promptly corrected and reported.

  • Report faulty equipment uses Lock Out-Tag Out and ensure immediate removal from the unit and contact charge nurse or nursing supervisor.

This position serves as a Contract Consultant and is responsible for negotiating, drafting and administering supplier contracts of moderate complexity, working in conjunction with Legal and other internal stakeholders to protect the interests of AEP.

In this high-visibility role, the Contract Consultant will report to department and company leadership on the health of the assigned contract(s) and participate in the development and approval of contracting strategies. Additional duties include ensuring compliance with all statutes, regulations, company policies and contractual obligations.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

  • Draft and negotiate contract terms and conditions, analyze commercial sections of proposals and scopes of work, and interface with all disciplines, including legal, risk management, project controls, construction, engineering, finance/accounting and suppliers.

  • Prepare, maintain, retrieve and communicate records, reports or documents that may be required to meet corporate and Contract Administration requirements.

  • Provide consultative, analytical and contract administration support for commercial operations and senior management.

  • Protect the Company’s interest by enforcing warranties and mitigating risk.

  • Execute portfolio assignments as requested, perform contract risk assessments, and formulate mitigation strategies.

  • Develop Supplier performance criteria and service levels that align with business requirements.

  • Manage and oversee amendments to existing agreements using various models.

  • Lead the negotiation process through strategy development, issue recognition, and escalation of issues for moderate to complex negotiations.

  • Analyze vendor claims and lead in negotiating settlements for a broad range of issues, including impact of changes-in-law and governmental impositions.

  • Coordinate, prepare, and track documents to declare, close, and quantify impact of Company force majeure events.

  • Ensure all work activities are performed in accordance with the policies, practices, standards, and rules of the company.

  • Draft deal summaries for assigned contracts.

  • Other duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in related field of study + 4 years of relevant work experience.

  • (or) In lieu of Bachelor’s degree must possess an Associate’s degree in related field of study, and a minimum of 6 years of relevant work experience.

  • (or) In lieu of Associate’s degree must possess a High School Diploma or equivalent, and a minimum of 8 years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as a Masters in Business Administration, Law degree or global equivalent.

  • Six (6) years of contract administration, subcontract administration, and procurement experience.

  • Experience developing and negotiating contracts terms and conditions for contracts related to services, construction, engineering, materials and equipment installation.

  • Experience administering the Request for Proposal/Request for Quotation process.

  • Experience in work change, claims evaluation and negotiation.

  • Experience with Contract Lifecycle Management systems.

Other Requirements:

  • Physical demand level is Sedentary

  • Demonstrate significant experience in a moderate range of subject categories relevant to areas of contract responsibility.

  • Apply problem-solving skills and use creativity in problem solving.

Where You'll Work:

What You'll Get:

  • 401(k) Match

  • AEP Pension

  • Comprehensive Benefits Package

Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. title: Scribe Tech
description:
About Our Company

We’re a physician-led, patient-centric network committed to simplifying health care and bringing a more connected kind of care.

Our primary, multispecialty, and urgent care providers serve millions of patients in traditional practices, patients' homes and virtually through VillageMD and our operating companies Village Medical, Village Medical at Home, Summit Health, CityMD, and Starling Physicians.

When you join our team, you become part of a compassionate community of people who work hard every day to make health care better for all. We are innovating value-based care and leveraging integrated applications, population insights and staffing expertise to ensure all patients have access to high-quality, connected care services that provide better outcomes at a reduced total cost of care.

Please Note: We will only contact candidates regarding your applications from one of the following domains: @summithealth.com, @citymd.net, @villagemd.com, @villagemedical.com, @westmedgroup.com, @starlingphysicians.com, or @bmctotalcare.com.

Job Description

Scribe Tech

The Scribe Tech is responsible for:

  • Capturing accurate and detailed documentation of the patient visit into the EMR in a timely manner.
  • Assisting the physician with basic patient care and medical procedures.
  • Assisting site management with directing patient flow, inventory, and following up on labs.
  • Ensuring site lab compliance with Department of Health (DOH) Regulations.
  • Provide unparalleled customer service to our patients, adhering to established protocols and work processes, and successfully managing volume without ever compromising quality.

*This is a great opportunity for those interested in CNA, MA, EMT, or Paramedic careers

* Great exposure to the healthcare profession (excellent resume builder for medical school, PA school, nursing school)

Essential Functions/Responsibilities:

The essential functions of a Scribe Tech are:

  • Assisting the physician with basic patient care and medical procedures, which may include but is not limited to phlebotomy, Urine Drug Screens, lab processing, fit testing, rapid point of care testing, UA, EKG, procedure set ups, etc.
  • Ensuring Department of Health (DOH) compliance of site lab and exam rooms which may include but is not limited to logbook maintenance, checking for expired medications and supplies, proper handling of specimens etc.
  • Escort patients to exam rooms, x-rays or other facilities on site as needed.
  • Ability to maintain quick pace in fast paced urgent care facility for the duration of scheduled shift (8-12 hours except for meals/break time).
  • Facilitating any necessary diagnostic tests (e.g., CT, MRI, ultrasounds, etc.) and referrals to medical specialists for follow-up care via Aftercare
  • Communicating with patients, pharmacies, and physicians over the phone under physician guidance.
  • Helping maintain a clean, courteous, and professional working environment.
  • Ensuring the site is fully stocked with supplies.
  • Providing compassionate care to our patients.

Qualifications

A candidate’s qualifications will include:

  • High School Degree or GED, Undergraduate degree a plus
  • Graduation from an accredited Medical Assisting program and/or phlebotomy certifications a plus, but not required. Training will be provided.
  • Friendly and professional with excellent bedside manner.
  • Flexible with full-time work schedule including a weekend day.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills.
  • English language (speaking and writing) skills required
  • High attention to detail.
  • Must exhibit passion for outstanding results and compassion for those we work with and serve.
  • Team player.
  • Knowledge of third-party payor requirements preferred.
  • Strong aptitude for detail, and ability to work independently, required.
  • Strong organizational, problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills required.
  • Computer Proficiency
  • Happy and positive thinking, able to project this attitude around others.
  • Flexible & adaptable nature to work in a continuously evolving environment.
  • Passion for helping others in an urgent care environment.
  • Bilingual language skills required or preferred based on-site location.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required at time of hire.

Physical requirements

The job may require at times to lift light to moderate amounts of weight (e.g., boxes of medical/facility supplies) to assist team members. Job also requires the ability to maintain a quick pace in fast paced urgent care medical facility for the duration of scheduled shift minus meal/break time.




Pay Rate: $20.58 per hour


The provided compensation amount is based on industry standards and salary determinations will be made based on numerous factors including but not limited to years of experience and location of position.




About Our Commitment

Total Rewards at VillageMD

Our team members are essential to our mission to reshape healthcare through the power of connection. VillageMD highly values the critical role that health and wellness play in the lives of our team members and their families. Participation in VillageMD’s benefit platform includes Medical, Dental, Life, Disability, Vision, FSA coverages and a 401k savings plan.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Our Company provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of, race, color, religion, creed, gender/sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression (including transgender status), national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, military status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Safety Disclaimer

Our Company cares about the safety of our employees and applicants. Our Company does not use chat rooms for job searches or communications. Our Company will never request personal information via informal chat platforms or unsecure email. Our Company will never ask for money or an exchange of money, banking or other personal information prior to the in-person interview. Be aware of potential scams while job seeking. Interviews are conducted at select Our Company locations during regular business hours only. For information on job scams, visit, or file a complaint at .

Position: Systems Business Analyst

Department: IT (Supply Chain)

Positions Type: Full time, Permanent

Work Location: London, United Kingdom (hybrid- 3 days per week in office)

What you will be doing:

We are seeking a Business Systems Analyst with expertise in Oracle ERP solutions and business process mapping to join our dynamic IT team.

This role will analyze, design, and implement solutions that enhance business operations, particularly in Order Management and Supply Chain domains.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, experience in process optimization, and a Bachelor’s degree with progressive experience in providing IT solutions in Supply Chain.

Business Analysis & Process Mapping

  • Working closely with business stakeholders to understand and translate process inefficiencies into Oracle ERP solutions primarily focused in the supply chain and distribution space
  • Conducting end-to-end process mapping, identifying gaps and automation opportunities to improve efficiency
  • Developing functional specifications, business requirements documents (BRD), and process flow diagrams
  • Performing gap analysis between business requirements and Oracle ERP capabilities

ERP Implementation & Solution Development

  • Designing and implementing Oracle ERP solutions for Order Management, Advanced Pricing, and Supply Chain modules
  • Work with the EDI team to deploy, test and validate EDI solutions with customers and 3PL warehouses
  • Experience around Available to promise, Item master/MDM and Production Information Management (PIM) Modules in oracle.
  • Working with cross-functional teams to integrate Oracle ERP with third-party applications such as NuOrder or other digital application tools.
  • Working experience in B2B and DTC Environment and complexities around the same.
  • Lead configuration, customization, and enhancements to Oracle ERP applications or other ERP’s.
  • Basic Knowledge of Financial modules like AP, AR and GL.

Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Providing technical support and troubleshooting for Oracle ERP systems
  • Optimizing system performance and resolve complex business problems
  • Ensuring data integrity, compliance, and alignment with best practices
  • Developing and maintaining comprehensive system documentation

🗝Skills needed to be successful in this role:

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written), French a plus.
  • Excitement about joining a midsize yet growing company with fast-growing brands!
  • Project Management Capabilities to connect with various stakeholders and handle small to mid-sized projects

Minimum Qualifications:

  • University degree or technical experience in IT Business Systems Analysis with progressive experience in providing solutions in Supply Chain or equivalent.
  • Adept at integrating Oracle ERP or other ERP’s (SAP, MS Dynamics etc) with other enterprise systems
  • Working experience in Supply Chain domain area around Order Management, Warehousing, Procurement and Planning
  • Working experience in various reporting tools like Power BI, OBIEE etc

  • 💪 Lunch and Learns
  • 🏝 Company closure between Christmas and New Year’s

  • 👌 The chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment!

title: Postdoctoral Scientist - Gulati Lab - Center for Neural Science & Medicine
description:
Principal Investigator, Tanuj Gulati, PhD is looking for a Postdoctoral Scientist to join the team!

When the work you do every single day has a crucial impact on the lives of others, every effort, every detail, and every second matters. This shared culture of happiness, passion, and dedication pulses through Cedars-Sinai, and it’s just one of the many reasons why we rank as one of the top hospitals in the nation by U.S. News & World Report.

The Gulati Laboratory is a systems neuroscience laboratory interested in understanding the motor basis of behavior. The lab uses cortical and spinal electrophysiology to understand the neural basis of motor control and learning, as well as sleep-related consolidation of a motor skill.

The Gulati Lab is also investigating novel neuroengineering strategies for repair and functional recovery after brain injury (stroke) and spinal cord injury that utilize development of spinal/cortical motor prostheses, brain machine interfaces and neurorobotics. To learn more, please visit: Gulati Lab | Cedars-Sinai (cedars-sinai.org).

Are you ready to be a part of breakthrough research?

Under the guidance and mentorship of Dr. Tanuj Gulati in the Center for Neural Science and Medicine (CNSM) within the Department of Biomedical Sciences (BMS), and working closely with other postdoctoral scholars, graduate students, undergraduate students, research associates, and collaborators, the postdoctoral fellow will be engaged in cutting-edge research with the goal of developing a mechanistic understanding of stroke recovery and developing rehabilitation therapies in preclinical rodent stroke models. The postdoctoral scholar will be responsible for performing rodent procedures such as rodent stroke surgeries, viral injections, neural implant procedures (for recording and stimulating neural activity). The postdoctoral scholar will also develop new rodent stroke models (endothelin injections) and implement simultaneous neurophysiological recordings with stroke injury in awake behaving rodents. They will participate in data analysis and interpretation and may assist in preparation of grant proposals. The postdoctoral scholar will participate in publications and presentations as an author or co-author.

Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • May assist in the preparation of grant proposals, but is not responsible for generating grant funds.
  • May participate in publications and presentations as author or co-author.
  • Designs and performs experiments. Will keep appropriate experimental records and documentation and analyze the results with the Principal Investigator.
  • Analyzes interpret, summarizes, and compiles data.
  • Performs routine and complex laboratory procedures throughout the training period.
  • Operates and maintains equipment and instruments.
  • May observe MD-patient or MD-human research subject interactions as it pertains directly to research being performed.

Department-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Perform rodent stroke surgeries and neural implant procedures for recording and stimulation of neural activity.
  • Perform neural implant (recording/ stimulation) surgical procedures and optogenetic viral injections.
  • Perform rodent stroke procedures (photothrombotic, endothelin and middle cerebral artery occlusion), conduct neurophysiology recordings in rodents during motor training and spontaneous periods.
  • May write/modify IACUC application in collaboration with the PI.
  • Interacts respectfully and efficiently with other lab members, department colleagues, and husbandry and clinical staff of Comparative Medicine.

Education:

  • Doctorate (MD, PhD, VMD, or DDS) in area directly related to field of research specialization.

Experience and Skills:

  • Acquires thorough technical and theoretical knowledge of research project and objectives during one to five (1-5) year post-doctoral appointment.
  • Works independently on research projects designed by a mentor (typically the PI) within area of specialization.
  • Previous experience with rodent surgeries and animal intracranial electrophysiology is required.
  • Proven ability to conduct rodent procedures as evidenced by first author publications is required.
  • Demonstrated aptitude to perform experimental protocols and procedures, including detailed data collection, analysis, operation, and maintenance of specialized equipment.
  • Function efficiently and cooperatively with a team of faculty, research associates, technicians, and students.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills are essential.
  • Knowledge of safety standards and maintenance of specialized equipment.
