We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting .

Job Summary

The Senior Exercise & Training Analyst will initially focus on Disaster Recovery technology testing and exercise activities, while supporting related training activities and maintaining broader exercise and training responsibilities across Emergency Management, Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, operational resilience, incident management, and enterprise preparedness in alignment with the Enterprise Resilience Policy and the Training, Exercise and Evaluation Standard. This role develops exercise and training materials, supports facilitation, manages evidence, documents results, and contributes to after-action reporting, corrective-action tracking, records maintenance, and program reporting. The Senior Analyst partners with Business Units, Operating Companies, technology stakeholders, and external partners to validate preparedness capabilities against defined scope, objectives, assumptions, dependencies, RTO/RPO expectations, validation criteria, and enterprise preparedness standards. Assignments may focus on exercise activities, training activities, Disaster Recovery testing, or integrated exercise and training efforts based on program needs. The Analyst Senior applies independent judgment to improve documentation quality, strengthen learning materials, measure training effectiveness, identify capability gaps, and support preparedness validation.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

Essential Job Functions & Tasks:

  • Leads selected exercise and/or training activities consistent with the Enterprise Resilience Policy, the Training, Exercise and Evaluation Standard, HSEEP methodology, adult learning principles, and enterprise preparedness expectations.

  • Support or leads assigned exercise activities, training activities, Disaster Recovery testing, or integrated exercise and training efforts based on program needs, role expectations, and enterprise preparedness priorities.

  • Develops exercise materials, learning objectives, curricula, job aids, facilitation guides, validation materials, after-action inputs, and corrective-action documentation.

  • Partners with Business Units, Operating Companies, technology stakeholders, and external partners to validate preparedness capabilities and role-based readiness.

  • Monitors exercise evidence, training completion, learner feedback, documentation quality, capability gaps, and improvement-plan progress.

  • Executes assigned tabletop, functional, full-scale, seminar, workshop, Disaster Recovery testing, and training delivery activities, including scheduling, materials preparation, facilitation support, evidence management, and results documentation.

  • Develops corrective-action documentation and reporting inputs to support improvement-plan tracking, gap resolution, preparedness reporting, and program maturity measures.

  • Partners with junior analysts by providing guidance on exercise design, training support, facilitation preparation, validation methods, and documentation quality.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Utility or critical-infrastructure experience; Enterprise Resilience Policy and Training, Exercise and Evaluation Standard familiarity; HSEEP methodology familiarity; ICS, NIMS, FEMA National Response Framework, and ISO 22301 familiarity; adult learning, instructional design, training facilitation, learning evaluation, virtual facilitation platforms, learning management systems, exercise management tools, and change management experience.

ABOUT TOPGOLF

Topgolf is a sports entertainment company that has changed how millions of people experience golf—and a genuinely energizing place to build a career. Under the direct supervision of the Pharmacist, the Student Employee in the Cancer Institute Pharmacy will assist and support the pharmacist in the day-to-day dispensing operations. The Student Employee will be responsible for compounding sterile preparations, including chemotherapy infusions. They will utilize technology when necessary and appropriate, such as the electronic medical record. They will perform daily and monthly cleaning tasks for the cleanroom suites on a rotating basis or as assigned. The Student Employee will prioritize work based on immediate need and rapidly changing workload.   • Computer skills (i.e., Microsoft Office and EMR experience)

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. This role ensures a rapid response to user needs, escalates critical issues, and drives incident mitigation. The role is also responsible for proactive monitoring, incident documentation, and seamless collaboration with engineering, business, and executive leadership teams to ensure incidents are resolved promptly. The selected candidate drives major incident resolution efforts by leveraging active communication skills as well as critical problem-solving skills.

  • Partner and participate in Major Incident Problem Management reviews

  • Hands-on experience fulfilling user service requests and troubleshooting front-line technical issues
  • Proven ability to lead during high-pressure, mission-critical incidents
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills for presenting needs, challenges, and solutions to teams, partners, and stakeholders, as well as driving critical incidents to resolution

  • Experience with observability tools such as DataDog, BigPanda, Conviva, Grafana, Splunk
  • Experience leading peers as well as working with minimal supervision


Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge and experience with Problem Management or Change Management Processes
  • Knowledge of reliability and resiliency practices (failover strategies, circuit breaker patterns)

description:
A+E Global Media offers a work environment where employees collaborate in office 3 times per week. Division Story

A+E’s Technology team is deep-rooted in the heart of our business. We have great people and great technologies, and together we take on the toughest challenges. As innovators, we choose to iterate, pivot, and adapt quickly. We’ve reinvented the way A+E leverages technology to produce and sell world-class content. We’ve modernized our core solutions and embraced a cloud first approach. Perched on the virtues of our “Technology Code”, we make technology better, create solutions together, and most of all, we have fun with it. Our team members are motivated individuals who help each other do remarkable things every day. Together we deliver best-in-class solutions that transform the way A+E works. If this sounds like something you want to be a part of, we want to hear from you!

Job Description

The Corporate Solutions team within A+E Technology implements and supports the applications used by the Human Resources and Legal & Business Affairs organizations, including enterprise-wide platforms such as Workday, eDocs, and Docusign. While many of these solutions are third-party applications—primarily SaaS and client-server platforms—they often require integration with A+E’s technology infrastructure for hosting, security, identity management, and single sign-on.

The Sr. Business Analyst, Corporate Solutions will collaborate with business stakeholders, Technology peers, and management to support and enhance the existing corporate applications ecosystem while identifying and delivering technology solutions to address evolving business needs. This role will be responsible for analyzing and documenting business and user requirements, supporting application operations, and contributing to project management activities for new implementations, enhancements, integrations, and process improvements.

MORE ABOUT WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Gather and document business requirements, workflows, use cases, and user stories.
  • Compare current-state and future-state processes and document gap analyses, including opportunities for improvement.
  • Research emerging technology and business solutions, identify options to address gaps, and collaborate with the team to develop a technology roadmap.
  • Participate in vendor evaluations, RFPs, product demonstrations, and selection processes.
  • Serve as a liaison among business stakeholders, implementation consultants, vendors, and internal Technology teams to configure and implement solutions within defined scope.
  • Extract data from existing systems and develop data mappings to support data conversion and migration activities.
  • Develop test cases, test plans, and supporting documentation for system testing and user acceptance testing.
  • Prepare user guides, training materials, and other supporting documentation; conduct training sessions and contribute to change-management plans that promote user adoption.
  • Provide application support and collaborate with internal development teams and vendors to resolve production issues and deliver enhancements.
  • Stay current on emerging technologies, industry trends, and business solutions while continuously expanding knowledge of the organization’s applications and processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Analysis

  • Lead requirements analysis, functional and technical design, and production implementation for HR and Legal applications, including Workday, eDocs, DocuSign, and other third-party solutions.
  • Analyze business requirements, processes, and workflows to produce clear, concise, and unambiguous system requirements.
  • Review business use cases and validate that they adequately address proposed HR and Legal business-process flows.
  • Ensure that business and technical requirements are understood, agreed upon, and formally approved by the appropriate stakeholders at key stages of the project lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with internal Software Development and Infrastructure teams to continuously evaluate and improve the HR and Legal application technology ecosystem.
  • Identify opportunities where technology, new system development, enhancements to existing applications, and integration solutions can improve efficiency, productivity, and user experience.
  • Serve as a liaison among vendors, Technology teams, and business stakeholders to identify process enhancements, resolve issues, and define system improvements.

Application Support

  • Work closely with vendor support organizations and internal Technology teams to support and maintain existing HR and Legal applications.
  • Investigate, analyze, and resolve application issues in a timely manner while minimizing business disruption.
  • Identify recurring defects, break/fix issues, and root causes; recommend and implement actions to prevent recurring problems.
  • Monitor application performance and stability and escalate issues to the appropriate internal or vendor support teams.
  • Document incidents, resolutions, known issues, and support procedures to improve knowledge sharing and operational effectiveness.

Project Management

  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Provide direction and guidance to assigned project managers, review project requests, and coordinate project activities across stakeholders and Technology teams.
  • Prepare project activity and progress reports for regular status reporting, covering both project initiatives and application-support work.
  • Monitor project progress, dependencies, issues, and risks to help ensure that programs, initiatives, and projects are delivered on time and within agreed-upon scope.
  • Proactively identify risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans to address potential impacts to timelines, resources, budget, and deliverables.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis.
  • 1–2+ years of recent experience implementing or supporting corporate, HR, or Legal applications, including vendor-provided and custom-built solutions.
  • Knowledge of HR and Legal business processes, with an understanding of how technology can be leveraged to support these business areas.
  • Excellent analytical, verbal, written, facilitation, and organizational skills.
  • Experience conducting user audits using Excel or other appropriate tools.
  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and highly interested in systems, technology, and process improvement.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional business and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated business acumen and the ability to apply technology solutions to address business challenges.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively and influence stakeholders at all levels of management.
  • Demonstrated ownership, accountability, and integrity.
  • Demonstrates, models, and promotes the vision and values of the Technology team.

Desired:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.
  • Experience working in the media industry, including experience with an agency, technology vendor, or media company.
  • Experience configuring and integrating HR applications, such as Workday, strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting Legal applications, such as eDocs or similar document-management systems, preferred.
  • Experience supporting corporate applications, such as DocuSign, preferred.

Compensation

Annual Incentive Target: 12.50%

title: General Superintendent
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Who You'll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the U.S., becoming part of a team of over 1,500 professionals dedicated to shaping the world around us. As a General Superintendent within our Construction Practice, you will provide leadership and oversight for multiple industrial construction projects serving Food & Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods, Life Sciences, Advanced Technology, and Manufacturing clients.

The General Superintendent serves as the senior field operations leader, partnering closely with Project Directors, Construction Managers, Project Managers, Safety Managers, and client leadership teams to ensure successful execution of projects while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, schedule, and field productivity. This role provides direct leadership and mentorship to Superintendents and field staff across multiple projects and geographic locations.

What You'll Do

Field Operations Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership and oversight of field construction operations across multiple projects and job sites.
  • Establish and maintain consistent project execution standards, safety expectations, and quality requirements across all assigned projects.
  • Lead, mentor, train, and develop Superintendents, Assistant Superintendents, and field personnel.
  • Evaluate field staffing needs and coordinate resources to support project demands.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex construction, schedule, safety, and subcontractor issues.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Construction Directors to develop project execution strategies and recovery plans.
  • Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and operational excellence.

Project Oversight

  • Provide strategic oversight for multiple industrial construction projects from pre-construction through commissioning and closeout.
  • Monitor project progress, productivity, schedule adherence, quality performance, and safety metrics.
  • Conduct regular site visits and field audits to ensure compliance with company standards and client expectations.
  • Review and support development of site logistics plans, staffing plans, and construction sequencing strategies.
  • Identify project risks and implement corrective actions to mitigate schedule, quality, or budget impacts.
  • Ensure consistent implementation of project controls, documentation, and reporting processes.
  • Support project teams in managing inspections, permitting activities, and project turnover.

Pre-Construction Leadership

  • Participate in constructability reviews, planning sessions, and project execution strategy development.
  • Support estimating and operations teams during project pursuits and proposals.
  • Review staffing requirements, equipment needs, logistics plans, and project schedules.
  • Evaluate subcontractor capability, workforce plans, and site readiness requirements.
  • Collaborate with project teams to establish project-specific safety, quality, and execution plans.

Construction Execution

  • Provide oversight and support to site Superintendents to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Monitor labor productivity, subcontractor performance, and field coordination activities.
  • Facilitate resolution of field conflicts, design issues, and construction challenges.
  • Conduct regular project reviews focused on safety, schedule, quality, and resource utilization.
  • Ensure job sites maintain company standards regarding housekeeping, organization, and professionalism.
  • Support commissioning, startup, and turnover activities as required.

Safety Leadership

  • Champion a proactive safety culture and ensure compliance with all company HSEQ programs and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead safety reviews and audits across multiple project sites.
  • Review project safety performance metrics and implement corrective actions when necessary.
  • Partner with Safety Managers to drive continuous improvement initiatives and achieve incident-free projects.
  • Ensure Superintendents are properly trained and equipped to effectively manage job site safety.

Scheduling & Planning

  • Review and evaluate master project schedules and recovery plans.
  • Ensure Superintendents maintain effective short-term planning through look-ahead schedules.
  • Identify schedule risks and work with project teams to implement corrective measures.
  • Support resource planning and allocation across multiple projects and regions.

Client & Team Leadership

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, contractors, subcontractors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Represent Design Group during client meetings, project reviews, and operational planning discussions.
  • Foster collaboration between project management, engineering, procurement, quality, and field teams.
  • Provide leadership that promotes employee development, engagement, and retention.
  • Lead by example and uphold Design Group's core values in all interactions.

Travel

  • Travel regularly to project sites throughout assigned regions.
  • Support projects requiring extended site visits during critical construction, commissioning, and startup phases.
  • Work schedules may include nights, weekends, and holidays as project needs dictate.

What You'll Bring

  • 15+ years of industrial construction experience, including significant experience leading field operations on large and complex projects.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Senior Superintendent, Lead Superintendent, General Superintendent, Construction Manager, or equivalent leadership role.
  • Proven ability to supervise multiple concurrent industrial construction projects and field teams.
  • Experience managing projects ranging from $10M to $250M+ in industrial, manufacturing, food & beverage, life sciences, advanced technology, or mission-critical environments.
  • Strong knowledge of construction means and methods, site logistics, scheduling, quality control, and subcontractor management.
  • Demonstrated success building, mentoring, and developing high-performing field teams.
  • OSHA 30 certification required; OSHA 500, CHST, CSP, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Procore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6, and other construction management software.
  • Experience working within active operating manufacturing facilities preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.


At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process. ​

Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.

title: Technical Lead - Full Stack Development
description:
We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead, Full-Stack Development to lead the design, development, and enhancement of enterprise applications. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. The successful candidate will be expected to actively write production-quality code, build APIs and integrations, troubleshoot complex issues, review code, and guide other developers.

The ideal candidate has strong experience delivering scalable application solutions and working across both front-end and back-end technologies.

This role will support a manufacturing-focused organization and may contribute to digital initiatives involving plant systems, data collection, MES, and shop floor connectivity. Prior Industrial IoT experience is highly desirable. The successful candidate should be willing to deepen their knowledge of IoT connectivity concepts and best practices and progressively take ownership of this area while collaborating with business and technical teams.

**Work Location and Schedule

This is a primarily remote position with an expectation of approximately one day per week on-site at TWB's Monroe, Michigan location. Candidates located in the Detroit metropolitan area or within a reasonable commuting distance are preferred.

**Work Authorization

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a hands-on technical lead who designs, develops, tests, debugs, and maintains scalable enterprise applications while actively contributing production-quality code.

  • Learn and apply IoT connectivity concepts, integration patterns, and best practices.
  • Progressively take ownership of the IoT connectivity area, including technical standards, solution design, documentation, and support practices.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support reliable and secure data exchange between connected systems.
  • Lead the setup of a standardized container-based development environment for the TWB development team.
  • Define the tools, configurations, templates, and practices needed to build, run, debug, and test containerized applications consistently.
  • Create reusable Docker and Docker Compose configurations that support local development and testing, and contribute to Kubernetes-based deployment configurations as needed.
  • Establish standards for dependency management, environment configuration, security, logging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Create setup guides, onboarding materials, technical documentation, and support procedures.
  • Train and mentor developers on full-stack development, container-based development, and software engineering best practices.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices to improve build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
  • Implement secure authentication, authorization, logging, monitoring, and error-handling practices.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front-end, back-end, API, database, integration, container, and deployment layers.
  • Maintain interface specifications, architecture diagrams, deployment guides, and support runbooks.
  • Promote strong engineering practices through code reviews, testing standards, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  • Stay current with modern application development, cloud, DevOps, manufacturing technology, IoT, and AI-enabled development practices.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise application development.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain hands-on with software development while providing technical leadership and mentoring.
  • Strong recent experience writing production code across full-stack application layers.
  • Experience leading technical design, architecture, development standards, and delivery for complex applications.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing modern front-end applications using frameworks such as Angular or React.
  • Strong back-end development experience using .NET and ASP.NET Core.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining REST APIs.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server and Oracle.
  • Experience with Git and modern source control practices.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Docker Compose.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing container-based development environments for software teams.
  • Experience establishing reusable development templates, local debugging workflows, documentation, and onboarding processes for containerized applications.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, security, and scalable application development.
  • Experience mentoring developers and providing technical leadership.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and collaboration skills.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting applications in a manufacturing environment, including MES integrations or related workflows.
  • Experience with Industrial IoT, shop floor connectivity, equipment data collection, edge systems, or connected manufacturing solutions.
  • Familiarity with technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Kepware, PLC-connected equipment, or similar connectivity platforms.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts, deployment patterns, and container orchestration.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, event-driven architectures, messaging technologies, or near-real-time data solutions.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools or building generative AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, or LLM APIs.

title: Staff Software Engineer (AI-Native Platform)
description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

Remote Work Welcome

Be part of a transformative engineering organization shaping how First American builds and delivers world-class AI-native technology products that power the real estate industry. We are looking for exceptional engineers who thrive in ambiguity, influence without authority, and create technical leverage across teams.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams, driving architecture, engineering standards, and reusable platforms that enable teams to build intelligent software faster, safer, and more consistently. You will partner with engineering leaders, product management, architects, and AI practitioners to solve complex technical challenges that span products and organizations.

You will play a critical role in modernizing our platform through cloud-native architecture, shared engineering platforms, and production AI systems that improve both customer outcomes and engineering velocity.

What You'll Do

Drive Cross-Organization Technical Strategy

  • Lead technical initiatives that span multiple teams, products, and domains. Define architectural direction, align engineering organizations around common approaches, and guide long-term technical investments that improve organizational scalability, reliability, and developer productivity.
  • Navigate ambiguity, resolve competing priorities, and build consensus across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

Build with AI

  • Design and evolve the AI development practices and help drive the creation of AI powered products for our
  • AI is not just transforming how we build, it changes what we build. We are looking for a Staff Engineer who can help mentor teams on both.


Architect Complex Distributed Systems

  • Define architecture for large-scale, distributed systems spanning multiple services, domains, and business capabilities.
  • Drive architectural consistency around:
  • APIs
  • event-driven systems
  • cloud infrastructure
  • reliability
  • security
  • observability
  • operational excellence
  • Simplify complex systems through thoughtful abstractions and reusable patterns.

Raise the Engineering Bar

  • Establish engineering standards that improve software quality across the organization.
  • Lead architectural reviews, influence design decisions, and help engineering teams make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, simplicity, scalability, reliability, and cost.
  • Champion modern engineering practices including AI-assisted software development, automated testing, observability, continuous delivery, and platform engineering.

Mentor Technical Leaders

  • Multiply the effectiveness of senior engineers and technical leads through coaching, architectural guidance, and design mentorship.
  • Help engineers grow their system thinking, technical judgment, and decision-making while creating an engineering culture centered on curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Lead initiatives that improve organizational reliability, resiliency, security, and operational maturity.
  • Define engineering patterns for:
  • observability
  • production diagnostics
  • AI evaluation
  • latency budgets
  • cost optimization
  • incident response
  • resiliency
  • governance
  • Establish measurable engineering standards that improve the health of production systems over time.

Collaborate Across the Organization

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership, product management, solution architecture, security, platform engineering, infrastructure, and AI practitioners to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions.
  • Influence decisions through technical expertise, data, and strong communication rather than organizational authority.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years of experience designing and building production software systems, including significant experience leading large-scale technical initiatives
  • Demonstrated experience driving architecture across multiple teams, services, or business domains
  • Deep experience building cloud-native distributed systems using modern software engineering practices
  • Experience designing and operating production AI systems, including LLM-powered applications and agentic workflows
  • Strong experience creating reusable engineering platforms, frameworks, libraries, or shared infrastructure adopted across multiple teams
  • Expertise designing APIs, event-driven architectures, and highly available distributed systems
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, architectural patterns, and operational best practices across organizations
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical direction through influence rather than direct management
  • Deep understanding of AI operational concerns including evaluation strategies, model selection, latency optimization, cost management, observability, governance, and safety
  • Experience designing AI development workflows that improve engineering productivity through responsible use of AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, cloud infrastructure, reliability engineering, and platform design
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and elevate engineering organizations through coaching and technical leadership
  • Strong systems thinking with an outcome-oriented mindset focused on creating durable organizational leverage

Ideally, You'll Also Have Experience With

  • Enterprise AI platforms (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Databricks)
  • C# (.NET), Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, or similar languages
  • Kubernetes, Docker, and modern platform engineering practices
  • Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CDK, or similar tooling
  • Observability platforms including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar
  • Large-scale platform modernization or cloud migration initiatives
  • Highly regulated industries such as Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, or similar

title: HUB International Internship Program Summer 2027
description:

Great work happens when people come together, which is why we build teams where every voice is valued, ideas are encouraged, and growth is supported.

Are you ready to launch your career in insurance brokerage? Join HUB International’s U.S. award-winning Internship Program!

As an intern at HUB, you’ll be part of our collaborative culture where your contributions matter and your growth is supported. This internship is specifically designed to give you exposure to the many career opportunities within the fast-growing insurance brokerage industry.

Our rotational design will allow you to gain hands-on experience working alongside our Commercial Lines (Business Insurance), Personal Lines, Employee Benefits, and Retirement & Private Wealth teams, learning the ins and outs of our business of each group while exploring areas like client service, sales, and more.

Throughout the program, you’ll learn directly from industry experts across risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement, and wealth management, building both your professional skills and the foundation for a successful future career.

Learn more about these different business practices by visiting the Products page at Insurance Brokers | HUB International.

Full-time, paid, June 1 to August 6 (10-week) internship working out of our Chicago, Illinois office.

Program Highlights

  • Pathway to a Career at HUB: Our internship program is designed to identify and develop future talent. High-performing interns may have the opportunity to pursue full-time roles across HUB’s U.S. locations following graduation.

  • Connect with Industry Leaders: Build your network and learn from experienced professionals across HUB. Through our Speaker Series and other networking opportunities, you’ll gain exposure to leaders, fellow interns, and professionals from across the United States while developing a deeper understanding of the insurance industry.

title: Pathology Assistant
description:
About Our Company

We’re a physician-led, patient-centric network committed to simplifying health care and bringing a more connected kind of care.

Our primary, multispecialty, and urgent care providers serve millions of patients in traditional practices, patients' homes and virtually through VillageMD and our operating companies Village Medical, Village Medical at Home, Summit Health, CityMD, and Starling Physicians.

When you join our team, you become part of a compassionate community of people who work hard every day to make health care better for all. We are innovating value-based care and leveraging integrated applications, population insights and staffing expertise to ensure all patients have access to high-quality, connected care services that provide better outcomes at a reduced total cost of care.

Please Note: We will only contact candidates regarding your applications from one of the following domains: @summithealth.com, @citymd.net, @villagemd.com, @villagemedical.com, @westmedgroup.com, @starlingphysicians.com, or @bmctotalcare.com.

Job Description

Status: Full Time

Schedule: Monday - Friday, 6am - 2:30pm or Monday - Friday, 7am - 3:30pm

Essential Job functions:

  • Assures appropriate specimen accessioning and labeling

  • Accurately describes gross anatomic features of routine, complicated surgical specimens, ensuring that all lesions, markings and sutures are mentioned; Sections specimens per departmental protocol; submits entire specimen(s)/representative section(s) for histologic preparation.

  • Performs quality control and quality assurance tests as required.

  • Demonstrated the ability to prioritize and triage specimens.

  • Recognizes testing errors/discrepancies or problems and notifies the appropriate personnel; assists with problem resolution.

  • Operates all instruments/equipment per accepted written procedures

  • Recognizes and identifies equipment problems and contacts appropriate technical service

General Job functions:

  • Maintains all necessary documentation and current logs.

  • Handles and disposes of specimens and chemical waste based on the laboratory’s procedure manual and ensure compliance with regulatory policies.

  • Ensures that records are accurate, complete, legible and appropriately filed and stored electronically.

  • Meets acceptable turn-around time and productivity standards for the department.

  • Maintains confidentiality of sensitive patient information.

  • Maintains a clean, neat and orderly workplace including instruments and general laboratory equipment.

Physical Job Requirements

  • Endurance (e.g. continuous typing, prolonged standing/bending, walking lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling)

  • Work requires sitting, standing, and / or walking for periods of up to eight hours.

  • Dexterity of hands and fingers

  • Physical strength to lift heavy objects, carts, or items, taking frequency and weight into consideration.

  • The normal performance of duties may require lifting and carrying objects: Objects 1 to 10 pounds.

  • Physical mobility, which includes movement from place to place on the job, taking distance and speed into account.

  • Balance is maintained during climbing, bending and/or reaching.

  • Physical agility, which includes the ability to maneuver the body while in place.

Environmental Risks:

  • Chemicals, Sharps, Latex, and Fumes

  • Loud noises

  • Vibration

  • Allergens: dust, mold and/or pollen

  • Magnetic fields

Blood-borne Pathogen:

  • Exposure to infectious hazards, blood, body fluids, non-intact skin or tissue specimens.

  • Contact with patient specimens is possible.

Education, Certification, Computer and Training Requirements:

  • Master’s Degree in Pathology Assistant (PA) or Medical Degree distinction, preferred. Bachelor’s Degree or a higher degree in a NAACLA accredited Pathologists' assistant program.

  • Valid New York State Licensure as a Pathology Assistant (PA), and PA (ASCP) certificate, required.

  • Minimum of 2-4 years’ experience, 5-8 years preferred.

  • Must have experience with a Laboratory Information System.

Travel:

  • None Required


Pay Range: $37.69 - $47.12 Hourly



The provided compensation range is based on industry standards and salary determinations will be made based on numerous factors including but not limited to years of experience and location of position.


About Our Commitment

Total Rewards at VillageMD

Job Description

Summary

AV is seeking an experienced cyber or CNE targeting professional with strong technical expertise, data analytics, and operational awareness. The ideal candidate has experience with digital networks, analyzing large and unstructured data sets, identifying anomalies, and using technical findings to support client decision-making. With in this role, you will support a client’s operational requirements through cyber and/or Computer Network Exploitation (CNE) targeting. Additional background in finance, cryptocurrency, business, or emerging technologies is highly desirable.

Position Responsibilities

  • Conduct cyber and/or CNE targeting in support of client operations.
  • Apply targeting concepts to digital networks and technical environments.
  • Use Intelligence Community (IC) tools and systems to support operational objectives.
  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze raw data.
  • Identify hidden patterns and draw actionable conclusions from data.
  • Apply predictive analytics to anticipate trends, behaviors, or outcomes.
  • Apply prescriptive analytics to support improved operational decision-making.
  • Analyze network traffic to establish baseline activity and identify anomalies.
  • Leverage emerging technologies, including financial technology (FINTECH), where relevant.
  • Research and apply knowledge of business, cryptocurrency, finance, and related fields to targeting and analytical efforts.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)

  • Active TS//SCI with Polygraph Clearance.
  • More than three years of experience in: Cyber targeting; CNE targeting; or combination of cyber and CNE targeting experience.
  • Strong understanding of Digital networks; Technical targeting concepts; Data collection and analysis;
  • Network traffic and anomalous activity.
  • Experience using IC tools and systems.
  • Ability to analyze and organize complex technical data.
  • Ability to translate analytical findings into actionable conclusions and decisions.

Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies

  • Internet applications and protocols
  • Windows operating systems
  • Linux operating systems
  • SQL
  • Hadoop
  • Other database management systems (DBMS)
  • Scripting languages, particularly Python
  • Network traffic analysis tools, including: Wireshark, Suricata, and nDPI.
  • Experience with Cryptocurrency, Finance; and/or related financial or commercial fields.
  • Interest in applying new and emerging technologies to operational and analytical challenges.
  • Familiarity with or interest in FINTECH applications.

One or more of the following certifications is desired:

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN)
  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
  • Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
  • Certified Network Defense Architect (CNDA)
  • Security+.

Location: This position is on-site in McLean-Tysons area.

ITAR Requirement:

This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify U.S. person status under the ITAR and the EAR. A “U.S. person” according to their definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee, or asylee. See 22 CFR § 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements.

We also encourage you to review our company website at to learn more about us.

Principals only need apply. NO agencies please.

Who We Are

Based in California, AeroVironment (AVAV) is a global leader in unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Founded in 1971 by celebrated physicist and engineer, Dr. Paul MacCready, we’ve been at the leading edge of technical innovation for more than 45 years. Be a part of the team that developed the world’s most widely used military drones and created the first submarine-launched reconnaissance drone, and has seven innovative vehicles that are part of the Smithsonian Institution’s permanent collection in Washington, DC.

Join us today in developing the next generation of small UAS and tactical missile systems that will deliver more actionable intelligence to our customers so they can proceed with certainty – and succeed.

Building on a history of technological innovation, AeroVironment designs, develops, produces, and supports an advanced portfolio of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and tactical missile systems. Agencies of the U.S. Department of Defense and allied military services use the company’s hand-launched UAS to provide situational awareness to tactical operating units through real-time, airborne reconnaissance, surveillance, and target acquisition.

description:
At T. Rowe Price, we identify and actively invest in opportunities to help people thrive in an evolving world. As a premier global asset management organization with more than 85 years of experience, we provide investment solutions and a broad range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset capabilities to individuals, advisors, institutions, and retirement plan sponsors. We take an active, independent approach to investing, offering our dynamic perspective and meaningful partnership so our clients can feel more confident.

We believe doing the right thing for our clients and our associates is good business. With a career at the firm, you can expect opportunities to create real impact at work and in your community. You’ll enjoy resources to support your career path, as well as compensation, benefits, and flexibility to enrich your life. Join us for the opportunity to grow and make a difference in ways that matter to you.

Role Summary

Global Investment Compliance (GIO) is a global team responsible for ensuring compliance with a diverse set of requirements, including regulatory, prospectus, client-directed, internal investment, and operational restrictions (“Compliance Restrictions”) for portfolios managed by T. Rowe Price.

This position sits within the Monitoring team, which plays a crucial role in reviewing investment activities as it relates to Compliance Restrictions coded into the firm’s investment compliance monitoring system, Charles River (CRD), and supports client reporting on these restrictions.

The Investment Compliance Analyst collaborates with, and provides information to a diverse range of stakeholders, including investment personnel, legal counsel, client operations managers, and other internal and external partners. The analyst also participates in and manages projects assigned by the Investment Compliance leadership team.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze pre-trade, post-trade and batch compliance alerts in CRD to assess permissibility. When necessary, liaises with trading, legal, client operations and/or investment personnel by assisting with interpretation of guidelines and communications to clients
  • Communicate effectively through direct interaction with Trading, Investment, Client and Legal associates.

  • Develop a working understanding of investment strategies, security types, derivatives, and compliance monitoring concepts relevant to assigned coverage.
  • Maintain organized records of alert reviews, research, decisions, and escalations in accordance with team expectations and procedural requirements.

  • Continuously seeks opportunities to enhance efficiency: Actively identifies process improvement opportunities
  • Champions risk reduction: Works to reduce risk by looking for opportunities to make the compliance monitoring process more accurate, concise, and efficient.
  • Drives automation and innovation: Recommends and implements solutions to automate manual rules, and supports the integration of new compliance functionality.

Projects:

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience preferred, including experience in investment operations, compliance, trading support, portfolio operations, client reporting, data analysis, financial services, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • Strong attention to detail; commitment to quality
  • Strong customer service orientation
  • Strong interpersonal skills; effective written and oral communications
  • Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic environment with evolving priorities.

The successful candidate is a highly credible technical leader who can operate as a player-coach when needed, balancing strategic thinking with practical delivery execution. They are passionate about developing engineering talent, advancing AI engineering maturity, and helping product teams successfully adopt emerging AI technologies.

What You'll Do for Us

  • Design, develop, and operationalize AI capabilities within Fuelight 360, translating business and analytical requirements into scalable production solutions

  • Evaluate, design, and implement generative AI and agent-based solutions that improve decision support, scenario planning, user guidance, and insight generation within Fuelight 360.

  • Translate enterprise AI strategy, architecture standards, and platform capabilities into actionable Fuelight 360 delivery roadmap and implementation plans.

  • Provide technical expertise on AI architecture, model integration patterns, and emerging AI technologies to support Fuelight's product roadmap and long-term strategy.

  • Partner with Fuelight Product Managers, Technical Leads, Data Scientists, and Product Engineering leaders to prioritize and deliver high-value AI solutions

  • Ensure effective implementation of MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps practices, including lifecycle management, deployment automation, observability, monitoring, and operational governance.

  • Drive adoption of enterprise AI standards, reusable patterns, development tools, and engineering best practices across product teams.

  • Lead the design, development, deployment, and operation of production AI applications, LLM-powered products, and agent-based solutions.

  • Manage and develop AI engineering teams, providing coaching, technical direction, performance leadership, and career development.

  • Establish engineering quality standards through architecture reviews, code reviews, testing practices, and operational readiness assessments.

  • Partner with Core Technology teams to leverage enterprise AI platforms, orchestration services, and foundational capabilities while identifying opportunities for enhancement.

  • Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise governance, security, responsible AI, privacy, and risk management requirements.

  • Drive AI observability and operational excellence through monitoring, evaluation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement practices.

  • Support the delivery of enterprise digital twin, forecasting, simulation, optimization, and intelligent automation capabilities.

  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and engineering approaches and recommend opportunities that improve delivery effectiveness and business impact.

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, collaboration, and engineering excellence across AI engineering teams.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning engineering, platform engineering, or related technical disciplines.

  • 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical leads, or specialized engineering functions.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production AI solutions, including generative AI, large language model applications, intelligent agents, and machine learning systems.

  • Experience leading delivery across multiple products or business domains in a matrixed environment.

  • Strong expertise in agentic AI architectures, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, semantic search, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and AI orchestration frameworks.

  • Hands-on technical expertise in Python and cloud-native application development, with Azure preferred.

  • Experience implementing and operating MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps capabilities in production environments.

  • Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, development accelerators, and operational best practices.

  • Knowledge of responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy requirements, model governance, and enterprise risk controls.

  • Strong leadership capabilities with experience coaching engineers, leading technical teams, and driving organizational capability growth.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

  • Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to connect technical solutions to measurable business outcomes.

title: Vice President, Quality, Safety & Patient Experience
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Job Description:

The Vice President of Quality, Safety & Patient Experience serves as the executive leader responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing an integrated strategy that advances the highest standards of clinical quality, safety, equity, regulatory readiness, and patient/family experience across the entire health system.

This role provides strategic direction and operational leadership to multiple departments, ensuring alignment between system-level goals and hospital/clinical unit-level execution. The VP fosters a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and patient-centered care, while ensuring compliance with all regulatory and accreditation requirements.

The ideal candidate is a transformative, collaborative leader who can harmonize efforts across diverse hospitals and clinical units while driving measurable improvements in clinical outcomes, harm reduction, patient satisfaction, and health equity.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead the development and execution of a unified quality, safety, and patient experience strategy across the system.
  • Serve as a core member of the system’s leadership team, contributing to enterprise strategy, risk management, and care delivery redesign.
  • Build partnerships across clinical, operational, and administrative domains to embed quality and safety into every aspect of the patient journey.

Departmental Oversight

  • Directly oversees the BILH Quality team. Provides dotted line leadership to the hospital and clinical unit quality teams.
  • Ensure the department functions with a clear mission, high performance standards, appropriate staffing, and seamless integration across the continuum of care.

Governance & Performance Monitoring

  • Lead system quality governance councils, performance review processes, and board-level reporting.
  • Monitor performance against internal goals and national benchmarks (e.g., CMS Star Ratings, Leapfrog, Joint Commission, HCAHPS, mortality, readmissions, CLABSI, CAUTI, etc.).
  • Oversee the development and sustainment of enterprise dashboards, strategic scorecards, and escalation protocols for underperformance.

Operational Integration & Accountability

  • Ensure consistency in execution of quality programs at the hospital level through effective support of local Quality teams.
  • Translate strategy into action by developing frameworks for initiative deployment, outcome tracking, and local accountability.
  • Align hospital quality committees, performance improvement efforts, and site-based audits with enterprise priorities.
  • Partner with nursing, medical staff, infection prevention, risk management, and operations to improve quality across departments.

Workforce & Culture Development

  • Champion a systemwide culture of safety, equity, and patient/family partnership.
  • Models our WE CARE values and fosters our values with the team.
  • Partner with Talent Development to embed quality-related competencies into leadership development and performance evaluations.
  • Effectively champions and develops Quality team members across the system.

Regulatory & Risk Readiness

  • Oversee the enterprise approach to survey preparedness, including readiness audits, corrective action plans, and regulatory compliance infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with legal, compliance, and patient safety leaders on incident management, disclosure, and risk mitigation.

Patient Experience & Equity Leadership

  • Lead the integration of voice-of-the-patient mechanisms, service recovery practices, and cultural competence strategies into all care settings.
  • Support initiatives to identify and close gaps in care quality and experience for underserved populations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Public Health, Health Administration, or a related clinical or quality discipline required. Masters preferred.
  • Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, or performance improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading cross-functional teams and system-level change management.
  • Prior experience leading Quality, Safety and/or Patient Experience in a complex, multi-hospital or academic health system.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

  • Deep understanding of quality improvement science, safety culture, and patient engagement principles.
  • Strong familiarity with regulatory requirements and external performance programs (e.g., CMS, TJC, AHRQ, Leapfrog).
  • Exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills.
  • Data-literate, outcomes-oriented, and skilled in using analytics to drive decision-making.
  • Ability to lead through influence, collaboration, and coalition-building in a matrixed organization.

$320,000.00 USD - $375,000.00 USD

Job Description:

What's the role?

The Rotating Equipment Engineer (REE) is part of the Engineering Services. The REE will be responsible for providing technical assurance, reliability support, and project development expertise for rotating equipment across the Sarnia Manufacturing Centre. The role supports operations, maintenance, reliability, production teams, and projects in achieving safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of rotating assets.

The successful candidate will act as a key technical resource for machinery reliability, equipment troubleshooting, reliability improvement initiatives, capital projects, major outages, management of change activities, and critical spare asset management. The role combines hands-on machinery engineering with long-term reliability improvement and asset stewardship.

Accountabilities

  • Provide engineering support for site rotating equipment, including pumps, compressors, blowers, turbines, gearboxes, seals, bearings, lubrication systems, seal support systems, and associated auxiliaries.
  • Provide technical support for rotating equipment reliability issues, equipment failures, root cause investigations, and urgent troubleshooting activities.
  • Lead and facilitate rotating equipment alignment meetings to prioritize risks, opportunities, and reliability improvement activities.
  • Monitor and analyze equipment reliability and performance data, identify failure trends, and develop improvement plans to increase availability and reduce maintenance costs.
  • Identify, develop, justify, and execute machinery technical opportunities, reliability improvement initiatives, and asset replacement strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with operations, reliability, maintenance, planning, and production teams to plan and execute shutdowns, repairs, upgrades, replacements, and reliability programs.
  • Provide rotating equipment technical expertise and engineering support to capital projects throughout the project lifecycle, including design reviews, equipment selection, commissioning, and startup support.
  • Support annual Non-routine maintenance (NRM), process safety, and outage scope development for rotating equipment assets.
  • Act as the Engineering Services focal point for rotating equipment capital spares, including overhaul planning, vendor coordination, long-term preservation strategies, and repair execution.
  • Provide fit-for-purpose engineering solutions that appropriately balance safety, reliability, operability, risk, and cost.
  • Support the improvement of maintenance strategies, engineering standards, technical procedures, and work practices using failure analysis, equipment performance data, and field experience.
  • Ensure that rotating equipment expertise is incorporated into site threat/opportunity software activities, maintenance strategies, turnaround planning, and operational decision-making.
  • Influence stakeholders through sound technical recommendations, transparent risk assessments, and practical business-focused solutions.
  • Participate in the management of change (MOC) process by conducting technical reviews, supporting implementation activities, and ensuring successful closure of machinery-related modifications.
  • Coordinate OEM and vendor support for troubleshooting, repairs, overhauls, upgrades, shop inspections, and equipment performance issues.
  • Perform technical oversight and shop surveillance activities to ensure repairs and overhauls meet applicable specifications and reliability objectives.
  • Support the adoption of new technologies including online condition monitoring, wireless sensors, predictive analytics, and reliability improvement tools.
  • Promote and implement applicable industry standards, Shell DEPs, best practices, and lessons learned to improve rotating equipment reliability and maintainability.
  • Provide mentorship and technical guidance to developing engineers and machinery specialists.

What you bring

Skills and requirements

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Canada on a full-time basis.
  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related engineering discipline with >10+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Professional Engineer designation or eligibility for registration in Ontario.
  • Experience supporting rotating equipment in refining, petrochemical, chemical, mining, power generation, or heavy industrial facilities.
  • Working knowledge of pumps, compressors, turbines, seals, bearings, lubrication systems, vibration analysis, and rotating equipment reliability principles.
  • Experience in machinery troubleshooting, reliability engineering, root cause analysis, and equipment failure investigations.
  • Experience supporting capital projects, outages, turnarounds, equipment overhauls, or reliability improvement programs.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively across operations, maintenance, reliability, engineering, and project organizations.

What success looks like

  • Safe and reliable operation of rotating equipment assets.
  • Reduction of repeat machinery failures and bad actors.
  • Successful progression and execution of reliability improvement opportunities and MTOs.
  • Effective outage and turnaround support.
  • Strong stewardship of critical rotating equipment spares and repair programs.
  • Timely response to operational reliability challenges.
  • Long-term improvement in equipment reliability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost performance.

description:

Job Description:

Industrial Light & Magic (Mumbai) Lead Generalists create photo-real environments and landscapes and exhibit a strong foundation in photo-realistic, traditional, and digital art skills with an emphasis on landscapes. Lead Generalists:

Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Responsible for creating original 2D and 3D content that may comprise part or all of an environment

  • Responsible for creating multiple types of mattes from simple to moderately difficult and allocates detail based on the shot and feedback

  • Responsible for creating high quality computer graphics within a shot using a variety of software programs, and working under the general supervision of senior level artists and VFX Supervisors, dials in the look of the element before handing to final comp

  • Responsible for participating in team reviews of work under development

title: Senior FPGA Engineer
description:
Worker Type

Regular


Job Description

AV’s Electronic Warfare business unit is seeking an experienced FPGA Engineer to join our team in Sunrise, Florida. This is an opportunity to work on sophisticated digital hardware and FPGA-based systems that support advanced defense, communications, sensing, and electronic warfare capabilities.

As a Senior FPGA Engineer, you’ll help take complex system concepts from architecture and design through simulation, implementation, integration, and verification. You’ll work alongside talented electrical, FPGA, software, DSP, and systems engineers to create hardware that is high-performing, robust, maintainable, and intentionally simple.

This role is designed for an engineer who enjoys both hands-on technical problem solving and technical leadership. Depending on your interests and business needs, you may grow along a leadership path—guiding engineers and technicians—or a technical path, becoming a subject matter expert in a critical area of digital hardware and FPGA technology.

Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Design complex digital hardware and FPGA-based systems.
  • Prepare complete project design documentation, including requirements, design specifications, test plans, and reports.
  • Design and conduct experiments; analyze and interpret data to validate system and component performance.
  • Collaborate with hardware, FPGA, DSP, software, systems, and test engineers throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Assign tasks to and direct engineers, technicians, and administrative staff.
  • Plan and coordinate detailed aspects of engineering work, ensuring technical quality and schedule adherence.
  • Prepare scopes of work, budgets, and schedules for assigned projects.
  • Assist in the preparation of proposals to obtain funding for engineering projects and programs.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and 8 years of relevant digital design and/or FPGA engineering experience or a Master’s Degree and 6 years of prior relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in digital design and simulation.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in hardware description languages (HDLs), preferably VHDL.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Technical Depth & Breadth :

  • Experience with several of the systems and technologies outlined below.
  • Serves as a subject matter expert (SME) in at least one area or system outlined below.
  • Maintains a working knowledge in a number of other specialization areas outlined below.

Technical Competencies:

  • Software-defined radios (SDR)
  • HDL fundamentals
  • TFS and Git revision control tools
  • Basic C/C++ programming
  • Testbenches, simulation, automation, and debug
  • Xilinx and Altera (Intel) FPGA devices
  • Digital and analog circuits
  • Basic network technologies (e.g., Ethernet, TCP/IP)
  • Device and part evaluation and selection
  • System design concept and planning
  • Basic FPGA/ASIC design
  • Script writing to control synthesis and build tools
  • Basic physical layers (e.g., GMR, WiMAX, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth)

Additional Competencies: (NON‑TECHNICAL)

  • Design – Generates creative solutions; translates concepts and information into images; uses feedback to modify designs; applies design principles; demonstrates attention to detail.
  • Innovation – Displays original thinking and creativity; meets challenges with resourcefulness; generates suggestions for improving work; develops innovative approaches and ideas; presents ideas and information in a manner that gains others’ attention; participates in the SRT patent process.
  • Problem Solving – Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem‑solving situations; uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.
  • Professionalism – Approaches others in a tactful manner; reacts well under pressure; treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; accepts responsibility for own actions; follows through on commitments.
  • Quality – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; looks for ways to improve and promote quality; applies feedback to improve performance; monitors own work to ensure it meets established quality standards.

Why Join AV?

At AV’s Electronic Warfare business unit, you’ll work on challenging technology where advanced digital hardware, FPGA processing, communications, and real-time systems come together to support critical defense missions.

Located in Sunrise, Florida, this team offers experienced engineers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of complex designs, collaborate with highly skilled multidisciplinary teams, and help turn ambitious system concepts into real-world capabilities.

If you’re an experienced FPGA engineer who wants to solve challenging problems, influence architecture, mentor others, and build the FPGA-based technology behind next-generation electronic warfare systems, we want to hear from you.


Clearance Level

No Clearance

The salary range for this role is:

$91,000 - $138,750

AeroVironment considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the location, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

ITAR Requirement:

This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants must qualify as a U.S. person under the ITAR and the EAR, or a person to be approved for an export license by the governing agency whose technology comes under its jurisdiction. Please understand that any job offer that requires approval of an export license will be conditional on AeroVironment’s determination that it will be able to obtain an export license in a time frame consistent with AeroVironment’s business requirements. A “U.S. person” according to the ITAR definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee or asylee. See 22 CFR § 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements.

We also encourage you to review our company website at to learn more about us.

Principals only need apply. NO agencies please.

About AV:

AV isn’t for everyone. We hire the curious, the relentless, the mission-obsessed. The best of the best.

We don’t just build defense technology—we redefine what’s possible. As the premier autonomous systems company in the U.S., AV delivers breakthrough capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. From AI-powered drones and loitering munitions to integrated autonomy and space resilience, our technologies shape the future of warfare and protect those who serve.

Founded by legendary innovator Dr. Paul MacCready, AV has spent over 50 years pushing the boundaries of what unmanned systems can do. Our heritage includes seven platforms in the Smithsonian—but we’re not building history, we’re building what’s next.

If you're ready to build technology that matters—with speed, scale, and purpose—there’s no better place to do it than AV.

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics, with over a century of experience driving innovation and transforming global trade. With 100,000+ employees across 130 countries, we work together to deliver efficient, sustainable, and customer-focused supply chain solutions.

At Maersk, we value collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning, creating an environment where our people can grow while making a meaningful impact on the future of logistics.

  • Exposure to global logistics operations and opportunities to build deep expertise in customs brokerage and trade compliance

  • Opportunities for learning and career progression within Maersk’s integrated logistics network

  • A fast-paced yet supportive environment that encourages ownership, accountability, and continuous development.

As a Customs Entry Writer, you will play a critical role in ensuring our customers’ imports move smoothly, compliantly, and on time. You will manage end-to-end customs brokerage operations for a dedicated portfolio of accounts, partnering closely with customers, carriers, government agencies, and internal teams. This role is well suited for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and motivated to build expertise in customs brokerage while contributing directly to service delivery and operational excellence.

Operational accuracy & compliance focus: we are looking for someone who is highly detail-oriented, committed to accuracy, and proactive in ensuring all customs processes and documentation meet regulatory and company standards

  • 6–12 months of experience in customs brokerage, logistics, or a related operational role (2+ years preferred in CHB or similar environments)

  • Solid understanding of import processes, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with multiple stakeholders

  • High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent relevant work experience; Customs Broker License is an advantage but not required

Your Impact

In this role, you will contribute directly to enhancing customer experience, ensuring compliance, improving operational efficiency, and supporting the adoption of standardized processes and digital tools across customs brokerage operations.
