title: 2027 Technology Summer Internship Program
description:
Title:

2027 Technology Summer Internship Program

Company:

Everest Global Services, Inc.

Job Category:

Interns

Job Description:

2027 Technology Internship Program

This is a hybrid position: 3 days in the office, 2 days working remotely

Launch your career with Everest Group, Ltd.!

Join the Everest Summer Internship Program! This is an exciting opportunity to receive exposure to the world of Property & Casualty Reinsurance and Insurance through dynamic training, firsthand business experience, and networking with the industry’s leading experts and experienced professionals. Throughout the Program, you can expect to build upon the academic foundations you have established at school and apply your learning to real world scenarios. Everest does not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Successful candidates must possess the requisite permanent US employment authorization to be eligible for consideration.

Our Summer Program runs for 10 weeks: May 31, 2027 – August 6, 2027

Our Strength - Our People

Everest is a global leader in risk management, insurance and reinsurance, rooted in a rich, 50+ year heritage of enabling businesses to survive and thrive, and economies to function and flourish. We are underwriters of risk, growth, progress and opportunity. We are a global team focused on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders, who care deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world.

Your Impact & Opportunity

During this Summer Internship, you will have the opportunity to collaborate and gain exposure across multiple areas of Information Technology (IT): Insurance and Reinsurance, Data Analytics and Insights, IT Risk Management, IT Strategy and Execution, Cyber Security, Infrastructure and Operations, Cloud Modernization and Migration, AI Innovation and Automation, and more!

  • Work collaboratively on a cross functional group project(s) with fellow IT Interns, presenting to management at the conclusion of the program

  • Through your project assignments, work with staff and management across IT on a variety of supporting work, including, but not limited to:

  • Collaborate on activities within your project teams, participating in requirements gathering, analysis, designing solutions, creating specifications, assembling presentations, solution development and testing

  • Partner with business and subject matter experts (SMEs) to transform existing processes to more efficient and automated digital solutions

  • Elicit, document, and organize requirements into user stories with clear acceptance criteria

  • Research, collect and analyze data, identify challenges/barriers and provide recommendations

  • Gain familiarity with performance metrics, enhance the design of dashboards to track and enhance the visibility into potential data leakage

  • Participate in learning activities to enhance your understanding of one or more of the following:

  • Agile methodologies for system development

  • The usage and administration of security tools that control and monitor cyber security

  • Firewall, IDS/IPS logs, web content filtering logs, net flow device logs, and anti-virus logs

  • Basic security audits and security logs to uncover possible security violations

  • Governance activities of the department, IT Data Loss Prevention tools, and vulnerability and risk analysis

  • Opportunities to engage in volunteer activities and IT Cultural and after-hour events

  • Grow and develop while participating in a variety of leader led, professional and personal development workshops, networking events, and the like.

  • Start strong—your internship experience prepares you for a smooth transition into our Rotational Development Program!

What You Bring: Experience & Qualifications

  • You are a junior pursuing a bachelor’s degree at an accredited college/university, preferably majoring in: Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Data Analytics, , Information Security, IT Risk Management, or related field

  • Excellent communication, analytical, critical thinking, collaboration, skills

  • Familiarity with the documentation of business processes

  • Leadership or involvement in extracurricular activities, campus clubs/organizations, your community, etc.

  • Ability to work in a high volume, fast paced environment while managing multiple projects, priorities, and being attentive to deadlines

  • Strong desire and motivation to develop a career in information technology

  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

  • Must model the highest degree of moral and ethical behavior while maintaining confidential information

  • Proficiency in MS Office software, SQL Server, Excel VBA, R, and/or Python is a plus

  • Experience with Power BI or other data visualization tools is a plus

  • You have an understanding of data warehouse, analytics, reporting capabilities, and pricing models will also be a plus

The salary for this position is $1,000 per week. The offered rate of compensation is based on individual education, experience, qualifications and work location. All offers include access to a variety of benefits for the duration of the internship program, including health insurance coverage, 401k match, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO).

What if I don’t meet every requirement? At Everest we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. So, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every element in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout the application or interview process.

Our Culture

At Everest, our purpose is to provide the world with protection. We help clients and businesses thrive, fuel global economies, and create sustainable value for our colleagues, shareholders and the communities that we serve. We also pride ourselves on having a unique and inclusive culture which is driven by a unified set of values and behaviors. Click here to learn more about our culture.

  • Our Values are the guiding principles that inform our decisions, actions and behaviors. They are an expression of our culture and an integral part of how we work: Talent. Thoughtful assumption of risk. Execution. Efficiency. Humility. Leadership. Collaboration. Inclusion and Belonging.
  • Our Colleague Behaviors define how we operate and interact with each other no matter our location, level or function: Respect everyone. Pursue better. Lead by example. Own our outcomes. Win together.

All colleagues are held accountable to upholding and supporting our values and behaviors across the company. This includes day to day interactions with fellow colleagues, and the global communities we serve.

Intern

Full time

Warren, NJ

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, genetics, physical or mental disability, age, marital status, civil union status, family or parental status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. As part of this commitment, Everest will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Everest Benefits at everestbenefits@everestglobal.com.

title: Product Manager - Digital Product Data
description:
Some of what you will do:

As a Digital Product Manager, you will be responsible for driving the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of product data management across all Digital channels at Staples Canada. They will work closely with both business and technical teams to build, optimize, and maintain our Product Information Management (PIM) system and its integrations, ensuring accurate, enriched, and scalable product data flows that power a best-in-class customer experience.

This position plays a critical role in enabling a seamless, consistent, and high-quality product catalog for our B2B and B2C digital experiences. The successful candidate will provide product data and PIM expertise, develop a commercially viable product roadmap, and lead initiatives to improve product data quality, governance, and automation across our ecosystem.

The role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams to plan, develop, integrate, migrate, and optimize product data processes while supporting the growth of our business and the future-state vision for digital commerce.

Specifically, You Will:

  • Own the product data strategy for all digital channels, ensuring high-quality, complete, and consistent product information across platforms.

  • Create and maintain the product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on business goals and customer needs.

  • Partner with business and technical teams to improve data governance, taxonomy, enrichment workflows, and automation.

  • Monitor and optimize product data flows, identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities to streamline processes.

  • Writes and prioritizes requirement stories / develops business cases where required.

  • Provides routine and transparent product updates to executive level stakeholders via formal presentations and written communication.

Some of what you need:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent (MBA an asset).

  • Agile certification is an asset.

  • Strong understanding of Product Information Management (PIM) systems, product data governance, and digital commerce ecosystems.

  • Experience with product road-mapping tools, open-source technologies, public/private cloud technologies.

  • 3+ years’ experience as a Product Manager or Product Data Manager, ideally supporting a PIM system or product catalog in a B2B/B2C eCommerce environment.

  • 3+ years’ hands-on technical experience with PIM or related data platform.

  • Experience with both Agile and Scrum.

  • Familiarity with eCommerce workflows and customer journey optimization.

Physical demands/working conditions:

  • Office environment – Hybrid, with 4 days onsite in Richmond Hill, subject to the hybrid policy.

  • Travel required, 10% within Canada and USA

Some of what you will get:

  • Associate discount

  • Health and Dental benefits

  • RRSP/DPSP

  • Performance bonuses

  • Learning & Development programs

  • And more...

title: Senior Content Analyst - Corporate Transactions
description:
We are seeking a Senior Content Analyst, Corporate Transactions, to join our expert team. As a subject matter legal expert, you will leverage your corporate transactions experience to develop practical guidance on securities, capital markets, and/or corporate transactional matters. You will create checklists, toolkits, model documents, and timely updates that help law firm and in-house counsel navigate legal and market developments with efficiency and confidence.

The ideal candidate will have experience in one or more of the following areas: securities laws and transactions, initial public offerings, private placements, other types of offerings or transactions, and/or capital markets, broadly. Experience in corporate finance or restructuring finance is also valued.

What you will do:

  • Research, interpret, and analyze complex topics and issues that impact our customer base.

  • ⁠Leverage subject matter knowledge in relevant fields to prioritize work, identify developments, and contextualize developments within assigned content.

title: Wealth Advisor - Banner Bank
description:
LPL Financial collaborates with banks to provide a comprehensive suite of financial services tailored to their clients needs. This exciting opportunity at Banner Bank invites you to join our employee advisor model as a Wealth Advisor affiliated with LPL Financial. This role will require the employee to work on-site at the local bank branch located in Medford or Eugene, OR.

Job Overview:

A Wealth Advisor acts as a dedicated representative assigned to a specific branch (or multiple branches) to deliver Non-Deposit Investment Products (NDIPs) and services to the branch customers and prospective customer base. Serves as an advisor to provide an advice-based approach to financial solutions for an assigned book of business. Actively solicits new and existing investments and insurance solutions from retail client base designed to meet the individualized needs of each customer. Establish a strong partnership with Retail Branch Managers and Centers of Influence and maintain strong working relationships with all assigned Branches.

Responsibilities:

  • Utilizing a consultative, holistic approach, sales process, and assessment tools where appropriate.

  • Providing comprehensive, needs- based financial solutions to clients by offering a range of investment/insurance solutions

  • Delivering needs based, comprehensive financial solutions by offering a suitable and diversified set of brokerage, advisory, and insurance solutions to meet client needs and objectives.

  • Employing ethical business practices to ensure full compliance of regulatory, broker dealer and institution requirements

  • Delivering a high quality customer service experience during each customer interaction

  • Building strong relationships with retail branch staff, supporting and motivating their referral efforts. Developing a complete understanding of the core institution products to support cross- selling opportunities and to generate referrals back to the institution where appropriate

  • Meet or exceed established sales goals for assigned territory while ensuring compliance with policies, procedures and regulations governing products and services.

What are we looking for?

We want strong collaborators who can deliver a world-class client experience. We are looking for people who thrive in a fast-paced environment, are client-focused, team oriented, and are able to execute in a way that encourages creativity and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor’s Degree Preferred)

  • Minimum of two (2) years investment sales experience (preferably in a financial institution)

  • Must maintain Licenses and FINRA registrations: Active State Applicable Life Insurance License, Active Series 7 Registration, Active Series 63 Registration (if required by the state of hire), Active Series 65 or 66

  • Registration (If required by the state of hire. If required by state of hire and not active, must acquire within the first six months of hire)

  • Computer literate with proficiency in Microsoft Office product suite, including Power Point and applications specific to the broker dealer

Preferences:

  • Demonstrated ability to sell products and services to investment clients; evidence of strong sales results

  • Broad knowledge of characteristics and needs of clients and partners within the bank-based investment market space

  • Excellent knowledge of investment/insurance products and financial planning

Core Competencies:

  • Strong self-motivation and ability to work independently

  • Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills

  • Possess strong organization skills

  • Excellent customer service and business focus with a great attention to detail

  • Effective research and analysis skills

title: National Credit Coordinator (100% Remote)
description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE

Join Our Community of Food People!

The National Credit Coordinator provides credit and collections support for national customers performs the customer set up function, approves credit terms based on approval matrix, monitors customer terms and compliance and collects on delinquent accounts. In addition, negotiates payment arrangements and collaborates with national account sellers on customer financial issues. Supports Office third party collections, and/or customers with some degree of latitude and judgment using existing systems and procedures.

This position has been segmented "Remote Anywhere" meaning the work is completed 100% remote anywhere in the U.S. except Hawaii or United States Territories.

Schedule

Mon - Fri

8 am - 5 pm

Workstream Specific Responsibilities- 95%

• With limited direction makes credit decisions and establish payment terms within assigned authorities per Corporate Credit Policy Matrix; collects on national/large complex delinquent accounts and maintains portfolio for accuracy.
• Monitors and controls customer account applications/set ups for ownership linkage ensuring national or local account exposures are linked with the same ownership ID for aggregation purposes
• Ensures proper and complete documentation is obtained, analyze and suggest/approve credit terms for new customer accounts based on Credit Policy matrix
• Sets up customer accounts and secures proper credit approvals for terms
• Responsible for gathering financial and other credit information to be used in risk analysis to develop/modify credit limits for potential/existing customers
• Establishes root cause delinquency and maintains communication with sellers and/or USF customers within assigned portfolio to ensure expeditious collections of issues with rapid resolution of past due accounts
• Manages customer accounts receivable for terms compliance and ensures skipped invoices, short paid invoices, credit memos, and unapplied cash are resolved timely
• Creates amicable, effective payment plans on past due accounts and follows protocol for courtesy and demand letters as necessary to effect proper collection
• Prepares annual credit reviews/ write-ups and recommends credit limits in accordance with the Corporate Credit Policy.
• Assists their manager or supervisor to ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements including Sarbanes Oxley (Sox)controls
• If accounts are related to a GPO, be able to follow collection guidelines previously established
• Make recommendations or assist other team members to assign and provide documentation of uncollectible accounts to the centralized third-party collections group at the Support Office; may code and recommend accounts for write-off
• Assists with credit reporting requirements
• Participates in special projects or tasks as assigned/requested by manager or supervisor
• Other duties as assigned by manager

Personal Development – 5%

• Update to personal Individual Development Plan (IDP) and prepare for check-ins with your leader.
• Engage in formal US Foods performance management process.
• Strive to learn and benchmark against industry trends as well as be engaged in industry peer groups.

• 1-2 years’ experience approving credit terms, managing portfolio for adherence to credit terms, collecting amounts due, and resolving aged items is required

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
• Intermediate MS Office skills required with strong Excel skills (ability to create pivot tables, VLOOKUP and basic formulas required).
• Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing in a clear and concise manner under pressure so others will understand.

• Ability to balance multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
• Ability to work independently and in a professional manner.
• Ability to make risk management decisions for customers and collaborate with next level management on those with high degree of complexity
• Ability to guidance other team members regarding best practices and complex situations.
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to find the root cause of issues.
• Ability to collaborate cross functionally with internal associates and other stakeholders on past due AR to remedy and reach resolutions.

title: Student Staff - Bozeman, MT
description:
If you are currently on Young Life staff, please do not apply through this external jobs board. To apply for internal job opportunities, log in to Workday and use the Jobs Hub. Applying externally may delay your application and require you to resubmit internally.

Young Life requires all​ employees to sign a Statement of Faith. We recommend you read this statement before applying​ for any position.

Because of Young Life’s exclusive Christian purposes of evangelism and discipleship as set forth in its Articles of Incorporation and in these Bylaws, and to reflect what has always been and will continue to be the position of Young Life, specifically the Christian belief that each and every employee and volunteer of the corporation should minister as a servant of God with the primary responsibility of proclaiming the gospel of Jesus Christ and, as such, is an integral part of the Christian mission and ministry of the corporation,
Young Life shall only employ individuals or enlist volunteer leaders who: (a) profess a belief in Jesus Christ as their personal Savior and Lord; and (b) subscribe to the statements and policies required of all Young Life staff, including the Young Life Statement of Faith. Therefore, employees and volunteers of Young Life, during working and nonworking hours, shall: (i) be ready, willing and able to fulfill such ministry functions as may be required by the organization; (ii) refrain from conduct and statements that detract from the biblical standards taught and supported by Young Life, and (iii) abide by all policies and practices of Young Life including, without limitation, those related to religious belief or ministry activities.

Ministry Functions:
Spiritual Development — “Following Jesus” includes prayer and spiritual disciplines, fellowship, growth and health and church relationships.

  • Develop a yearly personal growth plan that fosters a vibrant spiritual life including time for solitude, retreat, reflection, prayer and a sincere commitment to understanding God’s Word.
  • Seek and maintain relationships and disciplines, in the context of active participation in a church community.
  • Actively participate in the spiritual life of the Young Life community.
  • Lead teams and individuals in spiritual development.

Leadership Development — “Equipping leaders, committee and staff” includes key volunteer care, recruiting, team building and training, supervision and vision casting.

  • Meet with your volunteer leaders and area leadership on a regular basis.
  • Learn to recruit and train new leaders to build a leadership team that reflects the community.
  • Model excellence in contact work, club, Campaigners and camping to other leaders.
  • Attend and be involved with area leadership as assigned.


Resource Development — “Fueling the ministry” includes events, major donor care, public relations (branding) and TDS team.

  • Raise financial support as directed and maintain good donor care practices.
  • Communicate ministry updates and progress to personal donor partners.
  • Assist with camp fundraisers and attend occasional committee and adult functions as assigned.


Direct Ministry — “Proclaiming and modeling” includes contact work, club, Campaigners and camp. Actively engage in all three levels of contact work.

  • Participate in leadership with a team to conduct a Young Life club and Campaigners/discipleship ministry with excellence.
  • Participate on a team to implement a summer and school-season camping strategy for a ministry.
  • Potentially serve on summer staff or assigned staff at a Young Life property with input and direction from the area director.

Ministry Support — “Taking care of business” includes accounting, administration, communication (internal), data management and strategic plan.

  • Adhere to all Young Life policies and procedures and maintain professionalism concerning office hours, dress, conduct and time management.
  • Learn to set yearly ministry and personal goals and objectives; review them on a regular basis.
  • Assist in the office administration when necessary and assigned.
  • Complete expense reports as necessary in a clear and timely fashion.
  • Perform other duties as assigned and congruent with gifts, experience and area needs.

Regional Training

  • At the regional director’s prerogative, certain regional training events may be required.

Area Training

  • Work through job assignments under the supervision of the area director or assigned mentor (assignments may be adapted to fit individual needs and the area situation)
  • Receive individualized training supervised by the area director designed to develop personal spiritual maturity and enhance personal character.
  • Give particular focus to an individualized program to learn and gain competency in ministry skills (i.e. The 5 C’s).
  • Become familiar with area strategy and ministry health as assigned by the area director.
  • Receive introduction to personal fund-raising principles, including familiarity with Basic Elements for Part-Time Staff
  • Take advantage of Young Life discipleship experiences (e.g. summer staff, discipleship focus, adventure camping).

Education:

  • Pursuing a college degree.

Qualifications Required For The Job:
Proven relational skills with both kids and adults.

  • Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.

Job Specific Working Conditions:


Gallatin Valley Young Life
Developing Future Leader (DFL)
High School Ministry
Core Responsibilities
1. Serve as a Young Life Leader
The DFL will continue to fulfill all normal expectations of a Young Life leader, including:
Building authentic relationships with high school students.
Consistently pursuing students outside of Club.
Attending and actively participating in Club and Campaigners.
Sharing the Gospel and introducing teenagers to Jesus Christ.
Participating in Young Life camp and area-wide events.
Developing relationships with parents, teachers, coaches, and other influential adults.
Praying regularly for students, leaders, and the ministry.
Modeling the mission, values, and culture of Young Life.
These responsibilities are in addition to the 10 hours per week dedicated to the DFL role.
2. Develop as a Future Leader
The primary purpose of the DFL role is to provide intentional opportunities for the individual to grow in leadership.
The DFL will:
Learn and grow in Young Life leadership.
Take increasing ownership of ministry responsibilities.
Develop skills in communication, organization, planning, and team leadership.
Learn how to recruit, equip, encourage, and develop other leaders.
Practice leading meetings, projects, and ministry initiatives.
Seek opportunities to identify and develop future leaders.
Receive regular coaching and feedback from the Area Director.
Take initiative rather than waiting to be assigned every responsibility.
Develop a deeper understanding of the mission, vision, and strategy of Gallatin Valley Young Life.
The expectation is that the DFL will grow in responsibility throughout the year as their leadership capacity increases.
3. Serve the High School Ministry Team
The DFL will provide additional support to the High School Ministry Team by:
Checking in regularly with Young Life leaders.
Encouraging and supporting leaders in their ministry.
Helping new leaders understand Young Life culture and expectations.
Assisting with leader meetings and trainings.
Helping communicate important information to leaders.
Helping plan and prepare for Club and Campaigners.
Assisting with special events and area-wide initiatives.
Helping identify areas where the leadership team needs additional support.
Taking ownership of specific projects assigned by the Area Director.
Helping create a healthy, unified, and encouraging leadership team.4. Student Ministry
The DFL will continue to prioritize reaching students who are far from Jesus.
Responsibilities may include:
Helping identify students who are not currently connected to Young Life.
Encouraging leaders to pursue new students.
Helping evaluate the health of Club and Campaigners.
Assisting with student outreach initiatives.
Helping leaders think strategically about reaching their schools and communities.
Celebrating stories of students encountering Jesus and growing in their faith.
The DFL should never lose sight of the primary mission:
To introduce adolescents to Jesus Christ and help them grow in their faith.

5. Spiritual Wellness
The DFL is expected to prioritize their own spiritual health as a foundational part of their leadership.
Because Young Life ministry flows out of a leader's relationship with Jesus, the DFL will intentionally pursue a healthy and growing spiritual life through:
Regular prayer.
Regular engagement with Scripture.
Active participation in a local church.
Meaningful Christian community.
Healthy rhythms of rest and Sabbath.
Personal reflection and spiritual evaluation.
Accountability with trusted Christian friends and leaders.
Regularly evaluating their relationship with Jesus and their motivations for ministry.
The DFL understands that ministry activity cannot replace a healthy relationship with Jesus.
The Area Director will regularly check in with the DFL regarding their spiritual, relational, and ministry health.
6. Fundraising & Financial Partnership
The DFL will participate in the financial support of Gallatin Valley Young Life.
Annual Fundraising Goal:
$6,000 per year
Monthly Goal:
$500 per month
The DFL will:
Develop a personal support team.
Invite individuals to financially partner with their ministry.
Communicate regularly with financial supporters.
Participate in Young Life fundraising opportunities.
Work with the Area Director to develop a fundraising plan.
Demonstrate consistency and initiative in pursuing their fundraising goal.
Fundraising is viewed not simply as raising money, but as inviting others to participate in the mission of reaching teenagers with the Gospel.
7. Individual Metrics & Accountability
Each DFL will work with the Area Director to establish individual ministry metrics at the beginning of their term.
These metrics will be based on the individual's strengths, responsibilities, school/community assignment, and the current needs of the High School Ministry.
Potential metrics may include:
Number of students relationally pursued.
New students connected to Young Life.
Leader recruitment.
Leader retention and engagement.
Leader check-ins.
Club attendance and growth.
Campaigners participation.
Camp participation.
Gospel conversations.
School/community connections.
Completion of assigned ministry projects.
Fundraising progress.
Leadership development goals.
Personal spiritual development goals.
The DFL agrees to:
Know their individual metrics.
Work consistently toward those goals.
Track progress when appropriate.
Discuss progress regularly with the Area Director.
Receive coaching and accountability.
Adjust goals as ministry needs change.
Metrics are not intended simply to measure activity. They are tools to help the DFL and Area Director evaluate growth, health, effectiveness, and faithfulness to the mission.
8. Communication & Team Culture
The DFL is expected to model healthy communication and team culture.
This includes:
Responding to communication in a timely manner.
Communicating proactively when challenges arise.
Following through on commitments.
Bringing concerns directly to the appropriate leader.
Maintaining confidentiality when appropriate.
Celebrating other leaders.
Encouraging unity within the team.
Being willing to receive feedback and correction.
Approaching conflict with humility and a desire for restoration.
The DFL should be someone who adds health to the team rather than simply completing tasks.
Time Commitment
The DFL role requires approximately:
10 hours per week dedicated to DFL responsibilities
PLUS
Normal Young Life leader responsibilities
The DFL's 10 hours may include:
Leader development
Leader check-ins
Ministry planning
Club/Campaigners preparation
Team meetings
Leadership training
Student outreach strategy
Special projects
Administrative responsibilities
Fundraising
Meetings with the Area Director
Other responsibilities determined by the Area Director
The weekly schedule may vary depending on the season of ministry.
Relationship with the Area Director
The DFL will serve under the leadership and direction of the Gallatin Valley Young Life Area Director.
The Area Director will:
Provide vision and direction.
Establish individual goals and metrics with the DFL.
Provide coaching and leadership development.
Meet regularly with the DFL.
Give feedback and accountability.
Gradually increase responsibility as the DFL demonstrates readiness.
The DFL will:
Take initiative.
Communicate consistently.
Follow through on commitments.
Ask questions when needed.
Receive coaching with humility.
Own assigned responsibilities.
Pursue continued growth as a leader.
Desired Characteristics
A successful DFL should be:
Faithful — committed to Jesus and the mission of Young Life.
Teachable — willing to learn, receive feedback, and grow.
Relational — passionate about teenagers and people.
Dependable — follows through on commitments.
Initiative-driven — sees what needs to be done and takes action.
Humble — willing to serve others rather than seek a title.
Organized — capable of managing additional responsibilities.
Communicative — keeps leaders and the Area Director informed.
Team-oriented — committed to the health of the entire ministry.
Mission-minded — keeps the Gospel and students at the center.
The Goal of the DFL Role
The goal of the Developing Future Leader position is not simply to do more ministry.
The goal is to develop a leader who can eventually lead others.
A successful DFL will finish their time in the role:
Growing deeper in their relationship with Jesus.
Growing in confidence and leadership ability.
Understanding Young Life ministry more deeply.
Taking greater ownership of ministry.
Developing the ability to lead and encourage others.
Identifying and investing in future leaders.
Reaching more students with the Gospel.
Becoming prepared to take on greater leadership within Gallatin Valley Young Life.

title: UX UI Designer
description:
Circa £40,000 (Depending on Skills & Experience)

Permanent

Full Time / 37 Hours (Flexible working opportunities available)

Huntingdon

Double Matched Pension Scheme (up to 21% combined)

Private Healthcare

Make every drop of your potential count!

We're looking for a mid-weight level UX/UI Product Designer to join our small in-house design team at TIDE Services. You'll design accessible, high-quality digital experiences for the family of brands across TIDE and the wider Anglian Water Group

You'll work end to end. Discovery, stakeholder interviews and journey mapping at the start, then wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity interface design and a clean handover to developers. You'll surface assumptions early, ask the awkward questions, and turn what you learn into designs that work for users and for the business.

It's a hands-on role for a designer who pairs strong UX thinking with real visual craft. One week you might be shaping a product flow, the next a campaign page or a shared component in a design system used across several brands. Across all of it, you'll help raise the bar for accessibility, consistency and the quality of the outcomes that are shipped.

What you'll be doing:

  • Contribute to discovery and research activities, including stakeholder interviews, journey mapping and usability testing

  • Translate insight into user flows, wireframes, storyboards, prototypes and high-fidelity interface designs

  • Design accessible and responsive experiences that meet WCAG 2.1 AA or higher

  • Present design decisions clearly to delivery teams and stakeholders, linking recommendations to user and business needs

  • Work fluently in Figma using components, variables, modes, prototyping and well-structured design files

  • Contribute to and maintain shared user interface kits and design systems across multiple brands

  • Prepare clear, annotated handovers and support developers through design quality assurance during build

  • Take ownership of the quality of the final delivered experience, not only the design file

  • Occasionally support brand and marketing and other internal teams with design, presentation and print assets.

  • Help maintain visual consistency across digital products and wider brand touchpoints

  • Where appropriate, implement approved design changes in Webflow using agreed designs and component patterns. Webflow is a desirable skill but not essential. Training will be provided.

  • Use artificial intelligence tools responsibly to support research, ideation, prototyping and accessibility checks

  • Share techniques, learnings and reusable patterns while contributing ideas that improve team processes and craft

What we're looking for

  • Proven commercial UX/UI design experience, supported by a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product and/or web design

  • Strong graphic design skills, visual judgement and attention to detail

  • Experience creating wireframes, user flows, storyboards, prototypes and high-fidelity designs

  • Strong Figma proficiency, including components, variables, modes and prototyping

  • Working knowledge of design systems and the discipline required to maintain consistency and quality

  • Experience designing accessible, responsive interfaces to recognised standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA or above

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Ability to take a brief forward with minimal direction while identifying assumptions, dependencies and risks early

  • Collaborative, organised and reliable approach, with pride in the quality of design files, documentation and handover

  • Curiosity about users, business goals, emerging tools and how design practice continues to evolve

Desirable:

  • Degree, HND or equivalent experience in design, digital or a related discipline

  • Experience working in a multi-brand or in-house design team

  • Experience using Webflow to implement approved designs (Not essential)

  • Practical experience using artificial intelligence tools to support research, design and delivery

  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript sufficient to collaborate effectively with developers

  • Awareness of search and answer engine optimisation, performance and analytics fundamentals as they relate to design

Interview Process

The application journey has 2 key stages

  • 30-minute call

  • Successful candidates at stage 1 will be invited to a 1-hour craft interview in person, where you’ll present a key case study and your portfolio to the Lead Designer plus another member of our team.



Why join Tide Services (In partnership with Anglian Water)?

At TIDE Services, design shapes products, supports brands and improves digital experiences for customers and colleagues across the Anglian Water Group. You'll join a small team where your work will be visible, valued and connected to genuine user and commercial outcomes.

You'll build experience across product, platform, web, marketing and brand design while working closely with developers, product owners, content specialists and senior stakeholders. You'll also have opportunities to deepen your capability in accessibility, design systems, Webflow and responsible AI-assisted design.

This is an opportunity to strengthen your portfolio, develop your craft and help deliver consistently high-quality digital experiences across a varied family of brands.

Benefits

  • 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays (increasing with length of service)

  • Flexible working options

  • Private health care

  • Competitive pension scheme - Anglian Water double-matches contributions up to 7%

  • Life assurance at eight times your salary

  • Annual bonus

  • Personal medical assessments

  • Virtual GP service

  • Cancer screening

  • Financial wellbeing support and salary finance benefits

  • Lifestyle savings including discounts on retail, travel and utilities

  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Volunteer days

Inclusion at Anglian Water

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We are proud signatories of the Social Mobility Pledge, Race at Work Charter and Armed Forces Covenant, and we're a Disability Confident employer.

title: Disaster Recovery Analyst - Senior
description:
Job Posting End Date

Job Summary

The Senior Disaster Recovery Analyst supports and leads selected DR program activities, including recovery documentation, inventory and dependency maintenance, testing coordination, evidence management, corrective-action tracking, and program reporting. This role works with technology, cybersecurity, business, and vendor stakeholders to maintain accurate recovery information and validate recovery readiness against enterprise standards. The Senior Analyst applies independent judgment to improve documentation quality, identify gaps, and support recovery capability validation without owning enterprise-level strategy or board-level reporting.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

Essential Job Functions & Tasks:

  • Maintain and improve DR inventory, RTO/RPO, dependency, contact, evidence, and recovery documentation in approved enterprise systems.

  • Support collection and validation of crown jewel and critical data recovery information, including system dependencies, RTO/RPO data, backup evidence, test results, ownership records, and remediation status in approved enterprise systems.

  • Coordinate and validate assigned DR inventory, recovery objective, dependency, and documentation updates in ServiceNow, CMDB, and other approved systems of record.

  • Coordinate assigned tabletop and functional recovery tests, including scheduling, materials, test evidence, lessons learned, and after-action documentation.

  • Support audit and regulatory readiness by collecting evidence, reviewing documentation quality, and tracking remediation items.

  • Monitor cloud, SaaS, managed-service, and vendor-supported recovery documentation for completeness and alignment with enterprise expectations.

  • Prepare program reporting inputs for recovery capability health, test completion, evidence quality, corrective actions, and maturity measures.

  • Support DR input into training curriculum and readiness materials aligned to enterprise standards.

Preferred Requirements:

  • ServiceNow/CMDB experience; experience supporting recovery tests, audit evidence, dependency documentation, and corrective actions; and certification such as ABCP, CBCP, MBCI, ITIL, CDRE, PMP, or equivalent.

What We're Looking For:

Education and Work Experience requirements are listed below:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, Risk Management, Emergency Management, or related field, or equivalent combination of education, certifications, and relevant experience.

Work Experience Requirements are listed below:

  • 4-6+ years in Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, Technology Resilience, IT Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Technology Risk, or related disciplines.

title: Federal Work Study - CIC Communications Assistant (Student Wage)
description:
**Federal work-study eligible student only**

In partnership with Student Financial Services Community Investment Collaborative (CIC) is recruiting for a federal work study eligible candidate to fill the position of Communications Assistant. This position will be located at 300 Preston Ave #206, Charlottesville, VA 22902.

For further consideration a candidate must be receiving federal work study funding.

Organization Description:

The Community Investment Collaborative (CIC) is a nonprofit

organization that specializes in micro-enterprise development and offers micro-financing and business training to small and micro-enterprises in Charlottesville and the surrounding counties. CIC's mission is to strengthen the community and contribute to economic development by fueling the success of under-resourced entrepreneurs through education, financing, mentoring, and networking. CIC leverages community

resources to provide capital and education to entrepreneurs who have

difficulty accessing funding from traditional sources and who seek an

educational support system that is relevant to their business needs.

CIC accomplishes this by providing loans and advisory support to

existing and aspiring entrepreneurs in the form of business training,

one-on-one mentoring, and networking events. By supporting small

business growth and expansion, CIC helps to create jobs and strengthen the local economy and community.

Overview of Opportunity:

CIC is looking for a student to join its team as a Communications Assistant. Working at CIC is a unique opportunity for students to be fully involved in a local and diverse organization. Interns will gain hands-on experience in developing marketing materials,

managing the website and social media, creating program literature,

evaluating the success metrics of the organization's programs and

communications outreach, and researching organizational fundraising opportunities. They can be assured of having a meaningful impact on the growth and development of a local community organization that supports small businesses.

Professional Development:

The Communications Assistant will experience the organic process of entrepreneurship not only through projects assigned but also through the stories and daily realities of CIC clients as they launch and grow their businesses. CIC maintains intimate relationships with its entrepreneur clients in order to ensure full support. Therefore, it will similarly have strong connections with the struggles and triumphs of business. Students will learn the art of communication through CIC’s education programs and stakeholder engagement, including writing, storytelling, interviewing, designing marketing materials (Canva, Adobe Suite, etc.), and adapting messages for different audiences. They will also gain a foundation in business through training courses and hands-on client work, such as successful fundraising strategies, community impact measurement, researching businesses, and collecting information. Additionally, students will have the opportunity to explore other areas of CIC and broaden their skills beyond communications.

Students will hone their communication skills through CIC's educational programs and stakeholder engagement and expand their knowledge of business throughout their internship.

Qualifications:

  • Curiosity/interest in learning
  • Interest in working with others and teams
  • Interest in marketing (social media, email newsletters, website management)
  • Interest in event planning and coordination
  • Interest in small business and entrepreneurship
  • Interest in helping individuals from low-income backgrounds
  • Strong communication skills
  • Strong writing skills, interest in grant writing
  • Strong technology skills (G Suite, Microsoft Office, Canva)
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at one time Schedule:

The Communications Assistant will collaborate with the Development and Communications Manager and the Chief Operating Officer will establish a mutually agreeable, required, and consistent schedule of 8hrs/wk. We request that the student work in the office at least 1 day per week.

All interested work study eligible students should submit a resume and cover letter in Workday.

The Communications Assistant position will be paid at $15.00 per hour with a maximum of 10 hours per week. This position is a hybrid position with 1 day per week required on site.

Position begins September 21, 2026 (or later) and ends May 14, 2027.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Resume and Cover Letter required.


Education: Current undergrad UVA student. Federal work-study eligibility required.
Experience: None
Licensure: None

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This is primarily a sedentary job involving extensive use of desktop computers. The job does occasionally require traveling some distance to attend shifts, meetings, and programs.

title: Tax Associate
description:
Company Description

Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to “Connect the world”. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.

Job Description

In this role, your main duty will be to manage and ensure adherence to social security regulations, overseeing the organization's social security programs. Responsibilities include administering benefits, maintaining precise compliance reporting, and executing social security policies within the organization.

As a Global Mobility Associate, you will support multinational employers and their internationally mobile employees on Luxembourg personal tax, employment tax and social security matters. Working with clients and colleagues across our global network, you will contribute to compliance and advisory assignments involving international assignments, cross-border working arrangements and employee reward. Through real client work, coaching and feedback, you will build practical knowledge of mobility rules and develop skills in technical research, tax calculations, data analysis, drafting, client communication and cross-border teamwork. You will also gain exposure to tax and mobility technologies, preparing you for a career in global mobility, personal or employment tax, social security, payroll or broader people advisory services.

Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:

  • Preparation of advice on personal tax, employment tax, payroll, social security and reward matters arising from international assignments and cross-border working arrangements.

  • Analyze employment structures and their Luxembourg tax and social security implications, including relevant market practices and regulatory developments.

  • Prepare Luxembourg individual income tax returns, tax equalization calculations and social security assessments for internationally mobile employees, and support related client queries.

  • Play an active role in developing client-focused service offerings aligned with evolving tax and social security regulations.

  • Prepare Luxembourg individual income tax calculations and comparative tax estimates, taking account of the cross-border circumstances of internationally mobile employees.

  • Coordinate with Vialto colleagues in other jurisdictions to support the consistent application of international tax treaties and social security rules.

  • Contribute to technical research, client meetings and the preparation of clear presentations, calculations and written advice.

Qualifications

  • You have recently graduated from a Master’s degree in Economics or Law, with a specialization in taxation. Any experience in the global mobility field is an asset.

  • You have a strong interest in individual taxation and compliance and you would like to work on individual tax consulting to individuals and employing companies.

  • You enjoy working in teams and look for an open-minded and friendly environment.

  • You have an excellent command of Microsoft Office.

  • You are fluent in both our working languages French and English. Knowledge of German will be considered an asset.

  • You have an appetite for numbers and for contact with people from all over the globe.

  • Accuracy, a critical mind-set and good writing skills are embedded in your DNA as well as a practical and hands-on attitude.

  • You have a drive and dynamism that contributes to the team spirit.

  • You are looking for a fun and great place to work.

Additional Information

We are offering:

  • Build a strong technical foundation while gaining valuable experience.

  • Work within a multidisciplinary team of passionate professionals in an international environment.

  • A workspace where everyone feels respected, valued, and free to be themselves.

  • Inspiring and awesome colleagues as well as a forward-looking and very accessible leadership.

  • Team events and celebrations.

  • The position is full time but with flexibility to accommodate for commitments related to your studies.

We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.

Please note, AI is used as part of the application process.

title: Product and Technical Communications
description:
Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

What you’ll do

Own trust, security, and incident communications. People build real businesses on Lovable, and their confidence in the platform is existential to ours. You’ll own Lovable’s trust narrative in earned and new media, proactively telling the story of how we think about security, privacy, reliability, and platform safety. And when something doesn’t go as planned, you’ll be the comms lead in the room, working alongside the Head of Communications to manage the external response with a cross-functional team.

Lead product launch communications. When Lovable ships something new, you own the earned media strategy around it, including knowing the right Substacks, podcasts, and new media channels beyond traditional outlets. You’ll work closely with product marketing to shape positioning, develop press materials, pitch the story, and make sure launches land. You’ll build a repeatable launch engine that moves as fast as the product team does.

Turn journalists and creators into builders. Some of the most powerful product coverage comes from people who’ve experienced Lovable firsthand. You’ll develop relationships with earned media and creators by getting the product into their hands, helping journalists, technical writers, and influencers build something real on Lovable so they can tell the product story from their own experience.

Be the comms partner to our CTO and product leadership. You’ll develop spokesperson platforms for our CTO, CISO, and senior product and engineering leaders. In partnership with product marketing, you’ll prep them for media, conferences, and podcasts. You’ll help them become recognized voices defining a new product category.

Own product-level partner integration comms. When Lovable launches a technical integration or platform capability that changes what builders can do, you own the comms. You’ll coordinate with product marketing and partnerships to shape the narrative and get it in front of the right audiences.

Build analyst and technical influencer relationships. You’ll build relationships with the analysts, tech media, and voices that shape opinion among technical audiences. You’ll make sure Lovable shows up in the right conversations and earns positioning in the right reports.

Ensure product news travels beyond traditional media. Product stories in 2026 don’t just live in TechCrunch. You’ll make sure product news reaches the Substacks, podcasts, technical creators, and communities where your audiences are.

Who you are

You’re technically fluent and genuinely curious about the product. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to understand how software products work, architecturally, not just conceptually. When an engineer explains a design decision, you understand why it matters and can translate it into something a reporter or analyst would care about.

You’ve run product comms at a fast-moving technology company. You’ve lived through the chaos of a product team that ships faster than comms can keep up, and you’ve built systems to stay ahead. You know how to run a launch process that’s tight but not slow, and you know when to push for a bigger moment versus when to just get the word out.

You have real trust and incident comms experience. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams. You know the difference between proactive trust storytelling and reactive crisis management, and you’ve done both. You’ve been in the room during a product incident and know how to craft external communications that are honest, precise, and fast.

You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. You know the reporters, podcasters, and analysts who cover AI, developer tools, and enterprise technology. You understand what makes them care about a product story, and you can get Lovable in front of them.

You write clearly, concisely, and technically without being dry. Product comms doesn’t mean jargon-heavy. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive.

You connect dots and see around corners. A feature ships, and you immediately think: which reporter is writing about this problem? What should our CTO say on social? How does this fit the narrative arc we’ve been building for the quarter? That connective instinct is what makes this role work.

You’re hands-on, agile, and low-ego. You’ll draft the press materials, build the media list, coordinate the launch timeline, and prep the spokesperson. You thrive in environments where the plan changes and the pace is relentless.

You have 8+ years of experience in communications, including product launches and trust or incident communications at a technology company. You’ve run launch processes, managed incident response, and built media relationships in the tech ecosystem.

What you need to know

This role requires genuine product immersion. You’ll work closely with product marketing to understand what’s shipping, why it matters, and how to position it. That partnership is what lets you move fast and tell the right story at the right moment.

Trust and incident comms are core to the role. You’ll need to be comfortable being the person who’s on call when something breaks, who can draft an incident communication at speed, and who brings the judgment to know when to say something, when to wait, and how to say it right.

Lovable is headquartered in Stockholm, with product and engineering teams across multiple offices. Wherever you sit, you’ll need to work effectively across time zones and build relationships with the teams who ship the product you’re talking about.

Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. You find ways to work smarter with AI, to measure what matters, and to step into work that isn't technically “yours” when the moment calls for it.

The Mechanical Project Manager (PM - Mech) is responsible for the onsite planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of mechanical systems on large-scale data center construction projects. This role ensures delivery of mechanical scope (piping, cooling systems, ductwork and related infrastructure) safely, on schedule, within budget and in accordance with contract requirements and data center performance standards.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Construction Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Experience: 4+ years of experience managing mechanical scopes on large-scale construction projects. Proven experience with mission-critical or data center projects is strongly preferred. Possesses a strong understanding of HVAC systems, chilled water systems, and data center cooling strategies, along with demonstrated success managing subcontractors, project schedules, and budgets.

Travel: 50%

Work Schedule: This position works Monday through Friday.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Leadership & Execution

  • Lead all aspects of mechanical scope, including pre-site mobilization, site mobilization, commissioning, and project turnover.
  • Coordinate with engineering, manufacturing, and construction teams to ensure seamless project execution
  • Manage project schedules, milestones, and deliverables to meet aggressive data center timelines
  • Ensure mechanical systems align with design intent, specifications and owner requirements

Cost & Contract Management

  • Develop and manage budgets, invoicing, forecasts and cost tracking for mechanical scope
  • Oversee subcontractor agreements, purchase orders and change management processes
  • Identify and mitigate cost risks; drive value engineering where appropriate

Coordination & Interface Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for mechanical trades, vendors, and stakeholders
  • Coordinate with FTI electrical, controls and GC teams to manage system interfaces
  • Coordinate commissioning activities with our manufacturing teams as well as our on-site install teams to ensure all aspects of the commissioning process is documented and accounted for regarding the mechanical systems.
  • Support BIM/VDC coordination, clash resolution and design integration efforts

Field Oversight & Quality

  • Partner with superintendents to ensure mechanical installations meet quality and safety standards
  • Monitor field progress, productivity and manpower planning
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable codes, specifications and commissioning requirements
  • Support development of a site-specific mechanical quality plan that is in line with the owner’s specifications.

Schedule & Planning

  • Develop detailed manufacturing and execution plans to integrate mechanical scope into the master schedule
  • Proactively identify risks to schedule and implement recovery plans as needed
  • Review daily Takt progress, deviations and remediation plans
  • Assist with coordination and development of Commissioning and Startup activities and sequence requirements.
  • Lead weekly coordination meetings and progress reviews

Safety & Compliance

  • Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all mechanical activities
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, site safety plans, and regulatory requirements
  • Support implementation of project-specific safety plans and procedures
  • Monitor field activities and report safety concerns

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a key mechanical liaison with owners, general contractors, inspectors, and design teams
  • Provide regular updates on progress, risks, and performance metrics

title: Data Engineer
description:

The Crown Is Yours

The Crown Is Yours

As a Data Engineer, you'll build data capabilities that power regulatory reporting, financial operations, and intelligent experiences across our platform. You'll create scalable data infrastructure that transforms complex transactional data into trusted, reporting-ready datasets while contributing to the future of our modern data platform. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Analytics, and business teams, you'll solve technical challenges, improve how data flows across the organization, and build foundations that enable AI-powered experiences and smarter decision-making.

What you'll do as a Data Engineer

  • Build scalable, high-performance data infrastructure that transforms complex transactional and financial data into trusted, reporting-ready datasets supporting regulatory reporting, financial operations, and business insights.
  • Develop reliable data solutions that prioritize accuracy, completeness, traceability, and auditability while supporting regulatory compliance and highly governed business processes.
  • Leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, enhance data quality, and build trusted data products that enable AI-powered applications and natural language access to data.
  • Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Analytics, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable, analytics-ready data models and solutions.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain modern data models while following best practices for data quality, governance, observability, and platform reliability.
  • Build and optimize cloud-based data pipelines and streaming solutions using technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, or similar distributed data platforms.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices for data transformation, streaming, platform performance, and operational excellence while collaborating with and learning from the Data Engineering Team.
  • Collaborate in an agile environment to deliver scalable, resilient solutions that evolve alongside business priorities and platform capabilities.

What you'll bring

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience, with at least 2 years of experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data platforms and distributed data systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience developing real-time or batch data processing solutions.
  • Experience building cloud-based data platforms using technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, or similar distributed data processing and streaming technologies.
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure, preferably Amazon Web Services (AWS), along with infrastructure and DevOps tools such as Terraform, PagerDuty, and Datadog.
  • Understanding of modern data architecture, including data warehousing, data lakes, ETL frameworks, and scalable data modeling techniques.
  • Experience building trusted data solutions that support financial operations, regulatory reporting, auditability, reconciliation, or other highly governed data domains. Experience supporting CFTC-regulated markets or financial services is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or similar technologies to automate workflows, build intelligent agents, and accelerate software development.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while partnering effectively across technical and business teams.

Join Our Team

We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role.

title: Material Control Specialist III (Shipping Coordinator)
description:
Worker Type

Regular


Job Description

Summary

The Material Control Specialist III is responsible for maintaining optimal inventory levels to support production and operational efficiency while adhering to company policies and procedures. This role involves tracking, analyzing, and reconciling inventory records to ensure accuracy and availability. The Material Control Specialist collaborates with procurement, production, and warehouse teams to optimize inventory flow and minimize discrepancies.

Position Responsibilities

  • Monitors inventory levels and ensures materials are available to meet production and operational needs.

  • Receives and counts stock items, and records data using computerized system.

  • Packs and unpacks items to be stocked on shelves in stockroom in an orderly and accessible manner.

  • Conducts cycle counts and physical inventory audits to reconcile stock discrepancies.

  • Investigates and resolves inventory variances by working closely with procurement, warehouse, and production teams.

  • Issues or distributes materials, products, parts, and supplies to customers or coworkers, based on information from incoming requisitions.

  • Maintains accurate inventory records in the ERP/MRP system, ensuring data integrity.

  • Depending on warehouse, some positions may also be responsible for packaging and shipping (domestic and international -- to include small package, large freight, dangerous goods, and sensitive items).

  • Collaborates with suppliers and internal stakeholders to track incoming shipments and expedite critical materials when necessary.

  • Assists in implementing inventory control policies, procedures and process improvements to enhance inventory efficiency and reduce waste.

  • Works on assignments that are moderately difficult, requiring judgment in resolving issues or in making recommendations.

  • Performs other duties as assigned by supervisors or inventory managers.

title: Business Analyst - Lead, Front Office Technology & Business Delivery
description:

October 3, 2026

Opportunity

Opportunity

At AIMCo, technology is a key enabler of investment success. As a Business Analyst - Lead, Front Office Technology & Business Delivery, you will partner with investment and technology teams to deliver solutions that support AIMCo's investment objectives.
Working closely with Portfolio Managers, Traders, Analysts, Risk Managers, and technology teams, you will translate business needs into actionable requirements, drive technology-enabled change, and contribute to initiatives across the investment lifecycle.   • Support initiatives from business case development through design, testing, implementation, and deployment.

  • Lead small to medium-sized initiatives and contribute to larger enterprise programs.

  • Collaborate within an Agile/DevOps delivery model to support successful business outcomes.

  • Mentor junior Business Analysts and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

You are an experienced Business Analyst with strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. You thrive in complex environments, enjoy solving business challenges, and can effectively bridge business and technology teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of Business Analysis experience, preferably within investment management, capital markets, pension funds, or financial services.

  • Experience delivering technology solutions and supporting projects across the full delivery lifecycle.

  • Strong requirements gathering, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Experience working within Agile, DevOps, or similar delivery frameworks, with strong knowledge of backlog refinement, sprint planning, and dependency management.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of capital markets products and the investment management industry, with deep expertise in OTC derivatives, fixed income, and private markets.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps and investment management platforms such as Aladdin, SimCorp, eFront, or Bloomberg.

  • Professional Business Analysis, Agile, or related certifications.

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching other analysts.

  • Proficiency in leveraging emerging AI tools to improve productivity, automate routine tasks, accelerate analysis, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation within business and technology environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Build trusted partnerships across investments, operations, and technology.

  • Deliver high-quality analysis and requirements that support business outcomes.

  • Lead and contribute to technology initiatives that create value for investment teams.

AIMCo is one of Canada's largest and most diversified institutional investment managers, managing more than $200 billion on behalf of Alberta-based pension plans, endowment funds, and government clients. We are guided by our core values of excellence, transparency, humility, integrity, and collaboration and are committed to delivering long-term value for Albertans.

We are excited to meet you. Please submit your resume or CV to be considered for this opportunity. Applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis and we will be in touch with any questions.

description:
Position: Land Surveyor

Company Overview:

At McSteen, we are more than just a land surveying company. We are stewards of the very ground where we build our lives and the community around us. Our purpose is clear: Securing the Land where we Live, Work, and Play. Through unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction and innovative solutions, we safeguard real estate, ensuring that every inch is accounted for with precision and care.

Job Description:

Are you a licensed surveyor with a passion for precision, problem-solving, and community impact? McSteen is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented Licensed Surveyor to join our growing team. This role offers the opportunity to apply technical expertise and utilize innovative technology to contribute to projects that shape our communities. If you’re a dedicated surveyor looking to take your career to the next level with a company that values autonomy, growth, and teamwork, we’d love to meet you! Full time role (potential for part time).

  • Review and analyze mortgage surveys to ensure compliance with legal and industry standards.

  • Identify potential errors or inconsistencies in survey data and recommend corrective actions.
  • Communicate with field crews, drafters, and other stakeholders to clarify survey information and resolve discrepancies.
  • Prepare final reports summarizing survey findings and conclusions.
  • Provide technical assistance and guidance to drafters and other departmental staff.
  • Stay up-to-date with changes in industry and legal standards related to land surveying and mortgage review.

  • Strong understanding of land surveying principles, boundary law, and construction layout.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Join Us in Securing the Future:

At McSteen, we believe the land where we live, work, and play deserves nothing less than the highest standard of care. If you share our passion for precision and want to make a tangible impact in your community, apply today and join a team that values your expertise and commitment.

title: Senior CX Consultant
description:
Sr Customer Experience Consultant- Ground Freight & Cold Chain

We are Maersk, a global leader in integrated logistics. We connect and simplify our customers’ supply chains through collaboration, operational excellence, and a commitment to delivering dependable customer experiences.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Customer Experience Consultant, you will serve as the primary connection between a key customer and our operational teams supporting Ground Freight and Cold Chain transportation solutions. You will oversee shipment activity from booking through final delivery, provide proactive communication, manage operational exceptions, and help ensure customer requirements are understood and executed.
This is a full-time position based onsite five days per week in Charlotte, North Carolina. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys customer interaction, transportation operations, problem-solving, and working across teams in a fast-paced environment. Previous experience in Cold Chain or Ground Freight is helpful but not required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, strong attention to detail, a collaborative mindset, and a willingness to learn.

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to support growing Ground Freight and Cold Chain operations.
  • Exposure to transportation partners, stations, brokers, dispatch teams, service providers, and customer stakeholders.
  • Training and development to strengthen your knowledge of transportation operations and temperature-controlled logistics.
  • A collaborative work environment where accountability, curiosity, teamwork, and operational excellence are valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the customer and operational teams, responding to inquiries by email and phone.
  • Monitor shipments throughout the transportation lifecycle and maintain visibility from booking through final delivery.
  • Provide proactive shipment updates and communicate clearly regarding delays, risks, exceptions, and resolution plans.
  • Coordinate with operations, brokerage teams, dispatchers, carriers, cold storage facilities, reefer providers, stations, and specialized transportation partners.
  • Ensure shipment execution aligns with customer standard operating procedures, operational requirements, and applicable Cold Chain quality and safety standards.
  • Investigate operational disruptions, identify root causes, escalate critical service failures, and coordinate timely resolutions.
  • Identify performance trends and process gaps, participate in customer and operational reviews, and recommend improvements that strengthen service delivery.

Who We Are Looking For

We welcome candidates with varied logistics, transportation, operations, and customer service backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a collaborative team.
  • Two or more years of experience in logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, supply chain, customer experience, shipping, warehousing, or operations.
  • Experience working with trucking, dispatch, refrigerated cargo, Ground Freight, or temperature-controlled supply chains is preferred but not required.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Clear and professional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving, root cause analysis, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple shipments, customer requests, and operational priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, reporting tools, or transportation management systems.
