title: Floormanager Jack's Casino
description:
Als Floormanager bij Jack’s Casino Roosendaal ben jij het aanspreekpunt op de vloer voor zowel gasten als collega’s. Je ondersteunt het team tijdens de dienst, houdt het overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat onze gasten kunnen rekenen op een gastvrije en plezierige ervaring. In ons casino is altijd iets te doen: je schakelt tussen contact met gasten, operationele werkzaamheden en het begeleiden van collega’s.

Geen dienst is hetzelfde en juist die afwisseling maakt jouw werk zo leuk. Dus heb jij ervaring als bijvoorbeeld teamleider, dan is dit misschien wel iets voor jou!

DIT GA JE DOEN

Als Floormanager ben jij zichtbaar aanwezig op de casinovloer en zorg je ervoor dat alles tijdens jouw dienst soepel verloopt. Je ondersteunt en begeleidt collega’s, bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze gastvrijheid en houdt overzicht in een omgeving waar altijd iets gebeurt. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen gastcontact, operationele werkzaamheden en het aansturen van het team. Juist die afwisseling maakt geen dienst hetzelfde.

  • Meewerkend: Je werkt actief mee op de vloer en geeft tegelijkertijd richting aan het team tijdens de dienst

  • Aansturen: Je begeleidt collega's tijdens de dienst, geeft ondersteuning waar nodig en zorgt voor een goede samenwerking.

  • Gastvrijheid: Je bent aanspreekpunt voor gasten en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen zich welkom voelt.

  • Overzicht: Je houdt de speelvloer in de gaten, signaleert bijzonderheden en schakelt snel wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt.

  • Coachen: Je motiveert collega's, deelt kennis en helpt hen zich verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid: Je ziet toe op het naleven van procedures en wet- en regelgeving.

DIT BIEDEN WIJ

  • €2.795 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur

  • Extra verdienen met toeslagen: 50% na 01:00 uur en 100% op feestdagen

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 25 vakantiedagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 km (€0,23/km, maximaal 60 km per dag)

  • 2 extra vakantiedagen wanneer je 1 jaar niet ziek bent

  • Parttime of fulltime werken: 28 tot 38 uur per week, uren in overleg

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Assistent casinomanager of Casinomanager

  • Trainingen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de JVH Academy

DIT BEN JIJ

Je bent een natuurlijke teamleider met een passie voor gastvrijheid. Je houdt van dynamiek, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet collega's te motiveren om iedere gast een geweldige ervaring te bieden. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Leiderschap: je neemt initiatief, weet collega's te coachen en houdt het overzicht tijdens drukke diensten.

  • Gastvrij en sociaal: je maakt makkelijk contact en zorgt ervoor dat gasten én collega's zich welkom voelen.

  • Ervaring: je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring als teamleider of andere leidinggevende rol binnen hospitality, horeca, leisure of retail.

  • Flexibel: je vindt het geen probleem om in de avonduren, nachten en weekenden te werken.

  • Vervoer: eigen vervoer en een rijbewijs B zijn gewenst. Vanwege onze openingstijden moet je zelfstandig van en naar het casino kunnen reizen.

  • Nederlandse taal: je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Betrouwbaar: een VOG-aanvraag maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

OVER JACK’S CASINO ROOSENDAAL DE STOK

Werken bij Jack’s Casino Roosendaal De Stok betekent werken op een unieke hospitality locatie waar entertainment, gastvrijheid en Brabantse gezelligheid samenkomen. De vestiging ligt naast het Otium Hotel en vlak bij Designer Outlet Roosendaal, waardoor je een mix van vaste gasten en bezoekers van buiten de regio ontvangt. Samen met je collega’s zorg je dagelijks voor een stijlvolle, energieke en gastvrije sfeer waarin gasten zich echt welkom voelen met een goede dosis Brabantse gezelligheid.

Daarnaast werk je in een moderne en warme omgeving waar teamgevoel, veiligheid en persoonlijke aandacht centraal staan. Door de ligging naast het hotel en het outletcentrum ontmoet je dagelijks een gevarieerde stroom aan gasten, wat zorgt voor afwisseling en een levendige werksfeer. De locatie biedt ruime parkeergelegenheid, een luxe uitstraling en een team dat bekend staat om zijn open, gezellige en professionele manier van werken.

ENTHOUSIAST GEWORDEN?

Solliciteer dan snel! Vragen over deze vacature? Mail, app of bel met onze recruiter Kevin via kvdsteen@jvh.nl en 0646448382

Wij werven en selecteren onze kandidaten zelf. Acquisitie door werving- en selectiebureaus of andere derden naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Head of Administration
description:
We are looking for a highly organized, hands-on Head of Administration to own the day-to-day running of our office and workplace operations, reporting to the CFO. This is a central, cross-functional role responsible for keeping the office running smoothly, safely, and efficiently — from facilities and vendors to budget, procurement, travel, and everything in between.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who is comfortable both managing at a strategic level and rolling up their sleeves to get things done. They take full ownership, partner effectively with HR, IT, Finance, Compliance and leadership, and treat the office as a service that makes everyone else's work easier.

Responsibilities

Office & Workplace Management

  • Own the end-to-end day-to-day operation of the office, ensuring it is clean, safe, functional, well-stocked, and a pleasant place to work.
  • Manage office services and infrastructure: reception, cleaning, maintenance, kitchen and amenities, meeting rooms, and building systems.
  • Oversee space and occupancy planning as the team grows, including seating, moves, and office maintenance and improvement projects.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for anything office-related — the person everyone turns to when something needs to happen or be fixed.

Budget Management

  • Own and manage the administration/operations budget end-to-end: annual planning, expense approval and tracking, and variance monitoring against forecast.
  • Provide clear, regular reporting to Finance and management with no surprises.
  • Continuously identify cost-improvement opportunities through smart procurement — without compromising service or employee experience.

Vendor & Procurement Management

  • Manage the full vendor lifecycle: sourcing, tenders, negotiation, contracts, and ongoing supplier performance against SLAs.
  • Maintain strong, fair relationships with suppliers while holding them to agreed standards; keep backup options for critical services.
  • Manage service providers across cleaning, maintenance, security, catering, office supplies, and more.

Travel Management

  • Own the company's business travel operations: booking flights, accommodation and transportation, and managing travel vendors and policies.
  • Ensure travel runs smoothly, cost-effectively, and in line with company policy; support employees with travel needs and issues.
  • Track and reconcile travel expenses in coordination with Finance.

Cross-Functional Partnership (HR, IT, Finance & Compliance)

  • Partner closely with HR on employee experience, onboarding/offboarding logistics, events, and workplace initiatives.
  • Partner closely with IT on office equipment, access, and the physical side of technology needs.
  • Partner closely with Finance on budget planning and tracking, procurement, purchase orders and invoices, and travel-expense reconciliation.
  • Partner closely with Compliance and security on audits, policies, access control, and meeting regulatory and physical-security requirements.
  • Coordinate with leadership to keep the workplace aligned, compliant, and running well.

Events, Logistics & Safety

  • Plan and run company events, meetings, off-sites, and team-building activities, end-to-end.
  • Oversee workplace health, safety and physical security, ensuring the office meets relevant requirements.
  • Manage day-to-day logistics and ad-hoc operational needs as they arise.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in office management, administration, operations, or facilities — ideally in a fast-paced, growing company.
  • Hands-on, can-do attitude — comfortable both owning processes and personally stepping in to solve problems; not a behind-the-desk role.
  • Strong budget-management skills: planning, tracking, and cost control.
  • Experience managing vendors, contracts and negotiations.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills; able to prioritize and stay calm under pressure.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; a natural cross-functional partner.
  • Service-oriented mindset with high attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace; familiarity with an ERP (e.g., NetSuite) and management tools — an advantage.
  • Fluent Hebrew and very good English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a fintech, tech, or global/multi-site company.
  • Experience scaling an office through growth.
  • Background in procurement, health & safety, or compliance support.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first few months, the Head of Administration will have taken full ownership of the office and vendor ecosystem, stabilized day-to-day operations so that things "just work," and become the reliable, go-to partner that lets the rest of the company focus on their work — all while keeping the budget under control and the workplace a great place to be.

Synchrony’s Treasury Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative group focused on delivering technology solutions that support critical financial operations at scale. As part of this team, you will help design, build, and modernize platforms that enable secure, reliable, and efficient treasury capabilities across the enterprise.

Treasury Engineering supports complex financial processes that may appear simple to customers and business users, but operate behind the scenes with significant scale, precision, and resilience. From managing high-volume payment flows to enabling accurate funding, reconciliation, liquidity, and settlement processes, our systems help ensure transactions move smoothly and reliably around the clock.

The team leverages modern engineering practices, automation, cloud-native technologies, data-driven insights, and resilient architecture to manage the continuous flow of financial information across millions of accounts and transactions. Our work is essential to maintaining operational excellence, improving efficiency, and supporting Synchrony’s broader financial ecosystem.

We foster a collaborative environment where engineers are encouraged to solve complex problems, innovate, and grow their careers. If you are passionate about building scalable financial technology, driving automation, and shaping the future of treasury platforms, Synchrony’s Treasury Engineering Team is the place to be.

Role Summary/Purpose:

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Engineer / Tech Lead who can both build and guide the delivery of production-grade agentic AI and cloud-native applications. This role is focused on treating AI agents and intelligent services as enterprise software systems—engineered with strong architecture, reliability, security, scalability, and operational readiness—not as isolated prompt experiments.

This person will own the engineering quality bar for 1–2 delivery teams, driving excellence across cloud engineering practices, distributed system design, Java and Python development, Spring Boot services, Kafka-based event architectures, testing, evaluations, CI/CD, observability, and on-call readiness. They are expected to write code approximately 60% of the time while leading design reviews, mentoring engineers, establishing patterns, and ensuring delivery teams build solutions that are resilient, maintainable, and production-ready.

The ideal candidate brings strong design thinking skills—able to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions, balance user needs with engineering constraints, and guide teams through iterative discovery, prototyping, validation, and delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and delivery of production-grade agentic AI and cloud-native applications, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.

  • Own the engineering quality bar for 1–2 teams by setting standards for architecture, code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, runbooks, and on-call readiness.

  • Write hands-on production code using Java, Spring Boot, Python, Kafka, APIs, and cloud-native design patterns, while mentoring engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing.

  • Apply design thinking to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, guiding discovery, prototyping, validation, and iterative delivery.

  • Integrate with enterprise platform capabilities such as model gateways, tool/service registries, memory stores, guardrails, identity services, evaluation frameworks, and operational controls while aligning with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

Required Skills/Knowledge:

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience building cloud-native, production-grade applications using Java, Spring Boot, Python, REST APIs, microservices, Kafka, and event-driven architecture.

  • Minimum 8+ years of understanding of distributed systems, scalability, resiliency, security, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, logging, metrics, tracing, and on-call readiness.

  • Experience engineering agentic AI applications with tool integration, memory, guardrails, evaluations, identity, governance, and production operational controls.

  • Strong technical leadership and design thinking skills, with the ability to guide architecture, mentor engineers, collaborate across teams, and translate business needs into scalable solutions. Knowledge of U.S. payment processing with ACH / Wires is a plus.

​Desired Skills/Knowledge:

  • Proven experience as a Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, or Senior Engineering Leader guiding teams in building enterprise-scale, cloud-native and AI-enabled applications.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Python, Kafka, microservices, APIs, and distributed system design patterns.

  • Experience with agentic AI platforms and patterns, including model gateways, tool registries, memory, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and operational controls.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive engineering excellence through CI/CD, automated testing, observability, resiliency, security, and production support practices.

  • Strong communication, mentoring, and design thinking skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, collaborate across product/platform/security teams, and align delivery with enterprise standards.

title: Product Manager - Digital Brokerage Experience
description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

As a Product Manager on our Wealth Products & Solutions team, you will help build and evolve Empower’s new native digital brokerage experience, creating an engaging investing destination that helps customers understand their investments, monitor their progress, and take action with confidence.

You will help shape experiences across the brokerage journey, from how customers understand their portfolio, positions, performance, balances, and activity to how they discover investment opportunities, trade, and engage with their investments over time. Your focus will be on turning complex brokerage information and capabilities into experiences that are intuitive, useful, and compelling for investors.

Importantly, Empower’s brokerage experience will serve customers across both our personal wealth and workplace retirement businesses. You will help evolve our native brokerage capabilities for retail investors while also supporting experiences such as Self-Directed Brokerage Accounts (SDBAs) offered through employer-sponsored retirement plans. You will consider how the needs, expectations, and journeys of these customers differ, and where a common brokerage platform and experience can better serve both.

You will join an ambitious product team building the next generation of investing experiences at Empower. You will bring strong customer focus, analytical thinking, product judgment, and a collaborative approach to working with design, engineering, research, business, operations, and other partners.

What You Will Do

  • Help build and continuously improve Empower’s native digital brokerage experience, with a focus on creating intuitive and engaging experiences that customers return to as they manage their investments.

  • Own and support customer journeys and features across key brokerage experiences, including understanding and reviewing positions and account details, searching for and researching securities, placing trades and tracking orders.

  • Identify opportunities to increase brokerage adoption, engagement, and ongoing customer value, using customer behavior and feedback to understand where we can make the investing experience more useful.

  • Help evolve Empower’s brokerage capabilities to support multiple customer contexts, including direct-to-consumer brokerage and Self-Directed Brokerage Accounts within employer-sponsored retirement plans.

  • Partner closely with design to simplify complex financial information and create clear information architecture, navigation, interaction patterns, and visual presentation across brokerage experiences.

  • Use customer research, usability testing, behavioral data, experimentation, competitive research, and market insights to identify customer needs, friction points, and opportunities.

  • Translate customer, business, and technical needs into clear product requirements and priorities in partnership with engineering, design, research, operations, and other teams.

  • Contribute to product strategy and roadmap development by identifying opportunities and helping prioritize investments based on customer value, business impact, data, and feasibility.

  • Partner across Empower to connect brokerage experiences with customers' broader financial lives, including retirement, investing, financial planning, and other Empower experiences.

  • Define and track measures of success across adoption, engagement, usability, customer satisfaction, and digital behavior, using results to inform ongoing product optimization.

  • Use quantitative and qualitative insights, experimentation, and agile validation methods to test hypotheses and inform product decisions.

  • Navigate initiatives through the full product lifecycle, including discovery, requirements, prioritization, development, compliance and legal review, launch, measurement, and post-launch optimization.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years of product management or directly relevant digital product experience working with engineering, design, research, and other cross-functional teams.

  • Experience building or supporting consumer-facing digital products, preferably within financial services, fintech, investing, retirement, or another complex digital product environment.

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn complex financial information, capabilities, and customer needs into experiences that feel simple and intuitive.

  • A strong interest in customer engagement and behavior, with experience identifying opportunities to improve adoption, usage, retention, or other measures of customer value.

  • Experience defining product requirements and partnering closely with design on customer journeys, interaction design, information architecture, navigation, and information presentation.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using quantitative and qualitative data to identify insights, prioritize opportunities, and evaluate product performance.

  • Strong prioritization and stakeholder-management skills, including experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams.

  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and organizational skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive product initiatives, collaborate effectively, and deliver results in a cross-functional environment.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience building digital brokerage, investing, trading, or portfolio experiences for consumers.

  • Track record of developing experiences across brokerage journeys such as account opening and funding, portfolio views, positions and holdings, performance, trading, transaction activity, or investment discovery.

  • Experience designing products that drive digital engagement, helping customers better understand their financial position and identify relevant actions they can take.

  • Experience with Self-Directed Brokerage Accounts (SDBAs) or other brokerage capabilities offered through employer-sponsored retirement plans.

  • Understanding of the differences between retail brokerage customers and retirement plan participants, including how brokerage experiences may need to adapt to different customer contexts.

  • Experience working with brokerage infrastructure, clearing or custody providers, including Pershing.

  • Experience connecting investing experiences with a broader financial ecosystem, such as retirement, financial planning, advice, banking, or wealth management.

  • Familiarity with Stock Plan Services or equity compensation experiences and how workplace equity can connect customers to broader brokerage and investing relationships.

  • Experience operating within regulated financial services and partnering with legal, compliance, risk, or operations teams.

  • Experience taking products through the full lifecycle from discovery and validation through launch, measurement, and optimization.

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans

  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

description:

Who we are

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. Toyota’s Data and Analytics Department is looking for a passionate and highly-motivated Associate SAP Data Analyst.

The primary responsibility of this role is to support data preparation, analysis, and reporting across SAP and cloud-based analytics platforms. The person in this role will help build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and insights that enable business decision-making.

Reporting to the Data and Analytics Manager, the person in this role will support the department’s objective to deliver trusted, timely, and actionable data solutions.

What you’ll be doing

  • Perform data validation, cleansing, and basic analysis to ensure data quality and consistency

  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to understand reporting requirements and translate them into analytics outputs

  • Ability to validate, cleanse, and analyze structured data with attention to detail and accuracy

Added bonus if you have

  • Experience working in SAP data structures, SAP Datasphere, and/or AWS data platforms

title: Associate R&D Technician
location: United States of America, North Carolina, Raleigh
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron is seeking a highly motivated Associate R&D Technician to support the operation, maintenance, and expansion of the Distributed Intelligence Laboratory (DI-Lab). This role bridges the gap between an electrician, electronics technician, and laboratory test engineer.

The successful candidate will work hands-on with electrical distribution system models, meter installations, power electronics, laboratory infrastructure, data acquisition systems, and prototype test equipment. The position requires comfort working around low-voltage and medium-voltage electrical systems, mains-powered equipment, and energized laboratory environments while adhering to strict electrical safety practices.

This role is ideal for an individual who enjoys building, troubleshooting, wiring, fabricating, and maintaining complex systems while supporting engineers developing next-generation utility and distributed intelligence technologies.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Laboratory Operations & Maintenance

  • Support day-to-day operations of the Distributed Intelligence Laboratory and associated workshop facilities.
  • Assemble, install, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory infrastructure, electrical panels, transformers, metering equipment, and power distribution systems.
  • Perform electrical wiring, cable routing, termination, and panel construction according to applicable electrical codes and laboratory standards.
  • Assist with laboratory expansions, equipment upgrades, and facility improvements.
  • Conduct routine inspections, preventative maintenance, and safety checks.

Electrical & Power Systems Support

  • Work with single-phase and three-phase AC power systems.
  • Install and maintain mains-powered equipment, electrical loads, breakers, relays, transformers, and power monitoring devices.
  • Support testing involving utility distribution system simulations and metering equipment.
  • Diagnose electrical faults using multimeters, oscilloscopes, power analyzers, clamp meters, and related instrumentation.
  • Assist with lockout/tagout (LOTO) and electrical safety procedures.

Electronics & Instrumentation

  • Build and modify electronic assemblies, prototypes, and test fixtures.
  • Perform bench-level troubleshooting of analog and digital circuits.
  • Support integration of sensors, embedded systems, communications equipment, and data acquisition hardware.
  • Maintain documentation, wiring diagrams, test procedures, and equipment inventories.

Research & Development Support

  • Assist engineers with experimental setup, testing, and data collection activities.
  • Support customer demonstrations and proof-of-concept evaluations.
  • Fabricate and modify prototype equipment used for distributed intelligence application development.
  • Help maintain laboratory automation systems, instrumentation networks, and test platforms.

Inventory & Asset Management

  • Maintain laboratory inventory, consumables, and spare parts.
  • Track equipment calibration, repair status, and maintenance schedules.
  • Support receiving, inspection, staging, and deployment of laboratory equipment and materials.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Associate degree in Electrical Technology, Electronics Technology, Industrial Maintenance, Mechatronics, or related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in electrical, electronics, industrial maintenance, laboratory, or technician roles.
  • Experience working with AC mains power systems and electrical equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, equipment manuals, and mechanical drawings.
  • Experience using electrical test equipment, including digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, clamp meters, power analyzers, and signal generators.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work safely in an electrically energized environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and technical documentation.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Licensed electrician, apprentice electrician, or equivalent industrial electrical experience.
  • Experience with medium-voltage equipment, switchgear, transformers, or utility infrastructure.
  • Experience in an engineering laboratory or research environment.
  • Familiarity with the National Electrical Code (NEC), lockout/tagout procedures, arc-flash safety, and PPE requirements.
  • Experience with industrial controls, relays, PLCs, or automation systems.
  • Knowledge of networking, Ethernet wiring, or industrial communications.
  • Basic Linux and Windows system administration skills.
  • Experience soldering, cable fabrication, and electronics assembly.
  • Experience supporting utility, power systems, metering, renewable energy, EV charging, or DER technologies.

Travel:

  • Less than 10%

Physical Demands:

  • Ability to stand, walk, and work in laboratory environments for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift and move equipment up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, climb ladders, and work around equipment racks and electrical cabinets.
  • Ability to perform fine motor tasks such as wiring, assembly, soldering, and instrumentation setup.
  • Ability to distinguish wire colors and visually inspect electrical equipment.

Safety Requirements:

The Associate R&D Technician will routinely work around energized equipment and must:

  • Follow all laboratory safety procedures and electrical work practices.
  • Utilize appropriate PPE when required.
  • Adhere to lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Maintain awareness of electrical hazards and arc-flash boundaries.
  • Safely operate electrical and mechanical tools and equipment.
  • Participate in routine safety training and audits.

Benefits Info:

This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more!

#LI-JH1

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!

The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.

Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.


Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world:

title: Expert Architect
description:
One of the best-known names in cruising, Princess is the world’s leading international premium cruise line and tour company, carrying millions of guests each year to hundreds of destinations around the globe. We give our guests the Medallion Class experience others simply can’t. The Love Boat promises something for everyone.

The Principal Enterprise Architect, Infrastructure Virtualized Solutions serves as the organization’s highest-level technical authority and a globally recognized external thought leader in enterprise virtualization, hybrid infrastructure, resilient computing, storage, workload mobility, disaster recovery, and infrastructure automation.

The role defines and governs the global infrastructure architecture strategy supporting complex shoreside and fleet operations. It establishes the long-term architecture vision, enterprise principles, reference models, technology standards, and investment direction for platforms that enable mission-critical operational, guest-facing, and corporate services.

Operating with enterprise-wide authority and substantial independence, the role proactively identifies and solves the organization’s most complex and unprecedented infrastructure challenges. It develops innovative solutions from first principles when established practices, technologies, or precedents are insufficient. Decisions made by the role materially influence business continuity, cybersecurity posture, global scalability, capital investment, technology risk, operational performance, and the strategic direction of the business.

The role leads the organization’s largest, most strategically significant, and technically complex multidisciplinary infrastructure transformation initiatives. These initiatives span fleet and shoreside environments, data centers, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, application ecosystems, engineering, and business operations.

The role participates directly in the development of business and technology strategy and advises executive leadership on emerging technologies, strategic risk, enterprise investment, operational resilience, and the infrastructure capabilities required to support long-term growth and innovation.

Through external professional leadership, strategic technology partnerships, and engagement with major vendors and industry bodies, the role influences industry practices and technology roadmaps. It originates major architectural innovations expected to advance the infrastructure architecture profession and establish the organization as a leader in secure, resilient, and globally distributed technology environments.

Here’s a summary of what Princess is looking for in a Principal Enterprise Architect. Is this you?

Responsibilities:

Enterprise Architecture Strategy, Authority, and Governance

  • Define and govern the global infrastructure architecture strategy across virtualized compute, storage, networking, private and public cloud, workload mobility, disaster recovery, automation, and platform engineering.

  • Establish the long-term architecture vision, enterprise principles, reference models, technology standards, decision frameworks, and investment roadmaps supporting global shoreside and fleet operations.

  • Exercise final enterprise architectural authority for the organization’s most complex, highest-risk, and most strategically significant infrastructure solutions and transformation initiatives.

  • Lead enterprise architecture review boards, resolve architectural conflicts across functions and platforms, and approve exceptions to enterprise standards based on business value, strategic risk, and long-term architectural integrity.

  • Establish architecture health metrics and executive-level reporting that identify enterprise risk, technical debt, modernization opportunities, and strategic investment requirements.

Business, Technology, and Investment Strategy

  • Participate directly in the formulation of enterprise business and technology strategy, translating long-range business objectives into global infrastructure capabilities, architecture roadmaps, and investment priorities.

  • Advise executive leadership on how emerging technologies and infrastructure capabilities can enable business growth, fleet expansion, guest experience innovation, operational resilience, and enterprise risk reduction.

  • Identify and sponsor opportunities where infrastructure innovation can create new business capabilities or materially improve the organization’s global operating model.

  • Shape and materially influence enterprise infrastructure investment strategy, including major capital expenditures, operating expenditures, sourcing decisions, and long-range financial plans.

  • Evaluate the business, financial, operational, cybersecurity, regulatory, and technology implications of major infrastructure investments and present executive-level recommendations.

Global Thought Leadership and Industry Innovation

  • Serve as a globally recognized authority and external thought leader in enterprise virtualization, hybrid infrastructure, resilient computing, cloud architecture, infrastructure automation, and related technologies.

  • Originate innovative architectural approaches, reference models, and technology strategies that materially advance enterprise capabilities and address challenges for which accepted industry practices or existing solutions are insufficient.

  • Develop solutions from first principles for the organization’s most complex and unprecedented infrastructure and business challenges.

  • Represent the organization in strategic vendor councils, industry bodies, professional forums, and executive technology communities.

  • Influence industry practices and the strategic roadmaps of major technology providers based on the organization’s complex global business, fleet, and operating requirements.

Global Infrastructure Transformation and Technical Leadership

  • Lead the organization’s largest, most strategically significant, and technically complex multidisciplinary infrastructure transformation initiatives.

  • Direct programs spanning global shoreside and fleet operations, data centers, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, application ecosystems, network services, engineering, and business operations.

  • Establish architecture direction, decision rights, risk parameters, success measures, and technical priorities for global infrastructure transformation programs.

  • Maintain enterprise accountability for architectural outcomes that materially affect global business continuity, operational resilience, cybersecurity posture, guest-facing services, technology risk, and long-term investment.

  • Provide enterprise-wide technical leadership, establish direction for senior architects and engineers, and align executive stakeholders, technology leaders, vendors, and external partners around a unified architecture strategy.

  • Anticipate emerging business and technology requirements and initiate transformation strategies before existing platforms or practices constrain organizational performance, innovation, or growth.

Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, and Resilience Architecture

  • Define and govern the global architecture for enterprise virtualization, compute, server, storage, converged and hyper-converged platforms, hybrid cloud, multi-cloud, and globally distributed infrastructure environments.

  • Establish enterprise standards for workload placement, cloud adoption, connectivity, portability, platform lifecycle management, performance, capacity, high availability, disaster recovery, and workload mobility across shoreside and fleet environments.

  • Determine strategic platform direction based on business criticality, performance, scalability, reliability, cybersecurity, regulatory requirements, resilience, lifecycle considerations, and total cost.

  • Define the architectural control framework required to meet Zero Trust, identity, network segmentation, secure virtualization, platform-hardening, audit, data-protection, and business-continuity obligations.

  • Exercise architectural authority over infrastructure-related security and resilience decisions with material enterprise impact and ensure the continuity and recovery of mission-critical guest-facing, operational, and corporate services.

  • Anticipate emerging cyber, regulatory, operational, and technology risks and determine the required enterprise architecture response.

Automation, Strategic Partnerships, and Organizational Influence

  • Establish the enterprise automation, infrastructure-as-code, self-service, configuration-management, orchestration, and platform-engineering strategy.

  • Define architectural standards for Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, GitOps, policy-driven automation, and related technologies.

  • Originate reusable enterprise platforms and architecture patterns that reduce operational complexity, improve reliability, strengthen security, accelerate delivery, and support global shoreside and fleet environments.

  • Direct the technical evaluation of strategic vendors, platforms, partnerships, and sourcing decisions, balancing business value, architectural integrity, operational resilience, financial impact, and long-term technology risk.

  • Influence vendor product strategies and technology roadmaps and establish the technical requirements governing strategic enterprise technology partnerships.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership, mentor senior technical professionals, and develop enterprise architecture capability across multiple infrastructure disciplines.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Scope: The Principal Enterprise Architect, Infrastructure Virtualized Solutions has global, enterprise-wide accountability for defining and governing the strategic architecture of virtualized compute, storage, private and public cloud, resilient fleet infrastructure, workload mobility, disaster recovery, and infrastructure automation. The role’s authority extends across Princess shoreside and fleet operations and interconnected enterprise technology environments where architectural decisions have significant implications for global operations, business continuity, cybersecurity, guest experience, capital investment, operational performance, and enterprise risk. The role operates across multiple technology and business disciplines and has few comparable technical peers within the organization. It establishes architecture principles, standards, and decision frameworks that govern the work of engineering, operations, cybersecurity, cloud, application, data, and delivery teams. The role shapes strategic technology partnerships and influences the long-range product and service roadmaps of key infrastructure vendors. Solutions and standards established by the role affect the organization’s most critical services and form the technology foundation for future business growth, fleet expansion, modernization, and new digital capabilities.

  • Problem Solving: The role solves the organization’s most complex, ambiguous, and unprecedented infrastructure and business problems, including challenges for which accepted industry practices, established technologies, or internal precedents do not provide an adequate solution. The role develops original architectural approaches from first principles by integrating emerging technologies, business strategy, cybersecurity requirements, operational constraints, financial considerations, regulatory obligations, and long-range enterprise risk. The role anticipates systemic challenges before they materialize and determines the architectural response necessary to protect or advance the business. Problems addressed typically span multiple disciplines, business functions, geographies, fleet environments, technology ecosystems, and strategic vendors. Recommendations and decisions may establish new enterprise standards, materially alter infrastructure investment priorities, influence strategic vendor roadmaps, and advance accepted practices within the infrastructure architecture profession.

  • Impact: The role has direct and significant impact on the management and strategic direction of the business. Its decisions establish the architecture foundation for global operations, business continuity, enterprise cybersecurity, technology investment, operational resilience, guest-facing services, and future growth. The role shapes enterprise infrastructure investment priorities and materially influences major capital and operating expenditure decisions. Architectural decisions may affect the organization’s global operating model, enterprise risk exposure, ability to introduce new business capabilities, and long-term competitiveness. The role leads the largest and most strategically significant infrastructure initiatives, with outcomes affecting complex global business operations. Innovations originated by the role are expected to create material enterprise value and influence the advancement of infrastructure practices beyond the organization.

  • Leadership: The role provides enterprise-wide technical leadership and serves as the final architectural authority for the organization’s most complex, highest-risk, and most strategically significant infrastructure decisions. The role leads the largest global infrastructure programs and aligns senior technology leaders, engineering teams, cybersecurity professionals, application leaders, business executives, strategic vendors, and external partners around a unified architecture direction. The role advises executive leadership on business strategy, enterprise risk, technology investment, operational resilience, and emerging technologies. It influences decisions at the highest levels of the organization through recognized expertise, business judgment, external credibility, and strategic impact. The role establishes technical direction for senior architects and engineering leaders and develops enterprise capability by mentoring recognized experts across multiple infrastructure disciplines. It represents the organization externally as a thought leader and influences industry practices, professional standards, and strategic technology roadmaps.

For all roles:

  • Skills: Strong time management and organizational skills

  • Abilities: Ability to maintain reliable and consistent attendance / Capacity to be punctual and meet deadlines / Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and work as part of a team / Demonstrated professionalism in all interactions and tasks..

Essential/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline preferred.

  • Advanced professional architecture, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or technology leadership certifications preferred.

  • Experience

  • Demonstrated record of originating and implementing major infrastructure innovations with impact beyond a single team, platform, business unit, or technology domain.

title: Dual Rate Slot Supervisor / Dual Rate S
description:
Great teams make the #Best8Hours of your day. At Seneca Resorts & Casinos, we work hard, celebrate often, and build a culture people actually want to be part of.

The Slot Supervisor (Primary position) is responsible for supervision of the Slot Attendants on an assigned shift and responsible for ensuring that the Slot Attendants are providing consistent high levels of customer service, is called upon to fill the Slot Shift Manager (Secondary position) when needed. The Slot Shift Manager oversees all slot operations on the casino floor during assigned shift. All duties are to be performed within the guidelines of the Seneca Gaming Corporation’s policies and procedures, Internal Control Standards and objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Responsible to work in conjunction with the Slot Shift Manager in the supervision of personnel and efficient operation of the facilities during an assigned shift. Monitor employee personnel activities and take appropriate actions in support of efficient operations.
2. Observe activities in the Slot machine department areas watching for irregularities. Ensure Slot Machines are functioning properly and the machines are being played legitimately.
3. Assign personnel to areas of the casino, schedules and monitors breaks in order to provide proper coverage and efficient service to Slot customers.
4. Assist in monitoring the payouts on the machines, to ensure that proper amounts are being paid to customers.
5. Act as signatory on jackpots as outlined by Internal Control Manual.
6. Must know and enforce all policies and procedures regarding the security of monies, parts, equipment and required documentation.
7. Utilize effective communication tools to ensure that consistent, accurate and timely information is provided through all shifts.
8. Ensure professional behavior and appearance is in compliance with established standards, rules, and regulations of the Slot Department and the Seneca Gaming Corporation.
9. Maintain a current understanding of all policy and guidelines regarding information security including the Seneca Gaming Corporation Acceptable Use Policy. Understand and comply with all information security policies and procedures at all times.
10. Provide exceptional customer service to all patrons and communicate in a pleasant, friendly and professional manner at all times. Maintain a professional work environment with supervisors, managers and staff.
11. Meet the attendance guidelines of the job and adhere to regulatory, departmental and company policies.
12. Must complete all required SGC Training programs within nine (9) months from commencement of employment.
13. Attend all necessary meetings.
14. Duties, responsibilities, requirements and expectations pertaining to this job are subject to change as needed. Hours are determined by a 24-hour schedule.

ADDITIONAL SECONDARY POSITION DUTIES:
1. Responsible for observing and analyzing the integrity of play and tracking guests and employee activity. Assume responsibility and accountability for the overall function and performance of assigned shift.
2. Supervise shift of Slot Supervisors and Slot Attendants.
3. Manage the operation of the Slot department during assigned shift.
4. Assist in the formulation, development and implementation of goals and objectives for the department.
5. Train all new employees to the assigned shift to ensure that these employees receive the proper knowledge to perform their duties at an acceptable level.
6. Implement departmental and company procedures, including all policies and procedures regarding the security of monies, parts, equipment and required documentation.
7. Ensure proper staffing levels in order to provide adequate floor coverage and a high level of customer and machine service with minimum labor hours.
8. Delegate assignments to ensure that all functions of the shift are carried out in a timely and efficient manner. Track assigned tasks to ensure their proper completion.
9. Ensure all slot operations staff are familiar with, and accurately completing all necessary shift paperwork in order to ensure accuracy and thoroughness of all departmental records and reports. Investigate any discrepancies found.
10. Perform payroll duties including submitting timecards/sheets in a timely manner, and maintaining accurate and up-to-date attendance records and personnel files for each of the employees on an assigned shift.
11. Maintain a working knowledge of all Seneca Gaming Corporation facilities including, but not limited to, special promotions and events in order to provide pertinent information to employees as well as customers.
12. Evaluate shift employees to ensure the maintenance of an acceptable performance level.
13. Assist with recruitment, hiring, training, recognition, coaching and discipline, terminations and other personnel related issues.
14. Communicate regularly with employees and keep them informed of all casino activities and events.
15. Settle customer disputes that cannot be readily resolved by subordinates.

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:
Education/Experience:
1. Must be 18 years of age or older upon employment.
2. High School Diploma or equivalent is required.
3. Bachelor’s Degree or two (2) years of casino experience and at least one (1) year of supervisory experience.
4. Minimum two (2) years gaming/casino experience (can be concurrent with leadership experience)
5. Game performance experience desirable
6. Knowledge of casino rules, regulations and procedures.
7. Basic computer skills required

Language Skills and Reasoning Ability:
1. Must possess excellent communication skills.
2. Ability to write routine correspondence and to speak effectively to the public, employees and customers.
3. Must have the ability to deal effectively and interact well with the customers and employees.
4. Must have the ability to resolve problems/conflicts in a diplomatic and tactful manner.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. When on the casino floor, the noise levels increase to loud. Must be able to work in an environment where smoking is permitted.
1. Must be able to stand, walk, and move through all areas of the casino.
2. Must be able to use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls.
3. Maintain physical stamina and proper mental attitude to work under pressure in a fast-paced, casino environment and effectively deal with customers, management, employees, and members of the business community in all situations.

description:
You desire impactful work.

You’re RGA ready

RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. A Fortune 200 Company and listed among its World’s Most Admired Companies, we’re the only global reinsurance company to focus primarily on life- and health-related solutions. Join our multinational team of intelligent, motivated, and collaborative people, and help us make financial protection accessible to all.

RGA Enterprise Services Company (RGA) seeks an Actuary, Americas Risk Management to develop mortality and morbidity research for RGA’s Americas region by providing critical actuarial expertise into population mortality and morbidity trends and insurance implications for key stakeholders, including management, pricing teams, valuation teams, risk teams, and clients. This position will: provide guidance and recommendations on future population and insured mortality and morbidity views; lead mortality and morbidity research across Americas business units through management of appropriate committees and working groups; coordinate collaboration on mortality and morbidity insights across Americas business units through regular communications; monitor population mortality and morbidity trends, review new studies, and educate stakeholders on insights; develop mortality improvement assumption and post-pandemic excess claims guidance for Americas business units; serve as an expert through internal presentations, client meetings, industry meetings, and external thought leadership; lead projects on current and emerging topics of interest to RGA or clients, including mortality and morbidity research, industry studies, third party data insights, statistical analysis, and data analytics; foster and energize positive collaboration with key stakeholders, such as pricing, business development, underwriting, global data analytics, global risk, and external clients, etc.; and participate in special projects, committees, meetings and client presentations as required. The position reports to RGA headquarters in Chesterfield, MO. A qualified applicant must reside within commuting distance of the Chesterfield, MO office, as occasional on-site work is required. Telecommuting is permitted for approximately 60% of the work week. RGA’s compensation package includes an annual bonus plan. RGA also maintains a full range of health, retirement, and other employee benefits. The compensation range noted below indicates that the base pay varies depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. For this particular position, the offered salary is $156,374.00 to $175,000.00 and is non-negotiable.

Basic Qualifications:

The position of Actuary, Americas Risk Management requires a bachelor’s degree, or its foreign equivalent, in Math, Finance, Actuarial Sciences, Statistics, or a related field. Employer will accept any suitable combination of education, training, or experience. The position also requires seven (7) years of actuarial experience in life insurance and/or reinsurance. A qualified applicant’s experience must include the following skills:

1. Experience leading mortality and morbidity research using statistical analysis and data analytics, including, but not limited to, population trend analysis;

2. Experience managing cross-functional teams and liaising with individuals across a variety of operational, functional, and technical disciplines to ensure projects are driven to conclusion;

3. Experience developing and validating complex actuarial and statistical models and interpreting and deriving valuable insights from large datasets using advanced statistical techniques;

4. Experience presenting and/or communicating complex actuarial and statistical analyses to technical and non-technical internal and external stakeholders in a way that is meaningful and well received by the specific audience;

5. Experience independently learning and using data visualization, database, and actuarial software applications;

6. Experience analyzing and modeling life, health, and/or annuity insurance products, including conducting mortality and lapse experience studies; and

7. FSA Accreditation.

  • Enjoy a respectful, welcoming environment that fosters individuality and encourages pioneering thought.

  • Join the bright and creative minds of RGA, and experience vast, endless career potential.

•In-depth competence with SAS and R statistical software

title: International Trainee - Strategic Advisor Ringhals AB
description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Shape the future of energy.

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.

What you will experience

  • Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.
  • Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”

Your role as a Trainee - Strategic Advisor

You will join the Strategy and Development team, where we work with corporate strategy, sustainability, risk management, organisational development and continuous improvement across Ringhals. As a Trainee Strategic Advisor, you will contribute to analyses, decision support and development initiatives that help shape the long-term direction of the business. You will collaborate closely with experienced specialists, managers and senior stakeholders across Ringhals and the wider Vattenfall organisation. During your first year, you will gain insight into strategic planning, business development and executive decision-making while developing a broad understanding of the energy sector. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with experienced leaders and experts, gain first-hand insight into how strategic priorities are developed, and contribute to shaping the future direction of one of Sweden's most important energy assets.

Your responsibilities:

  • Support strategic analyses, reports and decision-making material for management and stakeholders
  • Contribute to business development and organisational improvement initiatives
  • Participate in workshops, meetings and cross-functional projects across Ringhals and Vattenfall
  • Gather, analyse and present information to support strategic priorities and long-term planning

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Strategic Advisor

  • Master's degree in Industrial Engineering and Management, Business Administration, Economics, Technology Management, or a related field
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure complex information
  • Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, both written and spoken
  • Interest in strategy, business development and organisational improvement

You should also recognize yourself

title: Project Director, Construction
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1900 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment.


When you join Design Group as a Project Director, Construction, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world’s leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Architecture + Engineering + Construction (AEC) Business and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.


What You’ll Do

As a Project Director, Construction, you'll be at the forefront of regional construction engagements, steering your team from initial client meetings to final closeouts for our clients within the Food, Beverage, Life Science, Home and Personal Care Markets. Your role is pivotal in ensuring that each project reflects our unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, budget adherence, timing precision, quality standards, and safety norms. By embodying the essence of Design Group's vision and values, you will be instrumental in leveraging the full potential of our team, fostering an environment ripe for growth and professional excellence. This role demands effective utilization of team capacity and a focus on team member development.

In this role, you will be supported by a team of industry and project delivery experts who have experience converting our clients’ capital spending initiatives into commercialized solutions. You will join our AEC team and partner with leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to develop design-build and EPC projects.


Strategic Leadership & Client Relations & Business Development

  • Project Visionary: Guide projects from conception to fruition, ensuring alignment with client and organizational objectives.
  • Risk and Contract Savvy: Lead in risk assessment, contract negotiations, and making critical fee and pricing decisions.
  • Client Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for market leaders, symbolizing the face of excellence in project performance.
  • Identify new opportunities and actively participate in the development of proposals that accurately and concisely define the scope of work, which achieves the clients’ objectives and support group decisions.

Project Management & Operational Excellence

  • Budget and Financial Oversight: Maintain a hawk-eye view on budget and financial aspects, ensuring fiscal responsibility throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Construction & Design-Build Champion: Take charge in Construction & Design/Build initiatives, with key responsibilities in estimating and proposal crafting.
  • Scope and Schedule Creator and Guardian: Ensure that estimate, design, schedule sequencing, and proposal stages meet client expectations in terms of budget, aesthetics, scope, and schedule.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Team Captain: Communicate project goals and requirements effectively, leading your team to success.
  • Mentor, Develop, and Train: Cultivate the talents of your team, guiding them towards achieving personal and professional milestones.
  • Willingness to lead by example in all team roles, fostering unity and collaboration of the project team. Ability to step into every role on the project as needed to maintain team effectiveness and morale.

Technical Proficiency & Quality Assurance & Safety focus

  • Construction Expertise: Oversee the entire spectrum of construction activities, from initial estimates to contractor bidding processes for industrial facilities & structures (Cold Storage Distribution Centers, Food & Beverage Processing, Packaging, & Distributions Centers, Life Science and Advanced Technology Manufacturing Facilities, Industrial Tilt Wall Distribution Centers, ASRS Robotics Distribution Centers, Data Centers, Clean Room/Dry Room Construction, MEP Driven Projects, etc.).
  • Quality and Compliance: Ensure that every aspect of the project aligns with company standards, industry norms, and regulatory requirements.
  • Implement and enforce comprehensive safety programs and monitor jobsite safety.

What You’ll Bring


Experience & Industry Knowledge

  • Seasoned Expert: Bring a wealth of 15+ years in diverse construction roles and 8+ years in construction management and leading teams.
  • Proven ability to lead complex industrial construction projects end-to-end
  • Construction & Design Build Acumen: Show your prowess in Construction and A&E design build projects, with a keen eye for industrial structures. Food, beverage, consumer goods, or life science sector experience preferred.
  • Excellent leadership and team development skills.
  • Proven track record of managing industrial projects valued between $50K and $50M.
  • Familiarity with process systems and proficiency in reading P&IDs.
  • Safety-focused. Experience implementing comprehensive safety programs and monitoring jobsite safety programs.
  • Technologically savvy. Should be adept and quick to learn project management software, scheduling programs, building information systems, etc.
  • Travel as needed for client meetings, AHJ meetings, internal meetings, site visits to review project progress and status.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, MS Project, Timberline, AutoCAD, or Revit.
  • Strong grasp of prime contract requirements including creation of estimates, schedules, scopes, budgets.
  • OSHA 10- or 30-hour certification.
  • Construction project management certification (preferred).
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or a related technical field (preferred).
  • Contractor Qualifier License(s) or a willingness to obtain licensure in numerous states

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path. As a Project Director, Construction, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class engineer and a highly effective leader.

Feel like you're on the path to becoming a Project Director, Construction but you're not quite there yet? We'd love to connect with you to see if we can take you from where you are today and grow you into one.



At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process. ​

Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify.


Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments.

title: CIC: Programs Research Assistant - Federal Work-Study (Student Wage) Hybrid Position
description:
**Federal work-study students only**

In Partnership with Student Financial Services Community Investment Collaborative (CIC) is recruiting for a student undergraduate intern to fill the position of Programs Research Assistant. This position will be located at 300 Preston Ave #206, Charlottesville, VA 22902. This will be a hybrid position. Any students expressing interest in the position must be receiving federal work study funding.

Organization Description:

The Community Investment Collaborative (CIC) is a nonprofit organization that specializes in micro-enterprise development and offers micro-financing and business training to small and micro-enterprises in Charlottesville and the surrounding counties. CIC's mission is to strengthen the community and contribute to economic development by fueling the success of under-resourced entrepreneurs through education, financing, mentoring, and networking. CIC leverages community resources to provide capital and education to entrepreneurs who have difficulty accessing funding from traditional sources and who seek an educational support system that is relevant to their business needs. CIC accomplishes this by providing loans and advisory support to existing and aspiring entrepreneurs in the form of business training, one-on-one mentoring, and networking events. By supporting small business growth and expansion, CIC helps to create jobs and strengthen the local economy and community.

Overview of Opportunity:

CIC is looking for a student to join its team for a project-based internship as a Programs Research Assistant. In this particular position, the intern will contribute directly to the Programs Department by helping build a research and recruitment pipeline behind the Culpeper Orange Entrepreneur Workshop (COW) while also supporting the Entrepreneurial Impact Manager who serves those communities. Working at CIC is a unique opportunity for students to be fully involved in a local and diverse organization. The intern will gain hands-on experience through data collection and organization; researching existing business resources, entrepreneur networks, institutions, community demographics, and more; connecting with

entrepreneurs and community partners; assisting with program

recruitment; and organizing business leads. They can be assured of

having a meaningful impact on the growth and development of a local community organization that supports small businesses.

Professional Development:

The Programs Research Assistant will experience the organic process of entrepreneurship notonly through their assigned project and research, but also through the stories and daily realities of CIC clients as they launch and grow their businesses. CIC maintains intimate relationships with its entrepreneur clients in order to ensure full support. Therefore, it will similarly have strong connections with the struggles and triumphs of business

Students will learn the art of community outreach while also gaining a

foundational understanding of business through hands-on work and

research. Additionally, students will have the opportunity to explore other

areas of CIC and broaden their understanding of how nonprofits and CDFIs work and support communities.

Qualifications:

  • Interest in small business and entrepreneurship
  • Interest in helping individuals from low-income backgrounds
  • Interest in learning more about community outreach
  • Strong research and data collection skills
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Comfortable reaching out to entrepreneurs and partners via phone and email
  • Strong technology skills (G Suite in particular)
  • Curiosity/interest in learning
  • Interest in working with others and in teams

Schedule: The Programs Research Assistant will collaborate with the COW Entrepreneurial Impact Manager on a schedule that fulfills a 10hrs/week commitment. We request that the student work in the office at least 1 day per week.

All candidates interested in applying for this position should submit a Resume and Cover Letter in Workday. Student must be receiving federal work study funding for further consideration from the hiring manger. The Research Assistant will work a maximum of ten hours per week.

Compensation is set at $15.00 per hour.

This position begins September 21, 2026 (or later) and ends May 14, 2027.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Resume and cover letter required.

Education: Current undergrad UVA student. Federal work-study elibility required.
Experience: None
Licensure: None

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This is primarily a sedentary job involving extensive use of desktop computers. The job does occasionally require traveling some distance to attend meetings, and programs.
