title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
Nightwing provides technically advanced full-spectrum cyber, data operations, systems integration and intelligence mission support services to meet our customers’ most demanding challenges. Our capabilities include cyber space operations, cyber defense and resiliency, vulnerability research, ubiquitous technical surveillance, data intelligence, lifecycle mission enablement, and software modernization. Nightwing brings disruptive technologies, agility, and competitive offerings to customers in the intelligence community, defense, civil, and commercial markets.

Senior Software Developer - Software Defined Networking

At Nightwing, we are seeking an exceptional Senior Software Developer who embodies technical excellence and craftsmanship in Software Defined Networking. We need someone who doesn't just write code, they architect elegant, performant solutions that stand the test of time. If you can spot the slop in poorly designed systems and have an innate drive to build SDN solutions that "just work forever," this role is for you.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Developer specializing in Software Defined Networking, you will be responsible for designing and implementing mission-critical SDN infrastructure that demands reliability, performance, and maintainability. You will work with open-source SDN controllers, create infrastructure-as-code solutions, and establish engineering standards that elevate our entire development practice. This is not a role for those who chase trends; We want an industry leader who understands the nuances of network protocols, distributed systems, and the subtle art of writing code that remains stable and maintainable for years.

This onsite role is based at our National Business Park, Maryland location supporting the Neptune program.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop Software Defined Networking solutions using open-source controllers with deep attention to architectural integrity and long-term maintainability
  • Implement Layer 2/3 network protocols, routing algorithms, and network management interfaces (e.g., YANG) with precision and performance optimization
  • Create infrastructure-as-code solutions using Terraform, Ansible, and modern CI/CD pipelines that are reproducible and resilient
  • Develop and integrate SDN applications with containerized architectures using Kubernetes, ensuring seamless orchestration across hybrid cloud environments
  • Lead code reviews with a critical eye for quality, identifying architectural weaknesses, performance bottlenecks, and maintainability issues before they reach production
  • Collaborate with network engineers and security teams to implement DevSecOps practices that don't compromise on either velocity or security
  • Mentor junior developers on software craftsmanship, network protocol implementation, and the principles of building systems that endure
  • Work with physical network processors and network debugging tools to troubleshoot and optimize at both application and packet levels

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related STEM field
  • 8+ years of software development experience with demonstrable expertise in building production-grade network systems
  • Deep proficiency in multiple programming languages including Python, Java, and C/C++ with the ability to choose the right tool for each problem
  • Expert-level understanding of network protocols: TCP/IP stack, Layer 2/3 protocols, DHCP/DHCPv6, RIP, ARP, with hands-on implementation experience
  • Strong background in NETCONF/YANG, REST APIs, and network management interfaces
  • Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable, performant code that other engineers respect and want to emulate
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Proficiency with CI/CD workflows using GitLab, Jenkins, or similar platforms
  • Active TS/SCI clearance with polygraph
  • U.S. citizenship required

What Sets This Role Apart:

This is not a position for engineers who prioritize speed over quality or follow the latest framework fad without understanding the fundamentals. We're looking for someone who:

  • Understands the nuances: You know why certain design decisions matter five years down the line, not just today
  • Spots the slop: You can review code and immediately identify technical debt, performance issues, and maintainability problems
  • Builds to last: Your solutions are elegant, well-documented, and require minimal maintenance because they were designed correctly from the start
  • Leads by example: Other developers look at your code and learn what excellence looks like

Security Clearance Required: TS/SCI with polygraph (active)

Salary & Benefits

The salary associated with this position ($122,000-$253,000) is commensurate with the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, and demonstrated level of expertise. Compensation will be determined based on these factors to ensure alignment with skills, responsibilities, and market standards.

Nightwing offers medical, vision and dental insurance coverage in addition to a 401k plan, PTO, Holidays, and additional insurances.

A bachelor's degree in a relevant academic discipline, such as Geography & Geospatial Science, Digital Engineering; Data Science / Engineering; Environmental Science.

We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.

In addition, you'll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.

The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.

Different people, shared values

Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you're pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas - this drives our excellence.

Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion - we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.

title: Project Director, Construction
description:
About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.


Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.


Job Description:

Who You’ll Work With

You will join one of our 45 offices in the US, be part of a committed team of over 1500 professionals, and work in teams and directly with our clients doing work that is shaping the world around us. You will be welcomed into a rapidly growing business and team and empowered to make an impact. You will be valued, cared for, and challenged on your path to becoming a world-class professional consultant and surrounded by leaders who are committed to creating an environment that enables you to realize your own success and fulfillment.

When you join Design Group as a Project Director, Construction, you are joining a team that will challenge you and position you for growth. In this role, you will work with a team of industry experts to help the world’s leading companies solve their most difficult problems. You will join our Architecture + Engineering + Construction (AEC) Business and partner with seasoned leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to deliver the highest quality solutions to our clients with consistency and accuracy.

What You’ll Do

As a Project Director, Construction, you'll be at the forefront of regional construction engagements, steering your team from initial client meetings to final closeouts for our clients within the Food, Beverage, Life Science, Home and Personal Care Markets. Your role is pivotal in ensuring that each project reflects our unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, budget adherence, timing precision, quality standards, and safety norms. By embodying the essence of Design Group's vision and values, you will be instrumental in leveraging the full potential of our team, fostering an environment ripe for growth and professional excellence. This role demands effective utilization of team capacity and a focus on team member development.

In this role, you will be supported by a team of industry and project delivery experts who have experience converting our clients’ capital spending initiatives into commercialized solutions. You will join our AEC team and partner with leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to develop design-build and EPC projects.

Strategic Leadership & Client Relations & Business Development

  • Project Visionary: Guide projects from conception to fruition, ensuring alignment with client and organizational objectives.
  • Risk and Contract Savvy: Lead in risk assessment, contract negotiations, and making critical fee and pricing decisions.
  • Client Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for market leaders, symbolizing the face of excellence in project performance.
  • Identify new opportunities and actively participate in the development of proposals that accurately and concisely define the scope of work, which achieves the clients’ objectives and support group decisions.

Project Management & Operational Excellence

  • Budget and Financial Oversight: Maintain a hawk-eye view on budget and financial aspects, ensuring fiscal responsibility throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Construction & Design-Build Champion: Take charge in Construction & Design/Build initiatives, with key responsibilities in estimating and proposal crafting.
  • Scope and Schedule Creator and Guardian: Ensure that estimate, design, schedule sequencing, and proposal stages meet client expectations in terms of budget, aesthetics, scope, and schedule.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Team Captain: Communicate project goals and requirements effectively, leading your team to success.
  • Mentor, Develop, and Train: Cultivate the talents of your team, guiding them towards achieving personal and professional milestones.
  • Willingness to lead by example in all team roles, fostering unity and collaboration of the project team. Ability to step into every role on the project as needed to maintain team effectiveness and morale.

Technical Proficiency & Quality Assurance & Safety focus

  • Construction Expertise: Oversee the entire spectrum of construction activities, from initial estimates to contractor bidding processes for industrial facilities & structures (Cold Storage Distribution Centers, Food & Beverage Processing, Packaging, & Distributions Centers, Life Science and Advanced Technology Manufacturing Facilities, Industrial Tilt Wall Distribution Centers, ASRS Robotics Distribution Centers, Data Centers, Clean Room/Dry Room Construction, MEP Driven Projects, etc.).
  • Quality and Compliance: Ensure that every aspect of the project aligns with company standards, industry norms, and regulatory requirements.
  • Implement and enforce comprehensive safety programs and monitor jobsite safety.

What You’ll Bring

Experience & Industry Knowledge

  • Seasoned Expert: Bring a wealth of 15+ years in diverse construction roles and 8+ years in construction management and leading teams.
  • Proven ability to lead complex industrial construction projects end-to-end
  • Construction & Design Build Acumen: Show your prowess in Construction and A&E design build projects, with a keen eye for industrial structures. Food, beverage, consumer goods, or life science sector experience preferred.
  • Excellent leadership and team development skills.
  • Proven track record of managing industrial projects valued between $50K and $50M.
  • Familiarity with process systems and proficiency in reading P&IDs.
  • Safety-focused. Experience implementing comprehensive safety programs and monitoring jobsite safety programs.
  • Technologically savvy. Should be adept and quick to learn project management software, scheduling programs, building information systems, etc.
  • Travel as needed for client meetings, AHJ meetings, internal meetings, site visits to review project progress and status.

Technical Skills

  • Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, MS Project, Timberline, AutoCAD, or Revit.
  • Strong grasp of prime contract requirements including creation of estimates, schedules, scopes, budgets.
  • OSHA 10- or 30-hour certification.
  • Construction project management certification (preferred).
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or a related technical field (preferred).
  • Contractor Qualifier License(s) or a willingness to obtain licensure in numerous states

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path. As a Project Director, Construction, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class engineer and a highly effective leader.

Feel like you're on the path to becoming a Project Director, Construction but you're not quite there yet? We'd love to connect with you to see if we can take you from where you are today and grow you into one.

title: Outside Auto Appraiser
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Claim

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$63,800.00 - $105,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

title: Cable Splicer - Underground (Oncor)
description:
Position Summary

The Cable Splicer is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical underground systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized systems and may be required travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized underground new work systems with safety first.

  • Lead crew members in the absence of the Employee in Charge and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefing.

  • Train and mentor apprentices and groundmen.

  • Install and repair underground power, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of tagging procedures, grounding and induced voltage on energized and de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment and understanding of underground services, infrastructure and duct banks.

  • Work in confined spaces, and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Will operate a backhoe, bucket trucks and digger trucks, mini excavator.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Perform live‑line work using approved gloving and hot‑stick techniques of energized lines.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential.

Minimum Requirements

  • Three (3) years of recent underground experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willingness to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

The FinOps Practice Lead will build and lead Clorox's enterprise FinOps capability, driving financial governance, cost optimisation, and value realisation across Cloud, AI, SaaS, and other consumption-based technologies. Working closely with Technology, Finance, Procurement, and business leaders, you'll establish the frameworks, processes, and governance needed to improve cost transparency, forecasting accuracy, and investment decision-making.

In this role, you will:

Be in a highly visible leadership role for someone who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping the organisation maximise the value of its technology investments while shaping the future of FinOps and AI financial management across the enterprise.

The purpose of the FinOps Practice Lead role is to establish and lead Clorox's enterprise-wide FinOps capability, ensuring the company maximises the value of its investments in Cloud, AI, SaaS, and other consumption-based technologies.

The role provides the governance, financial transparency, and cost optimisation needed to help technology teams make informed investment decisions, improve forecasting accuracy, and align technology spending with business outcomes.

By partnering across Technology, Finance, Procurement, Enterprise Architecture, and the business, the FinOps Practice Lead will drive financial accountability, optimise technology consumption, and create a sustainable framework that enables innovation while controlling cost, managing risk, and delivering measurable business value.

As Clorox continues to increase its investment in Cloud, AI, SaaS, and other consumption-based technologies, managing these costs effectively has become critical to ensuring sustainable business value. The FinOps Practice Lead plays a key role in helping the organisation balance innovation with financial discipline.

This position provides the leadership, governance, and visibility needed to understand where technology spend is occurring, why it's occurring, and whether it is delivering the expected business outcomes. By establishing clear accountability, improving forecasting accuracy, and identifying optimisation opportunities, the role helps Clorox maximise the return on its technology investments while reducing unnecessary spend and risk.

Beyond cost management, the role is instrumental in enabling the responsible growth of emerging technologies such as AI and Generative AI. It ensures that technology decisions are aligned with enterprise priorities, that investments are scalable and sustainable, and that leaders have the insights needed to make informed decisions.

Ultimately, the FinOps Practice Lead helps transform technology spending from a cost centre discussion into a strategic value and business outcome conversation.

title: Global Mobility Tax Intern
description:
Company Description

Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to “Connect the world”. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.

Job Description

As a Global Mobility Intern, you will support multinational employers and their internationally mobile employees on Luxembourg personal tax, employment tax and social security matters. Working with clients and colleagues across our global network, you will contribute to compliance and advisory assignments involving international assignments, cross-border working arrangements and employee reward. Through real client work, coaching and feedback, you will build practical knowledge of mobility rules and develop skills in technical research, tax calculations, data analysis, drafting, client communication and cross-border teamwork. You will also gain exposure to tax and mobility technologies, preparing you for a career in global mobility, personal or employment tax, social security, payroll or broader people advisory services.

Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:

  • Support the preparation of advice on personal tax, employment tax, payroll, social security and reward matters arising from international assignments and cross-border working arrangements.

  • Assist with analyzing employment structures and their Luxembourg tax and social security implications, including relevant market practices and regulatory developments.

  • Assist with the preparation of Luxembourg individual income tax returns, tax equalization calculations and social security assessments for internationally mobile employees, and support related client queries.

  • Prepare Luxembourg individual income tax calculations and comparative tax estimates, taking account of the cross-border circumstances of internationally mobile employees.

  • Coordinate with Vialto colleagues in other jurisdictions to support the consistent application of international tax treaties and social security rules.

  • Contribute to technical research, client meetings and the preparation of clear presentations, calculations and written advice.

Qualifications

  • You will soon complete a Master’s degree in Law or Economics. Any specialization in Tax is an asset.

  • You have a strong interest in personal tax, employment tax, social security and international mobility, and you are keen to develop both compliance and advisory skills.

  • You enjoy working in teams and look for an open-minded and friendly environment.

title: Aquatics Facility Supervisor
description:
Parks & Recreation

Aquatics Facility Supervisor

General Description and Classification Standards:

Supervises staff, and maintains associated facility paperwork; supervises and coordinates the short- and long-term operation and maintenance of a municipal swimming pool and performs other related work as required for the assigned department. Enhances and increases program participation, awareness, and community involvement with the facility, Duties include, but are not limited to: supervising and training various aquatics pool staff including safety instructors, lifeguards and aquatic assistants; providing general lifeguard services (i.e. rescuing swimmers in distress, administering CPR and first aid); maintaining pool safety; maintaining sanitation of pool facilities; instructing swimming and life guarding classes; and performing other duties as required.

Normally receives guidance regarding group objectives, scheduling, unusual priorities, etc., but is free to set work methods and individual assignments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

These are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.

  • Prepares documents for evaluations, revenue and inspection reports, meetings, supplies, payroll, staff scheduling, etc.
  • Registers, collects fees, and maintains records for class, season pass, lap swim, weight room, water aerobics, and swim lesson participants.
  • Maintains order and cleanliness of the facility to comply with local government standards.
  • Attends all necessary meetings including routine facility staff, monthly ATL Stats, and yearly GRPA meetings.
  • Supervises employees regarding time cards, program staffing and participation, and disciplinary procedures as needed.

  • Provides customer-based needs and resolves customer issues.
  • Coordinates, oversees, and monitors program operations.
  • Enforces safety rules and regulations for the safety of the patrons and guest.
  • May perform other duties as assigned.

The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. COA may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities:

This is a partial listing of necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job successfully, it is not an exhaustive list.

  • General knowledge of pool equipment, chemicals, and emergency procedures.
  • Ability to work under stress while performing duties and responsibilities in a cooperative manner with staff, supervisor, and general public.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education and Experience - High School diploma or equivalent.

Licensures and Certifications - CPR; First Aid; Lifeguard Training (LGT); Valid Georgia Driver's license.

Preferred Requirements - Some college education or vocational training, plus five (5) years of related experience in aquatics and supervisory experience. Certified Pool Spa Operator (CPO); Water Safety Instructor (WSI); USA Swimming Coach (USASC); Lifeguard Training Instructor (LGI);

Work Environment:

Required physical, lifting, and sensory capabilities are requirements to perform the job successfully. Typical environmental conditions associated with job.

Lifting Requirements:

Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force to move objects.

title: Director, Actuarial & Analytics - Actuarial Product Cross Lines Initiatives
description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Actuarial, Data Analytics

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$132,800.00 - $219,100.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Director, Actuarial and Analytics is an analytic leadership role that is responsible for the implementation of a variety of actuarial/statistical techniques and analyses which may include reserving, rate making, pricing, planning/forecasting, project management and research. This role is expected to execute strategic and operational initiatives, drive change within assigned unit, provide analytical insights and recommendations to leadership and business partners, and share ownership of the business's financial results. The Director, Actuarial and Analytics will work within broad limits and authority on complex assignments requiring specialized knowledge and expertise in breadth and/or depth in one or more of the following areas: Actuarial and/or research methods Advanced statistical analyses Broad business knowledge In-depth Line of Business knowledge Broader awareness of enterprise Actuarial & Analytics community This role may act as a manager of a small team.

This role sits within the BI Actuarial Product Cross-Lines Initiatives team--the CLI team's responsibilities and projects extend across lines--a so-called "all lines" team. The team leads initiatives to modernize and transform data, tools & processes, exploring and leveraging modern technologies both within and outside the CLI. We need a technical actuarial leader with interest and expertise in tools, technology, and coding, ability to challenge status quo, and a passion for continuous improvement and efficiency. Additionally, strong actuarial acumen, project management, customer focus, and communication are valued, as responsibilities require partnership with a wide variety of business partners across Business Unit and Actuarial Product Actuarial, Technical teams, BI Finance and senior leaders. This role will lead a small team of direct reports and could lead matrixed reports of fluid talent to accomplish goals.

What Will You Do?

Strategy:

  • Assess, prioritize, influence and communicate strategic initiative options to senior leaders.

  • Demonstrate effective execution and completion of assigned strategic initiatives and projects.

  • Regularly generate process improvements and explore opportunities for innovation.

  • Lead assigned unit strategic initiatives (narrow scope, limited and well defined) and cross-unit initiatives on a limited basis and is expected to participate in Enterprise initiatives on a limited basis.

Operational:

  • Independently perform actuarial and analytic analyses to solve business problems and apply judgment appropriately.

  • Drive day to day execution within unit. Support broad department initiatives.

  • Promote efficiency across primary working group, balancing additional effort against incremental lift gained from work.

  • Begin to make decisions independently in accordance with department practices.

  • Provide direction and review others' analytical work.

  • Translate business requests into analytical solutions.

  • Provide support as necessary for initiatives across the Enterprise within the scope of influence.

Communication:

  • Communicates on a regular basis with staff, peers and business partners and on an occasional basis with senior leaders.

  • Tailors communication of analysis, project results, and other business initiatives to audience.

  • Communicates technical topics to non-technical audiences with limited guidance.

  • Leads group discussions with primary working group.

  • Creates formal written communication such as memos or presentations with limited guidance.

  • Able to influence and collaborate with peers and partners to take actions to enhance business outcomes.

Talent:

  • Staff responsibilities are likely to include direct management of a small team of individual contributors.

  • Acquisition, retention, and development of talent for assigned unit.

  • Execute and communicate talent development processes, including performance and personal development goals.

  • Succession planning and talent assessment recommendations.

  • Performance management.

  • Support staff engagement cross Enterprise initiatives.

  • Mentor less experienced talent across the Enterprise.

  • Onboard new employees and interns in unit.

  • Support various training and skill development initiatives across Segment and the Enterprise.

  • May provide support for recruiting efforts and candidate talent assessment efforts.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • College degree in STEM related field.

  • Associate Actuarial Credential.

  • 7+ years of quantitative analysis experience.

  • Strong understanding of insurance products and industry.

  • Demonstrated ability in actuarial and quantitative analysis and statistical concepts.

  • Management experience.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to present and translate complex information in relevant business terms.

  • Strong PC skills (MS Office) and programming skills (eg. SQL, SAS).

Leadership:

  • Begins to challenge conventional thinking.

  • Takes ownership of projects related to strategic initiatives and makes recommendations to influence business outcomes.

  • Proficient in Leading Self, exhibiting decisiveness and self-awareness while also effectively managing ambiguity.

  • Initial development of Leading Others, including modeling the way for others and effectively leading team projects.

  • Initial development of Leading the Business, including actively engaging in driving business results, broad thinking and promoting an Enterprise culture.

Business Acumen:

  • Has an in-depth understanding and knowledge of certain key business drivers and disciplines such as: underwriting, products, reinsurance, distribution, sales, operations, risk control, claim, and financials.

  • Able to effectively utilize this business knowledge in developing and implementing analytic solutions.

  • Has a general perspective of the industry and developing trends, including: technology, analytic methodology, products, and performance of competitors.

  • Is familiar with other key business drivers and disciplines.

Relationship Management:

  • Proactively build and own professional business relationships across the Enterprise.

  • Generate and solicit ideas, and build consensus.

  • Aware of potential conflict and address proactively.

  • Acknowledge accomplishments of others within your primary working group.

  • Set and manage expectations with business partners for large projects.

  • Understand diverse perspectives to effectively accomplish business goals.

Quantitative Analysis:

  • Able to introduce innovative techniques to existing problems.

  • Independently perform and implement complex analytics.

  • Leads and actively engages in technical/peer reviews.

  • May offer technical consultative feedback.

  • Can assess various technical solutions to optimize analytical outcomes.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.

  • 4 years of experience performing quantitative analysis.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

title: Sr Power Systems Engineer
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

We are looking for talented, energetic, and outgoing application engineers to work in a rapidly growing field where you will have the opportunity to deliver state-of-the-art Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS) to some of the most exciting electric utilities around the world. You will be involved in designing, building, configuring, testing, and delivering these systems all while working closely with other driven Engineers and with our customers. Specifically, you’ll be working on the Outage Management System (OMS) that spans the electric utility’s operational and information technology domains; you will be building systems that improve the efficiency of the utility’s grid operations and capture information and data in support of their business functions. These systems will expand the utility’s Smart Grid capabilities by providing detailed insight into the operations of the electrical grid. You will have the opportunity to shape the future of the electrical grid, which will reduce environmental impacts through the conservation of crucial resources. You will be reporting to the Outage Management System (OMS) Manager.

Your Impact

  • Develop and execute system build plans accounting for software architecture, information security, and hardware deployment.
  • Work closely with customers to understand their operational needs, provide system training and configuration to meet their needs.
  • Perform system and acceptance testing with customers.
  • Develop scripts and other middleware solutions to integrate into third-party systems.
  • Troubleshoot complex problems and collaborate with technical experts in various domains.
  • Lead workshops with customers.
  • Travel to customer sites and work directly with customers to successfully deliver, test, and integrate systems.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in applications engineering, software engineering, or computer engineering or related field.
  • 4+ years of application engineering work experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%.
  • Solid understanding of general computer operations including file systems, file navigation, system settings.
  • Familiarity with multiple operating systems (Windows, Linux, etc.).
  • Basic understanding of remote system access.
  • Comfortable working with configuration files and navigating servers.
  • Ability to collect and analyze data to identify software defects.
  • Ability to distinguish between configuration issues and development bugs and submit highly detailed defects to the development team.
  • Attention to detail: ability to accurately update and sync configuration across a large number of servers.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve technical issues without step-by-step guidance.
  • Ability to translate complex technical problems into clear, customer-friendly explanations.
  • Capable of identifying root causes and communicating solutions without overwhelming the customer and/or leadership with unnecessary technical detail.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into configuration.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server, MongoDB.
  • Understanding of, or experience with, an OMS or ADMS.

Work Authorization

AspenTech will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1(including those with OPT or CPT) , H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

title: Lokalvårdare deltid
description:
Om oss – Wernamo Bemanning & Allservice AB

Wernamo Bemanning & Allservice AB är ett företag där kvalitet, service och människor står i centrum. Vi arbetar med lokalvård och service hos både företag och privatpersoner i Värnamo med omnejd.

För oss är våra medarbetare en viktig del av företaget. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar, tydlig kommunikation och ett gott samarbete. Hos oss ska du kunna känna stolthet över arbetet du utför och veta att din insats gör skillnad – både för våra kunder och för dina kollegor.

Vi söker inte bara någon som kan städa. Vi söker en person som vill bli en del av vårt team, tar ansvar för sina kunder och tycker att god service och ett trevligt bemötande är lika viktigt som ett väl utfört arbete.

Arbetsdagarna är varierande och du får arbeta självständigt med stort eget ansvar. Samtidigt vill vi att det ska vara enkelt att fråga om hjälp och att vi tillsammans löser de situationer som kan uppstå under arbetsdagen.

Vi uppskattar medarbetare som ser vad som behöver göras, hjälper till när det behövs och vill utvecklas tillsammans med företaget.

Hos oss är du inte bara någon som fyller ett arbetspass – du representerar Wernamo Bemanning & Allservice AB ute hos våra kunder och är en viktig del av vårt företags ansikte utåt.

Är du noggrann, serviceinriktad och tycker om att skapa rena och trivsamma miljöer?



﻿Nu söker vi en engagerad och flexibel lokalvårdare till vårt team i Värnamo.

Hos Wernamo Bemanning & Allservice AB får du ett varierande arbete där kvalitet, ansvar och god service står i centrum. Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta självständigt, möta olika kunder och vill ha ett deltidsarbete på ca 34 %.

Om tjänsten

Arbetet består av lokalvård hos våra kunder i Värnamo med omnejd. Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med hemstädning, kontorsstädning och restaurangstädning.

Arbetstiderna varierar och tidiga morgnar förekommer. I tjänsten ingår även arbete varannan lördag. Eftersom vi behöver kunna hjälpa våra kunder även när ordinarie personal blir sjuk söker vi dig som har möjlighet att vara flexibel och ibland hoppa in med kort varsel.

Vem söker vi?

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet. För oss är det viktigt att våra kunder inte bara får ett väl utfört arbete utan också ett trevligt och professionellt bemötande.

Vi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarsfull och pålitlig, har ett öga för detaljer och kan arbeta både självständigt och effektivt. Du är serviceinriktad, tycker om kundkontakt och förstår vikten av att lämna ett gott intryck hos våra kunder.

B-körkort och tillgång till egen bil är ett absolut krav för tjänsten.

Tidigare erfarenhet av lokalvård är meriterande, men vi värdesätter framför allt rätt inställning, arbetsvilja, ansvarskänsla och god service.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du en stabil arbetsplats med varierande arbetsdagar och eget ansvar. Vi erbjuder marknadsmässig lön, OB-ersättning och milersättning.

Omfattning: ca 34 %

Arbetsort: Värnamo med omnejd

Arbetstider: Varierande, inklusive tidiga morgnar och varannan lördag

Krav: B-körkort och egen bil

📩 info@wernamo-bemanning.se

When you're at Apex, you drive this change. You're part of a global team with a clear vision: to be the trusted technology that powers the digital economy. Our offices in Austin, Dallas, Chicago, New York, Portland, Belfast, and Manila are home to over 1,000 employees.

Together, we’re shaping the future of financial innovation. Embrace change. Solve big. Win together. And be G.R.E.A.T. — grit, results, empathy, accountability, and teamwork — with Apex.

2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 - Presented by BuiltIn

WealthTech of the Year

2025 - Presented by US FinTech Awards

The World’s Top 250 Fintech Companies

2024 - Presented by CNBC

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Business Analyst (GSD) is role focused on developing strategic frameworks to optimize operational processes within the organization while ensuring that activities are aligned with compliance regulations. It involves active risk mitigation strategies to anticipate, manage, and minimize potential operational issues. Individuals in this role have a strong emphasis on strategy-driven problem-solving, project coordination, and ensuring that operational objectives are both efficient and regulatory-compliant.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyzing existing operations for efficiency improvements, identifying risks, and implementing measures to mitigate them effectively.
  • Collaborating with subject matter experts to create strategies that enhance workflows, increase productivity, and maintain compliance with regulatory standards.

title: Power Systems Engineer -Outage Management System
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. The Role

We are seeking talented, energetic, and customer‑focused application engineers to join a rapidly growing field where you will help deliver state‑of‑the‑art Advanced Distribution Management Systems (ADMS) to leading electric utilities worldwide. In this role, you will design, build, configure, test, and deliver systems while collaborating closely with fellow engineers and customers.

Your primary focus will be on the Outage Management System (OMS), which spans both operational and information technology domains within electric utilities. You will help build systems that enhance grid operations, improve efficiency, and support key business functions. These systems expand Smart Grid capabilities by providing deeper insight into grid performance and enabling more sustainable operations. This role reports to the Manager, Power Systems Engineering.

Your Impact

  • Develop and execute system build plans that account for software architecture, information security, and hardware deployment.
  • Work closely with customers to understand operational needs and provide training and configuration support.
  • Perform system and acceptance testing with customers.
  • Develop scripts and middleware solutions for third‑party integrations.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues and collaborate with technical experts across domains.
  • Lead customer workshops.
  • Travel to customer sites to deliver, test, and integrate systems.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in applications engineering, software engineering, computer engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of application engineering experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 20%.
  • Strong understanding of general computer operations, including file systems, navigation, and system settings.
  • Familiarity with multiple operating systems (Windows, Linux, etc.).
  • Basic understanding of remote system access.
  • Comfort working with configuration files and navigating servers.
  • Ability to collect and analyze data to identify software defects.
  • Ability to distinguish between configuration issues and development bugs and submit detailed defect reports.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistent configuration across multiple servers.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • Ability to translate complex technical problems into clear, customer‑friendly explanations.
  • Ability to identify root causes and communicate solutions without unnecessary technical detail.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into system configuration.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server and MongoDB preferred.
  • Understanding of, or experience with, OMS or ADMS preferred.

Work Authorization

AspenTech will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1(including those with OPT or CPT) , H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

description:

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. What Is the Opportunity?

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic team player to join our Strategic Resolution Group Claim team as a Technical Specialist handling complex toxic tort, latent injury, sexual misconduct and/or environmental claims that may present significant financial exposures. With general supervision, you will manage moderate to large exposure claims with complex liability and coverage issues, with the goal of developing strategies to ensure that claims are successfully resolved in the most efficient and effective way while meeting established protocols and delivering optimal customer service. As you meet the challenges of an ever-changing litigation landscape, you will maintain and develop a strong understanding of applicable law in multiple jurisdictions enhancing your ability to successfully manage complex coverage and liability issues.

What Will You Do?

  • File Maintenance and Administrative Compliance - Maintain well-documented and organized claim files. Maintain proficiency with SRG claim systems and databases. Adhere to applicable requirements for data accuracy. Efficiently manage file inventory.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. title: Commercial P&C Billing Specialist
description:
Experience GuideStone!

We are an innovative organization that invests in the spiritual, relational, financial, physical and professional development of our employees. We have a culture that values excellence, teamwork, humility, integrity, compassion and stewardship.

What We Offer You!

We offer employees a generous benefits package, flexible work schedules, the opportunity to be involved in community outreach and tuition reimbursement.

The Commercial Property and Casualty Agency Billing Specialist supports GuideStone Agency Services by performing general agency-specific accounting and bookkeeping tasks of increasing complexity with moderate supervision and some latitude for independent judgment. This role maintains accurate agency billing, invoice, remittance, and commission records; manages agency-billed account workflows; and works with GuideStone Finance and Accounting to reconcile commission payments, resolve discrepancies, and ensure money received or paid by the agency is documented accurately and handled timely. The role applies developing proficiency in agency accounting, Applied Epic, commission processing, and internal controls, while relying on more experienced peers for guidance on more complex work. We serve those that serve the Lord with the integrity of our hearts and the skillfulness of our hands. (Psalm 78:72)

What You'll Do:

Agency Billing and Remittance

• Manage routine and moderately complex agency-billed account activities, including premium collection, payment remittance requests, carrier payment documentation, and follow-up on stale or unresolved billing items

• Prepare, organize, and route remittance support materials to Finance and Accounting for payment processing according to documented procedures and assigned timelines

• Ensure customer funds, carrier payment requests, invoice records, and supporting documentation are matched, complete, and retained in the appropriate agency systems or repositories

• Review billing activity reports, resolve routine issues independently, and escalate more complex or exception-based items to the manager for direction

Commission Statement Processing and Reconciliation

• Receive, organize, validate, and process carrier commission statements, ensuring alignment with agency records, commission percentages, premium amounts, transaction types, and related Applied Epic activity records

• Research discrepancies between carrier statements, Applied Epic transactions, direct-bill or agency-bill commission records, and funds received by GuideStone, seeking guidance on complex reconciliation issues

• Partner with Finance and Accounting to reconcile commission payments received, identify missing or unmatched remittance detail, and document follow-up items through resolution

Invoice, Payment, and Vendor/Partner Coordination

• Review agency-related invoices and route accurate invoices or payment requests to the appropriate Finance and Accounting processing channel according to established procedures

• Monitor recurring agency invoices, reimbursements, carrier fees, and vendor charges to ensure expected items are received, reviewed, routed, and tracked

• Coordinate with agency team members, Finance and Accounting, carriers, brokers, and vendors to obtain documentation, clarify payment details, and resolve billing questions

Records, Controls, and Cross-Functional Support

• Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential records for agency billing, commission statements, invoices, remittance documentation, and reconciliation support materials, contributing to process improvement recommendations

• Partner with Sales, Account Management, Operations, Finance and Accounting, and agency leadership to support timely and accurate financial processing tied to agency operations, driving meaningful results that advance enterprise strategy

What You'll Need:

• 2+ years of experience in related bookkeeping, billing, accounting support, insurance agency, financial operations, or similar experience required.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree, college coursework, or certificate in accounting, bookkeeping, business, finance, or a related field preferred.

• CPA license is not required.

• Working understanding of bookkeeping concepts such as invoices, payments, receivables, payables, reconciliation, and record retention.

• Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel; working proficiency with Applied Epic, Workday-related workflows, SharePoint, and other GuideStone systems.

• Ability to compare documents and data, identify mismatches, and resolve routine discrepancies with some latitude for independent judgment.

• Ability to work within established procedures while applying developing judgment to routine and moderately complex situations.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage recurring tasks, deadlines, inboxes, documentation queues, and process checklists.

• Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills.

• Must have complete confidentiality regarding GuideStone business matters.

• Developing working knowledge of commercial property and casualty agency operations, including agency bill, direct-bill commissions, carrier statements, policy transactions, and supporting documentation.

• Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Monitor, track, and inspect new prototype equipment being deployed through Research and Development projects.
  • Prepare training and documentation related to the commissioning of new equipment.
  • Capable of assuming full responsibility and a leadership role when responding to emergency field problems in his/her field of expertise.

title: Technology Leadership Development Associate
description:
About the Leadership Development Program
The CSX Leadership Development Program is an 18-month professional development experience designed to provide associates with meaningful exposure to CSX operations, business functions, and leadership. Through a combination of structured learning, training opportunities, mentorship, field experiences, networking events, and collaborative development activities, associates gain a broad understanding of the railroad industry while building the skills needed to succeed in a dynamic business environment.
Throughout the program, associates will strengthen their leadership capabilities, expand their business acumen, and develop professional competencies that support long-term career growth. By the conclusion of the program, participants will be equipped with the knowledge, experience, and confidence to influence decisions, drive innovation, and contribute strategically to CSX's continued success.
Please Note: The CSX Leadership Development Program is expected to begin in June 2027. Early-start opportunities may be available for candidates who graduate prior to the official program start date.

Job Summary

Fortune 500 company seeking future business leaders to help foster growth, efficiency and innovation as a Technology Leadership Development Associate (LDA). Leadership Development Associates participate in a 18-month program aimed at developing the skills of future business leaders within the Technology organization. The Technology LDA creates innovative applications, processes, and tools that support business needs and enable business growth. LDAs serve as key members of product and software engineering teams to discover business opportunities which lead to the design, development, and sustainability of high quality software. The LDA will work in a full-time position in CSX Technology while also participating in a structured orientation and career development program to increase their knowledge of CSX and the railroad industry.

Primary Activities and Responsibilities:

Leadership Development Professionals will be placed with a technology team based on their skills, aspirations, and active company initiatives. An LDA may work with one or more teams including: Applications Development, Product Management, Industrial Engineering, Data Science & Analytics, Cybersecurity, Agile Delivery, Enterprise Engineering (including Mobility, DevOps, and Cloud), User Experience, IT Operations, Integrations/API, Project Management, Robotics/Drones, and Service Support.

Regardless of team placement, all technology LDAs play an important role in advancing and delivering Technology initiatives. The expectations of these compensated positions include but are not limited to:

  • Active contribution in a dynamic, agile team environment
  • Adherence to best practices for developing and maintaining secure systems
  • Root-cause analysis to iterate improvement and increase reliability and efficiency
  • Engagement across teams and stakeholders to ensure shared understanding and value delivery

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree/4-year Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering or a related major field of study from an accredited institution

Equivalent Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma/GED and IT specific certifications
  • 2 or more years of experience in Information Technology/Transportation/Intermodal Operations, Information Systems, or Industrial Engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

In addition to meeting the above qualifications, any of the following are preferred:

  • Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) concepts, tools, and emerging technologies, with the ability to apply them to enhance business processes and decision-making.
  • Knowledge of Supply Chain and Operations Management to ensure the efficient utilization of resources
  • Knowledge of cloud and low code (Microsoft Power Platform) technologies
  • Knowledge of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies for process optimization of workflow and system
  • Knowledge of risk and cost analysis to ensure resource optimization with risk-to-benefit valuation
  • Knowledge of web (Angular/Java) programming concepts and technologies
  • Knowledge of relational, document, and/or graph database concepts and functions
  • Knowledge of DevOps, cybersecurity, and integration practices and concepts
  • Knowledge of statistical, simulation, modeling, analytical and related programming languages (Python)
  • Knowledge of Quality Management methods and techniques

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Strong communication, collaboration, interpersonal and influence skills
  • Problem-solving, analysis, organizational, and time management skills
  • Agile team roles and methodologies
  • Fosters a culture of innovation
  • Pattern and dependency recognition supporting the development of sustainable and adaptable systems in various domains and contexts
  • Project Management skills to support the planning and execution of complex projects
  • Critical thinking skills including complex problem recognition, reflective thinking, and causal analysis

Job Requirements:

  • Communicate effectively and professionally with peers, leadership, stakeholder audiences
  • Work within established deadlines
  • Willing and able to work days and hours as assigned
  • Successfully complete a background check and drug test

Environmental Conditions:

  • Work inside an onsite office environment

title: Principal Product Engineer
description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

This opportunity is for a Product Engineer in the Digital and Signoff Group (DSG) at Cadence. The Cadence Digital and Signoff Group will offer you a dynamic environment in which you will work with innovative R&D and Customer Engagement teams to influence the development of software tools for advanced chip design platforms. As Product Engineer, you will be a source of technical place and route expertise to Cadence customers and to R&D.

You are a motivated and energetic engineer with a deep understanding of ASIC design methodologies and of every stage of the RTL to GDSII flow.
You have proven hands-on experience with timing closure and PPA optimization at 16nm and below nodes.
You combine your deep understanding with strong analysis skills to debug customer problems and propose solutions, with an organized and coherent approach.
You are an excellent communicator.

Position Responsibilities:
Support Cadence products in the Digital and Signoff team.
Track and debug customer issues and work with R&D and release team on issue resolution.
Run design benchmarks and develop flows and solutions.

Position Requirements:
MS in EE with 5+ years of experience in Digital Implementation, either as a design engineer or as a product engineer

Or BS in EE with 8+ years of experience in Digital Implementation, either as a design engineer or as a product engineer
Strong understanding of VLSI physical design and timing analysis; familiarity with digital implementation challenges including RTL synthesis, placement optimization, clock tree synthesis, routing optimization and silicon signoff.
Experience with industry standard EDA tools in Synthesis, Physical design and Signoff at 16nm and below nodes.
Exposure to, and solid understanding of, hierarchical design methodologies and low power design
Energetic team player with a passion for problem solving
Strong analysis skills with a track record to prove it
Strong communication skills (verbal and written)
Automation skills using Perl, Tcl and shell scripting

We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

title: Industrielektriker lærling til Nybro Gasbehandlingsanlæg
description:

Du bliver del af El-vedligehold, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger arbejder med drift og vedligehold af elektriske installationer og automatiserede systemer på Nybro Gasbehandlingsanlæg og tilknyttede faciliteter. Teamet har fokus på sikkerhed, kvalitet, dokumentation og læring i praksis. Din arbejdsplads er primært Nybro Gasbehandlingsanlæg og tilknyttede faciliteter. Der kan forekomme opgaver på andre lokationer ved behov. I vores team samarbejder vi tæt, deler viden og prioriterer sikkerhed, kvalitet og faglig udvikling i hverdagen.

I jobbet vil du:

  • assistere ved installation og vedligehold af elektriske installationer og anlæg
  • udføre kabeltræk, fejlfinding og test af automatiserede systemer
  • arbejde med PLC, instrumentering og DCS/SCADA under oplæring og supervision
  • deltage i driftsoptimering, sikkerhedskontrol og kvalitetsdokumentation
  • udarbejde dokumentation, arbejdsordrer samt sikkerheds- og kvalitetsrapporter.

For at få succes i denne rolle forventer vi, at du:

  • er i gang med eller har gennemført GF2 til industrielektriker eller elektriker
  • arbejder struktureret, har et godt håndelag og sans for detaljer
  • sætter sikkerhed og kvalitet højt og bevarer roen i et teknisk krævende miljø
  • behersker dansk i skrift og tale; engelsk på arbejdsniveau er en fordel
  • er teamorienteret, lærevillig og motiveret for et længerevarende lærlingeforløb
  • har interesse for olie- og gasbranchen, automation, PLC/instrumentering og ATEX.

Selvom din profil ikke matcher alle punkterne, har du måske andre kompetencer, der vil være relevante. Mener du, at du kan bidrage til teamet, så send os din ansøgning.

Form fremtiden med os
Send din ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesdokumentation til os så hurtigt som muligt.

Hvis du ønsker at anmode om justering af arbejdsmetoder eller arbejdsmønstre eller hjælp til rekrutteringsprocessen, så send en e-mail til accommodation@orsted.com.

Bemærk venligst, at din ansøgning kun bliver taget i betragtning, hvis den indsendes via vores online karriereside. Vi tager ikke ansøgninger eller forespørgsler fra eksterne rekrutteringsbureauer eller bureauer i betragtning til denne stilling.

Lønramme:
For denne stilling er det forventede grundlønsniveau henhold til industriens overenskomst for elektrikere for lokationen i jobannoncen. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af relevante kompetencer, erfaring og forventet opfyldelse af rollen inden for det angivne løninterval for at sikre et fair og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Lønniveauet vil derfor typisk ligge i den lavere del af det samlede interval for stillingen. Vi byder dog også ansøgninger fra alle kvalificerede kandidater velkommen, uanset erfaringsniveau. Hvor det er relevant, kan du desuden være berettiget til variabel løn og en omfattende fordelspakke.

Vores fordelspakke:
I denne stilling får medarbejdere, der opfylder berettigelseskravene, adgang til: arbejdsgiverbetalt pension (11 % indbetaling), fuld forsikringsdækning (ulykke, liv, kritisk sygdom og sundhedsforsikring); fem ugers betalt ferie plus 10 ekstra betalte fridage/feriefridage pr. ferieår; 3 % feriepengetillæg; adgang til Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality, herunder holdtræning, fysioterapi, massage og trivselstilbud; en multimediepakke (mobiltelefon, pc, og internet); medlemskab af personaleklub med sports- og kulturaktiviteter samt adgang til virksomhedens kantine (månedlig frokostordning eller dagsbilletter).

Denne stilling kræver et baggrundstjek som en del af ansættelsesprocessen, og jobtilbuddet er afhængigt af resultatet af dette tjek. Du vil modtage yderligere information i løbet af rekrutteringsforløbet. Baggrundstjekket udføres af en ekstern udbyder i overensstemmelse med lokal lovgivning.

description:

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. $139,400.00 - $230,000.00
